npc.a_bearded_woman.stdmod_1:
في عالم عادل، سأكون قائد سفينة كبيرة،...\z
	سيكون هؤلاء القراصنة هناك الآن أتباعي، وسوف نتحدى البحار ونصبح رعب المدن الساحلية! ... \ض
	لو أن خطتنا نجحت!
npc.a_bearded_woman.stdmod_2:
باع الكابتن كيد سفينته لشراء أشياء لا معنى لها مثل تلك الأقفال الباهظة الثمن لأبواب الزنازين. ... \ض
	وقال إن الزوارق ستفعل لفترة من الوقت. ... \ض
	كان لدي انطباع بأنه لم يكن حزينًا للغاية لترك السفينة لأنه كان معروفًا أنه يعاني كثيرًا من دوار البحر.
npc.a_bearded_woman.stdmod_3:
كنت سأصبح قائدًا أفضل بكثير من كيد. لقد لعبت دور العديد من القادة على المسرح وكنت جيدًا! ... \ض
	حيث كان كيد يشتاق إلى تقدير رجاله، كنت أحكم بالخوف وبقبضة من حديد!
npc.a_bearded_woman.stdmod_4:
لقد كانت فكرة الكابتن كيد. كما ترون، كان يكره اسمه ويخطط ليصبح معروفًا باسم الكابتن كيدناب. ... \ض
	كل ما يحتاجه هو شخص مشهور ليختطفه. ... \ض
	نظرًا لافتقار رجاله إلى الموهبة والذكاء، كان من الممكن أن يكون هذا إنجازًا كبيرًا. ... \ض
	كنا نعرف بعضنا البعض من خلال بعض عمليات الاحتيال التي قمنا بها معًا في الماضي، لذلك اتصل بي. ... \ض
	كان علي أن أقلد شخصية الأميرة الشهيرة لوميليا. كما تعلمون، الشخص الذي كان الجميع يبحث عنه. ... \ض
	وهذا من شأنه أن يُظهر لرجاله والقراصنة الآخرين كم كان خاطفًا عظيمًا. ... \ض
	لقد وعدني بأنني سأصبح الرجل الثاني في القيادة وأن أعيش حياة رائعة مليئة بالنهب والسرقة والسلب. ... \ض
	لذلك وافقت على انتحال شخصية الأميرة لفترة من الوقت وقد سار الأمر بشكل جيد في البداية. ... \ض
	لقد عاد معي مرتديًا زي الأميرة من غارة بمفرده وكان على الفور بطل اليوم بالنسبة لرجاله. ... \ض
	ساءت الأمور عندما قرروا إقامة حفل انتصار. ... \ض
	وبقدر ما استطعت أن أفهم من غمغمات القراصنة، فقد كيد مفتاح زنزانتي أثناء قضاء حاجته في النهر الجوفي. ... \ض
	وقرر الأحمق أن يغوص بعدها.. ولن يراه مرة أخرى. ... \ض
	عندما علمت بوفاة كيد، حاولت إقناع القراصنة بأنها خدعة، لكنهم لم يصدقوني!
npc.a_bearded_woman.stdmod_5:
آه الاختطاف هو الكثير من المرح. هذا إذا لم تكن في الطرف المتلقي. ... \ض
	إنه أموال سهلة ولديك فرصة لتخويف وتعذيب شخص لا يستطيع القتال!
npc.a_bearded_woman.stdmod_6:
كلما كان الناس أكثر غباء، كان من الأسهل خداعهم. ... \ض
	وكلما كانوا أكثر فقراً، قلت وسائل الانتقام لديهم. هار هار! ... \ض
	لذلك أتأكد من أنني أفسد أولئك الذين أخدعهم. ثم لديهم أشياء أخرى تقلقهم غير الانتقام مني.
npc.a_bearded_woman.stdmod_7:
لقد ضاع المفتاح في النهر الجوفي وربما جرفته المياه إلى البحار السبعة الآن! ... \ض
	لو لم يكن ذلك الطفل الغبي مهووساً بالاختطاف لما باع سفينته ليشتري أغلى وأعقد أقفال لزنزاناته!
npc.a_bearded_woman.stdmod_8:
وطالما أننا متمسكون بالمدن الساحلية غير المحمية، فيمكننا أن نحقق ثروة سهلة. هار هار! ... \ض
	بمجرد أن أخرج من هنا سأصبح أخيرًا قائد القراصنة بمفردي. لا أحتاج الكابتن كيد!
npc.a_bearded_woman.voice_1: أنا رجل! أخرجوني أيها الحمقى السكارى!
npc.a_bearded_woman.voice_3: أخرجني! لقد كان كل ذلك جزءاً من الخطة أيها الحمقى!
npc.a_bearded_woman.voice_4: إذا خرجت من هنا، سأقتلكم جميعاً! لكم جميعا!
npc.a_bearded_woman.voice_5: أنا لست الأميرة لوميليا أيها الحمقى!
npc.a_bearded_woman.voice_6: احصل على صانع أقفال وحررني وإلا ستندم على ذلك أيها القراصنة الأغبياء!
npc.a_beautiful_girl.greet_msg_1: لقد أتيت إذن، |PLAYERNAME|. كنت أتمنى أن لا...
npc.a_beggar.say_1: أعتقد ذلك. سيكون عليك التحدث مع الملك بالرغم من ذلك. الملك المتسول هو. الملك لا يمنح الحضور للجميع فقط. أنت تعرف كيف هم هؤلاء الملوك، أليس كذلك؟ ...
npc.a_beggar.say_2: ومع ذلك، للحصول على مقابلة مع الملك، سيكون عليك مساعدة رعاياه قليلاً. ...
npc.a_beggar.say_3: رعاياه سيكونون نحن الفقراء، هل تعلم؟ ...
npc.a_beggar.say_4: فلماذا لا تظهر تفانيك للفقراء؟ اذهب وساعد تشافيس في منزل الفقراء. إنه يجمع الطعام لأشخاص مثلنا. ...
npc.a_beggar.say_5: إذا أحضرت ما يكفي من الأشياء سترى أن الملك سيمنحك الدخول في {palace}.

npc.a_dead_bureaucrat.greet_msg_1: مرحبًا {}، مرحبًا بك في ردهة مجال Pumin. نحن بحاجة إلى بعض المعلومات منك قبل أن نتمكن من السماح لك بالمرور. أين تريد أن تذهب؟?
npc.a_dead_bureaucrat1.say_1: هوهو، من فضلك لا تؤذيني مع {} الخاص بك! سبب زيارتك؟?
npc.a_dead_bureaucrat1.say_2: كم هو مثير للاهتمام. يجب أن أقول ذلك لمعلمي على الفور. من فضلك اذهب إلى زملائي واطلب النموذج 356. ستحتاج إليه من أجل المتابعة.
npc.a_dead_bureaucrat1.say_5: نموذج 411؟ أنت بحاجة إلى نموذج 287 للحصول على ذلك! هل لديك ذلك؟?
npc.a_dead_bureaucrat1.say_6: نموذج 411؟ أنت بحاجة إلى نموذج 287 للحصول على ذلك! هل لديك ذلك؟?
npc.a_dead_bureaucrat1.say_7: أوه، يا له من مؤسف. اذهب لرؤية أحد زملائي. أعطيك الإذن بالحصول على النموذج 287. إلى اللقاء!
npc.a_dead_bureaucrat1.say_8: عظيم. تفضل. نموذج 411. عد في أي وقت تريد التحدث فيه. الوداع.
npc.a_dead_bureaucrat1.say_9: لا يصدق، لقد فعلت ذلك!! استمتع في مجال Pumin!
npc.a_dead_bureaucrat2.say_1: بالتأكيد، يمكنك الحصول عليه مني. تفضل. الوداع
npc.a_dead_bureaucrat3.say_1: لقد كنت {} أيضًا قبل أن أموت !! ماذا تريد مني?
npc.a_dead_bureaucrat3.say_3: هذا صحيح، يمكنك الحصول على النموذج 145 مني. ومع ذلك، أحتاج إلى نموذج 411 أولاً. أعود عندما يكون لديك.
npc.a_dead_bureaucrat3.say_4: أحسنت! لديك نموذج 411!! هنا النموذج 145. استمتع به.
npc.a_dead_bureaucrat4.say_1: {}، هل هذا صحيح؟! ماذا تريد مني?
npc.a_dead_bureaucrat4.say_3: عذرًا، أنت بحاجة إلى النموذج 145 للحصول على النموذج 356. عد عندما تحصل عليه
npc.a_dead_bureaucrat4.say_4: أنت أفضل مما اعتقدت! تهانينا، ها أنت هنا: النموذج 356!

npc.a_dragon_mother.greet_msg_3: لقد فعلت لي معروفًا والمعرفة التي تبحث عنها ستكون لك. لقد قمت بإذابة الجليد من أجلك، يمكنك المرور الآن.
npc.a_dragon_mother.multi_1: كما أخبرتك، قامت مخلوقات جليدية شيطانية بسحب بيضتي إلى الكهوف السفلية. ...
npc.a_dragon_mother.multi_2: وبدون حرارة كافية، سوف تموت البيضة قريبًا. قم بالمغامرة هناك وأنقذ صغاري وستكون المعرفة التي تبحث عنها ملكًا لك!
npc.a_dragon_mother.multi_4: لذا عد إلى الأنفاق العلوية حيث يسكن الطوائف وغولم الجليد. في مكان ما في هذه الأنفاق ستجد سجنًا صغيرًا يطارده شبح. جنوب هذه الزنزانة يوجد نفق يقودك شرقًا. ...
npc.a_dragon_mother.multi_5: اتبع النفق حتى تصل إلى كهف صغير. تنحى لأسفل ولأسفل حتى ترى مجال الطاقة الأزرق. سوف يقودك إلى بيضتي. إنه مغلق حتى لا يتمكن الجميع من دخول الغرفة. ولكن لديك الإذن الآن.
npc.a_dragon_mother.multi_6: لقد سرقت مخلوقات الجليد البائسة بيضتي التي كانت على وشك الفقس. ...
npc.a_dragon_mother.multi_7: نظرًا لأنني في غاية الصعوبة لدخول تلك الأنفاق السفلية، يجب أن أطلب منك الاهتمام بـ {egg} الخاص بي. هل ستفعل هذا؟?
npc.a_dragon_mother.say_1: أنا على علم بما تبحث عنه. عادة ما أفضّل أن ألتهمك، ولكن بسبب الظروف المؤسفة، أحتاج إلى {assistance} الخاص بك.

npc.a_frog.stdmod_1: If another prince comes to kiss me, I'll kick his ass so bad that he'll need a sedan chair to get away.
npc.a_frog.stdmod_2: If another prince comes to kiss me, I'll kick his ass so bad that he'll need a sedan chair to get away.

npc.a_frog.stdmod_4: Talking frogs don't exist, idiot. It's your fucking imagination tricking you. And now your imagination commands you to walk away.
npc.a_frog.stdmod_5: Finally someone notices I'm a FROG. Congratulations, you're VERY observant... *sigh*
npc.a_frog.stdmod_6: A quest? Yeah I got a quest! Go and tell King Tibianus his son tried to kiss me again!
npc.a_frog.stdmod_7: Pyrale? That idiot transformed me into an human once. But my wife came and kissed me, so I'm a frog again.

npc.a_ghostly_sage.stdmod_1: You will now be travelled out of here. Are you sure that you want to face that teleport?
npc.a_ghostly_sage.stdmod_2: Then stay here in these ghostly halls.

npc.a_ghostly_woman.stdmod_1: Once I was a member of the order of the nightmare knights. Now I am but a shadow who walks these cold halls.

npc.a_prisoner.say_10: Great riddle, isn't it? If you can tell me the correct answer, I will give you something. Hehehe!

npc.a_restless_soul.multi_1: I was captured and tortured to death by the cultists here. They worship a being that they call Ghazbaran ...
npc.a_restless_soul.multi_2: In his name they have claimed the mines and started to melt the ice to free an army of vile demons that have been frozen here for ages ...
npc.a_restless_soul.multi_3: Their plan is to create a new demon army for their master to conquer the world. Hjaern and the other shamans must learn about it! Hurry before its too late.
npc.a_sleeping_dragon.multi_10: With your eyes covered and avoiding direct sight of the rays, you put the mirror into the stand. ...
npc.a_sleeping_dragon.multi_11: Instinctively you run to a larger emerald bluff near the raise to find cover. Mere seconds after you claimed the sturdy shelter, a deep dark humming starts to swirl through the air. ...
npc.a_sleeping_dragon.multi_12: Seconds pass as the hum gets louder. The noise is maddening, drowning all other sounds around you. As you cover your ears in pain, the humming explodes into a deafening growl. ...
npc.a_sleeping_dragon.multi_13: You raise your head above the edge of the emerald to catch a glimpse of what's happening. ...
npc.a_sleeping_dragon.multi_14: The hand seems to have grown into a fist. In the distance you can now see a blurry scheme of a creature too large for your eyes to get a sharper view of its head. ...
npc.a_sleeping_dragon.multi_15: Blending the rays, the mirror directs pure white light directly towards the part where you assume the face of the creature. ...
npc.a_sleeping_dragon.multi_16: The growl transforms into a scream, everything around you seems to compress. As you press yourself tightly against the bluff, everything falls silent and in a split second, the dark being dissolves into bursts of blackness. You wake.
npc.a_sleeping_dragon.multi_17: You lunge out and throw the model far into the water. As nothing happens, you turn your back to the ocean. ...
npc.a_sleeping_dragon.multi_18: The very moment you walk down the dune to head back south, rays of light burst over your head in a shock wave that makes you tumble down the rest of the hill. ...
npc.a_sleeping_dragon.multi_19: As your eyes adjust to the sudden reduction of brightness, you see the giant wings of the gate before you move to the side. You can also make out something shiny on the ground.
npc.a_sleeping_dragon.multi_20: You pick the mirror from the ground.
npc.a_sleeping_dragon.multi_22: A broad darkness surrounds you as if a heavy curtain is closing before your eyes. After what seems like minutes of floating through emptiness, you get the feeling as if a hole opens in the dark before you. ...
npc.a_sleeping_dragon.multi_23: The hole grows larger, you cannot close your eyes. An unimaginable black. Deeper and darker than any nothingness you could possibly imagine drags you into it. ...
npc.a_sleeping_dragon.multi_24: You feel as if you cannot breathe anymore. The very second you let loose of your consciousness, you sense all heaviness around you lifted. ...
npc.a_sleeping_dragon.multi_25: You dive into an ocean of emerald light. Feeling like born anew the colour around you is almost overwhelming. Countless objects of all shapes and sizes are dashing past you. Racing against each other, millions are clashing in the distance. ..
npc.a_sleeping_dragon.multi_26: The loudness of the gargantuan spectacle around you bursts your hearing, yet you absorb all the sounds around you. ...
npc.a_sleeping_dragon.multi_27: As several large obstacles move aside directly in front of you, an intense bright centre leaps into your view. Though you cannot perceive how fast you are, your pace seems too slow. ...
npc.a_sleeping_dragon.multi_28: Ever decelerating, you ultimately approach a middle in this chaos of tones of green. ...
npc.a_sleeping_dragon.multi_29: As you come closer to it, yellowish shades of orange embrace you, softer shapes emerge and you almost forget the mayhem before. In warm comfort you see what lies in the heart of it all. ...
npc.a_sleeping_dragon.multi_30: A majestic dragon in his sleep is surrounded by what seems the warmth and energy of a thousand suns. The tranquillity of its sight makes you smile gently. ...
npc.a_sleeping_dragon.multi_31: You feel a perfect mixture of joy, compassion and sudden peacefulness. Bright xanthous impressions of topaz, orange and white welcome you at the final halt of your journey. ...
npc.a_sleeping_dragon.multi_33: You find yourself inside the dragon's dream. You can {look} around or {go} into a specific direction. You can also {take} or {use} an object. Enter {help} to display this information at any time.
npc.a_sleeping_dragon.multi_6: You are now prepared to enter the realm of the evildoer. I am grateful for your help, wayfarer. Should you seek my council, use this charm I cede to you. For my spirit will guide you wherever you are. May you enjoy a sheltered future, you shall prevail.
npc.a_sleeping_dragon.multi_8: I assume you need to get through the gate to reach the evildoer. I can help you if you trust me, wayfarer. I will share a part of my mind with you which should enable you to step through the gate. ...
npc.a_sleeping_dragon.multi_9: This procedure may be exhausting. Are you prepared to receive my key?
npc.a_sleeping_dragon.say_1: You find yourself inside the dragon's dream. You can {look} around or {go} into a specific direction. You can also {take} or {use} an object. Enter {help} to display this information at any time.
npc.a_sleeping_dragon.say_10: You return through the semi-translucent gate to the west.
npc.a_sleeping_dragon.say_11: You head back north to the plateau.
npc.a_sleeping_dragon.say_12: You travel east across several large emerald bluffs and edges. All sorts of gems are scattered alongside your path.
npc.a_sleeping_dragon.say_13: You take a rather large ruby out of a pile before you.
npc.a_sleeping_dragon.say_14: You head north passing countless stones in the crimson sea of stones beneath your feet.
npc.a_sleeping_dragon.say_15: Avoiding the bright light, you carefully put the attachment on top of the strange socket. ...
npc.a_sleeping_dragon.say_16: Your path to the north is open. You pass the gigantic gate wings to your left and right as you advance. After about an hour of travel you hear a slight rustling in the distance. You head further into that direction. ...
npc.a_sleeping_dragon.say_17: You travel all the way back down the dune and through the gate to the south.
npc.a_sleeping_dragon.say_18: You return to the crimson sea of rubies in the south.
npc.a_sleeping_dragon.say_19: You travel back to the plateau in the west.
npc.a_sleeping_dragon.say_2: Advancing to the west, you recognise an increase of onyx on the ground.
npc.a_sleeping_dragon.say_20: Advancing to the west, you recognise an increase of onyx on the ground.
npc.a_sleeping_dragon.say_21: You continue travelling the barren sea of gemstones to the north.
npc.a_sleeping_dragon.say_22: You leave the massive open gate behind you and go to the west.
npc.a_sleeping_dragon.say_23: You carefully remove the sapphire from Bastesh's grasp.
npc.a_sleeping_dragon.say_24: You head back to the east and to the plateau.
npc.a_sleeping_dragon.say_25: You head back south to the site with the onyx lookout.
npc.a_sleeping_dragon.say_26: You return to the plateau in the east.
npc.a_sleeping_dragon.say_27: You put the stand into a small recess you find near the middle of the plateau.
npc.a_sleeping_dragon.say_28: As the ruby slips into the notch, the strong red of the stone intensifies a thousandfold. You fear to hurt your eyes and turn away immediately. The ray seems to be directed to the centre of the plateau with astounding precision.
npc.a_sleeping_dragon.say_29: As the sapphire slips into the notch, the deep blue of the stone intensifies a thousandfold. You fear to hurt your eyes and turn away immediately. The ray seems to be directed to the centre of the plateau with astounding precision.
npc.a_sleeping_dragon.say_3: You carefully lift the onyx attachment from its socket. It is lighter than you expected.
npc.a_sleeping_dragon.say_30: As the emerald slips into the notch, the vibrant green of the stone intensifies a thousandfold. You fear to hurt your eyes and turn away immediately. The ray seems to be directed to the centre of the plateau with astounding precision.
npc.a_sleeping_dragon.say_31: I call you the wayfarer. You travelled through my dreams. You ultimately freed my mind. My mind accepted you and so will I.
npc.a_sleeping_dragon.say_4: You return to the plateau in the east.
npc.a_sleeping_dragon.say_5: You wander to the south, passing large obelisks of emerald to your left and sprawling trees of topaz to your right.
npc.a_sleeping_dragon.say_6: As you rip the solid stand out of its socket and take it with you, the large gate opens with a deafening rumble.
npc.a_sleeping_dragon.say_7: You gasp at the size of the large open gate as you walk through to head further to the east.
npc.a_sleeping_dragon.say_8: You reach for a small solitary arrangement of combined small houses and put it in your pocket.
npc.a_sleeping_dragon.say_9: You take an emerald from the pile.
npc.a_strange_chalice.greet_msg_1: Hi? What do you mean 'hi' - can't you see I am a... I have to lower my voice. Did it occur to you, that this 'chalice' does not want to be disturbed?! Leave me alone!
npc.a_strange_chalice.multi_1: Yes, well for instance I tried for some time to figure out how to enter the fiery portal in this complex. Most of the draken never come up here. They rather hide somewhere down there, planning and plotting. ...
npc.a_strange_chalice.multi_10: Then something happened, lizardfolk started to appear, searching the place. I had to retreat from my hiding place and advance through a safer position. ...
npc.a_strange_chalice.multi_11: I needed to get close and blend in. So I came up with the ultimate disguise: a chalice. I could establish foothold right in their midst, would never be identified as an intruder and could even analyse their drinks! ...
npc.a_strange_chalice.multi_12: I quickly dug a tunnel to get into what I assume is a throne room and waited for them to pick me up an carry me around! ...
npc.a_strange_chalice.multi_13: They also 'used' me a bit, you don't want to go into any details here. I am really {thirsty}.
npc.a_strange_chalice.multi_14: No water then? Ah drat - er, don't worry, no problem. So, from the day I received news of the discovery of Zao, I wanted to study its inhabitants, wildlife, plants and geography. ...
npc.a_strange_chalice.multi_15: The academy instated the 'Edron-Zaoan Exploration Division' shortly after. I was a founding member and head of the 'Draken' research branch. ...
npc.a_strange_chalice.multi_16: Since my valued and practical oriented colleague and mentor Spectulus did not join us, there is only one member of the academy exploration division to actually venture out to see the place - me. ...
npc.a_strange_chalice.multi_17: You must know, most things in the academy happen 'inside', behind closed doors. But some of us simply refuse to let theory reign over practical experience in science. ...
npc.a_strange_chalice.multi_18: Well, basically Spectulus is the only one likeminded so far. In fact, he incited me to work in the field in first place. So here I am! {Disguised} as a chalice.
npc.a_strange_chalice.multi_19: Well, besides being a renowned sorcerer and scholar at the magic academy in Edron, I am also the proud father of a beautiful daughter, Ivalisse. My little endeavour here must have troubled the poor thing all the time since I left. ...
npc.a_strange_chalice.multi_2: I already know how to enter it, you need to step in and yell 'zzubaran'. Unfortunately they never took me with them. ...
npc.a_strange_chalice.multi_20: Tell her I love her and that I will take care. I have to press on! My research is most valuable to the 'Edron-Zaoan Exploration Division'. You don't happen to have some water, do you? Ah nevermind. It's a long {story}.
npc.a_strange_chalice.multi_3: I heard them say it once, when a seemingly drunk guard yelled it in front of a wall mounted torch, hitting his head against it afterwards. He spilt all my contents on the floor, hmpf.
npc.a_strange_chalice.multi_4: Ah did I say that? Nevermind, I'm not really thirsty. It's part of this illusion. Somehow, I've been in hiding for so long, I started to... become... a vessel. ...
npc.a_strange_chalice.multi_5: I don't know, I have that constant urge to drink but in this form I would not need to, there is no mouth, no stomach, no flesh and no actual need to eat, drink or sleep. ...
npc.a_strange_chalice.multi_6: I basically communicate by making the metal of this goblet vibrate and using its form as a body of sound. Like a real voice, don't you think?? Yes, alright I know it's creepy. ...
npc.a_strange_chalice.multi_7: I am still in the middle of my research and do not want to go home, so please tell my daughter to not worry about my - this will be a breakthrough! I already {learned} a lot!
npc.a_strange_chalice.multi_8: Oh yes, so since I wanted to study the Draken up close, I came up with an idea. Based on my research, and some slight bruises and a scar, the perfect hiding place is often right in the middle of subjects. ...
npc.a_strange_chalice.multi_9: If I could enter their lair unseen and establish a forward camp, I would be able to study the draken in peace - or so I thought. Turns out the whole place was empty. I set up my camp and waited. ...
npc.a_strange_chalice.say_3: Finally. That's what I... oh wait, you're still talking to me - you will blow my cover! What do you want? Oh wait, did my {daughter} send you? It has been some time now, indeed.
npc.a_strange_chalice.stdmod_1: 'Alice the chalice'... Hmpf, of course I won't TELL you my name, I am UNDERCOVER! Now be quiet or they will hear you.
npc.a_strange_chalice.stdmod_2: Well, I am drinking most of the time. Er, no I mean - trying to hold my fluids... ah, wait that came out wrong: I am doing research. Let's just keep it at that.
npc.a_strange_fellow.say_1: A bill? Oh boy so you are delivering another bill to poor me?
npc.a_strange_fellow.say_2: Ok, ok, I'll take it. I guess I have no other choice anyways. And now leave me alone in my misery please.
npc.a_strange_fellow.say_4: What? My hat?? Theres... nothing special about it!
npc.a_strange_fellow.say_5: Stop bugging me about that hat, do you listen?
npc.a_strange_fellow.say_6: Hey! Don't touch that hat! Leave it alone!!! Don't do this!!!!
npc.a_strange_fellow.say_7: Noooooo! Argh, ok, ok, I guess I can't deny it anymore, I am David Brassacres, the magnificent, so what do you want?
npc.a_swan.multi_1: Thank you, human being! I guess the thieving troll headed to the mountains east of here. As far as I know you can only reach these mountain tops by diving into a small cave. ...
npc.a_swan.multi_2: The connecting tunnels will lead you to a mountain where you may discover him. I heard a man named Jerom talking about this when he passed by this river. Perhaps he knows more about it.
npc.a_swan.multi_3: This is everything that remained of my cloak? That's terrible! However, I guess I can put the feathers together again. Yes, that should be enough feathers. ...
npc.a_swan.multi_4: Please give them to me so I can restore my cloak. But don't watch me! Swan maidens don't like to be observed. Nature's blessings, human being. I will tell Ikassis that you have been of great assistance.
npc.a_swan.multi_5: My sister Ikassis sent you? Blessed be her soul! Yes, it is true: I need help. Listen, I will tell you a secret but please don't break it. As you might already suspect I'm not really a swan but a fae. ...
npc.a_swan.multi_6: But other than many of my siblings I did not take over a swan's body. I'm a swan maiden and this is one of my two aspects. I can take the shape of a swan as well as that of a young maiden. ...
npc.a_swan.multi_7: But to do so I need a magical artefact: a cloak made of swan feathers. If I lose this cloak - or someone steals it from me - I'm stuck to the form of a swan and can't change shape anymore. And this is exactly what happened: ...
npc.a_swan.multi_8: A troll stalked me while I was bathing in the river and he stole my cloak. Now I am trapped in the form of a swan. Please, can you find the thief and bring back the cloak?
npc.a_swan.say_1: You need to deliver me like 5 feathers.
npc.a_swan.say_2: You are not on that mission.
npc.a_sweaty_cyclops.say_1: Firy steel it is. Need green ones' breath to melt. Or red even better. Me can make from shield. Lil' one want to trade?
npc.a_sweaty_cyclops.say_10: Good good! Woman happy will be. Now me happy too and help you.
npc.a_sweaty_cyclops.say_11: Lil' one bring three bast skirts.
npc.a_sweaty_cyclops.say_12: Lil' one bring three bast skirts?
npc.a_sweaty_cyclops.say_13: Very noble. Shiny. Me like. But breaks so fast. Me can make from shiny armour. Lil' one want to trade?
npc.a_sweaty_cyclops.say_15: Firy steel it is. Need green ones' breath to melt. Or red even better. Me can make from shield. Lil' one want to trade?
npc.a_sweaty_cyclops.say_17: Hellsteel is. Cursed and evil. Dangerous to work with. Me can make from evil helmet. Lil' one want to trade?
npc.a_sweaty_cyclops.say_19: Good iron is. Me friends use it much for fight. Me can make from weapon. Lil' one want to trade?
npc.a_sweaty_cyclops.say_2: Wait. Me work no cheap is. Do favour for me first, yes?
npc.a_sweaty_cyclops.say_21: Uh. Me can make some nasty lil' bolt from soul orbs. Lil' one want to trade all?
npc.a_sweaty_cyclops.say_22: Cling clang! Me done good work today! Li'l one gets double bolts!
npc.a_sweaty_cyclops.say_3: Me need gift for woman. We dance, so me want to give her bast skirt. But she big is. So I need many to make big one. Bring three okay? Me wait.
npc.a_sweaty_cyclops.say_4: Good good! Woman happy will be. Now me happy too and help you.
npc.a_sweaty_cyclops.say_5: Lil' one bring three bast skirts.
npc.a_sweaty_cyclops.say_6: Lil' one bring three bast skirts?
npc.a_sweaty_cyclops.say_7: Firy steel it is. Need green ones' breath to melt. Or red even better. Me can make from shield. Lil' one want to trade?
npc.a_sweaty_cyclops.say_8: Wait. Me work no cheap is. Do favour for me first, yes?
npc.a_sweaty_cyclops.say_9: Me need gift for woman. We dance, so me want to give her bast skirt. But she big is. So I need many to make big one. Bring three okay? Me wait.
npc.a_sweaty_cyclops.stdmod_10: Not good to make stuff off. Bad steel it is. But eating magic, so useful is.
npc.a_sweaty_cyclops.stdmod_11: Brightsteel is. Much art made with it. Sorcerers too lazy and afraid to enchant much.
npc.a_sweaty_cyclops.stdmod_12: Heartiron from heart of big old mountain, found very deep. Lil' lil ones fiercely defend. Not wanting to have it used for stuff but holy stuff.
npc.a_sweaty_cyclops.stdmod_13: Me parents live here before town was. Me not care about lil' ones.
npc.a_sweaty_cyclops.stdmod_14: Lil' lil' ones are so fun. We often chat.
npc.a_sweaty_cyclops.stdmod_15: One day I'll go and look.
npc.a_sweaty_cyclops.stdmod_16: Is one of elven family or such thing. Me not understand lil' ones and their business.
npc.a_sweaty_cyclops.stdmod_17: Is one of elven family or such thing. Me not understand lil' ones and their business.
npc.a_sweaty_cyclops.stdmod_18: I called Bencthyclthrtrprr by me people. Lil' ones me call Big Ben.
npc.a_sweaty_cyclops.stdmod_19: You shut up. Me not want to hear.
npc.a_sweaty_cyclops.stdmod_20: Do lil' one want to trade a fire sword?
npc.a_sweaty_cyclops.stdmod_21: Do lil' one want to trade a dragon shield?
npc.a_sweaty_cyclops.stdmod_22: Do lil' one want to trade a sword of valor?
npc.a_sweaty_cyclops.stdmod_23: Do lil' one want to trade a warlord sword?
npc.a_sweaty_cyclops.stdmod_24: They were friend with me parents. Long before elves here, they often made visit. No longer come here.
npc.a_sweaty_cyclops.stdmod_25: Me not fight them, they not fight me.
npc.a_sweaty_cyclops.stdmod_5: Manny kinds of. Like {Mesh Kaha Rogh'}, {Za'Kalortith}, {Uth'Byth}, {Uth'Morc}, {Uth'Amon}, {Uth'Maer}, {Uth'Doon}, and {Zatragil}.
npc.a_sweaty_cyclops.stdmod_6: Most ancients use dream silver for different stuff. Now ancients most gone. Most not know about.
npc.a_sweaty_cyclops.stdmod_7: It's high steel called. Only lil' lil' ones know how make.
npc.a_sweaty_cyclops.stdmod_8: It's evil. Demon iron is. No good cyclops goes where you can find and need evil flame to melt.
npc.a_sweaty_cyclops.stdmod_9: Steel that is singing when forged. No one knows where find today.

npc.a_vulcongra.greet_msg_2: Pssst! Keep it down! <gives you an elaborate report on monster activity>

npc.a_weakened_forest_fury.greet_msg_1: I greet you, human. This is a time of distress, more than ever are we in need of guardians to protect us and our world.
npc.a_weakened_forest_fury.multi_1: Crafted generations ago to rob a creature of its freedom for that it may earn it again truthfully. You will need them if you plan on returning the birds to their rightful home in the glade. ...
npc.a_weakened_forest_fury.multi_2: Are you in need of another one?
npc.a_weakened_forest_fury.multi_3: Indeed, you will. Take one of these cages, which have been crafted generations ago to rob a creature of its freedom for that it may earn it again truthfully. Return the birds back to their home in the glade. ...
npc.a_weakened_forest_fury.multi_4: You will find {phials} for water near this sacred well which will take you safely to the glade. No seeds are left, they are in the hands of the intruders now. Have faith in yourself, guardian.
npc.a_weakened_forest_fury.multi_5: My pride is great but not greater than reason. I am not too proud to ask for help as this is a dark hour. ...
npc.a_weakened_forest_fury.multi_6: This glade has been desecrated. We kept it secret for centuries, yet evil has found a way to sully and destroy what was our most sacred. ...
npc.a_weakened_forest_fury.multi_7: There is only one way to reinvigorate its spirits, a guardian must venture down there and bring life back into the forest. ...
npc.a_weakened_forest_fury.multi_8: The purest {water} from the purest well needs to be brought there and poured and {birds} that give life need to be brought back to the inner sanctum of the glade. ...
npc.a_weakened_forest_fury.say_1: Seeds to give life to strong trees, blooming and proud. The {intruders} robbed us from them.
npc.a_weakened_forest_fury.say_2: The intruders appeared in the blink of an eye. Out of thin air, as if they came from nowhere. They overrun the glade within ours and drove away what was remaining from us within the day.
npc.a_weakened_forest_fury.say_3: The purest water flows through this well. For centuries we concealed it, for other beings to not lay their eyes on it.
npc.a_weakened_forest_fury.say_5: Phials for the purest water from our sacred well. They are finely crafted and very fragile. We keep a small supply up here around the well. Probably the only thing the intruders did not care for.
npc.a_weakened_forest_fury.say_6: I already handed a cage to you. If you are in need of another one, you will have to return to me later.
npc.a_weakened_forest_fury.stdmod_1: My name is now known only to the wind and it shall remain like this until I will return to my kin.
npc.a_weakened_forest_fury.stdmod_2: I was a guardian of this glade. I am the last one... everyone had to leave.
npc.a_weakened_forest_fury.stdmod_3: This glade's time is growing short if nothing will be done soon.
npc.a_weakened_forest_fury.stdmod_5: Cruel beings. Large and monstrous, with a single eye, staring at their prey.
npc.a_wrinkled_bonelord.farewell_msg_1: Wait right there. I will eat you after writing down what I found out.
npc.a_wrinkled_bonelord.greet_msg_1: What is this? An optically challenged entity called |PLAYERNAME|. How fascinating!
npc.a_wrinkled_bonelord.stdmod_10: These fools and their superstitious life cult don't understand anything of importance.
npc.a_wrinkled_bonelord.stdmod_12: I heard that elves moved in upstairs.
npc.a_wrinkled_bonelord.stdmod_13: Numbers are essential. They are the secret behind the scenes. If you are a master of mathematics you are a master over life and death.
npc.a_wrinkled_bonelord.stdmod_14: Our books are written in 469, of course you can't understand them.
npc.a_wrinkled_bonelord.stdmod_15: Go and wash your eyes for using this obscene number!
npc.a_wrinkled_bonelord.stdmod_16: The language of my kind. Superior to any other language and only to be spoken by entities with enough eyes to blink it.
npc.a_wrinkled_bonelord.stdmod_18: Their mages are so close to the truth. Closer then they know and closer then it's good for them.
npc.a_wrinkled_bonelord.stdmod_19: Good tools to work with ... After their death, that is.
npc.a_wrinkled_bonelord.stdmod_3: Yes, yes, I will kill you soon enough, now let me continue my investigation on you.
npc.a_wrinkled_bonelord.stdmod_4: They will mourn the day they abandoned us.
npc.a_wrinkled_bonelord.stdmod_6: It's a fine library, isn't it?
npc.a_wrinkled_bonelord.stdmod_7: I am 486486 and NOT 'Blinky' as some people called me ... before they died.
npc.a_wrinkled_bonelord.stdmod_9: Uglyness incarnate. One eye! Imagine that! Horrible!
npc.a_wrinkled_bonelord.walkaway_msg_1: Wait right there. I will eat you after writing down what I found out.

npc.a_wyrm.greet_msg_2: Pssst! Keep it down! <gives you an elaborate report on monster activity>

npc.ahmet.greet_msg_1: Be mourned pilgrim in flesh. I'm selling general goods. Just ask me for a {trade}.
npc.ahmet.multi_1: Well then. Here, take the book, I added the story. Oh, just a piece of advice: Not to inflame prejudice but poachers are of rather simple disposition. I doubt they are ardent readers. ...
npc.ahmet.multi_2: So if you want to make sure they read this anytime soon, perhaps don't hide the book in a shelf or chest. Make sure to place it somewhere where they will find it easily, like very obviously on a table or something.
npc.ahmet.multi_3: Of course you do! Go hunt down the thieves and bring back the stuff they have stolen from me. ...
npc.ahmet.multi_4: I saw them running out of town and then to the north. Maybe they hide at the oasis.
npc.ahmet.multi_5: What are you talking about?? I was robbed!!!! Someone catch those filthy thieves!!!!! GUARDS! ...
npc.ahmet.multi_6: <nothing happens>....<SIGH> Like usual, they hide at the slightest sign of trouble! YOU! Want to earn some quick money?
npc.ahmet.multi_7: You need some forged documents? But I will only forge something for a friend. ...
npc.ahmet.multi_8: The nomads at the northern oasis killed someone dear to me. Go and kill at least one of them, then we talk about your document.
npc.ahmet.say_1: The slayer of my enemies is my friend! For a mere 1000 gold I will create the documents you need. Are you interested?
npc.ahmet.say_3: I see: You want me to add an additional story to this book. A legend about how it brings ill luck to kill a white deer. I could do that, yes. It costs 5000 gold, however. Are you still interested?
npc.ahmet.say_4: And here they are! Now forget where you got them from.
npc.ahmet.say_6: GREAT! If you ever need a job as my personal security guard, let me know. Here is the reward I promised you.
npc.ahmet.say_7: Come back when you find my stuff.
npc.ahmet.say_8: You need 5000 gps and book with ancient legends.
npc.ahmet.say_9: You are not in this mission.
npc.ajax.greet_msg_1: You back. You know, you right. Brother is right. Fist not always good. Tell him that!
npc.ajax.multi_1: Good! Me make shiny weapon. If you help me, I make one for you too. Like axe I wear. I need stuff. Listen. ...
npc.ajax.multi_2: Me need 100 iron ore. Then need crude iron. Then after that 50 behemoth fangs. And 50 lizard leather. You understand?
npc.ajax.say_1: YOURS? WHAT IS YOURS! NOTHING IS YOURS! IS MINE! GO AWAY, YES?!
npc.ajax.say_13: Axe is done! For you. Take. Wear like me.
npc.ajax.say_15: Oh. Easy. Okay. Please is good. Now don't say anything. Head aches.
npc.ajax.say_16: Good. You get 100 iron ore first. Come back.
npc.ajax.say_2: YOU STUPID! STUBBORN! I KILL YOU! WILL LEAVE NOW?!
npc.ajax.say_20: Ah! All stuff there. I will start making axes now. Come later and ask me for axe.
npc.ajax.say_3: ARRRRRRRRRR! YOU ME DRIVE MAD! HOW I MAKE YOU GO??
npc.ajax.say_5: Please? What you mean please? Like I say please you say bye? Please?
npc.ajax.say_6: Annoying kid. Bro hates him, but talking no help. Bro needs {fighting spirit}!
npc.ajax.say_7: If you want to help bro, bring him fighting spirit. Magic fighting spirit. Ask Djinn.
npc.ajax.say_8: Bron gave me present. Ugly, but nice from him. Me want to give present too. You help me?
npc.al_dee.greet_msg_1: Hello, hello, |PLAYERNAME|! Please come in, look, and buy! I'm a specialist for all sorts of {tools}. Just ask me for a {trade} to see my offers! You can also ask me for general {hints} about the game. ...
npc.al_dee.greet_msg_2: You can also ask me about each {citizen} of the isle.
npc.al_dee.sendtrade_msg_1: Take a look in the trade window to your left.
npc.al_dee.stdmod_1: Are you looking for the best trades? Come to my shop!
npc.al_dee.stdmod_10: I'm a merchant. Just ask me for a {trade} to see my offers.
npc.al_dee.stdmod_11: My name is Al Dee, but you can call me Al. Can I interest you in a {trade}?
npc.al_dee.stdmod_12: It's about |TIME|. I'm so sorry, I have no watches to sell. Do you want to buy something else?
npc.al_dee.stdmod_13: If you want to challenge monsters in the {dungeons}, you need some {weapons} and {armor} from the local {merchants}.
npc.al_dee.stdmod_14: If you want to explore the dungeons such as the {sewers}, you have to {equip} yourself with the vital stuff I am selling. It's {vital} in the deepest sense of the word.
npc.al_dee.stdmod_15: Oh, our sewer system is very primitive - it's so primitive that it's overrun by {rats}. But the stuff I sell is safe from them. Just ask me for a {trade} to see it!
npc.al_dee.stdmod_16: The king encouraged salesmen to travel here, but only I dared to take the risk, and a risk it was!
npc.al_dee.stdmod_17: Bugs plague this isle, but my wares are bug-free, totally bug-free.
npc.al_dee.stdmod_18: One day I will return to the continent as a rich, a very rich man!
npc.al_dee.stdmod_2: Feeling lost? You can always ask me about general hints!
npc.al_dee.stdmod_20: Have you ever wondered what that 'main' is people are talking about? Well, once you've reached level 8, you should talk to the {oracle}. You can choose a {profession} afterwards and explore much more of Tibia.
npc.al_dee.stdmod_21: Oh, I'm sorry, but I don't deal with weapons. That's {Obi's} or {Lee'Delle's} business. I could offer you a {pick} in exchange for a {small axe} if you should happen to own one.
npc.al_dee.stdmod_22: Armor and shields can be bought at {Dixi's} or at {Lee'Delle's}. Dixi runs that shop near {Obi's}.
npc.al_dee.stdmod_23: Armor and shields can be bought at {Dixi's} or at {Lee'Delle's}. Dixi runs that shop near {Obi's}.
npc.al_dee.stdmod_24: I you want to find someone who may want to buy your cookies, you should meet Lily.
npc.al_dee.stdmod_25: Blueberries grow on bushes. They're quite common in Tibia. Just pick them from a bush if you need a snack!
npc.al_dee.stdmod_26: Sorry, I don't sell potions. You should visit {Lily} for that.
npc.al_dee.stdmod_27: Hmm, the best address to look for food might be {Willie} or {Billy}. {Norma} also has some snacks for sale.
npc.al_dee.stdmod_28: A bank is quite useful. You can deposit your money safely there. This way you don't have to carry it around with you all the time. You could also invest your money in my {wares}!
npc.al_dee.stdmod_29: The big building in the centre of Rookgaard. They have a library, a training centre, a {bank} and the room of the {oracle}. {Seymour} is the teacher there.
npc.al_dee.stdmod_3: Tools and general equipment at Al Dee's!
npc.al_dee.stdmod_30: The monk {Cipfried} takes care of our temple. He can heal you if you're badly injured or poisoned.
npc.al_dee.stdmod_31: As a premium adventurer you have many advantages. You really should check them out!
npc.al_dee.stdmod_32: If you tell me the name of a citizen, I'll tell you what I know about him or her.
npc.al_dee.stdmod_33: To view the offers of a merchant, simply talk to him or her and ask for a {trade}. They will gladly show you their offers and also the things they buy from you.
npc.al_dee.stdmod_34: You will learn everything you need to know about professions once you've reached the {Island of Destiny}.
npc.al_dee.stdmod_35: The Island of Destiny can be reached via the {oracle} once you are level 8. This trip will help you choose your {profession}!
npc.al_dee.stdmod_36: No thank you. I can already overstock the market with torches.
npc.al_dee.stdmod_37: I sell fishing rods and worms if you want to fish. Simply ask me for a {trade}.
npc.al_dee.stdmod_38: Yes, I am selling that. Simply ask me for a {trade} to view all my offers.
npc.al_dee.stdmod_39: He is just an old monk. However, he can heal you if you are badly injured or poisoned.

npc.al_dee.stdmod_41: He dedicated his life to welcome newcomers to this island.
npc.al_dee.stdmod_43: Yep, that's me. Smart of you to notice that!
npc.al_dee.stdmod_45: He mostly stays by himself. He's a hermit outside of town - good luck finding him.
npc.al_dee.stdmod_46: She's {Obi's} granddaughter and deals with {armors} and {shields}. Her shop is south west of town, close to the {temple}.
npc.al_dee.stdmod_47: He sells {weapons}. His shop is south west of town, close to the {temple}.
npc.al_dee.stdmod_48: If you are a {premium} adventurer, you should check out {Lee'Delle's} shop. She lives in the western part of town, just across the bridge.
npc.al_dee.stdmod_49: He's the local tanner. You could try selling fresh corpses or leather to him.
npc.al_dee.stdmod_5: Just ask me for a {trade} to see what I buy from you.
npc.al_dee.stdmod_50: She's currently recovering from her travels in the {academy}. It's always nice to chat with her!
npc.al_dee.stdmod_51: You can find the oracle on the top floor of the {academy}, just above {Seymour}. Go there when you are level 8.
npc.al_dee.stdmod_52: Seymour is a teacher running the {academy}. He has many important {information} about Tibia.
npc.al_dee.stdmod_53: She sells health {potions} and antidote potions. Also, she buys {blueberries} and {cookies} in case you find any.
npc.al_dee.stdmod_54: This is a local farmer. If you need fresh {food} to regain your health, it's a good place to go. However, many monsters also carry food such as meat or cheese. Or you could simply pick {blueberries}.
npc.al_dee.stdmod_55: This is a local farmer. If you need fresh {food} to regain your health, it's a good place to go. He's only trading with {premium} adventurers though.
npc.al_dee.stdmod_56: She used to sell equipment, but I think she has opened a small bar now. Talks about changing her name to 'Mary' and such, strange girl.
npc.al_dee.stdmod_57: Some call him a hero. He protects the town from {monsters}.
npc.al_dee.stdmod_6: Just ask me for a {trade} to see my offers.
npc.al_dee.stdmod_7: If you need general {equipment}, just ask me for a {trade}. I can also provide you with some general {hints} about the game.
npc.al_dee.stdmod_8: As an adventurer, you should always have at least a {backpack}, a {rope}, a {shovel}, a {weapon}, an {armor} and a {shield}.
npc.al_dee.stdmod_9: I'm fine. I'm so glad to have you here as my customer.

npc.al_dee.voice_2: Feeling lost? You can always ask me about general hints!

npc.albinius.greet_msg_1: Greetings, pilgrim. Welcome to the halls of hope. We are the keepers of this {temple} and welcome everyone willing to contribute.
npc.albinius.multi_1: The foundations of this {temple} are testament to their genius and advanced understanding of complex problems. They were master craftsmen and excelled in magic.
npc.albinius.multi_2: The foundations of this {temple} are testament to their genius and advanced understanding of complex problems. They were master craftsmen and excelled in magic.
npc.albinius.say_1: The temple has been restored to its former glory, yet we strife to live and praise in the {Shaper} ways. Do you still need me to take some old {tomes} from you my child?
npc.albinius.say_11: You may pass this portal if you have 50 fish as offering. Do you have the fish with you?
npc.albinius.say_12: Sorry, you first need to bring my Heavy Old Tomes or do the quest before continuing.
npc.albinius.say_13: Thank you for your offering. You may pass the Portal to the Powers of Ice now.
npc.albinius.say_14: I'm sorry, you don't have enough fish. Return if you can offer fifty of them.
npc.albinius.say_15: In this case I'm sorry, you may not pass this portal.

npc.albinius.say_2: You already offered enough tomes for us to study and rebuild this temple. Thank you, my child.

npc.albinius.say_30: In this case I'm sorry, you may not pass this portal.

npc.albinius.say_6: If you have some old shaper tomes I would {buy} them.
npc.albinius.say_7: I'm sorry, I don't buy anything. My main concern right now is the bulding of this temple.

npc.albinius.say_9: I'm sorry but you lack the needed rune parts.

npc.albinius.stdmod_3: I find ways to unveil the secrets of the stars. Judging by this question, I doubt you follow my weekly publications concerning this research.

npc.aldo.say_2: Sorry, you don't have the item.
npc.aldo.say_3: Sorry, you don't have enough gold.
npc.alesar.multi_1: So you have made it? You have really managed to steal a Tear of Daraman? ...
npc.alesar.multi_10: To my knowledge there is only one place where you can find these gemstones - I know for a fact that the Marid have at least one of them. ...
npc.alesar.multi_11: Well... to cut a long story short, your mission is to sneak into Ashta'daramai and to steal it. ...
npc.alesar.multi_12: Needless to say, the Marid won't be too eager to part with it. Try not to get killed until you have delivered the stone to me.
npc.alesar.multi_13: Needless to say, the Marid won't be too eager to part with it. Try not to get killed until you have delivered the stone to me.
npc.alesar.multi_14: So Baa'leal thinks you are up to do a mission for us? ...
npc.alesar.multi_15: I think he is getting old, entrusting human scum such as you are with an important mission like that. ...
npc.alesar.multi_16: Personally, I don't understand why you haven't been slaughtered right at the gates. ...
npc.alesar.multi_17: Anyway. Are you prepared to embark on a dangerous mission for us?
npc.alesar.multi_19: |PLAYERNAME|, that almost sounded like the word of greeting. Humans - cute they are!
npc.alesar.multi_2: Amazing how you humans are just impossible to get rid of. Incidentally, you have this character trait in common with many insects and with other vermin. ...
npc.alesar.multi_3: Nevermind. I hate to say it, but it you have done us a favour, human. That gemstone will serve us well. ...
npc.alesar.multi_4: Baa'leal, wants you to talk to Malor concerning some new mission. ...
npc.alesar.multi_5: Looks like you have managed to extended your life expectancy - for just a bit longer.
npc.alesar.multi_6: They are precious gemstones made of some unknown blue mineral and possess enormous magical power. ...
npc.alesar.multi_7: If you want to learn more about these gemstones don't forget to visit our library. ...
npc.alesar.multi_8: Anyway, one of them is enough to create thousands of our mighty djinn blades. ...
npc.alesar.multi_9: Unfortunately my last gemstone broke and therefore I'm not able to create new blades anymore. ...
npc.alesar.say_1: Shove off, little one! Humans are not welcome here, |PLAYERNAME|!
npc.alesar.say_2: What do you want from me, |PLAYERNAME|?
npc.alesar.say_3: Did you find the tear of Daraman?
npc.alesar.say_4: Don't forget to talk to Malor concerning your next mission.
npc.alesar.say_6: As I expected. You haven't got the stone. Shall I explain your mission again?
npc.alesar.say_7: As I expected. You haven't got the stone. Shall I explain your mission again?
npc.alesar.say_8: I'm sorry, but you don't have Malor's permission to trade with me.

npc.alexander.stdmod_1: Selling all sorts of magic equipment. Come and have a look
npc.alexander.voice_1: Selling all sorts of magic equipment. Come and have a look
npc.alia.greet_msg_1: Welcome, young |PLAYERNAME|! If you are heavily wounded or poisoned, I can {heal} you for free.
npc.alia.keyword_1: So receive the protection of the twist of fate, pilgrim.
npc.alia.stdmod_1: So receive the protection of the twist of fate, pilgrim.
npc.alia.stdmod_11: You are hurt, my child. I will heal your wounds.
npc.alia.stdmod_12: You aren't looking that bad. Sorry, I can't help you. But if you are looking for additional protection you should go on the {pilgrimage} of ashes or get the protection of the {twist of fate} here.
npc.alia.stdmod_13: Whenever you receive a lethal wound, your vital force is damaged and there is a chance that you lose some of your equipment. With every single of the five {blessings} you have, this damage and chance of loss will be reduced.
npc.alia.stdmod_14: There are five blessings available in five sacred places: the {spiritual} shielding, the spark of the {phoenix}, the {embrace} of Tibia, the fire of the {suns} and the wisdom of {solitude}. Additionally, you can receive the {twist of fate} here.
npc.alia.stdmod_15: I see you received the spiritual shielding in the whiteflower temple south of Thais.
npc.alia.stdmod_16: I can sense that the druids north of Carlin have provided you with the Embrace of Tibia.
npc.alia.stdmod_17: I can see you received the blessing of the two suns in the suntower near Ab'Dendriel.
npc.alia.stdmod_18: I can sense that the spark of the phoenix already was given to you by the dwarven priests of earth and fire in Kazordoon.
npc.alia.stdmod_19: I can sense you already talked to the hermit Eremo on the isle of Cormaya and received this blessing.
npc.alia.stdmod_2: Fine. You are free to decline my offer.
npc.alia.stdmod_20: You can ask for the blessing of spiritual shielding in the whiteflower temple south of Thais.
npc.alia.stdmod_21: The druids north of Carlin will provide you with the embrace of Tibia.
npc.alia.stdmod_22: You can ask for the blessing of the two suns in the suntower near Ab'Dendriel.
npc.alia.stdmod_23: The spark of the phoenix is given by the dwarven priests of earth and fire in Kazordoon.
npc.alia.stdmod_25:
This is a special blessing I can bestow upon you once you have obtained at least one of the other blessings and which functions a bit differently. ... \z
	It only works when you're killed by other adventurers, which means that at least half of the damage leading to your death was caused by others, not by monsters or the environment. ... \z
	The {twist of fate} will not reduce the death penalty like the other blessings, but instead prevent you from losing your other blessings as well as the amulet of loss, should you wear one. It costs the same as the other blessings. ... \z
	Would you like to receive that protection for a sacrifice of |PVPBLESSCOST| gold, child?
npc.alia.stdmod_4: Ah, you want to replace your adventurer's stone for free?
npc.alia.stdmod_7: Ah, you want to replace your adventurer's stone for 30 gold?
npc.alia.stdmod_9: Sorry, you don't have enough money.
npc.alia.walkaway_msg_1: Remember: If you are heavily wounded or poisoned, I can heal you for free.
npc.alkestios.farewell_msg_1: May your path always be even.
npc.alkestios.greet_msg_1: Nature's blessing, traveller! May you not be affected by any sinister force.
npc.alkestios.multi_1: I heard there is a problem with a wolf mother and her whelps. However, I don't know more about it. One of my sisters, Ikassis, has taken over the body of a snake. ...
npc.alkestios.multi_10: You succeeded! It seems the poachers have read your little faked story about killing white deer and the ensuing doom. They stopped chasing me. Thank you! ...
npc.alkestios.multi_11: You proved yourself trustworthy - at least as far as I am concerned. But as I told you I'm actually not a real animal. If you want to enter our hidden island, you must prove that you are also willing to help real animals. Would you do that?
npc.alkestios.multi_2: She knows more about the wolf. Seek her out in the north-west of Edron, near a circle of standing stones.
npc.alkestios.multi_3: Your decision honours you. However, if you consider killing the poachers in question I ask you to halt. We, the fae, are rather peaceful beings and abhor bloodshed. Therefore, we must find another way to solve this problem. ...
npc.alkestios.multi_4: I already have an idea: Some birds told me that poachers are a superstitious lot. Perhaps we can get them with their own misbelief. I know that the poachers have a kind of camp north of the Green Claw Swamps. ...
npc.alkestios.multi_5: Please search it out and examine it closely. Perhaps you will find something you can use against them in order to stop them from hunting white deer.
npc.alkestios.multi_6: I indeed have some troubles since I'm travelling this part of the world. When I took over the body of a white deer I wasn't aware that such an animal is a sought after quarry for hunters and poachers. ...
npc.alkestios.multi_7: Now I'm living in the constant danger of being caught and killed. Of course, I could just take over another animal but this deer has really grown on me. I'd like to help this beautiful stag but I need your assistance. Are you willing to help me?
npc.alkestios.multi_8: I'm very happy that you could help fae and animals alike. You earned our trust and may now visit our secret realm. I marked you with an arcane fae seal. Hereby you will be able to use the elemental shrines strewn about Tibia. ...
npc.alkestios.multi_9: There are fire, ice, energy and earth shrines. If you don't know their locations you can also reach them by most temples in this world. The elemental shrines will transport you to Feyrist now that you bear the magical seal.
npc.alkestios.say_1: Uhmn.. Maybe Ahmet in Ankrahmun can help we to fake this book.
npc.alkestios.say_2: The poachers are still chasing me. Please hurry and find a way to help me.
npc.alkestios.say_3: You have already started this mission.
npc.alkestios.stdmod_1: Outside of our secret {realm} my siblings and I can't keep our true shape. If we want to travel other parts of the world, we must take over the bodies of animals. But we are causing them no harm and we just take control if necessary.
npc.alkestios.stdmod_2: We call it Feyrist and it is a secret, hidden place. Just few mortals get permission to enter it. A long time ago, we learned how to hide our realm from the outside world. Only if you gain our trust I will tell you how to reach it.
npc.alkestios.stdmod_3: We call ourselves the fae. Some name us nature spirits or peri but we prefer the former term. Most of us are rather reclusive and live peaceful lives in our secret realm. We only leave it in order to {protect} our home. ...
npc.alkestios.stdmod_4: We call ourselves the fae. Some name us nature spirits or peri but we prefer the former term. Most of us are rather reclusive and live peaceful lives in our secret realm. We only leave it in order to {protect} our home. ...
npc.alkestios.stdmod_5: I can sense a kind of dark energy lately. It is pervading this world, more and more every day. Yet I don't know where it arises from nor what we could do to dispel it.
npc.alkestios.stdmod_6: It is rather subversive, so most creatures won't sense it ... yet. But its corrosive power has already begun to affect my kind and our hidden realm in unpleasant ways.
npc.alkestios.stdmod_7:
Some call us nature spirits or peri but we prefer the term fae. Most of us are rather reclusive and live peaceful lives in our secret realm. We only leave it in order to protect our home. ... \z
	We tend to be secretive about our true nature, but I guess there was once an elven sage who visited our realm and put his experiences down on paper. There might be a book about the fae in the library of Ab'Dendriel.
npc.alkestios.walkaway_msg_1: May your path always be even.
npc.altar.greet_msg_1: Kneel before the all-devouring power of blooded decay.
npc.altar.say_1: Prepare your offer and cling to the sanctitity of this place.
npc.altar.say_2: Five tainted hearts and five darklight hearts drowned in a worldly wealth of 50000000 gold pieces for the righteous. Are you prepared?
npc.altar.say_3: Sorry, you don't have all items.
npc.altar.say_4: Sorry, you don't have enough gold.
npc.altar.say_5: Your sacrifice has been accepted, mortal. Embrace your reward!

npc.alyxo.say_14: Thanks. I was looking for Lyre for a long time.
npc.alyxo.say_16: Did you manage to find Small Tortoise?
npc.alyxo.say_17: Thanks. I was looking for Small Tortoise.
