npc.alyxo.say_2: Come back as soon as you kill all 3 bosses.
npc.alyxo.say_22: Did you finish the 3 jobs I gave you?
npc.alyxo.say_23: Congratulations, you have completed the 3 jobs I gave you.
npc.alyxo.say_3: Sorry, you do not have access.
npc.alyxo.say_4: Did you manage to face all 3 bosses?
npc.alyxo.say_7: Could you help me with some more work?
npc.alyxo.say_8: Kill 300 members of the Fafnar cult, help me find Ivory Lyre and help me find an animal to stone.
npc.amanda.greet_msg_1: Welcome, young |PLAYERNAME|! If you are heavily wounded or poisoned, I can {heal} you for free.
npc.amanda.keyword_1: So receive the protection of the twist of fate, pilgrim.
npc.amanda.stdmod_1: Well, I would do it myself but I can't leave town for a longer time. Would you be so kind to bring me a vial of holy water from the White Raven Monastery?
npc.amanda.stdmod_10: Ah, you want to replace your adventurer's stone for 30 gold?
npc.amanda.stdmod_12: Sorry, you don't have enough money.
npc.amanda.stdmod_14: I think you have forgotten to bring your stake, my child.
npc.amanda.stdmod_15: Yes, I was informed what to do. Are you prepared to receive my line of the prayer?
npc.amanda.stdmod_16: So receive my prayer: 'Wicked curses shall be broken'. Now, bring your stake to Kasmir in Darashia for the next line of the prayer. I will inform him what to do.
npc.amanda.stdmod_18: You should visit Kasmir in Darashia now, my child.
npc.amanda.stdmod_19: You already received my line of the prayer.
npc.amanda.stdmod_2: I thank you a lot in advance. The power of the holy water from the White Raven Monastery is legendary. For my task it is indispensable. We talk about that when you get back.
npc.amanda.stdmod_20: A blessed stake? That's a strange request. Maybe Quentin knows more, he is one of the oldest monks after all.
npc.amanda.stdmod_21: You are hurt, my child. I will heal your wounds.
npc.amanda.stdmod_22: You aren't looking that bad. Sorry, I can't help you. But if you are looking for additional protection you should go on the {pilgrimage} of ashes or get the protection of the {twist of fate} here.
npc.amanda.stdmod_23: Whenever you receive a lethal wound, your vital force is damaged and there is a chance that you lose some of your equipment. With every single of the five {blessings} you have, this damage and chance of loss will be reduced.
npc.amanda.stdmod_24: There are five blessings available in five sacred places: the {spiritual} shielding, the spark of the {phoenix}, the {embrace} of Tibia, the fire of the {suns} and the wisdom of {solitude}. Additionally, you can receive the {twist of fate} here.
npc.amanda.stdmod_25: I see you received the spiritual shielding in the whiteflower temple south of Thais.
npc.amanda.stdmod_26: I can sense that the druids north of Carlin have provided you with the Embrace of Tibia.
npc.amanda.stdmod_27: I can see you received the blessing of the two suns in the suntower near Ab'Dendriel.
npc.amanda.stdmod_28: I can sense that the spark of the phoenix already was given to you by the dwarven priests of earth and fire in Kazordoon.
npc.amanda.stdmod_29: I can sense you already talked to the hermit Eremo on the isle of Cormaya and received this blessing.
npc.amanda.stdmod_3: It's your decision. I will ask the next believing mind that visits the temple of Banor's blood.
npc.amanda.stdmod_30: You can ask for the blessing of spiritual shielding in the whiteflower temple south of Thais.
npc.amanda.stdmod_31: The druids north of Carlin will provide you with the embrace of Tibia.
npc.amanda.stdmod_32: You can ask for the blessing of the two suns in the suntower near Ab'Dendriel.
npc.amanda.stdmod_33: The spark of the phoenix is given by the dwarven priests of earth and fire in Kazordoon.
npc.amanda.stdmod_35:
This is a special blessing I can bestow upon you once you have obtained at least one of the other blessings and which functions a bit differently. ... \z
	It only works when you're killed by other adventurers, which means that at least half of the damage leading to your death was caused by others, not by monsters or the environment. ... \z
	The {twist of fate} will not reduce the death penalty like the other blessings, but instead prevent you from losing your other blessings as well as the amulet of loss, should you wear one. It costs the same as the other blessings. ... \z
	Would you like to receive that protection for a sacrifice of |PVPBLESSCOST| gold, child?
npc.amanda.stdmod_4: Your mission here on Tibia is to be polite and friendly. The gods will reward you, I promise!
npc.amanda.stdmod_5: So receive the protection of the twist of fate, pilgrim.
npc.amanda.stdmod_6: Fine. You are free to decline my offer.
npc.amanda.stdmod_8: Ah, you want to replace your adventurer's stone for free?
npc.amanda.walkaway_msg_1: Remember: If you are heavily wounded or poisoned, I can heal you for free.
npc.amarie.voice_1: Please leave me alone... I have to study.
npc.ambassador_of_rathleton.say_1: This is a very beautiful ring. Thank you for this generous present!
npc.ambassador_of_rathleton.say_3: I don't need a present right now. Thank you.
npc.ambassador_of_rathleton.voice_1: What a beautiful palace. The Kilmareshians are highly skilful architects.
npc.ambassador_of_rathleton.voice_2: The new treaty of amity and commerce with Kilmaresh is of utmost importance.
npc.ambassador_of_rathleton.voice_3: The pending freight from the saffron coasts is overdue.
npc.amber.greet_msg_1: Oh hello, nice to see you |PLAYERNAME|. Are you here to hear some stories of my {adventures} or do you need {help}?
npc.amber.say_1: Ah, you noticed my new accessory? Sorry, this one is not for sale. It's handmade from rare minotaur leather.
npc.amber.say_10: Great! Alright, I need a while to finish this backpack for you. Come ask me later, okay?
npc.amber.say_11: I know, it's quite some work... don't lose heart, just keep killing minotaurs and you'll eventually get lucky. Would you rather like to buy a normal backpack for 10 gold?
npc.amber.say_2: Ah, right, almost forgot about the backpack! Have you brought me 100 pieces of minotaur leather as requested?
npc.amber.say_3: Just in time! Your backpack is finished. Here you go, I hope you like it.
npc.amber.say_4: Uh... I didn't expect you to return that early. Sorry, but I'm not finished yet with your backpack. I'm doing the best I can, promised.
npc.amber.say_5: Sorry, but I can only make one backpack per person, else I'd have to close my shop and open a leather manufactory.
npc.amber.say_6: Well, if you really like this backpack, I could make one for you, but minotaur leather is hard to come by these days. Are you willing to put some work into this?
npc.amber.say_7: Alright then, if you bring me 100 pieces of fine minotaur leather I will see what I can do for you. You probably have to kill really many minotaurs though... so good luck!
npc.amber.say_8: Sorry, but I don't run a welfare office, you know... no pain, no gain.
npc.amber.say_9: Sorry, but that's not enough leather yet to make one of these backpacks. Would you rather like to buy a normal backpack for 10 gold?
npc.amber.stdmod_1: I wish I could eat some salmon right now... best prepared in Liberty Bay style... yummy.
npc.amber.stdmod_10: My voyage on the sea was exhausting. The weather was bad, the waves high and my raft quite simple. There's a certain excitement to it, though.
npc.amber.stdmod_11: Sorry, I lost my watch in a storm.
npc.amber.stdmod_12: Well, I can give you general {hints} or tell you about my {adventures} and many other topics. Oh, and if you are bored, I might have a small {quest} for you.
npc.amber.stdmod_13: Well, I can give you general {hints} or tell you about my {adventures} and many other topics. Oh, and if you are bored, I might have a small {quest} for you.
npc.amber.stdmod_14: I had no time to explore the dungeons of this isle yet, but I've seen two big caves in the East, and there is a ruined tower to the north-west. Oh, and there're the {sewers}.
npc.amber.stdmod_15: I like sewers. I made my very first battle experience in the sewers below {Thais}. The small sewer system of {Rookgaard} has some nasty rats to fight.
npc.amber.stdmod_16: Oh, I fought {orcs}, {cyclopses}, {minotaurs}, even {dragons}, and many other creatures.
npc.amber.stdmod_17: I don't like the way they look at you. Their eye seems to pierce right through you. Creepy!
npc.amber.stdmod_18: Their breath is so hot! I had to cut my hair after my last encounter with a dragon because the ends were all burnt. That's what you gotta deal with as a female adventurer!
npc.amber.stdmod_19: I left my raft at the south-eastern shore. I forgot my private {notebook} on it. If you could return it to me, I would be very grateful.
npc.amber.stdmod_2: Wow, I'm tired. I really should get some sleep... zzzz.
npc.amber.stdmod_20: I left my raft at the south-eastern shore. I forgot my private {notebook} on it. If you could return it to me, I would be very grateful.
npc.amber.stdmod_21: I left my raft at the south-eastern shore. I forgot my private {notebook} on it. If you could return it to me, I would be very grateful.
npc.amber.stdmod_22: I think this poor guy was a bad choice as head of the {academy}.
npc.amber.stdmod_23: A fine institution, but it needs definitely more funds from the {king}.
npc.amber.stdmod_24: King Tibianus is the ruler of {Thais}. The island of {Rookgaard} belongs to his kingdom.
npc.amber.stdmod_25: A fine city, but the {king} has some problems enforcing the law.
npc.amber.stdmod_26: The best weapons on this isle are just toothpicks compared with the weapons warriors wield on the {mainland}.
npc.amber.stdmod_27: Spells are only taught in the guildhalls of the mainland.
npc.amber.stdmod_28: I'm trying to explore each spot of Tibia, and one day I'll have seen it all.
npc.amber.stdmod_29: If you travel to Thais, you really should visit the marvelous castle there.
npc.amber.stdmod_3: What was that word again in Orcish language... hmm.
npc.amber.stdmod_30: You'll be surprised once you leave this island. The world outside there is gigantic.
npc.amber.stdmod_31: The most important tools you need are a {rope}, a {shovel} and maybe a {torch}.
npc.amber.stdmod_32: One day I fell into a hole without having a rope. I was yelling for help for three whole days! Eventually a fisherman passed by and pulled me out with his own rope, lucky me.
npc.amber.stdmod_33: Sometimes I have the strong urge to use it to knock someone out.
npc.amber.stdmod_34: You know, on mainland you will be able to cast magic spells which provide you with light. You won't really need torches anymore.
npc.amber.stdmod_35: I have almost no money with me anyway, so no need to deposit any at the bank.
npc.amber.stdmod_36: You will find your destiny. I'm sure it's something big and important.
npc.amber.stdmod_37: A fine institution, but it needs definitely more funds from the {king}.
npc.amber.stdmod_38: Oh, I'm sorry, but I'm not interested in buying or selling anything.
npc.amber.stdmod_39: I wouldn't want to miss being a premium adventurer. Everything is so much easier!
npc.amber.stdmod_4: Hey you! Are you an adventurer, too?
npc.amber.stdmod_40: I don't have much to say about him. I think he sells {tools}.
npc.amber.stdmod_42: She seriously asked me if she could have the remains of my {raft} as fire wood! Can you imagine that??
npc.amber.stdmod_44: Did you know my name is also the name of a gem?
npc.amber.stdmod_45: To me he seems a bit rude, but maybe that's just my impression.
npc.amber.stdmod_46: I heard her offers are extraordinarily good.
npc.amber.stdmod_47: The oracle is said to show you your {destiny} once you are level 8.
npc.amber.stdmod_48: She has changed a lot since I last saw her.
npc.amber.stdmod_49: I think this poor guy was a bad choice as head of the {academy}.
npc.amber.stdmod_5: <sings> Stormy weathers, stormy weathers... stormy weathers on the sea!
npc.amber.stdmod_50: Hm, I think I haven't met her yet.
npc.amber.stdmod_51: He brought me some of his famous rat stew. I really didn't want to insult him, but I simply can't eat something like that. So I told him I'm a vegetarian and I only eat fish. <gulps>
npc.amber.stdmod_52: He's funny in his own way.
npc.amber.stdmod_53: No, I didn't go to the {bank} yet.
npc.amber.stdmod_54: A gentle person. You should visit him if you have questions or need healing.
npc.amber.stdmod_55: Hyacinth is a great healer. He lives somewhere hidden on this isle.
npc.amber.stdmod_57: I don't really know her, but she seems to be a nice girl.
npc.amber.stdmod_58: An extraordinary warrior. He's the first and last line of defense of {Rookgaard}.
npc.amber.stdmod_59: Not the nicest guys you can encounter. I had some clashes with them and finally ended up being their {prisoner} for a few months.
npc.amber.stdmod_60: I speak some Orcish words, not many though, just a few basics like '{yes}' and '{no}'.
npc.amber.stdmod_61: It's 'mok' in Orcish. I tell you more if you bring me some {food}.
npc.amber.stdmod_62: In Orcish that's 'burp'. I tell you more if you bring me some {food}.
npc.amber.stdmod_63: My favorite dish is {salmon}. Oh please, bring me some.
npc.amber.stdmod_64: Yeah! If you give me some salmon, I'll tell you another Orcish word. Okay?
npc.amber.stdmod_9: I fought fierce {monsters}, climbed the highest mountains, explored the deepest {dungeons} and crossed the {sea} on a {raft}.
npc.amber.voice_1: I wish I could eat some salmon right now... best prepared in Liberty Bay style... yummy.
npc.amber.voice_2: Wow, I'm tired. I really should get some sleep... zzzz.
npc.amber.voice_3: What was that word again in Orcish language... hmm.
npc.amber.voice_4: Hey you! Are you an adventurer, too?
npc.amber.voice_5: <sings> Stormy weathers, stormy weathers... stormy weathers on the sea!
npc.an_old_dragon_lord.say_1: LEAVE THE DRAGONS' CEMETERY AT ONCE!
npc.an_old_dragon_lord.say_2: LEAVE THE DRAGONS' CEMETERY AT ONCE!
npc.an_old_dragon_lord.say_3: AHHHH THE PAIN OF AGESSS! I NEED MUSSSSHRROOOMSSS TO EASSSE MY PAIN! BRRRING ME MUSHRRROOOMSSS!
npc.an_old_dragon_lord.say_4: AHHH MUSHRRROOOMSSS! NOW MY PAIN WILL BE EASSSED FOR A WHILE! TAKE THISS AND LEAVE THE DRAGONSSS' CEMETERY AT ONCE!
npc.an_old_dragon_lord.voice_1: AHHHH THE PAIN OF AGESSS! THE PAIN!
npc.anderson.greet_msg_1: Ahoi, young man |PLAYERNAME| and welcome to the Nordic Tibia Ferries. If you need a {passage}, let me know.
npc.anderson.stdmod_2: Do you want a passage to {0} for {1}?
npc.anderson.stdmod_5: Where do you want to go today? We serve the routes to Senja, {Folda} and {Vega} and back to {Tibia}.
npc.anderson.voice_1: Passages to Tibia, Folda and Vega.
npc.andrew_lyze.greet_msg_1: Hello, I am the warden of this {monument}. The {sarcophagus} in front of you was established to prevent people from going {down} there. But I doubt that this step is sufficient.
npc.andrew_lyze.greet_msg_2: Well, let's see if your mission was successful. Just bring me all needed {materials}.
npc.andrew_lyze.greet_msg_3: If you dug up all three crystals of sufficient quantity and obtained the poison gland, the charging of your compass can start! For the very first time it will be charged by the violet crystal. Ready to {unleash} the power of the crystals?
npc.andrew_lyze.multi_1: I put these crystals onto the top of compass. As you can see, the compass is now pulsating in a warm, violet colour. ...
npc.andrew_lyze.multi_10: Well, a while ago powerful magic devices were used all around Tibia. These are chargeable compasses. There was but one problem: they offered the possibility to make people rich in a quite easy way. ...
npc.andrew_lyze.multi_11: Therefore, these instruments were very coveted. People tried to get their hands on them at all costs. And so it happened what everybody feared - bloody battles forged ahead. ...
npc.andrew_lyze.multi_12: To put an end to these cruel escalations, eventually all of the devices were collected and destroyed. The remains were buried {deep} in the earth.
npc.andrew_lyze.multi_2: Now this compass is ready for usage. It can transfer the bound energy to other inanimate objects to open certain gates or chests.
npc.andrew_lyze.multi_3: Nice! To do so, take this golden axe and mine the prominent crystals in the cave. Besides, I need a poison gland of quite rare spiders, they are called lucifuga araneae. ...
npc.andrew_lyze.multi_4: These are quite shy, but I have a {bait} for you to lure them. But take care not to face too many of them at once. And hurry, the effect won't last forever!
npc.andrew_lyze.multi_5: Alright, I put the glasses into the right pattern and can repair the compass. ...
npc.andrew_lyze.multi_6: There we are! The next step is the charging of the compass. For this you have to dig three different crystals down there: 5 blue, 3 green and one violet crystal. Are you ready to do that?
npc.andrew_lyze.multi_7: I can repair the compass for you if you deliver what I need. Besides the broken compass you have to bring me the following materials: 50 blue glas plates, 15 green glas plates and 5 violet glas plates. ...
npc.andrew_lyze.multi_8: They all can be found in this closed cave in front of you. I should have destroyed this seal key but things have changed. The entrance is opened now, go down and do what has to be done.
npc.andrew_lyze.multi_9: They all can be found in this closed cave in front of you. I should have destroyed this seal key but things have changed. The entrance is opened now, go down and do what has to be done.
npc.andrew_lyze.say_1: As far as I know it is a place of helish heat with bloodthirsty monsters of all kinds.
npc.andrew_lyze.say_12: It was decided to collect all of the compasses, destroy them and throw them in the fiery depths of Tibia. I still have some of them here. I {sell} them for a low price if you want.
npc.andrew_lyze.say_13: Would you like to buy a broken compass for 10.000 gold?
npc.andrew_lyze.say_2: This sarcophagus seals the entrance to the caves down there. Only here you can get all the {materials} you need for a working compass of this kind. So no entrance here - no further magic compasses in Tibia. In theory.
npc.andrew_lyze.say_3: On first glance, this cave does not look very spectacular, but the things you find in there, are. You have to know that this is the only place where you can find the respective materials to build the compass.
npc.andrew_lyze.say_4: May I repair your compass if possible?
npc.andrew_lyze.say_5: You don't have the needed itens yet.
npc.andrew_lyze.say_8: You don't have the needed itens yet.
npc.andrew_lyze.say_9: Done. Worry, the effect won't last forever!
npc.anerui.stdmod_1: I am the mistress of the hunt. At this place you may buy the food our hunts provide.
npc.anerui.stdmod_10: The balance of nature, of course. It's everywhere, so don't ask but observe and learn.
npc.anerui.stdmod_11: We try to live in harmony with the forces of nature, may they be living or unliving.
npc.anerui.stdmod_12: The humans are a loud and ugly race. They lack any grace and are more kin to the orcs then to us.
npc.anerui.stdmod_13: Life and death are significant parts of the balance.
npc.anerui.stdmod_14: Life and death are significant parts of the balance.
npc.anerui.stdmod_15: I despise their presence in our town, but it may be a necessary evil.
npc.anerui.stdmod_16: That is the race to which I belong.
npc.anerui.stdmod_17: The magic they wield is all that matters to them.
npc.anerui.stdmod_2: Hunting is an art, practiced too often by diletantes. Every fool with a bow or a spear considers himself a hunter.
npc.anerui.stdmod_3: Bow, arrow, and spear are the hunters' best friends. In the northeast of the town one of us may sell such tools.
npc.anerui.stdmod_4: Hunters live a life of freedom and closeness to nature, unlike a simple farmer or bugherder.
npc.anerui.stdmod_5: Nature is not a friend but an unforgiving teacher, and the lessons we have to learn are endless.
npc.anerui.stdmod_6: Watch the sky, it will tell you.
npc.anerui.stdmod_7: I guess it's a human god for the human sight of nature. I have not much knowledge of this entity.
npc.anerui.stdmod_8: If they ever existed they are gone now.
npc.anerui.stdmod_9: The Kuridai are too agressive not only to people but also to the enviroment. They lack any understanding of the balance that we know as nature.
npc.aneus.farewell_msg_1: Good bye and take care of you!
npc.aneus.greet_msg_1: Greetings adventurer |PLAYERNAME|. What leads you to me?
npc.aneus.multi_1: They used the same trick as against the Red Legion and the orcs ... <m>
npc.aneus.multi_10: It is said that the orcish shamans cursed the Red Legion. <m>
npc.aneus.multi_11: Nobody knows. But one third of the soldiers died by a disease on the way back. <m>
npc.aneus.multi_12: And the orcs wanted to take revenge, and after some days they stroke back! <m>
npc.aneus.multi_13: The orcs and many allied cyclopses and minotaurs from all ...<m>
npc.aneus.multi_14: ... over Tibia came to avenge their friends, and they killed nearly all ... <m>
npc.aneus.multi_15: ... workers and soldiers in the castle. The HELP of the king's sister came too late.
npc.aneus.multi_16: Most of the Red Legion went to the island by night. The orcs ... <m>
npc.aneus.multi_17: ... were not prepared and the Red Legion killed hundreds of orcs ... <m>
npc.aneus.multi_18: ... with nearly no loss. After they were satisfied they WALKED BACK to the castle.
npc.aneus.multi_19: She ordered her loyal druids and hunters to disguise themselves ... <m>
npc.aneus.multi_2: ... started to fight their non-orcish-allies. After a bloody long fight ... <m>
npc.aneus.multi_20: ... as orcs from the near ISLAND and to ATTACK the Red Legion by night over and over again.
npc.aneus.multi_21: The king's sister was pretty upset about the situation there but her brother ... <m>
npc.aneus.multi_22: ... didn't want to do anything about this matter. So she made a PLAN to destroy the Red Legion for their CRUELTY forever.
npc.aneus.multi_23: All rebels were brought to the giant castle. Guarded by the Red Legion, ... <m>
npc.aneus.multi_24: ... they had to work and live in even worser conditions. Also some FRIENDS of the king's sister were brought there.
npc.aneus.multi_25: The development of the city was fine. Also a giant castle was build ... <m>
npc.aneus.multi_26: ... northeast of the city. But more and more workers started to REBEL because of the bad conditions.
npc.aneus.multi_27: The works on this new city began and the king sent his best ... <m>
npc.aneus.multi_28: ... SOLDIERS to protect the workers from ORCS and to make them WORK HARDER.
npc.aneus.multi_29: Ok, sit down and listen. Back in the early days, one of the ancestors ... <press m for more>
npc.aneus.multi_3: ... the orcs went back to their cities. The city of Carlin was rescued. <m>
npc.aneus.multi_30: ... of our king Tibianus III wanted to build the best CITY in whole of Tibia.
npc.aneus.multi_4: Since then, a woman has always been ruling over Carlin and this statue ... <m>
npc.aneus.multi_5: ... was made to remind us of their great tactics against the orcs ... <m>
npc.aneus.multi_6: ... and the Red Legion. So that was the story of Carlin and these Fields of Glory. I hope you liked it. *He smiles*
npc.aneus.multi_7: She tried to rescue the workers but it was too late. The orcs ... <m>
npc.aneus.multi_8: ... started immediately to attack her troops, too. Her royal troops ... <m>
npc.aneus.multi_9: ... went back to the city. A TRICK saved the city from DESTRUCTION.
npc.aneus.stdmod_1: It was the elite of the whole army. They were called the Red Legion (also known as the bloody legion).
npc.aneus.stdmod_2: The orcs attacked the workers from time to time and so they disturbed the WORKS on the city.
npc.aneus.stdmod_3: The soldiers treated the workers like slaves.
npc.aneus.stdmod_4: The General of the Red Legion became very angry about these attacks and after some months he STROKE back!
npc.angelina.greet_msg_1: The gods must be praised that I am finally saved. I do not have many worldly possessions, but please accept a small reward, do you?
npc.angelina.greet_msg_2: Thanks for saving my life! Should I teleport you out of the Dark Cathedral?
npc.angelina.say_1: I will tell you a small secret now. My friend Lynda in Thais can create a blessed wand. Greet her from me, maybe she will aid you.
npc.angelo.greet_msg_1: The Druid of Crunor? He told you that a new cave appeared here? That's right. I'm the head of a {project} that tries to find out more about this new {area}.
npc.angelo.greet_msg_2: Just get out of my way! You killed this beautiful creature. I have nothing more to say. Damn druid of Crunor!
npc.angelo.greet_msg_4: The Druid of Crunor? He told you that a new cave appeared here? That's right. I'm the head of a project that tries to find out more about this new area.
npc.angelo.say_1: The scientists are still missing? You just found some strange green shining mummies and a big oasis? I give you this analysis tool for the water of the oasis. Maybe that's the key. Could you bring me a sample of this water?
npc.angelo.say_10: MoTA is short for the recently founded Museum of Tibian Arts. We work together in close collaboration. New {results} are communicated to the museum instantly.
npc.angelo.say_11: We have no scientific results so far to reach our {goal}, because my workers aren't back yet. Should I be {worried}?
npc.angelo.say_12: Then I have to find out why they don't return. But I'm old and my back aches. Would you like to go there and look for my workers?
npc.angelo.say_13: Fantastic! Go there and then tell me what you've seen. I've opened the door for you. Take care of yourself!
npc.angelo.say_14: We don't know exactly why this cave has now exposed an entry via the {dark pyramid}. It seems that the cave already existed for a long time, however, without a connection to our world. Maybe some smaller earth movements have changed the situation.
npc.angelo.say_15: We don't know yet to wich extent the cave and the dark pyramid belong together. Thisi s what we try to find out. Maybe the history of this place has to be rewritten.
npc.angelo.say_2: Very good. Hopefully analysing this sample will get us closer to the solution of this mistery.
npc.angelo.say_3: Do you have the sample I asked you for?
npc.angelo.say_4: Thanks a lot. Let me check the result. Well, I think you need the counteragent. Please apply it to the oasis!
npc.angelo.say_5: What has happened? You applied the counteragent to the oasis and then it was destroyed by a sandstorm? Keep on investigating the place.
npc.angelo.say_6: Just get out of my way! You killed this beautiful creature. I have nothing more to say. Damn druid of Crunor!
npc.angelo.say_7: {Gareth} told you that there are rumours about fake artefacts in the MoTA? And it is your task to check that with a magnifier? I see. I don't need one right now, so you can have one of mine. You find one in the crate over there.
npc.angelo.say_8: So you found out that one artefact in the MoTA is fake? And {Gareth} sent you to me to get a new artefact as a replacement? Sorry, I hardly know you so I don't trust you. I won't help you with that!
npc.angelo.say_9: The project is called 'Sandy {Cave} Project' and is funded by the {MoTA}. Its goal is the investigation of this {cave}.
npc.angus.greet_msg_1: Greetings, what can I do for you?
npc.angus.multi_1: Our members travel to far away places and cross dangerous areas, many fall prey to enemies or the land ...
npc.angus.multi_10: Do you think you are ready for that mission?
npc.angus.multi_11: Fine, though it takes more then a mere lip service to join our ranks. To prove your dedication to the cause you will have to acquire an item for us ...
npc.angus.multi_12: The mission should be simple to fulfil. For our excavations we have ordered a sturdy pickaxe in Kazordoon. You would have to seek out this trader Uzgod and get the pickaxe for us ...
npc.angus.multi_13: Simple enough? Are you interested in this task?
npc.angus.multi_14: We would like to study some ancient runes that were used by the lizard race. We suspect some relation of the lizards to the founders of Ankrahmun ...
npc.angus.multi_15: Somewhere under the ape infested city of Banuta, one can find dungeons that were once inhabited by lizards...
npc.angus.multi_16: Look there for an atypical structure that would rather fit to Ankrahmun and its Ankrahmun Tombs. Copy the runes you will find on this structure...
npc.angus.multi_17: Are you up to that challenge?
npc.angus.multi_18: We acquired some knowledge about special magic stones. Some lost civilisations used it to store knowledge and lore, just like we use books ...
npc.angus.multi_19: The wisdom in such stones must be immense, but so are the dangers faced by every person who tries to obtain one...
npc.angus.multi_2: Sometimes the personal explorer brooches can be recovered. That way we learn about the fate of our members ...
npc.angus.multi_20: As far as we know the ruins found in the north-west of Edron were once inhabited by beings who used such stones. Do you have the heart to go there and to get us such a stone?
npc.angus.multi_21: Some high ranking members would like to study elven poetry. They want the rare book 'Songs of the Forest' ...
npc.angus.multi_22: For sure someone in Ab'Dendriel will own a copy. So you would just have to ask around there. Are you willing to accept this mission?
npc.angus.multi_23: We want to learn more about the ancient race of bonelords. We believe the black pyramid north east of Darashia was originally built by them ...
npc.angus.multi_24: We ask you to explore the ruins of the black pyramid and look for any signs that prove our theory. You might probably find some document with the numeric bonelord language ...
npc.angus.multi_25: That would be sufficient proof. Would you like to accept this mission?
npc.angus.multi_26: Both carvings are now charged and harmonised. In theory you should be able to travel in zero time from one base to the other ...
npc.angus.multi_27: However, you will need to have an orichalcum pearl in your possession to use it as power source. It will be destroyed during the process. I will give you 6 of such pearls and you can buy new ones in our bases ...
npc.angus.multi_28: In addition, you need to be a premium explorer to use the astral travel. ...
npc.angus.multi_29: And remember: it's a small teleport for you, but a big teleport for all Tibians! Here is a small present for your efforts!
npc.angus.multi_3: We offer a reward for each brooch returned to us. Have you found an explorer brooch?
npc.angus.multi_30: Those stories are just amazing! Men with faces on their stomach instead of heads you say? And hens that lay golden eggs? Whereas, most amazing is this fountain of youth you've mentioned! ...
npc.angus.multi_31: I'll immediately send some of our most dedicated explorers to check those things out!
npc.angus.multi_4: Ratha was a great explorer and even greater ladies' man. Sadly he never returned from a visit to the amazons. Probably he is dead ...
npc.angus.multi_5: The society offers a substantial reward for the retrieval of Ratha or his remains. Do you have any news about Ratha?
npc.angus.multi_6: That is quite courageous. We know, it's much we are asking for. The queen of the banshees lives in the so called Ghostlands, south west of Carlin. It is rumoured that her lair is located in the deepest dungeons beneath that cursed place ...
npc.angus.multi_7: Any violence will probably be futile, you will have to negotiate with her. Try to get a spectral dress from her. Good luck.
npc.angus.multi_8: Fine. The society is looking for new means to travel. Some of our most brilliant minds have some theories about astral travel that they want to research further ...
npc.angus.multi_9: Therefore we need you to collect some ectoplasm from the corpse of a ghost. We will supply you with a collector that you can use on the body of a slain ghost ...
npc.angus.say_1: Do you want to join the explorer society?
npc.angus.say_10: Do you have some collected ectoplasm with you?
npc.angus.say_11: The research on ectoplasm makes good progress. Now we need some spectral article. Our scientists think a spectral dress would be a perfect object for their studies ...
npc.angus.say_12: Have you acquired the spectral dress we need?
npc.angus.say_13: With the objects you've provided our researchers will make steady progress. Still we are missing some test results from fellow explorers ...
npc.angus.say_14: Oh, yes! Tell our fellow explorer that the papers are in the mail already.
npc.angus.say_15: The reports from Northport have already arrived here and our progress is astonishing. We think it is possible to create an astral bridge between our bases. Are you interested to assist us with this?
npc.angus.say_16: Did you get the requested pickaxe from Uzgod in Kazordoon?
npc.angus.say_17: Our finest minds came up with the theory that deep beneath the ice island of Folda ice can be found that is ancient. To prove this theory we would need a sample of the aforesaid ice ...
npc.angus.say_18: Did you get the ice we are looking for?
npc.angus.say_19: The mission asks you to collect some species of butterflies, are you interested?
npc.angus.say_2: Oh yes, an interesting topic. We had vivid discussions about this discovery. But what is it that you want?
npc.angus.say_20: Did you acquire the purple butterfly we are looking for?
npc.angus.say_21: This preparation kit will allow you to collect a blue butterfly you have killed ...
npc.angus.say_22: Did you acquire the blue butterfly we are looking for?
npc.angus.say_23: This preparation kit will allow you to collect a red butterfly you have killed ...
npc.angus.say_24: Did you acquire the red butterfly we are looking for?
npc.angus.say_25: In this mission we require you to get us some plant samples from Tiquandan plants. Would you like to fulfil this mission?
npc.angus.say_26: Did you acquire the sample of the jungle bells plant we are looking for?
npc.angus.say_27: Use this botanist's container on a witches cauldron to collect a sample for us. Bring it here and report about your plant collection.
npc.angus.say_28: Did you acquire the sample of the witches cauldron we are looking for?
npc.angus.say_29: Use this botanist's container on a giant jungle rose to obtain a sample for us. Bring it here and report about your plant collection.
npc.angus.say_3: You bring up this topic again? I don't think our talks make any sense unless you prove that you are a supporter of science. Do you have some proof for your dedication to science?
npc.angus.say_30: Did you acquire the sample of the giant jungle rose we are looking for?
npc.angus.say_31: The explorer society would like to acquire an ancient urn which is some sort of relic to the lizard people of Tiquanda. Would you like to accept this mission?
npc.angus.say_32: Did you manage to get the ancient urn?
npc.angus.say_33: Have you found any proof that the pyramid was built by bonelords?
npc.angus.say_34: It is commonly known that orcs of Uldereks Rock use some sort of powder to increase the fierceness of their war wolves and berserkers ...
npc.angus.say_35: Did you acquire some of the orcish powder?
npc.angus.say_36: Did you acquire a copy of 'Songs of the Forest' for us?
npc.angus.say_37: Were you able to acquire a memory stone for our society?
npc.angus.say_38: Did you create a copy of the ancient runes as requested?
npc.angus.say_39: We will see if you can handle this simple task. Get the pickaxe from Uzgod in Kazordoon and bring it to one of our bases. Report there about the pickaxe.
npc.angus.say_4: A whole new land is indeed very tempting. I can hardly imagine all the wonders that await us there. I doubt I could stop our explorers from going there even if I tried to.
npc.angus.say_40: Excellent, you brought just the tool we need! Of course it was only a simple task. However ...
npc.angus.say_41: So listen please: Take this ice pick and use it on a block of ice in the caves beneath Folda. Get some ice and bring it here as fast as you can ...
npc.angus.say_42: Just in time. Sadly not much ice is left over but it will do. Thank you again.
npc.angus.say_43: *Sigh* I think the time is right to grant you another chance to get that ice. Hurry up this time.
npc.angus.say_44: This preparation kit will allow you to collect a purple butterfly you have killed ...
npc.angus.say_45: A little bit battered but it will do. Thank you! If you think you are ready, ask for another butterfly hunt.
npc.angus.say_46: A little bit battered but it will do. Thank you! If you think you are ready, ask for another butterfly hunt.
npc.angus.say_47: That is an extraordinary species you have brought. Thank you! That was the last butterfly we needed.
npc.angus.say_48: Fine! Here take this botanist's container. Use it on a jungle bells plant to collect a sample for us. Report about your plant collection when you have been successful.
npc.angus.say_49: I see. It seems you've got some quite useful sample by sheer luck. Thank you! Just tell me when you are ready to continue with the plant collection.
npc.angus.say_5: For all I've heard, this is rather a barren isle than a whole new land. There are so many places to explore in this world, I won't send our best explorers on account of a rumour.
npc.angus.say_50: Ah, finally. I started to wonder what took you so long. But thank you! Another fine sample, indeed. Just tell me when you are ready to continue with the plant collection.
npc.angus.say_51: What a lovely sample! With that you have finished your plant collection missions.
npc.angus.say_52: You have indeed the spirit of an adventurer! In the south-east of Tiquanda is a small settlement of the lizard people ...
npc.angus.say_53: Yes, that is the prized relic we have been looking for so long. You did a great job, thank you.
npc.angus.say_54: Excellent! So travel to the city of Darashia and then head north-east for the pyramid ...
npc.angus.say_55: You did it! Excellent! The scientific world will be shaken by this discovery!
npc.angus.say_56: You are a brave soul. As far as we can tell, the orcs maintain some sort of training facility in some hill in the north-east of their city ...
npc.angus.say_57: You really got it? Amazing! Thank you for your efforts.
npc.angus.say_58: Excellent. This mission is easy but nonetheless vital. Travel to Ab'Dendriel and get the book.
npc.angus.say_59: Let me have a look! Yes, that's what we wanted. A copy of 'Songs of the Forest'. I won't ask any questions about those bloodstains.
npc.angus.say_6: The missions available for your rank are the {butterfly hunt}, {plant collection} and {ice delivery}.
npc.angus.say_60: In the ruins of north-western Edron you should be able to find a memory stone. Good luck.
npc.angus.say_61: A flawless memory stone! Incredible! It will take years even to figure out how it works but what an opportunity for science, thank you!
npc.angus.say_62: Excellent! Here, take this tracing paper and use it on the object you will find there to create a copy of the ancient runes.
npc.angus.say_63: It's a bit wrinkled but it will do. Thanks again.
npc.angus.say_64: Good! Take this container and use it on a ghost that was recently slain. Return with the collected ectoplasm and hand me that container ...
npc.angus.say_65: Don't lose the container. They are expensive!
npc.angus.say_66: Phew, I had no idea that ectoplasm would smell that ... oh, it's you, well, sorry. Thank you for the ectoplasm.
npc.angus.say_67: Just in time! With this spectral article we can start the final phase of our research.
npc.angus.say_69: Poor Ratha. Thank you for returning this skull to the society. We will see to a honourable burial of Ratha.
npc.angus.say_7: The missions available for your rank are {lizard urn}, {bonelord secrets} and {orc powder}.
npc.angus.say_70: Come back when you find any information.
npc.angus.say_71: Marvellous! You brought a giant smith hammer for the explorer society!
npc.angus.say_73: What a strange map. I wonder if any of our explorers recognises this coastal lines. However, you earned yourself another chance to convince me. Why do you think that Farmine would be interesting for us?
npc.angus.say_74: It's always a sad day when we learn about the death of a member. But at least we learnt about his fate. Thank you, here is your reward.
npc.angus.say_76: Come back when you find any information.
npc.angus.say_77: Come back when you find one.
npc.angus.say_78: The explorer society is looking for a genuine giant smith hammer for our collection. It is rumoured the cyclopses of the Plains of Havoc might be using one. Did you by chance obtain such a hammer?
npc.angus.say_8: The missions available for your rank are {elven poetry}, {memory stone} and {rune writings}.
npc.angus.say_9: The explorer society needs a great deal of help in the research of astral travel. Are you willing to help?
npc.angus.say_spectral_1: Good, just take this spectral essence and use it on the strange carving in this building as well as on the corresponding tile in our base at Northport ...
npc.angus.say_spectral_2: As soon as you have charged the portal tiles that way, report about the spectral portals.
npc.appaloosa.greet_msg_1: Salutations, |PLAYERNAME| I guess you are here for the {horses}.
npc.appaloosa.say_1: We can bring you to Thais with one of our coaches for 125 gold. Are you interested?
npc.appaloosa.say_2: Do you want to rent a horse for one day at a price of 500 gold?
npc.appaloosa.say_3: First get rid of those blood stains!
npc.appaloosa.say_7: You do not have enough money to rent a horse!
npc.appaloosa.say_8: I'll give you one of our experienced ones. Take care! Look out for low hanging branches.
npc.archery.farewell_msg_1: Please come back from time to time.
npc.archery.stdmod_1: Come into my tavern and share some stories!
npc.archery.voice_1: Come into my tavern and share some stories!
npc.archery.walkaway_msg_1: Please come back from time to time.
npc.archery_rook.farewell_msg_1: Please come back from time to time.

npc.archery_rook.voice_1: Come into my tavern and share some stories!
npc.archery_rook.walkaway_msg_1: Please come back from time to time.
npc.ariella.multi_1: The sailors always tell tales about the famous beer of Carlin. You must know, alcohol is forbidden in that city. ...
npc.ariella.multi_2: The beer is served in a secret whisper bar anyway. Bring me a sample of the whisper beer, NOT the usual beer but whisper beer. I hope you are listening.
npc.ariella.say_1: So you brought a cookie to a pirate?
npc.ariella.say_10: Come back when you got all neccessary items.
npc.ariella.say_11: Thank you very much. I will test this beauty in privacy.
npc.ariella.say_12: Come back when you got the neccessary item.
npc.ariella.say_13: INCREDIBLE! You have found all four of them! |PLAYERNAME|, you have my respect. You more than deserve this hat. There you go.
npc.ariella.say_14: You do not have all the required items.
npc.ariella.say_16: Alright then. Come back when you got all neccessary items.
npc.ariella.say_2: You mean my hat? Well, I might have another one just like that, but I won't simply give it away, even if you earned our trust. You'd have to fulfil a task first.
npc.ariella.say_3: Your task is to bring me the shirt of the Lethal Lissy, the sabre of Ron the Ripper, the hat of Brutus Bloodbeard and the eye patch of Deadeye Devious. Did you succeed?
npc.ariella.say_4: You know, we have plenty of rum here but we lack some basic food. Especially food that easily becomes mouldy is a problem. Bring me 100 breads and you will help me a lot.
npc.ariella.say_5: Are you here to bring me the 100 pieces of bread that I requested?
npc.ariella.say_6: Did you get a sample of the whisper beer from Carlin?
npc.ariella.say_7: You have no cookie that I'd like.
npc.ariella.say_8: How sweet of you ... Uhh ... OH NO ... Bozo did it again. Tell this prankster I'll pay him back.
npc.ariella.say_9: What a joy. At least for a few days adequate supply is ensured.
npc.ariella.voice_1: Have a drink in Meriana's only tavern!
npc.arito.greet_msg_1: Thank god you are back!! Did you find....err...what we were talking about??
npc.arito.multi_1: Thank you thousand times! Well, I think I start telling you what I think they are after...
npc.arito.multi_2: You have to know, I was one of them before I opened that shop here. Sure they fear about their hideout being revealed by me. Please go to the north, there is a small cave in the mountains with a rock in the middle. ...
npc.arito.multi_3: If you stand in front of it, place a scimitar - which is the weapon of the nomads - left of you and make a sacrifice to the earth by pouring some water on the floor to your right. ...
npc.arito.multi_4: The entrance to their hideout will be revealed in front of you. I don't know who is in charge there right now but please tell him that I won't spoil their secret...
npc.arito.multi_5: ... well, I just told you but anyway .... I won't tell it to anybody else. Now hurry up before they get here!!
npc.arito.multi_6: What?? My name on a deathlist which you retrieved from a nomad?? Show me!! ...
npc.arito.multi_7: Oh my god! They found me! You must help me! Please !!!! Are you willing to do that?
npc.arito.say_1: And what did they say?? Do I have to give up everything here? Come on tell me!!
npc.arito.say_2: These are great news!! Thank you for your help! I don't have much, but without you I wouldn't have anything so please take this as a reward.
npc.arito.voice_1: Come in, have a drink and something to eat.
npc.arkulius.farewell_msg_1: At last! Good things come to those who wait.
npc.arkulius.greet_msg_1: ...if the expected constant is higher than... Hmmm, who are you?? What do you want?
npc.arkulius.greet_msg_2: ...then I could transform a spell to bend... How can anyone expect me to work under these conditions?? What do you want?
npc.arkulius.greet_msg_3: ...if my calculations are correct, I will be able to revive... Arrgghh!! What do you want?
npc.arkulius.multi_1: Impressive!! Let me take a look.......Ahh,
npc.arkulius.multi_10: Anyway, there should be a way to use that energy and strengthen one of the elementals. If my calculations are right, you will create an Energy Overlord who hopefully will consist of some sort of 'concentrated' energy. ...
npc.arkulius.multi_11: THAT'S what we need!! Are you in on it?
npc.arkulius.multi_12: Okay, listen closely: First of all, you need to gather 20 enchanted sapphires in order to go to the ice sphere. Deep under the academy, one floor below the elemental shrines, there is a machine. Put the gems in there and activate it. ...
npc.arkulius.multi_13: Once you got there, find a way to gather elemental ice in any form. You will face ice elementals, that's for sure, but I don't know how the ice is stored. ...
npc.arkulius.multi_14: Anyway, there should be a way to use that elemental ice and strengthen one of the elementals. If my calculations are right, you will create an Ice Overlord who hopefully will consist of some sort of 'concentrated' ice or something similar. ...
npc.arkulius.multi_15: THAT'S what we need!! Are you in on it?
npc.arkulius.multi_16: Okay, listen closely: First of all, you need to gather 20 enchanted emeralds in order to go to the earth sphere. Deep under the academy, one floor below the elemental shrines, there is a machine. Put the gems in there and activate it. ...
npc.arkulius.multi_17: Once you got there, find a way to gather elemental earth in any form. You will face earth elementals, that's for sure, but I don't know how the earth is stored. ...
npc.arkulius.multi_18: Anyway, there should be a way to use that elemental earth and strengthen one of the elementals. If my calculations are right, you will create an Earth Overlord who hopefully will consist of some sort of 'concentrated' earth or something similar. ...
npc.arkulius.multi_19: THAT'S what we need!! Are you in on it?
npc.arkulius.multi_2: an ETERNAL FLAME! Now you need to find a knight, a druid, and a paladin who also completed this first task. ...
npc.arkulius.multi_20: Okay, listen closely: First of all, you need to gather 20 enchanted rubies in order to go to the fire sphere. Deep under the academy, one floor below the elemental shrines, there is a machine. Put the gems in there and activate it. ...
npc.arkulius.multi_21: Once you got there, find a way to gather elemental fire in any form. You will face fire elementals, that's for sure, but I don't know how the fire is stored. ...
npc.arkulius.multi_22: Anyway, there should be a way to use that elemental fire and strengthen one of the elementals. If my calculations are right, you will create a Fire Overlord who hopefully will consist of some sort of 'concentrated' fire or something similar. ...
npc.arkulius.multi_23: THAT'S what we need!! Are you in on it?
npc.arkulius.multi_24: There are four spheres we know of: ice, fire, earth and energy. ....<mumbles> Hmmm, should I ask or not?....The heck with it! Now that you know about the spheres ...
npc.arkulius.multi_25: I found a way to visit them. It's VERY dangerous and there is a decent chance that you won't come back BUT if you succeed you'll write history!!! Ask me about that {mission} if you're interested.
npc.arkulius.multi_26: The creation of the elemental shrines is a really complex matter. They are actually nodes, locations where the matching elemental sphere is very close. ...
npc.arkulius.multi_27: The shrine itself is like a portal between our world and the elemental {sphere} and enables us to use the elemental energy emerging from it.
npc.arkulius.multi_28: You need to know about the process of creating an elemental shrine to understand it completely, but I don't want to go into detail now. ...
npc.arkulius.multi_29: Anyway, his spell had a different outcome than he had planned. He accidentally created an Ice Overlord, pure living elemental ice, who froze him in a blink of an eye.
npc.arkulius.multi_3: MOTHER SOIL! Now you need to find a knight, a paladin, and a sorcerer who also completed this first task. ...
npc.arkulius.multi_30: Anyway, his spell had a different outcome than he had planned. He accidentally created an Ice Overlord, pure living elemental ice, who froze him in a blink of an eye.
npc.arkulius.multi_4: a FLAWLESS ICE CRYSTAL! Now you need to find a knight, a druid, and a sorcerer who also completed this first task. ...
npc.arkulius.multi_5: PURE ENERGY! Now you need to find a druid, a paladin, and a sorcerer who also completed this first task. ...
npc.arkulius.multi_6: Go down in the cellar again. I prepared a room under the academy where it should be safe. Your task is to charge the machines with the elemental substances and summon the LORD OF THE ELEMENTS. ...
npc.arkulius.multi_7: When you use an obsidian knife on it's corpse you hopefully get some of the precious neutral matter. It's the only way to revive my dear friend Alverus!!
npc.arkulius.multi_8: Okay, listen closely: First of all, you need to gather 20 enchanted amethysts in order to go to the energy sphere. Deep under the academy, one floor below the elemental shrines, there is a machine. Put the gems in there and activate it. ...
npc.arkulius.multi_9: Once you got there, find a way to gather elemental energy in any form. You will face energy elementals, that's for sure, but I don't know how the energy is stored. ...
npc.arkulius.say_1: You need some kind of pure elemental soil from the {} Overlord. Come back when you've got it.
npc.arkulius.say_2: AMAZING!! I'm going to start immediately with the research. If it turns out the way I expect it, Alverus will be revived soon!! Here, take this as a reward and try to collect more of this substance. I'll make you a good offer, I promise.
npc.arkulius.say_3: Good, don't waste time! Come back here when you have the elemental object!
npc.arkulius.stdmod_1: ...the arithmetical paradox has the same value in a metaphysical way, then...
npc.arkulius.stdmod_2: Oh my! Alverus!! Did you really...?!?! I have to recalculate it to make sure that I made no mistake.
npc.arkulius.stdmod_4: ...the minimum square deviation could cause a dislocation, in a matter of fact...
npc.arkulius.stdmod_5: ...it could be possible to bring the sphere to a destination where...
npc.arkulius.stdmod_6: Yes, that's it! The elementary particle are corresponding to the... the ... UNBELIEVEABLE!!!
