npc.arkulius.voice_4: ...the minimum square deviation could cause a dislocation, in a matter of fact...
npc.arkulius.voice_5: ...it could be possible to bring the sphere to a destination where...
npc.arkulius.voice_6: Yes, that's it! The elementary particle are corresponding to the... the ... UNBELIEVEABLE!!!
npc.arkulius.walkaway_msg_1: Good bye and please stay away, okay?
npc.armenius.greet_msg_1: Ah, an adventurer. Be greeted and have a seat. How may I {serve} you?
npc.armenius.say_1: What kind of strange offer is this? You're actually offering me a cookie?
npc.armenius.say_2: It'd be better for you to leave now.
npc.armenius.say_3: Errrkss - coughcough - what the - heck did you put in there? Get out of my sight!
npc.armenius.walkaway_msg_1: Oh, the nerve. Go to the rats which raised you.
npc.aruda.farewell_msg_1: Good bye, |PLAYERNAME|. I really hope we'll talk again soon.
npc.aruda.greet_msg_1: Oh, hello |PLAYERNAME|, your hair looks great! Who did it for you?
npc.aruda.greet_msg_2: Oh, hello, handsome! It's a pleasure to meet you, |PLAYERNAME|. Gladly I have the time to {chat} a bit.
npc.aruda.say_1: I would never have guessed that.
npc.aruda.say_11: I am a little sad, that you seem to have forgotten me, handsome. I am Aruda.
npc.aruda.say_13: Oh, I like it, how you say my name.
npc.aruda.say_14: Please don't be so rude to look for the time if you are talking to me.
npc.aruda.say_15: I am deeply sorry, I can't help you.
npc.aruda.say_16: UH! What a terrifying topic. Please let us speak about something more pleasant, I am a weak and small woman after all.
npc.aruda.say_17: What gives you the impression, I am the kind of women, you find in sewers?
npc.aruda.say_18: You should ask about that in one of the temples.
npc.aruda.say_19: The king, that lives in this fascinating castle? I think he does look kind of cute in his luxurious robes, doesn't he?
npc.aruda.say_2: Oh, sorry, I was distracted, what did you say?
npc.aruda.say_20: He is soooo strong! What muscles! What a body! Did you ask him for a date?
npc.aruda.say_21: He is soooo strong! What muscles! What a body! On the other hand, compared to you he looks quite puny.
npc.aruda.say_22: He is a little simple minded but always nice and well dressed.
npc.aruda.say_23: He should really sell some stylish gowns or something like that. We Tibians never get some clothing of the latest fashion. It's a shame.
npc.aruda.say_24: I don't understand this lonely monks. I love company too much to become one. Hehehe!
npc.aruda.say_25: Oh, isn't he funny? I could listen to him the whole day.
npc.aruda.say_26: As far as I know, he is working in the castle.
npc.aruda.say_27: I am a little shy and so don't hear many rumors.
npc.aruda.say_28: Oh, you little devil, stop talking like that! <blush>
npc.aruda.say_29: I know only little about weapons. Can you tell me something about them, please?
npc.aruda.say_3: Oh, I just remember I have some work to do, sorry. Bye!
npc.aruda.say_30: I believe that love is stronger than magic, don't you agree?
npc.aruda.say_31: Oh, sorry, I have to hurry, bye!
npc.aruda.say_32: I would like to visit the beach more often, but I guess it's too dangerous.
npc.aruda.say_33: I love this castle! It's so beautiful.
npc.aruda.say_34: Powerful sorcerers frighten me a little.
npc.aruda.say_35: I personally think it's inappropriate for a woman to become a warrior, what do you think about that?
npc.aruda.say_36: Druids seldom visit a town, what do you know about druids?
npc.aruda.say_37: I like brave fighters like him.
npc.aruda.say_39: I like dogs, the little ones at least. Do you like dogs, too?
npc.aruda.say_4: Take some time to talk to me!
npc.aruda.say_40: Oh, I am just a girl and know nothing about magic swords and such things.
npc.aruda.say_41: I ... don't know someone named like that.
npc.aruda.say_42: Yenny? I know no Yenny, nor have I ever used that name! You have mistook me with someone else.
npc.aruda.say_5: Well ... I have met him for a little while .. but this was nothing serious.
npc.aruda.say_6: I remember that grapes were his favourites. He was almost addicted to them.
npc.aruda.say_7: Thank you very much. How kind of you to care about me. I am fine, thank you.
npc.aruda.say_8: Sorry, I have nothing to sell.
npc.aruda.say_9: I do some work now and then. Nothing unusual, though. So I have plenty time to chat. If you are interested in any topic just ask me.
npc.aruda.voice_1: Hey there, up for a chat?
npc.aruda.walkaway_msg_1: I hope to see you soon.
npc.ashari.greet_msg_1: Hello, stranger! These caves must seem strange to you. I wonder what brings you here... maybe you are interested in some work? There are several tasks I could need a hand with.
npc.ashtamor.voice_1: The passage to the afterlife is filled with obstacles, but I can help you with my wares.
npc.asima.say_1: So you ask me for a {{}} to begin your adventure?
npc.asima.say_2: What? I have already gave you one {{}}!
npc.asima.say_3: Of course, just browse through my wares. You can also look at {}.
npc.asralius.voice_1: Let me speak a few words to you.
npc.asralius.voice_2: Death comes to the best of us, but this time you had no chance.
npc.atrad.say_1: You managed to deceive Erayo? Impressive. Well, I guess, since you have come that far, I might as well give you a task too, eh?
npc.atrad.say_2: I see you brought my stuff. Good. I'll keep my promise: Here's katana in return.
npc.atrad.say_4: Okay, listen up. I don't have a list of stupid objects, I just want two things. A behemoth claw and a nose ring. Got that?
npc.atrad.say_5: Good. Come back then you have BOTH. Should be clear where to get a behemoth claw from. There's a horned fox who wears a nose ring. Good luck.
npc.atur.greet_msg_1: Yes? What may I do for you, |PLAYERNAME|? Bank business, perhaps?
npc.atur.voice_1: Don't forget to deposit your money here in the Global Bank before you head out for adventure.
npc.aurita.farewell_msg_1: May your path always be even.
npc.aurita.multi_1: That's very kind of you, my friend! Listen: I know there is a spell to transform my fishtail into legs. It is a temporary effect, so I could return to the ocean as soon as the spell ends. Unfortunately I don't know how to cast this spell. ...
npc.aurita.multi_10: But I lost my heart to Taegen, I can't help it. We would love to spend some time together, but not just sitting on the beach. ...
npc.aurita.multi_11: I'd love to show him my homestead beneath the waves. I have an idea but I can't do it alone. Would you help me?
npc.aurita.multi_2: But there is a fairy who once told me about it. Perhaps she will share her knowledge. You can find her in a small fairy village in the southwest of Feyrist.
npc.aurita.multi_3: I already gave you the empty starlight vial.
npc.aurita.multi_4: Thank you, friend! Please take the starlight vial. It is made of a very rare kind of enchanted glass and magical metals, so it is able to preserve starlight. ...
npc.aurita.multi_5: A long time ago a pixie knight of Maelyrra carried it with her. But when she was flying above the waves she accidentally dropped it and it sunk. I found it but now you may take it and use it to help Feyrist.
npc.aurita.multi_6: Thank you again, friend! Taegen and I we're so happy now.
npc.aurita.multi_7: The spell works! I already took a walk on the beach last night in the moonlight. Please talk to Taegen now, he may have another request.
npc.aurita.multi_8: There is a fairy who once told me about this spell. Perhaps she will share her knowledge. You can find her in a small fairy village in the southwest of Feyrist.
npc.aurita.multi_9: Yes, there is something. I'm in love with Taegen, but he is a faun. As such he's inhabiting the forests, dancing with fairies. And I, being a mermaid, am living in the ocean, swimming with the fish between coral reefs. ...
npc.aurita.walkaway_msg_1: May your path always be even.
npc.avar_tar.multi_1: I'm tired of all these young unskilled wannabe heroes. Every Tibian can show his skills or actions by wearing a special outfit. To prove oneself worthy of the demon outfit, this is how it goes: ...
npc.avar_tar.multi_2: The base outfit will be granted for completing the annihilator quest, which isn't much of a challenge nowadays, in my opinion. Anyway ...
npc.avar_tar.multi_3: The shield however will only be granted to those adventurers who have finished the demon helmet quest. ...
npc.avar_tar.multi_4: Well, the helmet is for those who really are tenacious and have hunted down all 6666 demons and finished the demon oak as well. ...
npc.avar_tar.say_1: Do you really think you could bribe a hero like me with a meagre cookie?
npc.avar_tar.say_11: The helmet is for those who have hunted down all 6666 demons and finished the demon oak as well, |PLAYERNAME|.
npc.avar_tar.say_2: So you want to have the demon outfit, hah! Let's have a look first if you really deserve it. Tell me: {base}, {shield} or {helmet}?
npc.avar_tar.say_3: You have no cookie that I'd like.
npc.avar_tar.say_4: Well, you won't! Though it looks tasty ...What the ... WHAT DO YOU THINK YOU ARE? THIS IS THE ULTIMATE INSULT! GET LOST!
npc.avar_tar.say_7: You need to complete annihilator quest first, |PLAYERNAME|.
npc.avar_tar.say_9: The shield will only be granted to those adventurers who have finished the demon helmet quest, |PLAYERNAME|.
npc.awarness_of_the_emperor.greet_msg_1: I am not here to fight you, fool. Like it or not, we will have to work together to stop the catastrophe you and that priest have initiated.
npc.awarness_of_the_emperor.greet_msg_2: Greetings, mortal. Be aware that you are trying my patience while we are talking.
npc.awarness_of_the_emperor.multi_1: So you have mastered the crisis you invoked with your foolishness. I should crush you for your involvement right here and now. ...
npc.awarness_of_the_emperor.multi_10: You might have to fight several incarnations until the snake god is worn out enough. Then use the power of the snake's own sceptre against it. Use it on its corpse to claim your victory. ...
npc.awarness_of_the_emperor.multi_11: Be prepared for the fight of your life! Are you ready?
npc.awarness_of_the_emperor.multi_2: But such an act would bring me down to your own barbaric level and only fuel the corruption that destroys the land that I own. Therefore I will not only spare your miserable life but show your the generosity of the dragon emperor. ...
npc.awarness_of_the_emperor.multi_3: I will reward you beyond your wildest dreams! ...
npc.awarness_of_the_emperor.multi_4: I grant you three chests - filled to the lid with platinum coins, a house in the city in which you may reside, a set of the finest armor Zao has to offer, and a casket of never-ending mana. ...
npc.awarness_of_the_emperor.multi_5: Speak with magistrate Izsh in the ministry about your reward. And now leave before I change my mind!
npc.awarness_of_the_emperor.multi_6: The amplified force of the snake god is tearing the land apart. It is using my crystals in a reverse way to drain the vital force from the land and its inhabitants to fuel its power. ...
npc.awarness_of_the_emperor.multi_7: I will withstand its influence as good as possible and slow this process. You will have to fight its worldly incarnation though. ...
npc.awarness_of_the_emperor.multi_8: It is still weak and disoriented. You might stand a chance - this is our only chance. I will send you to the point to where the vital force is channelled. I have no idea where that might be though. ...
npc.awarness_of_the_emperor.multi_9: You will probably have to fight some sort of vessel the snake god uses. Even if you defeat it, it is likely that it only weakens the snake. ...
npc.azalea.greet_msg_1: Welcome, young |PLAYERNAME|! If you are heavily wounded or poisoned, I can {heal} you for free.
npc.azalea.keyword_1: So receive the protection of the twist of fate, pilgrim.
npc.azalea.stdmod_1: So receive the protection of the twist of fate, pilgrim.
npc.azalea.stdmod_11: You are hurt, my child. I will heal your wounds.
npc.azalea.stdmod_12: You aren't looking that bad. Sorry, I can't help you. But if you are looking for additional protection you should go on the {pilgrimage} of ashes or get the protection of the {twist of fate} here.
npc.azalea.stdmod_13: Whenever you receive a lethal wound, your vital force is damaged and there is a chance that you lose some of your equipment. With every single of the five {blessings} you have, this damage and chance of loss will be reduced.
npc.azalea.stdmod_14: There are five blessings available in five sacred places: the {spiritual} shielding, the spark of the {phoenix}, the {embrace} of Tibia, the fire of the {suns} and the wisdom of {solitude}. Additionally, you can receive the {twist of fate} here.
npc.azalea.stdmod_15: I see you received the spiritual shielding in the whiteflower temple south of Thais.
npc.azalea.stdmod_16: I can sense that the druids north of Carlin have provided you with the Embrace of Tibia.
npc.azalea.stdmod_17: I can see you received the blessing of the two suns in the suntower near Ab'Dendriel.
npc.azalea.stdmod_18: I can sense that the spark of the phoenix already was given to you by the dwarven priests of earth and fire in Kazordoon.
npc.azalea.stdmod_19: I can sense you already talked to the hermit Eremo on the isle of Cormaya and received this blessing.
npc.azalea.stdmod_2: Fine. You are free to decline my offer.
npc.azalea.stdmod_20: You can ask for the blessing of spiritual shielding in the whiteflower temple south of Thais.
npc.azalea.stdmod_21: The druids north of Carlin will provide you with the embrace of Tibia.
npc.azalea.stdmod_22: You can ask for the blessing of the two suns in the suntower near Ab'Dendriel.
npc.azalea.stdmod_23: The spark of the phoenix is given by the dwarven priests of earth and fire in Kazordoon.
npc.azalea.stdmod_25:
This is a special blessing I can bestow upon you once you have obtained at least one of the other blessings and which functions a bit differently. ... \z
	It only works when you're killed by other adventurers, which means that at least half of the damage leading to your death was caused by others, not by monsters or the environment. ... \z
	The {twist of fate} will not reduce the death penalty like the other blessings, but instead prevent you from losing your other blessings as well as the amulet of loss, should you wear one. It costs the same as the other blessings. ... \z
	Would you like to receive that protection for a sacrifice of |PVPBLESSCOST| gold, child?
npc.azalea.stdmod_4: Ah, you want to replace your adventurer's stone for free?
npc.azalea.stdmod_7: Ah, you want to replace your adventurer's stone for 30 gold?
npc.azalea.stdmod_9: Sorry, you don't have enough money.
npc.azalea.walkaway_msg_1: Remember: If you are heavily wounded or poisoned, I can heal you for free.
npc.baa_leal.multi_1: You found the thief! Excellent work, soldier! You are doing well - for a human, that is. Here - take this as a reward. ...
npc.baa_leal.multi_10: Each mission and operation is a crucial step towards our victory! ...
npc.baa_leal.multi_11: Now that we speak of it ...
npc.baa_leal.multi_12: Since you are no djinn, there is something you could help us with. Are you interested, human?
npc.baa_leal.multi_14: |PLAYERNAME|, that almost sounded like the word of greeting. Humans - cute they are!
npc.baa_leal.multi_2: Since you have proven to be a capable soldier, we have another mission for you. ...
npc.baa_leal.multi_3: If you are interested go to Alesar and ask him about it.
npc.baa_leal.multi_4: Well ... All right. You may only be a human, but you do seem to have the right spirit. ...
npc.baa_leal.multi_5: Listen! Since our base of operations is set in this isolated spot we depend on supplies from outside. These supplies are crucial for us to win the war. ...
npc.baa_leal.multi_6: Unfortunately, it has happened that some of our supplies have disappeared on their way to this fortress. At first we thought it was the Marid, but intelligence reports suggest a different explanation. ...
npc.baa_leal.multi_7: We now believe that a human was behind the theft! ...
npc.baa_leal.multi_8: His identity is still unknown but we have been told that the thief fled to the human settlement called Carlin. I want you to find him and report back to me. Nobody messes with the Efreet and lives to tell the tale! ...
npc.baa_leal.multi_9: Now go! Travel to the northern city Carlin! Keep your eyes open and look around for something that might give you a clue!
npc.baa_leal.say_1: Shove off, little one! Humans are not welcome here, |PLAYERNAME|!
npc.baa_leal.say_10: Hmmm... I don't think so. Return to Thais and continue your search!
npc.baa_leal.say_2: You know the code human! Very well then... What do you want, |PLAYERNAME|?
npc.baa_leal.say_3: You are still alive, |PLAYERNAME|? Well, what do you want?
npc.baa_leal.say_4: Did you find the thief of our supplies?
npc.baa_leal.say_5: Did you already talk to Alesar? He has another mission for you!
npc.baa_leal.say_6: After all, you're just a human.
npc.baa_leal.say_7: Finally! What is his name then?
npc.baa_leal.say_8: Then go to Carlin and search for him! Look for something that might give you a clue!
npc.baa_leal.say_9: Hmmm... I don't think so. Return to Thais and continue your search!
npc.barazbaz.say_1: Ancient structures in the sewers you say? Well, our city has had a certain bloody past, even before it has been city at all. But to investigate the archives for what you may have found is a time-consuming process. ...
npc.barazbaz.say_10: Something like the ruins you have found. What you have seen there hints to a new incident, though. As if someone or something was searching for something. In the past, when those ruins were buried, people were primitive and superstitious. ...
npc.barazbaz.say_11: Today, we have advanced far more and could have the ruins investigated in a far more efficient way. And that is what I would just recommend you to do: get a necrometer from magistrate Jondrin upstairs and investigate the ruins thoroughly.
npc.barazbaz.say_12: I know that handwriting you describe! It belongs to a traveller from far away. Magistrate Sholley introduced him to me and she was quite excited to learn more about our city's past. ...
npc.barazbaz.say_13: I should have thought of him right in the beginning when I heard the stuff you mentioned. But I haven't seen him for a while. You should ask Sholley about her friend to learn about his whereabouts.
npc.barazbaz.say_2: Usually, I'm too much bound to my duties to the city to sacrifice time for such an endeavour. ...
npc.barazbaz.say_3: But on the other hand, just now is the time of an important decision of the magistrate concerning the funding of the archives. It is a matter easily overlooked by our good citizens. ...
npc.barazbaz.say_4: If you'd be so kind to place just one of your votes for the funding of the archives, I would be inclined to take the time for your investigation in turn. ...
npc.barazbaz.say_5: Just go to Marvin in the magistrate and vote for a greater funding of the archives. Afterwards, I might be able to present you with some first results of my investigations on your behalf.
npc.barazbaz.say_6: Excellent! Concerning the ancient ruins that you have found, well, if you are not familiar with the city's history, feel free to browse a few books here. I will only refer to some basics here, so I don't waste your time. ...
npc.barazbaz.say_7: The first humans that lived here and that we have any records of lived in slavery of an ancient evil. ...
npc.barazbaz.say_8: The nature of this evil is up to debate, but there are hints that this evil predated the settlement of men and that it perhaps was part of a more ancient civilisation or caused the downfall of the latter. ...
npc.barazbaz.say_9: After that evil had been overcome, much was sealed away. Some say that only forbidden knowledge had been sealed, but others like me were always worried that more had been hidden. ...
npc.barbara.farewell_msg_1: LONG LIVE THE QUEEN! You may leave now!
npc.barbara.stdmod_1: MIND YOUR MANNERS COMMONER! To address the queen greet with her title!
npc.barbara.stdmod_2: MIND YOUR MANNERS COMMONER! To address the queen greet with her title!
npc.barnabas_dee.greet_msg_1: Welcome to my humble abode. If you come for new sorcerer {spells}, you have come to the right place.
npc.barnabas_dee.multi_1: So let us begin. Please concentrate with me. Concentrate! ...
npc.barnabas_dee.multi_7: I am afraid my supplies of peppermoon bell powder have gone flat again. Please provide me with the pollen of this flower. ...
npc.barnabas_dee.multi_8: It only blooms underground in a cavern to the northwest. I will need 15 units of pollen. Bring them to me and we shall conduct a seance.
npc.barnabas_dee.say_1: Do you already have 15 units of blue pollen with you?
npc.barnabas_dee.say_2: Ah! Did you bring me the peppermoon bell pollen I asked for?
npc.barnabas_dee.say_3: Ah! Well done! Now we shall proceed with the seance, yes?
npc.barnabas_dee.say_4: Ah! Well done! These 15 doses will suffice for now. Here, take this vote for your effort.
npc.barnabas_dee.say_5: No no no, I need 15 doses of freshly harvested pollen! Please, harvest those 15 doses yourself, to make absolutely sure you have first-rate quality. I am afraid nothing less will do.
npc.barnabas_dee.say_6: Splendid. Let me make the final preparations... There. Are you ready, too?
npc.barnabas_dee.say_7: Yes, take care, the gate is opening! Can you see a bright light?
npc.barnabas_dee.walkaway_msg_1: 'The impetuosity of youth', as my friend Mordecai would say.
npc.barry.say_1: Oh my, where to begin with .. <tells about the troubles he and his men have recently encountered>.
npc.barry.say_2: You can {pass} either to the {Magician Quarter} or {Sunken Quarter}. Which one will it be?
npc.bashira.sendtrade_msg_1: Of course, just browse through my offers.
npc.bashira.voice_1: Welcome to Ab'Dendriel's store for general goods.
npc.bashira.walkaway_msg_1: May God show you the path, |PLAYERNAME|.
npc.battlemart.farewell_msg_1: Farewell, |PLAYERNAME|, I'll be here if you need me again.
npc.battlemart.greet_msg_1: It is good to see you. I'm always at your {shop options}
npc.battlemart.say_2: Of course, just browse through my wares. You can also look at {}.
npc.baxter.sendtrade_msg_1: Do you bring freshly killed rats for a bounty of 1 gold each? By the way, I also buy orc teeth and other stuff you ripped from their bloody corp... I mean... well, you know what I mean.
npc.baxter.voice_1: People of Thais, bring honour to your king by fighting in the orc war!
npc.baxter.voice_2: The orcs are preparing for war!!!
npc.beatrice.say_1: Do you want to buy a football for 111 gold?
npc.beatrice.sendtrade_msg_1: Of course, just browse through my wares.
npc.beatrice.voice_1: Selling general goods and paperware! Come to my shop!
npc.benevola.voice_3: I can hear the call of the forest.
npc.benjamin.farewell_msg_1: It was a pleasure to help you.
npc.benjamin.greet_msg_1: Hello. How may I help you |PLAYERNAME|? Ask me for a {trade} if you want to buy something. I can also explain the {mail} system.
npc.benjamin.say_1: Oh they don't change that much since in the old days as... <tells a boring and confusing story about a cake, a parcel, himself and two squirrels, at least he tells you his measurements in the end>
npc.benjamin.voice_2: If you need help with letters or parcels, just ask me. I can explain everything.
npc.benjamin.voice_3: Hey, send a letter to your friend now and then. Keep in touch, you know.
npc.berenice.multi_1: Since you have already proved to be a valuable member of our society, I will happily entrust you with this mission, but there are a few things which you need to know, so listen carefully. ...
npc.berenice.multi_2: Calassa is an underwater settlement, so you are in severe danger of drowning unless you are well-prepared. ...
npc.berenice.multi_3: We have developed a new device called 'Helmet of the Deep' which will enable you to breathe even in the depths of the ocean. ...
npc.berenice.multi_4: I will instruct Captain Max to bring you to Calassa and to lend one of these helmets to you. These helmets are very valuable, so there is a deposit of 5000 gold pieces on it. ...
npc.berenice.multi_5: While in Calassa, do not take the helmet off under any circumstances. If you have any questions, don't hesitate to ask Captain Max. ...
npc.berenice.multi_6: Your mission there, apart from observing the Quara, is to retrieve a special logbook from one of the shipwrecks buried there. ...
npc.berenice.multi_7: One of our last expeditions there failed horribly and the ship sank, but we still do not know the exact reason. ...
npc.berenice.multi_8: If you could retrieve the logbook, we'd finally know what happened. Have you understood your task and are willing to take this risk?
npc.berenice.say_1: OH! So you have safely returned from Calassa! Congratulations, were you able to retrieve the logbook?
npc.berenice.say_2: The most important mission we currently have is an expedition to {Calassa}.
npc.berenice.say_3: Ah! So you have heard about our special mission to investigate the Quara race in their natural surrounding! Would you like to know more about it?
npc.berenice.say_4: Captain Max will bring you to Calassa whenever you are ready. Please try to retrieve the missing logbook which must be in one of the sunken shipwrecks.
npc.berenice.say_5: OH! So you have safely returned from Calassa! Congratulations, were you able to retrieve the logbook?
npc.berenice.say_6: Excellent! I will immediately inform Captain Max to bring you to {Calassa} whenever you are ready. Don't forget to make thorough preparations!
npc.berenice.say_7: Yes! That's the logbook! However... it seems that the water has already destroyed many of the pages. This is not your fault though, you did your best. Thank you!
npc.bertha.greet_msg_1: Oh, please come in, |PLAYERNAME|. What can I do for you? If you need adventure equipment, ask me for a {trade}.
npc.bertha.say_1: Do you want to buy a football for 111 gold?
npc.bertha.sendtrade_msg_1: Of course, just browse through my wares. {Footballs} have to be purchased separately.
npc.bertha.stdmod_1: Hey there, need some general goods or paperware?
npc.bertha.voice_1: Hey there, need some general goods or paperware?
npc.bertram.key_response: Oh my! You look so great in your uniform! You archpostwomen are not only daring but also beautiful. Here take it, that's the key you wanted. Just promise to visit me now and then!
npc.billy.greet_msg_1: Howdy |PLAYERNAME|. I'm a farmer and cook, maybe I can interest you in a {trade} with food? You can also ask me for general {hints} about the game.
npc.billy.stdmod_1: Add one fresh dead rat and stir it well...
npc.billy.stdmod_10: I came here for peace and leisure, so leave me alone with 'time'.
npc.billy.stdmod_11: Rather give your {money} to me than leaving it at the bank. Hehe.
npc.billy.stdmod_13: If you need information, I can provide you with general {hints}.
npc.billy.stdmod_14: I'm a cook, not a priest. If you need information, I can provide you with general {hints}.
npc.billy.stdmod_15: I'm the best cook around. You can sell most types of {food} to me. Just ask me for a {trade} to see what I buy from you as well as my offers.
npc.billy.stdmod_17: If you bring me a fresh rat for my famous stew, ask me for a {trade}.
npc.billy.stdmod_18: Nah, this is not a real shop. I have some offers, though. If you're interested, just ask me for a {trade}. There are other {merchants} on {Rookgaard} as well.
npc.billy.stdmod_19: There is so much to explore! Better hurry to get to the continent! Once you're level 8, look for the {oracle}.
npc.billy.stdmod_2: Argh, if I only had a pan!
npc.billy.stdmod_20: As an adventurer, you should always have at least a {backpack}, a {rope}, a {shovel}, a {weapon}, an {armor} and a {shield}.
npc.billy.stdmod_21: There are lots and lots of dusty books. You can read them for some basic knowledge about the world. Then again, you could also ask around in the village.
npc.billy.stdmod_22: The king and his tax collectors are far away. You'll meet them soon enough.
npc.billy.stdmod_23: Ask {Obi} or {Lee'Delle}. They make a fortune here with all those wannabe heroes.
npc.billy.stdmod_24: This island will prepare you for the main continent of {Tibia}. Learn to fight and grow stronger!
npc.billy.stdmod_25: Don't be scared, you should be safe as long as you stay in town. Dangerous monsters are roaming the {dungeons}.
npc.billy.stdmod_26: You'll find a lot of dungeons if you look around. One example are the {sewers} below Rookgaard.
npc.billy.stdmod_27: The local sewers are invested by {rats}. Fresh rats give a good stew, you can sell them to me.
npc.billy.stdmod_28: Just ask me for a {trade} to see what I buy from you. Food of almost any kind!
npc.billy.stdmod_29: To view the offers of a merchant, simply talk to him or her and ask for a {trade}.
npc.billy.stdmod_3: Bread, cheese, ham and meat! All fresh!
npc.billy.stdmod_30: That's right, I'm the god of cooking!
npc.billy.stdmod_31: I'd love to make pancakes, but I'm lacking a decent {pan}. If you get me one, I'll reward you.
npc.billy.stdmod_32: Armor and shields can be bought at {Dixi's} or at {Lee'Delle's}. Dixi runs that shop near {Obi's}.
npc.billy.stdmod_34: Well, no gold, no deal. Earn gold by fighting {monsters} and picking up the things they carry. Sell it to {merchants} to make profit!
npc.billy.stdmod_35: I can spell but I don't know any spells.
npc.billy.stdmod_36: Just ask me for a {trade} to see my offers.
npc.billy.stdmod_37: I like him, we usually have a drink or two once a week and share stories about {Willie}.
npc.billy.stdmod_38: That girl is all about party now. I think she was fed up with {equipment} selling.
npc.billy.stdmod_39: Now that's one crazy fellow. I usually hear him scream about some hole.
npc.billy.stdmod_40: He's a fisherman and somehow his hut is always infested with cockroaches.
npc.billy.stdmod_41: That old hag always finds someone to do her work. I have no clue how she is doing that.
npc.billy.stdmod_42: Decent guy. He sells general equipment such as {ropes}, {shovels} and so on.
npc.billy.stdmod_43: She's pretty indeed! I wonder if she likes bearded men.
npc.billy.stdmod_45: Don't listen to this old wannabe, I'm the best cook around.
npc.billy.stdmod_46: He never leaves the temple. He spends his time caring for those who newly arrive here. You can ask him for a heal if you are badly injured or poisoned.
npc.billy.stdmod_47: That's {Obi's} granddaughter. She helps him out by selling {armors} and {shields}. I think she'll be a beauty when she's grown up.
npc.billy.stdmod_48: I never see that guy around.
npc.billy.stdmod_49: Her shop is super-duper exclusive. If you're a premium adventurer, check it out in the western part of town. Lotsa nice offers there.
npc.billy.stdmod_5: Buying many types of food and ingredients, too!
npc.billy.stdmod_50: She lives in the very south of this town, selling her potions. Sweet - well, sweet-loving girl.
npc.billy.stdmod_51: You can find the oracle on the top floor of the {academy}, just above {Seymour}. Go there when you are level 8.
npc.billy.stdmod_52: He must have the most boring job there is.
npc.billy.stdmod_6: Hmm, hmm, now which ingredients do I need...
npc.billy.stdmod_7: Need food? I have plenty for sale!
npc.billy.stdmod_9: I'm a farmer and a {cook}. I'd love to make pancakes, but I'm lacking a good {pan}.
npc.billy.voice_1: Add one fresh dead rat and stir it well...
npc.billy.voice_2: Argh, if I only had a pan!
npc.billy.voice_3: Bread, cheese, ham and meat! All fresh!
npc.billy.voice_5: Buying many types of food and ingredients, too!
npc.billy.voice_6: Hmm, hmm, now which ingredients do I need...
npc.billy.voice_7: Need food? I have plenty for sale!
npc.black_bert.greet_msg_1: Hi there, |PLAYERNAME|! You look like you are eager to {trade}!
npc.blind_orc.stdmod_7: Ikem pashak porak, bata, dora. Ba goshak maruk?
npc.blind_orc.stdmod_8: Ikem pashak charcha, burka, burka bata, hakhak. Ba goshak maruk?
npc.bloodshade_rotten.greet_msg_1: Mortal! If you are on a {quest} to serve the blood god, my master - be greeted!
npc.bloodshade_rotten.multi_1: First you must fight the two pairs of evil twins that lurk in the realm beyond here. ...
npc.bloodshade_rotten.multi_2: Only when you are victorious over all four of them, your path to the source of vileness, the path to Bakragore will be opened. ...
npc.bloodshade_rotten.multi_3: And even this victory will only be the beginning.
npc.bloodshade_rotten.say_1: You already have started this quest.
npc.bloodshade_sacrifice.greet_msg_1: Mortal! If you are on a {quest} to serve the blood god, my master - be greeted!
npc.bloodshade_sacrifice.multi_1: Hm. I see. Well, I will be frank. Every blood sacrifice has its price. Blood money will please the blood god... just as well. ...
npc.bloodshade_sacrifice.multi_2: The sum would be five million gold pieces and I... my master will be pleased. Are you prepared for a sacrifice such as this?
npc.bloodshade_sacrifice.multi_3: To enter the realm of the sanguine master and destroy its spawn, a sufficient sacrifice is imperative. ...
npc.bloodshade_sacrifice.multi_4: Find and slay the keeper of blooded tears and bring the nectar of his eyes before the blood god. Present your gift on the sacrificial altar. ...
npc.bloodshade_sacrifice.multi_5: After - and under no circumstances before - you have completed this procedure, you can enter the sacred fluid. You can, of course also take a slightly faster... {detour}.
npc.bloodshade_sacrifice.say_2: You are willing to pay 5000000 gold pieces, then? There is no turning back after our... transaction is complete. Are you sure?
npc.bloodshade_sacrifice.say_3: Sorry, you don't have enough gold.
npc.bloodshade_sacrifice.say_4: The bargain has been made, the business is done.
npc.bo_ques.farewell_msg_1: Goodbye. I am sure you will come back for more. They all do.
npc.bo_ques.multi_1: The book! You have it! Let me see! <browses the book> ...
npc.bo_ques.multi_11: |PLAYERNAME|, that almost sounded like the word of greeting. Humans - cute they are!
npc.bo_ques.multi_13: |PLAYERNAME|, that almost sounded like the word of greeting. Humans - cute they are!
npc.bo_ques.multi_2: Dragon Egg Omelette, Dwarven beer sauce... it's all there. This is great! Here is your well-deserved reward. ...
npc.bo_ques.multi_3: Incidentally, I have talked to Fa'hradin about you during dinner. I think he might have some work for you. Why don't you talk to him about it?
npc.bo_ques.multi_4: Fine! Even though I know so many recipes, I'm looking for the description of some dwarven meals. ...
npc.bo_ques.multi_5: So, if you could bring me a cookbook of the dwarven kitchen, I'll reward you well.
npc.bo_ques.multi_6: I'm preparing the food for all djinns in Ashta'daramai. ...
npc.bo_ques.multi_7: Therefore, I'm what is commonly called a cook, although I do not like that word too much. It is vulgar. I prefer to call myself 'chef'.
npc.bo_ques.multi_8: My collection of recipes is almost complete. There are only but a few that are missing. ...
npc.bo_ques.multi_9: Hmmm... now that we talk about it. There is something you could help me with. Are you interested?
npc.bo_ques.say_1: Whoa! A human! This is no place for you, |PLAYERNAME|. Go and play somewhere else.
npc.bo_ques.say_2: Hey! A human! What are you doing in my kitchen, |PLAYERNAME|?
npc.bo_ques.say_3: I already told you about the recipes I am missing, now please try to find a cookbook of the dwarven kitchen.
npc.bo_ques.say_4: Do you have the cookbook of the dwarven kitchen with you? Can I have it?
npc.bo_ques.say_5: Thanks again, for bringing me that book!
npc.bo_ques.say_7: Too bad. I must have this book.
npc.bo_ques.say_8: Too bad. I must have this book.
npc.bo_ques.walkaway_msg_1: Goodbye. I am sure you will come back for more. They all do.
npc.bolfona.greet_msg_1: Are you talking to me? Well, go on chatting but don't expect an answer.
npc.bolfona.say_2: So did you tell her that the cake came from me?
npc.bolfona.say_3: Err, thanks. I doubt it's from you. Who sent it?
npc.bolfona.say_4: Oh, I thought you have one.
npc.bolfona.say_5: Oh, Frafnar. That's so nice of him. I gotta invite him for a beer.
npc.bolfona.say_6: Never heard that name. Well, I don't mind, thanks for the cake.
npc.boozer.greet_msg_1: Welcome to the Hard Rock Racing Track, |PLAYERNAME|.
npc.boozer.say_1: Yessss! Now I only need to build my own small brewery, figure out the secret recipe, duplicate the dwarvish brew and BANG I'll be back in business! Here take this as a reward.
npc.boozer.say_2: Shush!! I don't want everybody to know what I am up to. Listen, things are not going too well, I need a new attraction. Do you want to help me?
npc.boozer.say_3: Good! Listen closely. Take this bottle and go to Kazordoon. I need a sample of their very special brown ale. You may find a cask in their brewery. Come back as soon as you got it.
npc.boveas.greet_msg_1: Hi! I hope you're not going to kill me!
npc.bozo.farewell_msg_1: Remember: A joke a day keeps the ghouls away!
npc.bozo.greet_msg_1: Hi there, how's it hanging, |PLAYERNAME|! What brings you {here}?
npc.bozo.greet_msg_2: Hello, hello, hello, little lady |PLAYERNAME|! What brings you {here}?
npc.bozo.mission_30_t3_1: Great! That's the word of a true fool! Maybe you want to write the names down. Here we go: Deliver a cookie to: ...
npc.bozo.mission_30_t3_2: The pompous hero Avar Tar in Edron, Simon the greedy beggar on Fibula, the pirate Ariella on the Shattered Isles, the dubious Lorbas next to the ruins of the Dark Cathedral, King Markwin in the underground city Mintwalin ...
npc.bozo.mission_30_t3_3: The shaman Hjaern on the ice island Nibelor, the witch Wyda in the Green Claw Swamp, the ape Hairycles in the jungle city Banuta ...
npc.bozo.mission_30_t3_4: The orc king in the orc fortress Uldrek's Rock and the last one to EITHER Yaman, the green djinn, OR, Nah'Bob, the blue djinn ...
npc.bozo.mission_30_t3_5: A piece of cake isn't it? Did you take notes? If you need the list again, just ask me for it. Otherwise leave now and report about the mission whenever you're done.
npc.bozo.multi_1: You shaved the emperor, but lost the beard? What kind of fool are you? Well, at least he will have a nice surprise when he wakes up ...
npc.bozo.multi_10: Are you sure you want to waste a part of your limited lifetime on a quest that makes a fool of yourself and which might award you with the prestigious title of a grand fool in a far away future?
npc.bozo.multi_2: Still, as a small recognition of your accomplishments I'm willing to tell you how to get your own jester outfit. If you are interested in more fun and adventures, ask me for more missions.
npc.bozo.multi_3: What a foolish decision! You are indeed a worthy candidate! But let's talk about business ...
npc.bozo.multi_4: Being a jester is not just about telling jokes. A good jester heavily relies on requisites ...
npc.bozo.multi_5: Getting some requisites will be your first job. First of all we need a good supply of water squirt flowers ...
npc.bozo.multi_6: I'm making them on my own in my spare time but I need the right material. South of Thais, next to the Whiteflower Temple, you will find the ideal flowers ...
npc.bozo.multi_7: Take a kitchen knife, cut the thickest and healthiest flower and bring it here. Then talk to me about your mission.
npc.bozo.multi_8: So you want to make a total fool of yourself? Fine with me, but note that becoming a real fool means more than being just an ordinary fool ...
npc.bozo.multi_9: You will have to master a whole series of challenging, lengthy and, above all, totally foolish quests ...
npc.bozo.say_1: Wow, your stupidity would be pride and joy for every fool. You've already applied as a member. Let's rather talk about your current mission.
npc.bozo.say_10: Oh boy, why do only fools apply for the fools guild?
npc.bozo.say_2: Do you wish to become a jester and join the fools guild?
npc.bozo.say_3: I'm sure it suits you well.
npc.bozo.say_4: No, you aren't! Why do only fools apply for the fools guild?
npc.bozo.say_5: Eeeek! What have you done?? These pies are crawling with bugs! Those must be the infamous parcel bugs! Get some new pies at once you wannabe fool, and this time without any bugs!
npc.bozo.say_6: No, you don't! Why do only fools apply for the fools guild?
npc.bozo.say_7: Too bad, I'm convinced you have it in you.
npc.bozo.say_8: You won't be successful in the fool's world with such an attitude.
npc.bozo.say_9: You wasted the disguise?? Why do only fools apply for the fools guild? Here... try again, but be wittier this time.
npc.bozo.stdmod_10: I wonder if they love my water squirt flowers as much as all other plants.
npc.bozo.stdmod_11: They are the king's favourites, because they know how to 'bow'.
npc.bozo.stdmod_12: Did you notice that old knights have their scars just on their backs?
npc.bozo.stdmod_13: A fitting place for a {jester}. I guess there are worse {jobs} around.
npc.bozo.stdmod_14: Bozo: Nah, no jests about His Royal Highness.
npc.bozo.stdmod_15: I rarely leave the castle. It's really stressful to be as popular as me.
npc.bozo.stdmod_16: This castle is my home. A fitting place for a jester and all other fools. Feel welcome.
npc.bozo.stdmod_17: I'm a jester, not a doctor!
npc.bozo.stdmod_18: My name is Bozo. But it's more than a name, it's a lifestyle for me!
npc.bozo.stdmod_2: Do you know the one with the dragon? Where - and then ... hahahaha! Oh no, I guess I ruined it.
npc.bozo.stdmod_20: Ever since the first guild was created, there is a great demand of jesters and fools to join them.
npc.bozo.stdmod_21: Sell? Hmm, I know a little about magic and by chance I can sell you a truly unusual {weapon}.
npc.bozo.stdmod_23: I know the newest jokes in tibia.
npc.bozo.stdmod_24: Thank you, I'm fine, the gods are with me.
npc.bozo.stdmod_25: Pheeew! That sounds disgusting! Are you a cook at Frodo's?
npc.bozo.stdmod_29: Hey, the little one is almost as funny as me!
npc.bozo.stdmod_3: The fools' guild? Are you serious? No, of course not! Hahaha!
npc.bozo.stdmod_31: She's pretty but too serious for my taste.
npc.bozo.stdmod_32: Humourless old guy! Once, he turned me into a frog for painting his distasteful cave in pink.
npc.bozo.stdmod_33: A man of steel with a stomach of wax. Never offer him a beer!
npc.bozo.stdmod_34: He's my baby brother. If you tell him I sent you, he will grant you an extra spell or two.
npc.bozo.stdmod_35: He sells spell scrolls each day at midnight, but you have to address him that very second.
npc.bozo.stdmod_36: I better make no jokes about THIS matter.
npc.bozo.stdmod_37: Did you know that he sells a 'power axe of doom' now? Run and buy it, he only has got three in store.
npc.bozo.stdmod_38: He would make a fine jester, too.
npc.bozo.stdmod_39: I know a lot of monster jokes. Just tell me a monster's name, come on.
npc.bozo.stdmod_40: Why are the experienced heroes quicker than others? ... The demons love fast food!
npc.bozo.stdmod_41: Where do ghouls buy their robes? ... In a boooohtique!
npc.bozo.stdmod_42: Why do dragons breathe fire? ... They ate too many sorcerers in chilli sauce!
npc.bozo.stdmod_43: Why do orcs have green skin? ... They ate at Frodo's!
npc.bozo.stdmod_44: How many eyes does a cyclops have? ... One for each IQ point they have!
npc.bozo.stdmod_45: If you believe half the rumours he's spreading, you will get in a lot of trouble.
npc.bozo.stdmod_46: If you are a bad jester, you get a chance to visit them now and then.
npc.bozo.stdmod_47: What do all little minotaurs want to become when they are grown-ups? ... Cowboys, of course!
npc.bozo.stdmod_48: Why do trolls live underground? ... Because there are so many pks on the surface!
npc.bozo.stdmod_49: Why are bonelords so ugly? ... Because their mom and dad were bonelords, too!
npc.bozo.stdmod_5: I wanted to become a sorcerer, too, but I was overqualified!
npc.bozo.stdmod_50: Why does the rat have a wooden leg? ... Because it is a former pirate!
npc.bozo.stdmod_51: Why did the spider cross the road? ... Because it ... oh you already know this one!?
npc.bozo.stdmod_52: I had a cousin named like that.
npc.bozo.stdmod_54: Isn't he the author of the book 'Fun with Demons'?
npc.bozo.stdmod_55: He is kind of a father figure to me. Of course he denies all kinship to me.
npc.bozo.stdmod_56: He's a smart one. I heared he hid in a foreign country as the first bugs showed up.
npc.bozo.stdmod_57: I am not foolish enough to believe in the existence of this weapon.
npc.bozo.stdmod_58: Oh, I saw some demon carvings in the dungeons as I hid there after a little joke on old Stutch.
npc.bozo.stdmod_59: Yes, they showed demons, seven actually, dancing around a sword! In something like a flaming pit.
npc.bozo.stdmod_6: I wanted to become a druid, too, but I was overqualified!
npc.bozo.stdmod_60: Ah, don't ask me! Usually mages and mystics know more about such stuff.
npc.bozo.stdmod_61: I'm the royal jes ... uhm ... the royal tax-collector! Do you want to pay your taxes?
npc.bozo.stdmod_62: Come back, when you have enough money.
npc.bozo.stdmod_63: Thank you very much. I will have a drink or two on your health!
npc.bozo.stdmod_65: I actually know some spells! Do you want to learn how to 'lessen your load' for 200 gold?
npc.bozo.stdmod_66: Come back, when you have enough money.
npc.bozo.stdmod_67: Here you are, I already lessened your load.
npc.bozo.stdmod_68: You don't know what offer you are missing!
npc.bozo.stdmod_69: Do you want to buy a 'mace of the fury' for 250 gold?
npc.bozo.stdmod_7: I wanted to become a paladin, too, but I was overqualified!
npc.bozo.stdmod_70: Come back, when you have enough money.
npc.bozo.stdmod_71: And here it is, it suits you well!
npc.bozo.stdmod_72: You dont know what offer you have passed!
npc.bozo.stdmod_74: Do you want to kiss me?
npc.bozo.stdmod_75: Uh, oh! ... I am seeing stars!
npc.bozo.stdmod_76: Pah, I didn't want to kiss you anyway!
npc.bozo.stdmod_8: I wanted to become a knight, too, but I was overqualified!
npc.bozo.stdmod_9: The good thing about them is that they can't be at two places at the same time.

npc.brasith.stdmod_1: You may buy all the things we grow or gather at this place.
npc.brasith.stdmod_10: Life takes many forms. Plants are a very basic form of life. Its simplicity makes them close to the core of nature.
npc.brasith.stdmod_2: We abandoned the gods a long time ago. A short time after they abandoned us.
npc.brasith.stdmod_3: They are lost, and if they still exist they are alone in the cold and the darkness.
npc.brasith.stdmod_4: The Kuridai left the true path and can't see their error. Their way of living may have been suitable in the past, but if they don't come back to us, their path will lead into darkness.
npc.brasith.stdmod_5: We have still much to learn but we are on the correct path at least.
npc.brasith.stdmod_6: The Cenath forgot as many as they learned. I doubt they find the wisdom they are looking for without the things they neglected in their pursuit of knowledge.
npc.brasith.stdmod_7: I don't claim to understand this creatures but sometimes they are more close to the roots than we are.
npc.brasith.stdmod_8: They are so many, so planless, so divided. They choose a path I do not want for my own race.
npc.brasith.stdmod_9: Life takes many forms. Plants are a very basic form of life. Its simplicity makes them close to the core of nature.
npc.brewster.greet_msg_1: Welcome, young |PLAYERNAME|! If you are heavily wounded or poisoned, I can {heal} you for free.
npc.brewster.keyword_1: So receive the protection of the twist of fate, pilgrim.
npc.brewster.say_1: The only person who might have some cough syrup is this druid Ustan. You find him in the tavern. Hmmm the tavern ... <hicks>
npc.brewster.stdmod_1: So receive the protection of the twist of fate, pilgrim.
npc.brewster.stdmod_11: I think you have forgotten to bring your stake, pilgrim.
npc.brewster.stdmod_12: Yes, I have been informed and haven't yet drunk enough to forget, so you can count yourself lucky. Are you prepared to <hicks> receive my line of the prayer?
npc.brewster.stdmod_13: So receive my prayer: 'Your hand shall be guided - your feet shall walk in <hicks> harmony'. Now, take your stake to Tyrias in <hicks> Liberty Bay for the next line of the prayer. I shall let him know what he is to do.
npc.brewster.stdmod_15: You should visit Tyrias in Liberty Bay now.
npc.brewster.stdmod_16: You have already received my line of the prayer. Don't make me do more work than necessary!
npc.brewster.stdmod_17: A blessed stake? That's a <hicks> strange request. Maybe Quentin knows more, he is one of the oldest monks after all.
npc.brewster.stdmod_18: You are hurt, my child. I will heal your wounds.
npc.brewster.stdmod_19: You aren't looking that bad. Sorry, I can't help you. But if you are looking for additional protection you should go on the {pilgrimage} of ashes or get the protection of the {twist of fate} here.
npc.brewster.stdmod_2: Fine. You are free to decline my offer.
npc.brewster.stdmod_20: Whenever you receive a lethal wound, your vital force is damaged and there is a chance that you lose some of your equipment. With every single of the five {blessings} you have, this damage and chance of loss will be reduced.
npc.brewster.stdmod_21: There are five blessings available in five sacred places: the {spiritual} shielding, the spark of the {phoenix}, the {embrace} of Tibia, the fire of the {suns} and the wisdom of {solitude}. Additionally, you can receive the {twist of fate} here.
npc.brewster.stdmod_22: I see you received the spiritual shielding in the whiteflower temple south of Thais.
npc.brewster.stdmod_23: I can sense that the druids north of Carlin have provided you with the Embrace of Tibia.
npc.brewster.stdmod_24: I can see you received the blessing of the two suns in the suntower near Ab'Dendriel.
npc.brewster.stdmod_25: I can sense that the spark of the phoenix already was given to you by the dwarven priests of earth and fire in Kazordoon.
npc.brewster.stdmod_26: I can sense you already talked to the hermit Eremo on the isle of Cormaya and received this blessing.
npc.brewster.stdmod_27: You can ask for the blessing of spiritual shielding in the whiteflower temple south of Thais.
npc.brewster.stdmod_28: The druids north of Carlin will provide you with the embrace of Tibia.
npc.brewster.stdmod_29: You can ask for the blessing of the two suns in the suntower near Ab'Dendriel.
npc.brewster.stdmod_30: The spark of the phoenix is given by the dwarven priests of earth and fire in Kazordoon.
npc.brewster.stdmod_32:
This is a special blessing I can bestow upon you once you have obtained at least one of the other blessings and which functions a bit differently. ... \z
	It only works when you're killed by other adventurers, which means that at least half of the damage leading to your death was caused by others, not by monsters or the environment. ... \z
	The {twist of fate} will not reduce the death penalty like the other blessings, but instead prevent you from losing your other blessings as well as the amulet of loss, should you wear one. It costs the same as the other blessings. ... \z
	Would you like to receive that protection for a sacrifice of |PVPBLESSCOST| gold, child?
npc.brewster.stdmod_4: Ah, you want to replace your adventurer's stone for free?
npc.brewster.stdmod_7: Ah, you want to replace your adventurer's stone for 30 gold?
npc.brewster.stdmod_9: Sorry, you don't have enough money.
npc.brewster.walkaway_msg_1: Remember: If you are heavily wounded or poisoned, I can heal you for free.
npc.briasol.multi_1: Rashid sent you, I suppose. Before I sell you that vase, one word of advice. ...
npc.briasol.multi_2: Make room in your backpack so that I can place the vase carefully inside it. If it falls to the floor, it will most likely shatter or break if you try to pick it up again. ...
npc.briasol.multi_3: This vase it not meant to be touched by human hands, so just keep your hands off it. Are you ready to buy that vase for 1000 gold?
npc.briasol.voice_1: Come and take a look at the finest gems in the lands of Tibia.
npc.brodrosch.greet_msg_1: Welcome, |PLAYERNAME|! May earth protect you on the rocky grounds. If you need a {passage}, I can help you.
npc.brodrosch.say_1: Your weekly ticket is still valid. Would be a waste of money to purchase a second one
npc.brodrosch.say_2: Do you want to purchase a weekly ticket for the ore wagons? With it you can travel freely and swiftly through Kazordoon for one week. 250 gold only. Deal?
npc.brodrosch.say_4: Here is your stamp. It can't be transferred to another person and will last one week from now. You'll get notified upon using an ore wagon when it isn't valid anymore.
npc.brodrosch.stdmod_1: Passage to Cormaya! Unforgettable steamboat ride!

npc.bron.greet_msg_1: Oh no! Was that really me? This is so embarassing, I have no idea what has gotten into me. Was that the fighting spirit you gave me?
npc.bron.multi_1: Great! You see, I really would love to sew a nice shirt for him. I just need a few things for that, so please listen closely: ...
npc.bron.multi_10: Don't do this if you feel weak or ill. He will probably want to make you leave by using violence, but just stay strong and refuse to give up. ...
npc.bron.multi_11: If he should ask what else is necessary to make you leave, tell him to 'say please'. Afterwards, do leave and return to him one hour later. ...
npc.bron.multi_12: This way he might learn that violence doesn't always help, but that a friendly word might just do the trick. ...
npc.bron.multi_13: Have you understood everything I told you and are really willing to take this risk?
npc.bron.multi_14: This... person... makes me want to... say something bad... must... control myself. <sweats> I really don't know what to do anymore. ...
npc.bron.multi_15: I wonder if Ajax has an idea. Could you ask him about Gelagos?
npc.bron.multi_16: Convincing Ajax that it is not always necessary to use brute force... this would be such an achievement. Definitely a hard task though. ...
npc.bron.multi_17: Listen, I simply have to ask, maybe a stranger can influence him better than I can. Would you help me with my brother?
npc.bron.multi_2: He loves green and red, so I will need about 50 pieces of red cloth - like the material heroes make their capes of - and 50 pieces of the green cloth Djinns like. ...
npc.bron.multi_3: Secondly, I need about 10 rolls of spider silk yarn. I think mermaids can yarn silk of large spiders to create a smooth thread. ...
npc.bron.multi_4: The only remaining thing needed would be a bottle of warrior's sweat to spray it over the shirt... he just loves this smell. ...
npc.bron.multi_5: Have you understood everything I told you and are willing to handle this task?
npc.bron.multi_6: I'm impressed... I am sure this was Ajax' idea. I would love to give him a present, but if I leave my hut to gather ingredients, hewill surely notice. ...
npc.bron.multi_7: Would you maybe help me again, one last time, my friend? I assure you that your efforts will not be in vain.
npc.bron.multi_8: Really! That is such an incredibly nice offer! I already have a plan. You have to teach him that sometimes words are stronger than fists. ...
npc.bron.multi_9: Maybe you can provoke him with something to get angry, like saying... 'MINE!' or something. But beware, I'm sure that he will try to hit you. ...
npc.bron.say_10: Terrific! I will start to trim it while you gather 10 rolls of spider silk. I'm sure that Ajax will love it.
npc.bron.say_11: I'm impressed! You really managed to get spool of yarn for me! I will immediately start to work on this shirt. Please don't forget to bring me warrior's sweat!
npc.bron.say_12: Good work, |PLAYERNAME|! Now I can finally finish this present for Ajax. Because you were such a great help, I have also a present for you. Will you accept it?
npc.bron.say_13: I have kept this traditional barbarian wig safe for many years now. It is now yours! I hope you will wear it proudly, friend.
npc.bron.say_2: Oh! He really said that? I am so proud of you, |PLAYERNAME|. These are really good news. Everything would be great... if only there wasn't this {person} near my house.
npc.bron.say_3: Fighting spirit? What am I supposed to do with this fi... - oh! I feel strange... ME MIGHTY! ME WILL CHASE OFF ANNOYING KIDS!GROOOAARR!! RRRRRRRRRRRRAAAAAAAGE!!
npc.bron.say_4: Have you really managed to fulfil the task and brought me 50 pieces of red cloth and 50 pieces of green cloth?
npc.bron.say_5: Oh, did you bring 10 rolls of spool of yarn for me?
npc.bron.say_6: Were you able to get hold of a flask with pure warrior's sweat?
npc.bron.say_7: You are indeed not only well educated, but also very courageous. I wish you good luck, you are my last hope.
npc.bron.say_8: Again, I have to thank you for your selfless offer to help me. I hope that Ajax can come up with something, now that he has experienced the power of words.
npc.bron.say_9: Thank you, my friend! Come back to me once you have collected 50 pieces of red cloth and 50 pieces of green cloth.
npc.bron.stdmod_1: This... person... makes me want to... say something bad... must... control myself. <sweats>

npc.budrik.greet_msg_1: Hiho, hiho |PLAYERNAME|. Why do you {disturb} me?
npc.budrik.kw_shearton_softbeard_1: Yes, I remember him well. It was a tragedy. An earthquake led to a cave-in and many of our brave miners died. ...
npc.budrik.kw_shearton_softbeard_2: Their ghosts still haunt the Grothmok tunnel in which they died, so we had to seal it off.
npc.budrik.multi_1: By all that is holy! You are a truly great warrior! With much patience! I have just found out the location the hideout of The Horned Fox! I have marked the spot on your map so you can find it. Go there and slay him!! ...
npc.budrik.multi_2: BUT, you will have only this ONE chance to catch him! Good luck!
npc.budrik.multi_3: I want you to kill 5000 minotaurs - no matter where - for me and all the dwarfs of Kazordoon! Are you willing to do that?
npc.budrik.multi_4: I want you to kill 5000 minotaurs - no matter where - for me and all the dwarfs of Kazordoon! Are you willing to do that?
npc.budrik.multi_5: Funny that you are asking me for a mission! There is indeed something you can do for me. Ever heard about The Horned Fox? Anyway, yesterday his gang has stolen my mining helmet during a raid. ...
npc.budrik.multi_6: It belonged to my father and before that to my grandfather. That helmet is at least 600 years old! I need it back. Are you willing to help me?
npc.budrik.say_1: As I was just saying to the others, 'this brave fellow will bring me my mining helmet back' and here you are with it!! Here take my spare helmet, I don't need it anymore!
npc.budrik.say_2: We presume the hideout of The Horned Fox is somewhere in the south-west near the coast, good luck finding my mining helmet!
npc.budrik.say_3: Come back when you have slain {5000 minotaurs!}
npc.budrik.say_4: It was very decent of you to help me, and I am thankful, really I am, but now I have to get back to my duties as a foreman.
npc.budrik.say_5: Well, I could need help with that damn Horned Fox and his gang, but I guess since you are rather experienced, killing minotaurs would bore you to death. I'll wait for someone else. But thanks!
npc.budrik.say_7: I knew you have the guts for that task! We presume the hideout of The Horned Fox somewhere in the south-west near the coast. Good luck!
npc.budrik.say_8: Hussah! Let's bring war to those hoof-legged, dirt-necked, bull-headed minotaurs!! Come back to me when you are done with your {mission}.
npc.budrik.stdmod_11: This is no funhouse. Leave the miners and their drilling-worms alone and get out! We have already enough trouble without you.
npc.budrik.stdmod_2: We understand the ways of the earth like nobody else.
npc.budrik.stdmod_3: I'm a miner, not your mother. Go ask someone else.
npc.budrik.stdmod_4: The hideout of the Horned Fox is probably a dangerous if not lethal place for inexperienced adventurers. It is the source of all the {trouble} around here.
npc.budrik.stdmod_5: He is a minotaur who was kicked out of Mintwallin. He must have some kind of {hideout} nearby.
npc.budrik.stdmod_6: This is not an amusement park! Leave the miners and their drilling-worms alone and get out! We've already got enough {trouble} without you.
npc.budrik.stdmod_7: We occasionally come across nasty beasts in the deepest mines.
npc.budrik.stdmod_8: My name is Budrik Deepdigger, Son of Earth, from the Molten Rock.
npc.budrik.stdmod_9: The {Horned Fox} is leading his bandits in sneak attacks and raids on us.
npc.bunny_bonecrusher.multi_1: Normally we don't assign missions to civilians - and particularly to MALE civilians - but in this case I think we can make an exception. ...
npc.bunny_bonecrusher.multi_2: I need a courier to deliver a parcel to the watchtower in Femor Hills. You think you can handle that??
npc.bunny_bonecrusher.say_1: Alright, you delivered the parcel. So what is the password Thanita told you?
npc.bunny_bonecrusher.say_2: I am not sure if I should be glad now or not but anyway ... you will get a password so I will know if you just threw it away or actually delivered it. Here is the parcel. See you ....or not.
npc.bunny_bonecrusher.say_3: That's right. Here is your reward some elementary arrows. You did pretty well on your mission!
npc.bunny_bonecrusher.stdmod_10: Our city blends in with the nature surrounding it. Our {druids} take care of that.
npc.bunny_bonecrusher.stdmod_11: They are our main magic support and play a major role in our battle {tactics}.
npc.bunny_bonecrusher.stdmod_13: K.I.S.S.! Keep It Simple, Stupid! Complicated tactics are too easy to be crushed by a twist of fate.
npc.bunny_bonecrusher.stdmod_14: Our elite forces are trained by rangers and druids. In the woods they come a close second to elves.
npc.bunny_bonecrusher.stdmod_16: Sorry, we don't recruit foreigners. Maybe you can join if you prove yourself in a mission for the queen.
npc.bunny_bonecrusher.stdmod_2: We are in constant training and in perfect health.
npc.bunny_bonecrusher.stdmod_3: I am the general of the queen's army. I don't have time to explain this concept to you.
npc.bunny_bonecrusher.stdmod_4: Our family has been serving the Carlin army since countless generations!
npc.bunny_bonecrusher.stdmod_5: Our family has been serving the Carlin army since countless generations!
npc.bunny_bonecrusher.stdmod_6: She is one of my beloved sisters and serves Carlin as a town guard.
npc.bunny_bonecrusher.stdmod_7: HAIL TO QUEEN ELOISE, OUR NOBLE {LEADER}!
npc.bunny_bonecrusher.stdmod_8: Queen Eloise is a fine leader for our fair town, indeed!
npc.bunny_bonecrusher.stdmod_9: The army protects the defenceless males of our {city}. Our elite forces are the {Green Ferrets}.
npc.busty_bonecrusher.voice_1: Behave yourself as long as you are in Carlin, commoner!
npc.cael.greet_msg_1: Greetings, |PLAYERNAME|! You must have come around quite a bit. I'm always interested in learning new things about Zao.
npc.cael.multi_1: In the modern lizard culture thrones seem to be only a reminiscent of the past. Whereas in the past the rulers of the lizardmen used thrones and other insignia to show their status, in our days they are ruled by dragon kings. ...
npc.cael.multi_10: I think in the past, the lizardmen of this country might have worshipped a snake god or goddess just like their brethren in Tiquanda if we can believe the reports from this area. The dragons replaced the snake worship at some point of history. ...
npc.cael.multi_11: The reference to heretics and their extermination suggests that there might have been a rebellion against the dragons, which in turn hints at some close link between lizards and dragons, maybe a forced one. ...
npc.cael.multi_12: While reading this tome, I discovered a drawing of this beautiful statue. I was a skilled sculptor in the past, so I can't resist. ...
npc.cael.multi_13: I'm probably not that good anymore, but if you're interested and find me a red lantern, I could make one of those for you.
npc.cael.multi_14: It seems that some parts of the tome are just copies from other sources and rather unrelated to each other. As far as I could piece them together, there was a mythical founder of the lizard civilisation. ...
npc.cael.multi_15: His name was Zao and his deeds and exploits are immortalised in lizard folklore. Some of the earliest records in the tomes suggest a slightly different story though. ...
npc.cael.multi_16: Many records talk about an early lizard dynasty, but I doubt that Zao was a single person born into that dynasty. ...
npc.cael.multi_17: My guess is that several members of this dynasty are responsible for or connected to the feats that were attributed to the mythical 'Zao'. ...
npc.cael.multi_18: The improbable lifespan of 'Zao' can thus be explained with the time the Zao dynasty reigned. On the other hand, we all know larger-than-life heroes did exist and some of them had an extremely long lifespan. ...
npc.cael.multi_19: Most likely, he also had children which could explain the mentioning of a Zao family. I think even the lizardmen don't know for sure what happened in such distant past and so this might be one of those riddles that will never be solved. ...
npc.cael.multi_2: Those kings seem to be massive dragons of immense power. Of course they do not actually 'use' thrones anymore, but claim them nonetheless as symbol for their position. ...
npc.cael.multi_20: It seems that the origin of the Zao dynasty was somewhere in the Dragonblaze Peaks, or rather under them. Legends tell of a large fortress, once erected up the highest peak, but now buried deep underground. Who knows, maybe you'll find answers there?
npc.cael.multi_21: I think the origin of the Draken sheds some new light on certain aspects of the lizard society. It is obvious from the books that the Draken appeared only after the dragon kings revealed themselves to the lizards. ...
npc.cael.multi_22: It is specifically mentioned that the tide of the battle turned when they joined the army of the lizards. Parts of the tome were obviously erased and later overwritten. ...
npc.cael.multi_23: In the parts of the original text that I was able to reconstruct with the help of some alchemy, there were some references to lizard spawns that were sighted in the Tiquanda area and linked to the snake god. ...
npc.cael.multi_24: Admittedly, it is just a hypothesis that is based on a few hints in these tomes and my correspondence about serpent spawns with the sage Edowir... ...
npc.cael.multi_25: ...However, considering everything that I could figure out about their origin, they seem to hatch from the same eggs like ordinary lizardmen. ...
npc.cael.multi_26: It seems that some of those eggs are imbued with spiritual or magical power and as a result bear a serpent spawn. It appears that this changed when the dragon emperor became the ruler of this land. ...
npc.cael.multi_27: Unlike serpent spawns, the Draken hatched from some of the eggs in the hatcheries. ...
npc.cael.multi_28: I can only imagine what this might imply. As I said, it's only a theory, but I think a quite valid one and I'd treasure any additional information about that topic. ...
npc.cael.multi_29: In the meantime, I've also talked to Esrik about some information that I found in the tome concerning weaponry and armory. Knowing this dwarf, he might have some interesting offers for you by now.
npc.cael.multi_3: From what I can tell, the lizards are bound to those dragon kings by some kind of magic. I'm not sure what this magic does, but I guess it ensures their loyalty to some extent. ...
npc.cael.multi_30: You know, while all this talk about growing and preparing rice might sound boring, there are actually some bits of vital information hidden in all those lists. ...
npc.cael.multi_31: It seems that not only the loss of the southern area hampered the rice harvest of the lizards. ...
npc.cael.multi_32: Ever since the dragon kings established their reign, the harvest constantly got worse. And this is not all! It's reported that everything that is growing in this land experienced a fertility decrease. ...
npc.cael.multi_33: Even the lizards themselves seem to suffer from a population decline. It's widely blamed to a plague that ravaged the land in the past, but that seems unlikely given the fact that also plants and various animals were affected. ...
npc.cael.multi_34: Additionally, several plants changed in shape and became poisonous or toxic. Also, some new-born lizards seem to be affected by this. ...
npc.cael.multi_35: According to the descriptions, I'd call them mentally unstable, but their people see them as 'blessed by the dragon emperor'. I assume there are strange forces at work in this land, and I have a bad feeling about it. ...
npc.cael.multi_36: Anyway, you know what else was mentioned in this book? A path down to a hidden cave system below the Muggy Plains. ...
npc.cael.multi_37: Apparently, at first this system was used to hide - or rather to get rid of - new-born lizards that carried the sign of corruption - before the lizards decided to view it as a blessing. ...
npc.cael.multi_38: Who knows what happens down there now - maybe it's worth a look, maybe not. Maybe you won't even discover anything. In any case, be careful.
npc.cael.multi_39: Maybe you don't know that the great steppe was once a fertile ground. Well, to be precise - in the distant past it probably did not look any different from what it looks today. ...
npc.cael.multi_4: On an interesting side note - there were some hints in the tome that the dragon kings themselves are somehow bound to the dragon emperor through the same kind of magic. ...
npc.cael.multi_40: But when the lizard civilisation was at its peak, they apparently developed advanced irrigation systems to water the steppe and used this area as major source for their supplies on rice and other food. ...
npc.cael.multi_41: Back in those times, the lizard population was immense and their need of supplies tremendous. Therefore, they did not allow other races to co-exist and exterminated most of them almost completely. ...
npc.cael.multi_42: Some relics of the settlements of the pre-lizard cultures can still be found. Most of them were probably converted by the victorious lizardmen into something that suited their purposes better. ...
npc.cael.multi_43: All that talk about relics reminds me about something I've recently seen when getting some fresh air up in the mountains. Right next to the carpet pilot - may earth protect me from ever having to step on that thing - was an old lizard relic. ...
npc.cael.multi_44: Incredible how far their realm might have stretched at the peak of their civilisation! Time left its marks on the relic and I suppose it looks rather dangerous, but I am convinced that it is safe. You should try it out sometime.
npc.cael.multi_45: Well, to be honest it doesn't say much about humans in this book. However, it seems that the humans on this continent used to live in the steppe. ...
npc.cael.multi_46: In the great war against dragons and lizards, they didn't stand the slightest chance due to lack of equipment and well, let's face it, intelligence. The other races were superior in every way. ...
npc.cael.multi_47: They were driven back into the mountains and survived by growing mushrooms, collecting herbs and probably hunting smaller animals. Today, the orcs pose a major threat to them, so I guess they need every help they can possibly get. ...
npc.cael.multi_48: Anyway! The humans seem to make a so-called 'great hunt' now and then, and for that they play war instruments. If you're interested in drums or a didgeridoo and want to trade, let me know. I've recreated a few, they don't actually sound bad!
npc.cael.multi_49: Have you ever seen the towers of the large lizard city south-east of Zao? It's the last one south of the mountains and who knows how long they are able to hold it. ...
npc.cael.multi_5: It seems this kind of liege system was formed sometime after the arrival of the dragons in this land. It's definitely an interesting field of research and shows us how much we still have to learn and to discover. ...
npc.cael.multi_50: It's under constant and heavy siege by the steppe orcs and minotaurs. Sometimes they manage to crush the gates and storm the city. Watch out, you probably don't want to stumble right into the middle of a war. Or maybe you do? ...
npc.cael.multi_51: Anyway, I found another nice pattern in this book. It's for a lizard carrying device. I've given it to Pompan, just in case you're interested.
npc.cael.multi_52: I discovered an interesting recipe in this Tome of Knowledge. Maybe you've seen the large rice terraces in Muggy Plains - that is how the lizardmen apparently call that region. ...
npc.cael.multi_53: The book is a lot of blabla about how they cultivate and harvest their rice, but there's something we could actually learn, and that is a certain way to prepare that rice. ...
npc.cael.multi_54: If you ever come across a ripe rice plant, bring it to Swolt in the tavern and he might help you prepare it - grumpily.
npc.cael.multi_55: According to what I've read in that tome, the Draken seem to be a crossbreed between lizards and dragons, combining the dragons' strength with the lizards' swiftness. They seem to be the main figures in the dragons' internal quarrels. ...
npc.cael.multi_56: They can't fly and are stuck with walking on two feet, but else they combine the best of two worlds - they are intelligent, powerful and both strong magic users and skilled weapon wielders. ...
npc.cael.multi_57: Have you been to one of their settlements yet? They seem to have really beautifully adorned weapon racks. I've given a construction plan of such a rack to Esrik. Maybe he can recreate it.
npc.cael.multi_58: Did you know that most of the minotaurs you might have met by now do not originally come from Zao? The original minotaur race stood no chance against the united force of dragons and lizards. ...
npc.cael.multi_59: Most of them were killed and captured, but a few of them were able to flee the continent. They found other minotaurs, mighty Mooh'Tah masters, and told them their story. ...
npc.cael.multi_6: Well, I've certainly learnt how the great old thrones look like. If you bring me some red cloth, I could probably try and reconstruct one for you.
npc.cael.multi_60: The Mooh'Tah masters actually found the continent Zao and started to look for their lost brothers, but it doesn't say whether they actually found any survivors. ...
npc.cael.multi_61: In the tome, there was also a really nice pattern of a carrying device that might have been used by minotaurs. Or maybe by enemies of minotaurs. I've given it to Pompan. ...
npc.cael.multi_62: Maybe he can find a way to use it... we dwarfs are not that skilled when it comes to fashion.
npc.cael.multi_63: Did you know that the lizardmen were among the first races roaming this continent? They were waging war against the orcs, minotaurs and humans on Zao and for a long time it seemed that the forces were even. ...
npc.cael.multi_64: However, a while later, also a race of dragons arrived on this continent. Seeing the lizards as distant relatives, they decided to support their war, and together they drove all other races back into the steppe. ...
npc.cael.multi_65: It turned out though that the dragonkin didn't really view the lizards as allies but as servants and demanded gold and slaves for their help. Part of the lizard population agreed and obeyed their new masters, the others stirred up a violent rebellion. ...
npc.cael.multi_66: It doesn't really say what happened afterwards, but in the book were also pictures of special symbols the lizards use for their flags and banners. I've given this to Pompan. Maybe he can find a way to use it.
npc.cael.multi_7: Dragons are of great symbolism for this land. Even before the dragons came here and took control over Zao, the lizards worshipped the dragons as strong mythical beasts. ...
npc.cael.multi_8: When the future dragon kings came here - seemingly from a distant and foreign land - they probably took some advantage of this cult. ...
npc.cael.multi_9: Another symbol - that of the snake - that must have been much more popular than the dragon, faded into unimportance over the years. ...

npc.captain_haba.say_7: Excellent, now bring me 5 northern pike.
npc.captain_haba.say_8: Excellent, now bring me 5 green perch.
npc.captain_haba.say_9: Excellent, now bring me 5 rainbow trout.

npc.captain_haba.stdmod_10: Dis is no passenger ship it's a WARship. I'm on hunting business.
npc.captain_haba.stdmod_11: Never heard of him. He is no captain that's for sure, otherwise I'd know him. I was on the sea for the last 20 years hunting this, this monster.
npc.captain_haba.stdmod_12: Yee, I've been chasing that monster for over 20 years now. I promise I'll bring it down!
npc.captain_haba.stdmod_13: It lets me forget the long years, the lost years. The years I was chasing after THAT monster, the sea serpent.
npc.captain_haba.stdmod_15: Our last ship has been destroyed by the most evil creature of the ocean: the sea serpent. To continue our hunt, I've bought this ship here.
npc.captain_haba.stdmod_17: I'm faithful - I'll catch that monster one day. Yes I will, as sure as my name is Captain Haba!!
npc.captain_haba.stdmod_18: On the high seas there is no queen. At least I didn't see her yet. Hararar!
npc.captain_haba.stdmod_19: On the high seas there is no king. At least I didn't see him yet. Hararar!

npc.captain_haba.stdmod_5: My name is Haba, Captain Haba for ya little worm.
