npc.dixi.voice_2: Need some help? Just ask me, I can show you around!
npc.dixi.voice_3: Don't forget to protect yourself with a shield!
npc.dixi.voice_4: Selling the finest armors on Rookgaard!
npc.dixi.voice_5: Don't let these mean monsters hurt you - get better equipment now!
npc.doctor_gnomedix.greet_msg_1: Stand still on the examination platform |PLAYERNAME|.
npc.dorian.greet_msg_1: Greetings, |PLAYERNAME|! Why do you disturb me?
npc.dorian.multi_1: Once again you've finished your job, and I'll keep my promise. From now on, you can trade with old Black Bert somewhere upstairs to get access to certain items that mightbe of value to someone like you. ...
npc.dorian.multi_10: Unfortunately, we are lacking some good fighters, which is quite a disadvantage against certain other organisations. However, I think you're a really good fighter ...
npc.dorian.multi_11: Travel to the Plains of Havoc and find the base of our competitors under the ruins of the dark cathedral ...
npc.dorian.multi_12: On the lowest level, you'll find a wall with two trophies. Place a message of our guild on the wall, right between the trophies. On your way, get rid of as many of our competitors as you can.
npc.dorian.multi_13: We'd like to ease our lives somewhat. Therefore, we would appreciate the cooperation with one of the Venore city guards. ...
npc.dorian.multi_14: Find some dirt about one of them. It's unimportant what it is. As soon as we have a foothold, we'll convince him to cooperate. Bring me whatever you may find.
npc.dorian.multi_15: Your next job will be kidnapping. You'll get us the only creature that this scrupulous trader Theodore Loveless in Liberty Bay holds dear. ...
npc.dorian.multi_16: His little goldfish! To get that fish, you'll have to get in his room somehow. ...
npc.dorian.multi_17: As you might know I sell lock picks, but I fear unless you're extremely lucky, you won't crack this expensive masterpiece of a lock. However, get us that fish, regardless how.
npc.dorian.multi_18: Your next mission will lead you to Tiquanda. There is a hidden smugglers cave, north of town. ...
npc.dorian.multi_19: These smugglers think they don't have to pay us respect and try to withhold our share of the profit. Recently, they got hold of a certain valuable goblet. ...
npc.dorian.multi_2: If you like, you can also enter the room to the left and pick one item of your choice.
npc.dorian.multi_20: Find them and get us this goblet as rightful payment. If you have to bash some noses during your mission, even better.
npc.dorian.multi_21: Your next mission is somewhat bigger and I'm sure much fun for you. Some new-rich merchant is being a bit more greedy than it's good for him. ...
npc.dorian.multi_22: The good thing is he's as stupid as greedy, so we have a little but cunning plan. We arranged the boring correspondence in advance, so you'll come in when the fun starts. ...
npc.dorian.multi_23: You'll disguise yourself as the dwarven ambassador and sell that fool the old dwarven bridge, south of Kazordoon. ...
npc.dorian.multi_24: Well, actually it is a bit more complicated than that. Firstly, you'll have to get forged documents. Ask around in the criminal camp to find a forger. ...
npc.dorian.multi_25: Secondly, you'll need a disguise. Percybald in Carlin is an eccentric actor that might help you with that. ...
npc.dorian.multi_26: As soon as you got both things, travel to Venore and find the merchant Nurik. Trade the false documents for the famous painting of Mina Losa and bring it to me.
npc.dorian.multi_27: Our beloved king will hold a great festivity at the end of the month. Unfortunately he forgot to invite one of our guild's representatives. ...
npc.dorian.multi_28: Of course it would be rude to point out this mistake to the king. It will be your job to get us an invitation to the ball. ...
npc.dorian.multi_29: Moreover, It will be a great chance to check the castle for, well, opportunities. I'm sure you understand. However, it's up to that pest Oswald to give out invitations, so he's the man you're looking for.
npc.dorian.multi_3: Excellent, that little letter will do the trick for sure ...
npc.dorian.multi_30: A client of our guild would like to get a certain vase. Unfortunately, it's not for sale. Well, by the original owner, that is. ...
npc.dorian.multi_31: We, on the other hand, would gladly sell him the vase. Therefore, it would come in handy if we get this vase in our hands. ...
npc.dorian.multi_32: Luckily, the walls of the owner's house are covered with vines, that will make a burglary quite easy. ...
npc.dorian.multi_33: You'll still need some lock picks to get the chest open in which the vase is stored. Must be your lucky day, as I'm selling lock picks for a fair price. ...
npc.dorian.multi_34: You might need some of them to get that chest open. The soon to be ex-owner of that vase is Sarina, the proprietor of Carlin's general store.
npc.dorian.multi_35: Your first job is quite easy. The Thaian officials are unwilling to share the wealth they've accumulated in their new town Port Hope. ...
npc.dorian.multi_36: They insist that most resources belong to the crown. This is quite sad, especially ivory is in high demand. Collect 10 elephant tusks and bring them to me.
npc.dorian.multi_4: I think you're really capable and if you finish another mission, I'll allow you full access to our black market of lost and found items. Just ask me to learn more about that mission.
npc.dorian.multi_5: Ah, the key to untold riches. Don't worry, we'll make sure that no one will connect you to the disappearance of certain royal possessions. ...
npc.dorian.multi_6: You're too valuable to us. Speaking about your value, I might have some other mission for you.
npc.dorian.multi_7: Excellent. You'll learn this trade from scratch. Our operations cover many fields of work. Some aren't even illegal. ...
npc.dorian.multi_8: Well, as long as you don't get caught at least. Ask me for a mission whenever you're ready.
npc.dorian.multi_9: Competition might be an interesting challenge but our guild isn't really keen on competition. ...
npc.dorian.say_10: What an ugly vase. But who am I to question the taste of our customers? Anyway, I might have another mission in store for you.
npc.dorian.say_11: Excellent, that serves this fool right. I fear in your next mission, you'll have to get your hands dirty. Just ask me to learn more about it.
npc.dorian.say_12: That goblet is hardly worth all this trouble but we had to insist on our payment. However, I assume you are eager for more missions, so just ask.
npc.dorian.say_13: This little goldfish will bring us a hefty ransom! Just ask me if you're ready for another mission.
npc.dorian.say_14: Hm. Well, we could use some fresh blood. Ahum. Do you want to join the thieves guild, |PLAYERNAME|?
npc.dorian.say_15: Yes, I sell lock picks. Ask me for a trade.
npc.dorian.say_9: What a fine material. That will be worth a coin or two. So far, so good. Ask me for another mission if you're ready for it.
npc.doubleday.greet_msg_1: Hello there, hmm just... just wait right there, I'll be with you in a second. Just getting this {experiment} done...
npc.doubleday.multi_1: To actually 'find' a suitable location to deploy the probing device for my measurements, you should use my mono detector. The device detects singular chemical structures of any material or fabric I feed it with and signals it! ...
npc.doubleday.multi_10: Yes, well I am working on something very time-consuming at the moment. You see, a lot of us don't have time to go out much, to converse even just to meet and talk about recent discoveries. ...
npc.doubleday.multi_11: So I thought about a device to help communication in this wonderful city. I already had a helper, he was easily... 'stressed' and quit. Didn't have time to find a new one. ...
npc.doubleday.multi_12: So, if you'd like to help - there is a lot to do for me to bring my plans to fruition - and if you help me, you will earn my {votes} for the {magistrate} in turn! Are you in?
npc.doubleday.multi_2: If you have lost your detector or your probing device, I can hand out another - it will take some time, however. Do you need a new one?
npc.doubleday.multi_3: Very good, these readings do tell me a lot - the coloured glooth may be instable but it has some... 'interesting' effects on its surroundings. Oh - no worries, you will be perfectly safe. I will also take back my detector now, thanks. ..
npc.doubleday.multi_4: Feel free to help me deploy more probes whenever you like.
npc.doubleday.multi_5: Could you please just go down there and check if this is caused by... my... version of the {glooth}? You know, just some experiments I did to alter the basic elemental structure of the {glooth}, nothing personal. ...
npc.doubleday.multi_6: If you'd just take this very tiny probing device I designed to analyse the {coloured glooth} and, you know, go down there and place it - oh, and I'll also give you this really tiny {detector}, modified to find a spot where to place the {probe} - so?
npc.doubleday.multi_7: If you'd just take this very tiny probing device I designed to analyse the {coloured glooth} and, you know, go down there and place it - oh, and I'll also give you this really tiny {detector}, modified to find a spot where to place the {probe} - so?
npc.doubleday.multi_8: Good! Quite good! You know, there are actually several things I want you to address. ...
npc.doubleday.multi_9: First, there is the problem with {communication}, second I need someone to {probe} part of the sewers and last - {combinatorics}!
npc.doubleday.say_1: Very nice, there you go! Just bring me the printout from the probe after deploying it! You can request a new probing {device} or a new {detector} if you lose it - but it takes some time for me to get a new one ready so be careful with that stuff.
npc.doubleday.say_2: Hey, let's try to be reasonable here, alright? That's a bit too much for what you did, isn't it? It may seem that way but the number of votes I can offer isn't limitless.
npc.doubleday.say_3: Good, you just gained 1 genuine votes in the magistrate!
npc.doubleday.say_4: Alright, there you go - please, try to be more careful with my equipment next time!
npc.doubleday.say_5: Well, let's see, you helped me 1 times before exchanging any votes - how many votes do you want me to give you in exchange?
npc.doubleday.say_6: Well, let's see, you helped me 1 times before exchanging any votes - how many votes do you want me to give you in {exchange}?
npc.doubleday.say_7: Alright then, that's 2 vote(s) you want - I won't take them back, are you sure?
npc.doubleday.say_8: Alright then, that's 1 vote(s) you want - I won't take them back, are you sure?
npc.doubleday.say_9: You must wait until the detector is ready again.
npc.dove.say_1: Oh no! I knew that day would come! I am slightly above the allowed weight and if you can't supply me with some grapes to slim down I will get fired. Do you happen to have some grapes with you?
npc.dove.say_2: Oh thank you! Thank you so much! So listen ... <whispers her measurements>
npc.dukosch.greet_msg_1: Welcome, |PLAYERNAME|! Do you feel adventurous? Do you want a weekly {ticket} for the ore wagon system here? You can use it right here to get to the centre of Kazordoon!
npc.dukosch.say_1: Do you want to purchase a weekly ticket for the ore wagons? With it you can travel freely and swiftly through Kazordoon for one week. 250 gold only. Deal?
npc.dukosch.say_2: Your weekly ticket is still valid. Would be a waste of money to purchase a second one
npc.dukosch.say_3: Here is your stamp. It can't be transferred to another person and will last one week from now. You'll get notified upon using an ore wagon when it isn't valid anymore.
npc.duncan.greet_msg_1: Hi, come closer. Have a look at my wares.
npc.duncan.multi_1: I am glad to hear this. Please listen. The pirates on Nargor are breeding tortoises. They think eating tortoises makes a hard man even harder. ...
npc.duncan.multi_2: However I am quite fond of tortoises and can't stand the thought of them being eaten. So I convinced Captain Striker that I can train them to help us. As a substitute for rafts and such ...
npc.duncan.multi_3: All I need is one tortoise egg from Nargor. This is the opportunity to save a tortoise from a gruesome fate! ...
npc.duncan.multi_4: I will ask Sebastian to bring you there. Travel to Nargor, find their tortoise eggs and bring me at least one of them.
npc.duncan.multi_5: Listen, the task is not that hard. Simply prove that you are with us and not with the pirates from Nargor by bringingme some of their belongings. ...
npc.duncan.multi_6: Bring me 100 of their eye patches, 100 of their peg legs and 100 of their hooks, in that order. ...
npc.duncan.multi_7: Have you understood everything I told you and are willing to handle this task?
npc.duncan.say_1: You're talking about my sabre? Well, even though you earned our trust, you'd have to fulfill a task first before you are granted to wear such a sabre.
npc.duncan.say_10: Good! Come back to me once you have gathered 100 eye patches.
npc.duncan.say_11: Good job. Alright, now bring me 100 peg legs.
npc.duncan.say_13: Nice. Lastly, bring me 100 pirate hooks. That should be enough to earn your sabre.
npc.duncan.say_16: Indeed, what a fine work... the book I mean. Your work was acceptable all in all.
npc.duncan.say_18: A real tortoise egg ... I guess you are more accustomed to rescue some noblewoman in distress but you did something goodtoday.
npc.duncan.say_2: I need a new quality atlas for our captains. Only one of the best will do it. I heard the explorers society sells the best, but only to members of a certain rank. You will have to get this rank or ask a high ranking member to buy it for you.
npc.duncan.say_3: Did you get an atlas of the explorers society as I requested?
npc.duncan.say_4: You did some impressive things. I think people here start considering you as one of us. But these are dire times and everyone of us is expected to give his best and even exceed himself. Do you think you can handle that?
npc.duncan.say_5: Did you rescue one of those poor soon-to-be baby tortoises from Nargor?
npc.duncan.say_6: Are you up to the task which I'm going to give you and willing to prove you're worthy of wearing such a sabre?
npc.duncan.say_firebird: I see, I see. Well done. Go to Morgan and tell him this codeword: 'firebird'. He'll know what to do.
npc.duria.stdmod_1: In this category I have '{Wound Cleansing}' and '{Cure Poison}'.
npc.duria.stdmod_2: In this category I have '{Light}', '{Find Person}' and '{Great Light}'.
npc.duria.stdmod_3: I can teach you {healing spells} and {support spells}. What kind of spell do you wish to learn? You can also tell me for which level you would like to learn a spell, if you prefer that.
npc.ebenizer.greet_msg_1: Yes? What may I do for you, |PLAYERNAME|? Bank business, perhaps?
npc.ebenizer.voice_1: Don't forget to deposit your money here in the Global Bank before you head out for adventure.
npc.eclesius.greet_msg_1: Who are you? What do you want? You seem too experienced to become my assistant. Please leave.
npc.eclesius.voice_1: I'm looking for a new assistant!
npc.eclesius.voice_2: Err, what was it again that I wanted...?
npc.eclesius.voice_3: Do come in! Mind the step of the magical door, though.
npc.eclesius.voice_4: I'm so sorry... I promise it won't happen again. Problem is, I can't remember where I made the error...
npc.eclesius.voice_5: Actually, I STILL prefer inexperienced assistants. They're easier to keep an eye on and don't tend to backstab you.
npc.eclesius.voice_6: So much to do, so much to do... uh... where should I start?
npc.edala.greet_msg_2: Ashari, |PLAYERNAME|. How... nice to see a human taking interest in a beautiful art such as music.
npc.edala.greet_msg_4: Ashari, |PLAYERNAME|. You've made some... progress playing the lyre, haven't you..? I want to believe you have.
npc.edala.greet_msg_5: |PLAYERNAME|. My regular visitor. I certainly... appreciate your efforts to entertain me, but let me assure you, I'm quite comfortable up here by myself. Alone. In silence.
npc.edala.greet_msg_6: Ashari, |PLAYERNAME|. I'm starting to feel a little sorry... for your lyre. Being forced to produce such noise must be a tragic fate.
npc.edala.greet_msg_7: |PLAYERNAME|! You're driving me insane! I beg you, take your lyre away from this sacred and peaceful place.
npc.edala.greet_msg_8: |PLAYERNAME|! My ears! I'd prefer listening to drunken dwarves rambling all day to the sound of your lyre! Please, at least get it tuned. Here, you can have this elvish diapason.
npc.edala.keyword_1: So receive the fire of the suns, pilgrim.
npc.edala.stdmod_1: Would you like to receive that protection for a sacrifice of |BLESSCOST| gold, child?
npc.edala.stdmod_10: I can sense that the spark of the phoenix already was given to you by the dwarven priests of earth and fire in Kazordoon.
npc.edala.stdmod_11: I can sense you already talked to the hermit Eremo on the isle of Cormaya and received this blessing.
npc.edala.stdmod_12: You can ask for the blessing of spiritual shielding in the whiteflower temple south of Thais.
npc.edala.stdmod_13: The druids north of Carlin will provide you with the embrace of Tibia.
npc.edala.stdmod_14: The spark of the phoenix is given by the dwarven priests of earth and fire in Kazordoon.
npc.edala.stdmod_2: So receive the fire of the suns, pilgrim.
npc.edala.stdmod_3: Fine. You are free to decline my offer.
npc.edala.stdmod_4: You are hurt, my child. I will heal your wounds.
npc.edala.stdmod_5: You aren't looking that bad. Sorry, I can't help you. But if you are looking for additional protection you should go on the {pilgrimage} of ashes or get the protection of the {twist of fate} here.
npc.edala.stdmod_6: Whenever you receive a lethal wound, your vital force is damaged and there is a chance that you lose some of your equipment. With every single of the five {blessings} you have, this damage and chance of loss will be reduced.
npc.edala.stdmod_7: There are five blessings available in five sacred places: the {spiritual} shielding, the spark of the {phoenix}, the {embrace} of Tibia, the fire of the {suns} and the wisdom of {solitude}. Additionally, you can receive the {twist of fate} here.
npc.edala.stdmod_8: I see you received the spiritual shielding in the whiteflower temple south of Thais.
npc.edala.stdmod_9: I can sense that the druids north of Carlin have provided you with the Embrace of Tibia.
npc.eddy.greet_msg_1: Hello |PLAYERNAME|! Do you need some equipment for your house?
npc.eddy.sendtrade_msg_1: Have a look. Most furniture comes in handy kits. Just use them in your house to assemble the furniture. Do you want to see only a certain {type} of furniture?
npc.eddy.stdmod_1: Have you moved to a new home? I'm the specialist for equipping it.
npc.eddy.voice_1: Have you moved to a new home? I'm the specialist for equipping it.
npc.edgar_ellen.greet_msg_1: This world is nothing without poetry, don't you think? It gives us hope, it envokes love. It's inciting and invigorating all the same.
npc.edgar_ellen.stdmod_1: Orshabaal was out of his maze to make us suffer for many days. In Calmera, a knight with blue beard from his hideout appeared. He fought bravely supported by mages, the demon ran and is gone for ages.
npc.edgar_ellen.stdmod_2: A knight from Guardia needed Chayenne's key. His friend dropped the item on the floor, hoping no one would see. But, at the same moment, a man crossed their way and all the knight's dreams faded away.
npc.edgar_ellen.stdmod_3: A knight from Candia was dining at Frodo's hut, devouring plates full of meat and whatnot. Suddenly, he was called to fight. He wanted to put his armor on but it was too tight.
npc.edgar_ellen.stdmod_4: The druid entered a Premian pyramid intent on the kill, 'Oh, that djinn will die, it will!' Down and up the stairs she hopped like a cat... When, Oops! She moved the wrong way, and died a drunk rat.
npc.edgar_ellen.stdmod_5: Hoping to find a strange orc in his spawn, a Zaneran knight logged on before dawn. A sudden heart attack left him surprised as Sam's old backpack he had recognised.
npc.edgar_ellen.voice_1: Orshabaal was out of his maze to make us suffer for many days. In Calmera, a knight with blue beard from his hideout appeared. He fought bravely supported by mages, the demon ran and is gone for ages.
npc.edgar_ellen.voice_10: Do you think it's just a game? Don't you fear the dragon's flame? If you are as brave as bright, if you do not stray from fight, you may want to hear tonight, the tale of Guardia's lonely knight.
npc.edgar_ellen.voice_11: For a knight from Yanara 10,000 gold were a lot. So he ventured with a team into the desert to win that pot. He solved all the riddles, strongly willed. But on his journey home he sadly was killed.
npc.edgar_ellen.voice_12: A great mage from Celesta went dungeon down deep, he was very brave but his wand was cheap. Among white skeletons one of them was red. Last what he saw were the words: 'You are dead!'
npc.edgar_ellen.voice_13: A young sorcerer born and raised on Astera when dragons were scary, it was that kind of era. Walking all the way to the city of Venore, he stole from the dwarven bridge nothing less than an iron ore.
npc.edgar_ellen.voice_14: A druid from Eternia just bought his first boots of haste, to finally have his leather boots replaced. Catching a backpack of fish was now his dream, but he ended up swinging his new boots upstream.
npc.edgar_ellen.voice_15: A sorcerer from Efidia took his horse and got it saddled, and set out for battle. His horse lost control and threw him into a hole. Now his team lost all hope, because he forgot to bring a rope.
npc.edgar_ellen.voice_16: A knight in Guardia was feeling bored. He wanted to show a dragon lord the taste of his new carlin sword. To its lair then he did go. But before he saw his foe, he met his end by a one hit K.O.
npc.edgar_ellen.voice_17: On Secura a confident knight levelled to main, 840 rats he had slain. 'I am going to kill dragons,' he said while pounding his breastplate. The next thing he saw was: 'You have met a sad fate.'
npc.edgar_ellen.voice_18: One morning frosty fresh and nice, a knight was fishing on the ice. Catching some pikes for soup, but a dire penguin ate his loot. His angry wife said in the house: Now whole Beneva will laugh at us!
npc.edgar_ellen.voice_19: A paladin slaying dragons on Antica's soil, when a lord charges on to make the adventurer's blood boil. It puts up a strong fight, but to no avail. It gets slain and drops a dragon scale mail!
npc.edgar_ellen.voice_2: A knight from Guardia needed Chayenne's key. His friend dropped the item on the floor, hoping no one would see. But, at the same moment, a man crossed their way and all the knight's dreams faded away.
npc.edgar_ellen.voice_20: Through Rookgaard's sewer there swarmed no fewer than a hundred screeching rats. Wading through mud, and covered in blood, two young men fought back-to-back. To Trimera's end; a knight, and a friend.
npc.edgar_ellen.voice_3: A knight from Candia was dining at Frodo's hut, devouring plates full of meat and whatnot. Suddenly, he was called to fight. He wanted to put his armor on but it was too tight.
npc.edgar_ellen.voice_4: The druid entered a Premian pyramid intent on the kill, 'Oh, that djinn will die, it will!' Down and up the stairs she hopped like a cat... When, Oops! She moved the wrong way, and died a drunk rat.
npc.edgar_ellen.voice_5: Hoping to find a strange orc in his spawn, a Zaneran knight logged on before dawn. A sudden heart attack left him surprised as Sam's old backpack he had recognised.
npc.edgar_ellen.voice_6: The world I shall save', an Olympian knight proclaimed! But from a visit to the bar he could not abstain! He woke up in pain, it all was in vain. From Venorian beer he will forever refrain.
npc.edgar_ellen.voice_7: During the dark and scary night, when others sleep he goes to fight, banishing demons, that feels right, purging the evil on the sight, fearlessly waiting for daylight, Zeluna's bravest elite knight.
npc.edgar_ellen.voice_8: A druid from Celesta once talked with a girl, he even bought her a necklace with a huge white pearl. Every time he went home, without money and fame, I guess this girl is cursed, Aruda is the name.
npc.edgar_ellen.voice_9: A story of a knight untold, on Rowana the dice she rolled. She lured players from afar. Who could resist a shining star? She promised gold and many items, then stole their heart with cunning kindness.
npc.edowir.farewell_msg_1: Come back whenever you're in need of wisdom.
npc.edowir.greet_msg_1: Oh, hello |PLAYERNAME|! How nice of you to visit an old man like me.
npc.edowir.stdmod_1: I'm just an old man, but I know a lot about Tibia.
npc.edowir.voice_1: I'm just an old man, but I know a lot about Tibia.
npc.edowir.walkaway_msg_1: Come back whenever you're in need of wisdom.
npc.edvard.sendtrade_msg_1: Have a look. Most furniture comes in handy kits. Just use them in your house to assemble the furniture. Do you want to see only a certain {type} of furniture?
npc.edvard.stdmod_1: Have you moved to a new home? I'm the specialist for equipping it.
npc.edvard.voice_1: Have you moved to a new home? I'm the specialist for equipping it.
npc.eighty.greet_msg_1: Yes? What may I do for you, |PLAYERNAME|? Bank business, perhaps?
npc.eighty.voice_1: Don't forget to deposit your money here in the Global Bank before you head out for adventure.
npc.elane.greet_msg_1: Welcome to the paladins' guild, |PLAYERNAME|! How can I help you?
npc.elane.multi_1: Alright, I will give you a chance. Pay close attention to what I'm going to tell you now. ...
npc.elane.multi_2: Recently, one of our members moved to Liberty Bay out of nowhere, talking about some strange cult. That is not the problem, but he took my favourite crossbow with him. ...
npc.elane.multi_3: Please find my crossbow. It has my name engraved on it and is very special to me. ...
npc.elane.multi_4: Secondly, we need a lot of leather for new quivers. 100 pieces of lizard leather and 100 pieces of red dragon leather should suffice. ...
npc.elane.multi_5: Third, since we are giving out tiaras, we are always in need of enchanted chicken wings. Please bring me 5, that would help us tremendously. ...
npc.elane.multi_6: Lastly, for our arrow heads we need a lot of steel. Best would be one piece of royal steel, one piece of draconian steel and one piece of hell steel. ...
npc.elane.multi_7: Did you understand everything I told you and are willing to handle this task?
npc.elane.say_1: Oh, my winged tiara? Those are traditionally awarded after having completed a difficult {task} for our guild, only to female aspirants though. Male warriors will receive a hooded cloak.
npc.elane.say_10: Good work, |PLAYERNAME|! That is enough leather for a lot of sturdy quivers. Now, please bring me 5 enchanted chicken wings.
npc.elane.say_12: Great! Now we can create a few more Tiaras. If only they weren't that expensive... Well anyway, please obtain one piece of royal steel, draconian steel and hell steel each.
npc.elane.say_14: Wow, I'm impressed, |PLAYERNAME|. Your really are a valuable member of our paladin guild. I shall grant you your reward now. Wear it proudly!
npc.elane.say_2: So you are saying that you would like to prove that you deserve to wear such a hooded cloak?
npc.elane.say_3: I'm so excited! Have you really found my crossbow?
npc.elane.say_4: Did you bring me 100 pieces of lizard leather and 100 pieces of red dragon leather?
npc.elane.say_5: Were you able to get hold of 5 enchanted chicken wings?
npc.elane.say_6: Ah, have you brought one piece of royal steel, draconian steel and hell steel each?
npc.elane.say_7: That's the spirit! I hope you will find my crossbow, |PLAYERNAME|!
npc.elane.say_8: Yeah! I could kiss you right here and there! Besides, you're a handsome one. <giggles> Please bring me 100 pieces of lizard leather and 100 pieces of red dragon leather now!
npc.elane.stdmod_1: We are always looking for sniper gloves. They are supposed to raise accuracy. If you find a pair, bring them here. Maybe I can offer you a nice trade.
npc.elane.stdmod_10: We will help you to improve your skills. Besides I offer spells for paladins.
npc.elane.stdmod_11: Harkath Bloodblade is the royal general.
npc.elane.stdmod_12: Some paladins serve in the kings army.
npc.elane.stdmod_14: How spineless do you have to be to become a jester?
npc.elane.stdmod_16: He must have been skilled before he became the way he is now. Such a pity.
npc.elane.stdmod_17: I am the leader of the Paladins. I help our members.
npc.elane.stdmod_18: The alcohol he sells shrouds the mind and the eye.
npc.elane.stdmod_19: One of the most important members of our guild. She makes all the bows and arrows we need.
npc.elane.stdmod_2: I am the leader of the Paladins. I help our members.
npc.elane.stdmod_20: He sells a lot of useful equipment.
npc.elane.stdmod_21: He and his guildfellows lack the grace of a true warrior.
npc.elane.stdmod_22: A fine warrior and a skilled general.
npc.elane.stdmod_23: King Tibianus is a wise ruler.
npc.elane.stdmod_24: A follower of evil that will get what he deserves one day.
npc.elane.stdmod_25: Mhm, a little too nice for my taste. Still, it's amazing how she endures all those men stalking her, especially this creepy Oswald.
npc.elane.stdmod_26: A skilled healer, that's for sure.
npc.elane.stdmod_28: If there wouldn't be higher powers to protect him...
npc.elane.stdmod_29: A humble monk and a wise man.
npc.elane.stdmod_3: I am the leader of the Paladins. I help our members.
npc.elane.stdmod_4: Paladins are great warriors and magicians. Besides that we are excellent missile fighters. Many people in Tibia want to join us.
npc.elane.stdmod_5: Of course, we aren't as strong as knights, but no druid or sorcerer will ever defeat a paladin with a sword.
npc.elane.stdmod_6: There are many magic spells and runes paladins can use.
npc.elane.stdmod_7: Paladins are the best missile fighters in Tibia!
npc.elane.stdmod_8: I am a paladin, not a storyteller.
npc.elane.stdmod_9: Every paladin profits from his vocation. It has many advantages to be a paladin.
npc.elathriel.greet_1: Be greeted |PLAYERNAME|. What is your {business} near the {hellgate}?
npc.elathriel.greet_msg_1: Be greeted |PLAYERNAME|. What is your {business} near the {hellgate}?
npc.elathriel.say_1: If you are that curious, do you want to buy a key for 5000 gold? \z Don't blame me if you get sucked in.
npc.elathriel.say_2: Come back when you have enough money.
npc.elathriel.say_3: Believe me, it's better for you that way.
npc.elathriel.say_key: If you are that curious, do you want to buy a key for 5000 gold? Don't blame me if you get sucked in.
npc.elathriel.stdmod_1:
I am the leader of the Kuridai and the Az'irel of Ab'Dendriel. \z
				Humans would call it {sheriff}, executioner, or avenger.
npc.elathriel.stdmod_10: It's hard for some of my people to grasp the true concept of a strong leader.
npc.elathriel.stdmod_13: A human weakling, not much more.
npc.elathriel.stdmod_14: A human weakling, not much more.
npc.elathriel.stdmod_15: Druidic magic is too peaceful for my taste.
npc.elathriel.stdmod_16: I have seen human sorcerers doing some impressive things ... before they died.
npc.elathriel.stdmod_17: We might use the shelter earth and hills provide us, but their obsession for metal is a waste of time.
npc.elathriel.stdmod_18:
Like all inferior races, they can be at least of use for something good. \z
				The other castes are just jealous of us making use of them.
npc.elathriel.stdmod_2:
Sometimes people get imprisoned for some time. \z
				True criminals will be cast out and for committing the worst crimes offenders are thrown into the hellgate.
npc.elathriel.stdmod_20: Even if he'd walk through the town above, the other castes would not see the necessity to follow OUR way.
npc.elathriel.stdmod_21:
My people are divided in castes in these times, until they comprehend \z
				that only the way of the Kuridai can save us all.
npc.elathriel.stdmod_22: Arrogant bastards, but they wield quite powerful magic.
npc.elathriel.stdmod_23: Dreamers are of no practical use. I don't mourn their demise.
npc.elathriel.stdmod_24: Confused cowards. For all their skill, they still tend to hide and run. What a waste.
npc.elathriel.stdmod_25: We are the heart of the elven society. We forge, we build, and we don't allow our people to be pushed around.
npc.elathriel.stdmod_26: We watch this city and the actions of its inhabitants closely.
npc.elathriel.stdmod_27:
The merchants of venore provide us with some useful goods. \z
				Still I an convinced that they get more out of our bargain then we do.
npc.elathriel.stdmod_28: The Thaian kingdom and we share some enemies, so it's only logical to cooperate in a few areas.
npc.elathriel.stdmod_29: I offer hardly anything except for knowledge of {spells}.
npc.elathriel.stdmod_3:
Sometimes people get imprisoned for some time. \z
				True criminals will be cast out and for committing the worst crimes offenders are thrown into the hellgate.
npc.elathriel.stdmod_30: I offer hardly anything except for knowledge of {spells}.
npc.elathriel.stdmod_31: I offer hardly anything except for knowledge of {spells}.
npc.elathriel.stdmod_4:
Sometimes people get imprisoned for some time. \z
				True criminals will be cast out and for committing the worst crimes offenders are thrown into the hellgate.
npc.elathriel.stdmod_5:
It was here among other structures, like the depot tower, before our people came here. \z
				It's secured by a sealed door.
npc.elathriel.stdmod_6: For safety we keep the door to the hellgate locked all times. I have the {keys} to open it when needed.
npc.elathriel.stdmod_7: For safety we keep the door to the hellgate locked all times. I have the {keys} to open it when needed.
npc.elathriel.stdmod_8: Not that I like to talk to you, but I am Elathriel Shadowslayer.
npc.elathriel.stdmod_9: It's one of the more useful concepts we can learn from the other races.
npc.eleonore.multi_1: I am glad to hear that. So please listen: Due to circumstances too complicated to explain now, I met Captain Ray Striker. He is ... a freedom fighter and would not find my father's acceptance, but we fell in love ...
npc.eleonore.multi_10: I guess that evil parrot hid the ring somewhere on a high tree or a rock so that you might need a rake to get it.
npc.eleonore.multi_2: Even though he had to hide for a while, we have stayed in contact for a long time now. And our love grew even further against all odds ...
npc.eleonore.multi_3: However, recently we lost contact. I don't know what has happened to him and fear the worst ...
npc.eleonore.multi_4: We always have been aware that something terrible might happen to him due to his lifestyle. But perhaps there is a harmless explanation for the absence of messages <holds her tears back>. I have arranged a passage for you to Ray's hiding place ...
npc.eleonore.multi_5: Contact Captain Waverider, the old fisherman, and tell him the secret word 'peg leg'. He will make sure that you arrive safely ...
npc.eleonore.multi_6: Please look for Ray and find out what happened to him and why he was not able to answer. Return to me as soon as you have found something out. I wish you a good journey.
npc.eleonore.multi_7: Ahh, now I understand... One of my suitors - a real chicken-heart - just brought back my ring. I was really surprised. Suddenly he shows brave attitude. But... It seems you lost it and he tries to take advantage. ...
npc.eleonore.multi_8: Thanks a lot anyways and take this gold as a reward. By the way, I would need some help in another matter. It is only a small errand. Are you interested?
npc.eleonore.multi_9: My ring was stolen by a parrot, directly from my dressing table near the window. It flew to the nearby mountains and I fear my ring will be lost forever. Whoever returns it to me will be rewarded generously. ...
npc.eleonore.say_1: Oh, my beloved ring! Have you found it and want to return it to me?
npc.eleonore.say_2: I would need some help in another matter. It is only a small errand. Are you interested?
npc.eleonore.say_3: Great, thank you! As promised, here are your 5 gold pieces. Is there ... anything left that you might want to discuss with me?
npc.eleonore.say_4: You have returned my ring and proven yourself as trustworthy. There is something I have to discuss with you. Are you willing to listen?
npc.eleonore.say_5: <blushes> Oh, he is so wonderful. A very special man with a special place in my heart.
npc.eleonore.say_6: I can't thank you enough for freeing my beloved Ray from that evil spell. I am still shocked that a mermaid could steal his love that easily.
npc.eleonore.say_7: Oh, thank you so much! Take this gold as a reward. ... which reminds me, I would need some help in another matter. It is only a small errand. Are you interested?
npc.eleonore.say_8: Thank you! It is not a difficult matter but a rather urgent one. I need to send some money to a person in town. Would you be willing to run this small errand for me?
npc.eleonore.say_9: I was hoping that you'd agree. Please deliver these 200 gold pieces to the herbalist Charlotta in the south-western part of the town. If you return from this errand, I will grant you 5 gold pieces as reward for your efforts.
npc.elf_guard.stdmod_1: The elves of this city are the casts of the Cenath, the Kuridai, and the Deraisim.
npc.elf_guard.stdmod_2: I am a guardian of this town. I have no time to chat!
npc.elf_guard.stdmod_3: The Cenath are magic users. Look for them on the upper levels of the town.
npc.elf_guard.stdmod_4: The Deraisim are scouts and hunters. You may find them on the groundlevel of the city.
npc.elf_guard.stdmod_6: If you are looking for that kind of equipment you should ask a Kuridai.
npc.elf_guard.stdmod_7: Ask around in Ab'Dendriel. Many elves can teach you something about magic. The Cenath love magic most of all.
npc.elf_guard.stdmod_8: The city of the humans lies somewhere far to the south beyond the mountains of the dwarfs.
npc.elgar.greet_msg_1: Yes? What may I do for you, |PLAYERNAME|? Bank business, perhaps?
npc.elgar.voice_1: Don't forget to deposit your money here in the Global Bank before you head out for adventure.
npc.eliyas.greet_msg_1: Be greeted, |PLAYERNAME|. Which of my fine gems do you {need}?
npc.eliyas.stdmod_1: I am a jeweller. Maybe you want to have a look at my wonderful {offers}.
npc.eliyas.stdmod_2: Well, I sell gems and {goblets}. If you'd like to see my offers, ask me for a {trade}.
npc.eliyas.stdmod_3: Ah, our newest import! We have golden goblets, silver goblets and bronze goblets. All of them have space for a hand-written dedication.
npc.elliott.multi_1: A sacrificial site? Damn, sounds like some freakish cult or something. Just great. And this ancient structure you talked about that's not part of the sewers? You'd better see the local historian about that, man. ...
npc.elliott.multi_2: He can make more sense of what you found there. His name is Barazbaz. He should be in the magistrate building.
npc.elliott.multi_3: Wow, you already did it, that's fast. I'm used to a more laid-back attitude from most people. It's a shame to risk losing you to some collapsing tunnels, but a deal is a deal. ...
npc.elliott.multi_4: I hereby grant you the permission to enter the abandoned part of the sewers. Take care, man! ...
npc.elliott.multi_5: If you find something interesting, come back to talk about the {abandoned sewers}.
npc.elliott.multi_6: You want to enter the abandoned sewers? That's rather dangerous and not a good idea, man. That part of the sewers was not sealed off for nothing, you know? ...
npc.elliott.multi_7: But hey, it's your life, bro. So here's the deal. I'll let you into the abandoned sewers if you help me with our {mission}.
npc.elliott.say_1: I'm glad to see you back alive and healthy. Did you find anything interesting that you want to {report}?
npc.elliott.say_2: The sewers need repair. You in?
npc.elliott.say_3: Elliott's keeps calling it that. It's just another job! You fixed some broken pipes and stuff? Let me check, {ok}?
npc.elliott.say_4: Good. Broken pipe and generator pieces, there's smoke evading. That's how you recognise them. See how you can fix them using your hands. Need about, oh, twenty of them at least repaired. Report to me or Jacob
npc.elliott.say_5: Good. Thanks, man. That's one vote you got for helping us with this. If you want to redo this task just say {abandoned sewers} to repeat it.
npc.elliott.say_6: You already reported this mission, go to the next.
npc.elvith.multi_1: The last issue I had was bought by Randor Swiftfinger. He was banished through the hellgate and probably took the book with him ...
npc.elvith.multi_2: I would not recommend seeking him or the book there, but of course it is possible.
npc.elvith.say_17: Do you want to buy a poem scroll for 200 gold?
npc.elvith.stdmod_1: I sell musical instruments of many kinds.
npc.elvith.stdmod_10: That is some god the humans worship. Our pople are not interested in this gods anymore.
npc.elvith.stdmod_11: They are too loud and don't even understand the concept of a melody.
npc.elvith.stdmod_12: The other deraisim are too much concerned with mastering the nature so they don't listen to its music anymore.
npc.elvith.stdmod_13: The Cenath think they know the 'art' but the only true art is the music.
npc.elvith.stdmod_14: I went down to the mines and tried to lighten up their spirit, the foolish creatures did not listen to my songs, though.
npc.elvith.stdmod_15: Sorry, I don't feel like teaching magic today.
npc.elvith.stdmod_16: For the worst of crimes, criminals are cast into hellgate. It is said no one can return from there. Since it is not actually forbidden to enter hellgate, you might convince Elathriel to grant you entrance.
npc.elvith.stdmod_2: I sell lyres, lutes, drums, and simple fanfares.
npc.elvith.stdmod_3: Music is an attempt to condensate emotions in harmonies and save them for the times to come.
npc.elvith.stdmod_4: Time has its own song. Close your eyes and listen to the symphony of the seasons.
npc.elvith.stdmod_5: Everything is a song. Life, death, history ... everything. To listen to the song of something is the first step to understand it.
npc.elvith.stdmod_6: Everything is a song. Life, death, history ... everything. To listen to the song of something is the first step to understand it.
npc.elvith.stdmod_7: We are the most graceful of all races. We feel the music of the universe in our hearts and souls.
npc.elvith.stdmod_8: They could dig some halls for a big musical event, but they won't listen to me about that matter.
npc.elvith.stdmod_9: I bet they were great musicians.
npc.elyen_ravenlock.greet_msg_1: A shadow preceded you. You wish a {scroll} or a {mission}?
npc.elyen_ravenlock.multi_1: You have indeed. The shrines have sung back to you. Well done, brother. Not many men take such an interest in our art. ...
npc.elyen_ravenlock.multi_2: I will take the flute back. Our bargain stands. You may take the scroll.
npc.elyen_ravenlock.multi_3: I would have to sing to the Dark Shrines, but I cannot. ...
npc.elyen_ravenlock.multi_4: I... cannot bear Urgith's breed. Everywhere, I hear them - scrabbling, squeaking ...
npc.elyen_ravenlock.multi_5: Take this bone flute and play it in front of the five Dark Shrines so that they answer with song in return. You will find them in the Gardens of Night. ...
npc.elyen_ravenlock.multi_6: If you have done that, you may have the scroll piece. Now go.
npc.elyen_ravenlock.multi_7: The scroll piece there? The symbols look promising, but it is incomplete. ...
npc.elyen_ravenlock.multi_8: It is of little use to us. But it seems to be of interest to you ...
npc.elyen_ravenlock.multi_9: In exchange for the scroll piece, you must assist me with something. {Agreed}?
npc.elyen_ravenlock.say_1: Hello, brother. You come with a question to me, I believe?
npc.elyen_ravenlock.say_2: And what is it you want? Do you bring news from the undead, or do you seek a dark {artefact}?
npc.elyen_ravenlock.say_3: Hello, brother. You have finished the dance?
npc.elyen_ravenlock.voice_3: The rats... the rats in the walls...
npc.emael.farewell_msg_1: I wish you a good hunt. Goodbye!
npc.emael.greet_msg_1: Hello! Ever asked yourself who killed all the monsters for the wall trophies? Yeah, that was me, Emael the Beasthunter! I am an expert in displaying trophies. ...
npc.emael.greet_msg_2: So if you have at least some dangerous monster to show off I strongly advise you to aquire a {podium} of vigour.
npc.emael.say_1: Do you want to appropriately show off your boss trophies and buy an additional podium of vigour for 1000000 Gold?
npc.emael.say_2: Ah, I see you killed a lot of dangerous creatures. Here's your podium of vigour!
npc.emael.say_3: Please make sure you have free slots in your store inbox.
npc.emael.say_5: You have not aquired enough knowledge in hunting big scary creatures.
npc.emael.voice_1: Not enough space for all my trophies...
npc.emma.farewell_msg_1: LONG LIVE THE QUEEN! You may leave now!
npc.emma.multi_1: I have bad news: a mad dwarf threatens to destroy our beloved city. He claims to have invented some device that enables him to destroy the whole city ...
npc.emma.multi_10: And this is where you come into play. Find the ship plans in the Venorean shipyard or perhaps at the harbour and bring them here immediately.
npc.emma.multi_11: The scheming Venoreans are a constant thorn in our side. They supply our enemies with all kind of equipment to boost the threat they pose to our freedom. It will be your task to hinder future weapon deliveries significantly ...
npc.emma.multi_12: The druids have supplied us with some exotic bugs. They are called rust bugs and they did not receive this name for their colour ...
npc.emma.multi_13: Take this box of rust bugs and use them on the keyhole of the smithy in the Ironhouse. These 'pets' will ruin all metal there and it will take them a while to get rid of them.
npc.emma.multi_14: The druids have asked the brigade for a favour. Given that we heavily rely on their resources and they are important supporters of our cities, we can't deny them the request ...
npc.emma.multi_15: A wandering druid has recently visited the Green Claw Swamp, located north west of that corrupted hell hole Venore. While gathering herbs, he noticed some malignant presence in the said area ...
npc.emma.multi_16: Searching for the source of evil there, he detected some old ruin. Suddenly, he was attacked by bonelords and their undead minions. He barely managed to escape alive ...
npc.emma.multi_17: The evidence he found let him conclude that the bonelords in the ruins were raising so-called death trees.These trees are full of negative energy and slowly but steadily corrupt their surrounding ...
npc.emma.multi_18: After the druid's return to Carlin, divination confirmed his upsetting assumptions about the existence of these trees ...
npc.emma.multi_19: Over the years, hundreds have fallen victim to the swamp, conserved by mud and water for eternity. With the help of the death trees, the bonelords strive for an army of undeads. This cannot be tolerated ...
npc.emma.multi_2: He has a laboratory somewhere in Kazordoon, probably somewhere near the technomancer hall. Find him and kill him! Bring me his beard as a proof!
npc.emma.multi_20: Travel to Green Claw Swamp and rip out the heart out of the master tree. Without it, the unnatural trees will wither soon. Bring me the heart as proof.
npc.emma.multi_21: Our relations with Thais can be called strained at best. Therefore, it's not really astounding that the Thaian financed Edron's academy but refuse to share some knowledge with our druids ..
npc.emma.multi_22: But we won't accept this so easily. With the help of divination, we learnt that the knowledge our druids are looking for is found in a certain book ...
npc.emma.multi_23: It will be your task to enter the academy and to steal this book for us.
npc.emma.multi_24: Excellent. The queen was not amused about this threat. It's a good thing that you have saved the city ...
npc.emma.multi_25: Unfortunately, as we are secret agents we can't parade for you or something like that, but let me express our gratitude for everything you have done for our city ...
npc.emma.multi_26: Take this token of gratitude. You will know when to use it!
npc.emma.multi_3: As you might know, once the old aristocracy of our city shared blood-ties with the noblemen of Thais. There are many unresolved claims for titles and family heirlooms and Thais does little to help in this matter ...
npc.emma.multi_4: Therefore, we will take matters into our own hands. There is a grave in the crypts on the Isle of the Kings in which we assume a book containing ancient family histories and family trees ...
npc.emma.multi_5: We need this book! We will not ask how you acquired it.
npc.emma.multi_6: Ruins of some ancient cathedral are found south west of Venore. It was a project that the Thaians never finished. However, our scouts reported some suspicious activities there ...
npc.emma.multi_7: There is a continual coming and going which hints on something big hiding there. We ask you to enter the ruins of the cathedral and to find out what all these people are doing there ...
npc.emma.multi_8: You might find several hints there, but I am sure you will know exactly when you have found what we are looking for.
npc.emma.multi_9: Venore has plans for a new kind of ship. It will be faster and more resilient than any other known ship. It will surely improve their dominance over the sea trade. Unless we get those plans for ourselves ...
npc.emma.say_1: The girls brigade is the foremost front on which we fight the numerous enemies of our city ... It's a constant race to stay ahead of our enemies. Absolute loyalty and the willingness to put ones life at stake are attributes that are vital for this brigade ... If you join, you dedicate your service to Carlin alone! Do you truly think that you are girl enough to join the brigade?
npc.emma.say_10: Bring me back some hints or something!
npc.emma.say_11: I hope this old book will do those researches any good. Personally I see little use to proof some bloodlines after we cut all ties to Thais.
npc.emma.say_12: You need to bring us that book of family trees!
npc.emma.say_13: Please bring me proof of the mad technomancers defeat!
npc.emma.say_15: A man in the girls brigade? Come on this is hilarious, this is outright stupid, this is ... exactly what no one would expect. Mhm, on second thought the element of surprise might offset your male inferiority.
npc.emma.say_16: Don't try to fool me. We are perfectly aware to whom you are loyal.
npc.emma.say_2: How unnecessarily complicated, but that's the way those Thaians are. In the end we got what we wanted and they can't do anything about it.
npc.emma.say_4: I think the druids will be pleased to hear that the immediate threat has been averted.
npc.emma.say_5: Bring me the heart as proof.
npc.emma.say_6: Great! This blow strikes them where it hurts most: profit.
npc.emma.say_7: I hope our craftsmen can do something with this stuff. For me it makes hardly any sense.
npc.emma.say_8: You need to bring me those plans!
npc.emma.say_9: I will have this correspondence examined by our specialists. I am sure they are quite revealing.
npc.emma.say_join_female: The girls brigade is the foremost front on which we fight the numerous enemies of our city ... It's a constant race to stay ahead of our enemies. Absolute loyalty and the willingness to put ones life at stake are attributes that are vital for this brigade ... If you join, you dedicate your service to Carlin alone! Do you truly think that you are girl enough to join the brigade?
npc.emma.stdmod_1: I am privileged to be in service of our beloved queen!
npc.emma.stdmod_10: Darashia never bothers about the affairs of other cities.
npc.emma.stdmod_11: It's just another Thaian puppet. Still, it is distant enough to stand a fair chance to get rid of Thais's oppression one day.
npc.emma.stdmod_12: The dwarfs of Kazordoon usually mind their own business. I wish all other cities would do the same.
npc.emma.stdmod_13:
The CGB is a patriotic organisation that fights our numerous enemies with means that guards or army do not have at their disposal. ... \z
	We work secretly and covertly. We uncover secret plots and we are both the first line of defence of our city and the last. We are joined only by the best of the best.
npc.emma.stdmod_14:
The AVIN is rather a crime syndicate than anything else. If there is something dirty and illegal, they are most likely involved. ... \z
	They are unscrupulous and also do not back away from blackmailing and assassination.
npc.emma.stdmod_15:
The TBI is as old-fashioned, stubborn and inflexible as only males can be. What makes this bureaucracy somewhat dangerous, is the money they have at their disposal. ... \z
	They buy spies and traitors - all of them weak-willed or greedy individuals.
npc.emma.stdmod_16:
The elves of Ab'Dendriel are our allies. Our druids contribute most to keeping such a good relation. ... \z
	They seem to understand the elves a bit better than we ordinary people do.
npc.emma.stdmod_17:
The name of the city is a cruel joke. The people there are oppressed by Thais and Venore who slowly bleed the isle and its people white. ... \z
	It shows what would have happened to us if our rebellion had failed.
npc.emma.stdmod_2: We are proud people who fought hard for their freedom and won't allow others to oppress us again.
npc.emma.stdmod_3: I am the head of Carlin's Girls Brigade, also known as CGB.
npc.emma.stdmod_4: I am the head of Carlin's Girls Brigade, also known as CGB.
npc.emma.stdmod_6: The Thaians never got over the fact that we gained our independence. They do everything they can to hinder the prospering of our city.
npc.emma.stdmod_7: Venore is a hellhole of evil. The trade barons' greed lets them plot against all other cities and even against each other.
npc.emma.stdmod_8: Svargrond is an important project for our city. It's not a colony but many of our people live there alongside those barbarians. If everything works out fine, Carlin and Svargrond will both prosper.
npc.emma.stdmod_9: Strange people with strange customs live in this city. Luckily, we rarely have to deal with them.
npc.emperor_kruzak.greet_1: Hiho, may fire and earth bless you, my child. Are you looking for a promotion?
npc.emperor_kruzak.greet_2: Hiho, may fire and earth bless you, my child. Are you looking for a promotion?
npc.emperor_kruzak.multi_1: Excellent! Now, let me explain. If you donate 1.000.000.000 gold pieces, you will be entitled to wear a unique outfit. ...
npc.emperor_kruzak.say_1: In exchange for a truly generous donation, I will offer a special outfit. Do you want to make a donation?
npc.emperor_kruzak.say_10: You need to donate {armor} outfit first.
npc.emperor_kruzak.say_11: Take this boots as a token of great gratitude. Let us forever remember this day, my friend.
npc.emperor_kruzak.say_12: You do not have enough money to donate that amount.
npc.emperor_kruzak.say_14: You need to donate {helmet} addon first.
npc.emperor_kruzak.say_15: So you wold like to donate 500.000.000 gold pieces which in return will entitle you to wear a unique armor?
npc.emperor_kruzak.say_16: So you would like to donate 250.000.000 gold pieces which in return will entitle you to wear unique helmet?
npc.emperor_kruzak.say_17: So you would like to donate 250.000.000 gold pieces which in return will entitle you to wear a unique boots?
npc.emperor_kruzak.say_2: In that case, return to me once you made up your mind.
npc.emperor_kruzak.say_3: Take this armor as a token of great gratitude. Let us forever remember this day, my friend!
npc.emperor_kruzak.say_4: Please make sure you have free slots in your store inbox.
npc.emperor_kruzak.say_5: You do not have enough money to donate that amount.
npc.emperor_kruzak.say_7: Take this helmet as a token of great gratitude. Let us forever remember this day, my friend.
npc.emperor_kruzak.say_8: You do not have enough money to donate that amount.
npc.emperor_kruzak.stdmod_1: I can promote you for 20000 gold coins. Do you want me to promote you?
npc.emperor_rehal.multi_1: Splendid! My son Rehon set off on an expedition to the deeper mines. He and a group of dwarfs were to search for new veins of crystal. Unfortunately they have been missing for 2 weeks now. ...
npc.emperor_rehal.multi_2: Find my son and if he's alive bring him back. You will find a reactivated ore wagon tunnel at the entrance of the great citadel which leades to the deeper mines. If you encounter problems within the tunnel go ask Xorlosh, he can help you.
npc.emperor_rehal.say_1: May Fire and Earth bless you, stranger. What leads you to Beregar, the dwarven city?
npc.emperor_rehal.say_2: I always liked him and I still can't believe that he really stole that ring.
npc.emperor_rehal.say_3: Interesting. The fact that you have the ring means that Nokmir can't have stolen it. Combined with the information Grombur gave you, the case appears in a completely different light. ...
npc.emperor_rehal.say_4: Let there be justice for all. Nokmir is innocent and acquitted from all charges! And Rerun... I want him in prison for this malicious act!
npc.emperor_rehal.say_5: He's very ambitious and always volunteers for the long shifts.
npc.emperor_rehal.say_6: As you have proven yourself trustworthy I'm going to assign you a special mission. Are you interested?
npc.emperor_rehal.say_7: My son was captured by trolls? Doesn't sound like him, but if you say so. Now you want a reward, huh? ...
npc.emperor_rehal.say_8: Look at these dwarven legs. They were forged years ago by a dwarf who was rather tall for our kind. I want you to have them. Thank you for rescuing my son |PLAYERNAME|.
npc.emperor_rehal.say_9: Alright then, come back when you are ready.
npc.emperor_rehal.stdmod_1: I can promote you for 20000 gold coins. Do you want me to promote you?
npc.erayo.greet_msg_1: What the... I mean, of course I sensed you.
npc.erayo.multi_1: Thought so. Could use some help anyway. Listen, I need stuff. Someone gave me a strange assignment - sneak into Thais castle at night and shroud it with cloth without anyone noticing it. ...
npc.erayo.multi_2: I wonder why anyone would want to shroud a castle, but as long as long as the guy pays, no problem, I'll do the sneaking part. Need a lot of cloth though. ...

npc.eroth.multi_1: Recently we found out that they are in the possession of a scrying crystal ball. They can hear all our discussions about tactics and upcoming attacks. ...
npc.eroth.multi_2: No wonder that they always have been so well prepared. Now you come into play, destroy the scrying crystal ball in Elvenbane. It should be on the top floor. ...
npc.eroth.multi_3: We don't really know how to destroy it but we suppose it may work if you reflect the invisible power of the ball. The beam should be adjusted to Ab'Dendriel. Take this mirror and give it a try. Good luck.
npc.eroth.say_1: Have you ever heard of Elvenbane? It is the castle west of Ab'Dendriel which is inhabited by villains from all over the continent. Any support in this war is welcome. Are you willing to help?
npc.eroth.say_2: I heard the blow! The reflection must have caused a overcharge of magical energy leading to the contraction and the implosion. Just like I hoped! Please take this as a reward. Thank you very much.

npc.eshaya.greet_msg_1: Suon's and Bastesh's blessing, dear guest!
npc.eshaya.multi_1: {Kilmaresh} and {Oramond} maintain important commercial relations, and for this reason Rathleton has an envoy here. In the past, the relations were good but now ..
npc.eshaya.multi_2: I hate to admit it but I heavily suspect that the current {Ambassador} is a traitor and consorts with the forbidden cult of {Fafnar}. I have several hints and {Kallimae} saw it in one of her visions. ...
npc.eshaya.multi_3: But the vision of a Kilmareshian seer is no proof they will ever accept in Rathleton. And without proof we can't banish the {Ambassador}, this would cause major diplomatic fallout or even a war. I can't risk that. ...
npc.eshaya.multi_4: I need unequivocal evidence that the {Ambassador} conspires with the Fafnar cultists. Please go to his residence in the eastern part of the city and search for letters, journals ... anything that could prove him guilty.
npc.eshaya.multi_5: I need unequivocal evidence that the {Ambassador} conspires with the Fafnar cultists. Please go to his residence in the eastern part of the city and search for letters, journals ... anything that could prove him guilty.
npc.eshaya.multi_6: But there is only one way to achieve this: You have to find a Ring of {Secret Thoughts}. Legend has it that a monstrous being called {Urmahlullu} has such a ring. If the myths are true you can find this creature in a subterranean tomb south of Issavi.
npc.eshaya.multi_7: But there is only one way to achieve this: You have to find a Ring of {Secret Thoughts}. Legend has it that a monstrous being called {Urmahlullu} has such a ring. If the myths are true you can find this creature in a subterranean tomb south of Issavi.
npc.eshaya.say_1: Very good. But now you need the Ring of Secret Thoughts back in order to extract the Ambassador's memories.
npc.eshaya.say_2: You found the Ring of Secret Thoughts! Well done! Now give it to the Ambassador as a present. He's a peacock and will accept such a precious gift for sure. As soon as he wears it, his memories will be stored in the ring.
npc.eshaya.say_3: I'm willing to admit that I need help. And the help of someone who is not from {Issavi} at that. But the task could be dangerous and you would become embroiled in the politics and court intrigues of {Kilmaresh}. Will you help me anyhow?
npc.eshaya.say_4: This is the proof we need! Very well done! You have to report this to our {Empress}. She will grant you an audience now.
npc.eshaya.say_5: You haven't completed your mission yet. Keep searching!
npc.eshaya.say_6: I don't know whether you are experienced in such things. If not, you could ask somebody who is. But I'm not sure where in Issavi you should look to hire a thief.
npc.eshaya.say_7: I guess claiming back a present would be a bit suspicious. You'll have to find another way. I resent thinking about theft but sometimes, desperate times call for desperate measures.
npc.eshaya.say_8: You got the ring back? Very well done! Now search for the memories that will prove the Ambassador's treason. I don't know much about ancient artefacts but you could ask the librarian in the palace. I'm sure he knows something helpful.
npc.eshaya.say_9: Good luck on your audience with the Empress. May Kilmaresh prosper.
npc.eshaya.voice_2: I should talk to Kallimae soon.
npc.eshaya.voice_3: Issavi's safety is my first concern.

npc.falonzo.stdmod_1: I'm professor Falonzo from the mage's guild.
npc.falonzo.stdmod_10:
Something is tearing at the fabric of reality. I can't tell what is it but the {boundaries} between worlds are fading. ... \z
	A process that what watched for over a century but which has extremely grown in momentum over the last few years. Something is happening and it's for sure nothing good. ... \z
	Be it as it may, the plane trying to reconnect was only a side effect. It still might teach us about what is happening and it has for sure attracted some {attention} already.
npc.falonzo.stdmod_11:
We know about other planes of existence but in all history it has never been as easy to reach them as it is now. ... \z
	Sometimes world seem to overlap and we can identify more and more such planes and worlds. More then we ever had imagined. All we can tell is, that something is changing. And not for the good.
npc.falonzo.stdmod_2: I'm a researcher of scientific council of the mage guild and I came to that {place} to study this {anomaly}.
npc.falonzo.stdmod_3: This is a lesser plane of tarnished, elemental fire that once belonged to the world that we know. It was despoiled in the wars of the gods and broke loose from our world. {Lost} and drifting through the void, without a connection to our plane.
npc.falonzo.stdmod_4: Infernalists were the first who found their way into this sphere. Hoping to tap its rotten power somehow. Yet this sphere created creatures of its own and draw others here from other planes.
npc.falonzo.stdmod_5: Well, that was how it used to be. Lost and without any connection to our world. But that was before things ... have {changed}.
npc.falonzo.stdmod_6: Such an anomaly can't go unnoticed for long. That lead to the presence to unwanted {intruders} and other entities were {dragged} into by the nature of the sphere.
npc.falonzo.stdmod_7:
This {plane} is now inhabited by {intruders} and creatures that accidentally became {dragged} in. ... \z
	It is neither completely of our world nor is it still that disconnected and unreachable as it used to be. I fear it's only a harbinger of something more dangerous and more {sinister}.
npc.falonzo.stdmod_8:
Well, the whole place here is an anomaly so to say. You can hardly have missed the fact that you arrived here through a mystical gate. ... \z
	Well actually it's no gate at all but a rift in the fabric of nature. It is this minor {plane} trying to reconnect to our world.
npc.falonzo.stdmod_9:
This place became a fiery trap to certain beings with an affinity to fire. Somehow it reconnects randomly with the known world, to which it once belonged ... \z
	but also to other places that it shares some affinity with like hellish places of unspeakable evil that spawn infernal creatures.
