npc.flickering_soul.say_1: It has been a while since I roamed the world of the living in a mortal shell.
npc.flickering_soul.say_10: Thank you for accepting this burden.
npc.flickering_soul.say_11: You haven't killed Malice yet. You haven't killed Hatred yet. You haven't killed Spite yet. You haven't killed Cruelty yet. You haven't killed Greed yet.
npc.flickering_soul.say_12: My daughter was as ambitious as me, yet she lacked my intellect and my raw talent. She still was great and talented yet I sadly let her feel my disdain. One of the many errors that my way of hubris made me do.
npc.flickering_soul.say_13: I'm not aware of the fate of my linage. Neither I'm able to relate to the mortal world in that way. Each of us is an individual, not bound by ties of blood or herritage.
npc.flickering_soul.say_14: His avatar might be destroyed for now and it'd grip on Zarganash considerably weakened. Yet he burrowed to deep into the essence of this realm to be annihilated this easy.
npc.flickering_soul.say_15: I despised my followers for their petty agendas and for their limited vision of my own goals and personality.
npc.flickering_soul.say_16: I have cleansed you from the taints that you carried with you. You are now free from the burden that you should not have to bear.
npc.flickering_soul.say_17: You are not tainted by the darkness of the world. You are pure and free from the burdens that others carry.
npc.flickering_soul.say_18: I was once known as the necromant king. ...
npc.flickering_soul.say_19: For some it was meant as a curse, others used the name with reverence. To me it was just another stepping stone, in a life that burned with ambition.
npc.flickering_soul.say_2: I had many names in my live. The one that would be the most recognizable is probably the name Goshnar. Even that was an assumed name that I took when I left my mundane past behind.
npc.flickering_soul.say_20: My ambitions were high and knew no limits. Mastery over life and death was but a milestone that I wanted to accomplish. In the end I aspired probably somewhat like godhood. ...
npc.flickering_soul.say_21: Though in hindsight even that wouldn't have been enough. There was a hunger in me that nothing could put to rest.
npc.flickering_soul.say_22: I was so convinced about my brilliance, my greatness, my destiny. And this hunger for more, it let me not have peace at any point in my life. I was always driven. There was no time to rest. ...
npc.flickering_soul.say_23: And there was no looking back. I never cared to remember my humble beginnings, what I had sacrificed to get where I was. All that I had left behind and that I had lost forever. ...
npc.flickering_soul.say_24: Now I see the bitter irony. I could bring back the dead, but I couldn't create second chances. I couldn't restore the truly important things that I had lost.
npc.flickering_soul.say_25: Zarganash was not a place without its dangers, but for a soul as powerful as mine, there was little threat at all. For the first time in my existence I had to stop running forward. I had to wait for things to fit into their places. ...
npc.flickering_soul.say_26: And me, who had seen things that horrible, they would have obliterated a lesser man's mind, finally took the time to look back. And what I saw was frightening in its own right. ...
npc.flickering_soul.say_27: A great tiredness overcame me. With the flames of my ambitions calming down for the first time since I could remember, all my aspirations and plans seemed to petty and futile. ...
npc.flickering_soul.say_28: Everything I had worked for and my plans for the things to come seemed pointless, and the things I had lost and never allowed myself to experience weighed heavily on my soul.
npc.flickering_soul.say_29: I talked to other souls, lost in Zarganash, and most of them seemed like mirrors to myself. Their faults, their shortcomings, the things that were important to them and the things they had lost. ...
npc.flickering_soul.say_3: Everything in my life was just a tool to further my goals. The brotherhood of bones was just a tool for me. As was everyone or everything. In the path I had chosen nothing mattered but me and my ambitions.
npc.flickering_soul.say_30: It was all like miniature copies of my own grand plans and losses. It made me think. And the great tiredness weighed even more heavy on me. A weariness of the world, of the hunger that drove me.
npc.flickering_soul.say_31: Then I met a wise soul. A teacher that did not lecture. I never was impressed by anything but my own accomplishments. But the inner balance and peace of this soul, it did impress me. A lot. ...
npc.flickering_soul.say_32: I, who fancied myself to have been the epitome of knowledge, learned things that were entirely new to me. But this knowledge wasn't about power. It was about me.
npc.flickering_soul.say_33: I decided to stay here, even pass on into the great beyond at some point. Yet I still feel the pull of my fetters. I can faintly hear those who think they are my followers, calling to me.
npc.flickering_soul.say_34: And I feel others, many others who crave my powers and try to bring me back for their own gain.
npc.flickering_soul.say_35: Over my time in Zarganash I split away the parts of me that my worldly fetters were bound to. Yet I had to recognize that they are still a part of me and I'm bound to them. ...
npc.flickering_soul.say_36: The fetters and the efforts to call me back are empowering them. I feel them growing in strength and gaining awareness on their own. ...
npc.flickering_soul.say_37: They are beginning to feed not only on the fetters and incarnations but also on me. As I grow weaker, they grow more powerful over time.
npc.flickering_soul.say_38: You did it! For the first time I can feel free from the pull of my past. Now I'm free at last. ...
npc.flickering_soul.say_39: I might stay a while and teach other souls about the inner peace, but will eventually pass on. Thank you so much, my hero. My eternal gratitude and blessings will be with you!
npc.flickering_soul.say_4: Necromancy was a passion at first, another tool while I amassed power and a crutch when my ambitions surpassed that what it could accomplish.
npc.flickering_soul.say_40: You will have to reach each of the negative parts of my personality that I split away. They are hidden deep in the depths of Zarganash and will have corrupted and twisted their surroundings into dangerous nightmares. ...
npc.flickering_soul.say_41: Even worse, you'll likely encounter minions of those who want to claim my soul as their prize for their own depraved reasons. You will have to destroy my shards to set me free.
npc.flickering_soul.say_42: I hated the world for its flaws and the reluctance of people to comply with my will. I was convinced I was destined for greatness and to change everything. Ordinary beings were far beneath me and my consideration. ...
npc.flickering_soul.say_43: All this opposition, all the wars were a nuisance on my way to greatness. I would have sacrificed the whole world to reach my goals.
npc.flickering_soul.say_44: Even in the lands of the dead, this one caused a stir. The dead were whispering his name. It made me feel jealous and angry at first, but at some point, after much self-reflection, I could recognize my own faults in the stories about him.
npc.flickering_soul.say_45: It was almost like looking into a mirror for the first time. However, he lived way later than me, and I never met his soul here, so I can't tell more about him.
npc.flickering_soul.say_46: They called me the necromant king, in an act of reverence, but to me it was always more of a slander. To limit my greatness to this insignificant aspect was an insult to my ego. But I let it slip for the greater good. ...
npc.flickering_soul.say_47: I felt it was beneath me to correct them and I went along.
npc.flickering_soul.say_5: My demise did not meet me unprepared. As a powerful necromancer I had fettered my soul in the living world and the realms beyond. I had prepared for my return and was confident in my power.
npc.flickering_soul.say_6: My soul wandered the plains of Zarganash, waiting for my wards to power up. Waiting for my soul to be slowly pulled back and manifest in the world of the living once again. What I had not taken into consideration was peace.
npc.flickering_soul.say_7: I recognized the extent of my folly and failure. I decided not to return to the world of the living.
npc.flickering_soul.say_8: The only way I can get rid of them is to disperse them, to 'kill' them so to say. But they are tainted parts of myself and even going near them might endanger my sanity and stability. So all I can do is to ask you to do this daunting task.
npc.flickering_soul.say_9: I'm aware I have no right to ask and I have little to offer as a payment, but I ask you nonetheless. Will you face my fettered vices and destroy them for me?
npc.flickering_soul.shards_all_done: You have defeated all the Goshnar's Bosses. Your soul shines brighter with each victory.
npc.flora.greet_msg_1: Greetings, {}. Well, we all know what time it is. Always when we meet, the citizens of rathleton voted for the {Glooth Fairy}! ... Well, the rules are as simples as always. Ask me for a {fight} and I'll teleport you into the room with the lever, therefore I'll charge one voting right. ... From this room there is no way back to me. Pull the trigger and after one minute you and your buddies will face the {Glooth Fairy}.
npc.flora.say_1: Do you really want to enter the Glooth Fairy's hideout. There is no chickening out and I also have to charge one voting right! {Yes} or {no}?
npc.florentine.greet_msg_1: Welcome, |PLAYERNAME|. What can I do for you?
npc.florentine.sendtrade_msg_1: Of course, just browse through my wares.
npc.frafnar.greet_msg_1: Don't you see that I'm trying to write a poem? <sighs> So what's the matter?
npc.frans.greet_msg_1: Beeee greeeeted, Simula! What is your neeeed?
npc.frans.say_1: Of course, just browse through my wares. You can also look at {}.
npc.frederik.greet_msg_1: Hi there and welcome to my little magic shop.
npc.frederik.say_1: Of course, just browse through my wares. You can also look at {}.
npc.freezhild.farewell_msg_1: I hope you have a cold day, friend.
npc.freezhild.walkaway_msg_1: I hope you have a cold day, friend.
npc.frodo.farewell_msg_1: Please come back from time to time.
npc.frodo.greet_msg_1: Welcome to Frodo's Hut. You heard about the {news}?
npc.frodo.stdmod_1: Come into my tavern and share some stories!
npc.frodo.stdmod_11: Ah yes, the graveyard dungeon. All I know is this riddle: His Grave to the south, the tree above, his soul in the shade. No idea what that means, though!
npc.frodo.stdmod_12: I heard it when I was a child.
npc.frodo.stdmod_13: Yes, I remember him. His name was Berfasmur.
npc.frodo.stdmod_14: Sorry, he spoke only very little. I know nothing more about him.
npc.frodo.stdmod_15: Come on! You know that our world is called Tibia.
npc.frodo.stdmod_16: Nothing more than a tale for warriors.
npc.frodo.stdmod_17: Uhm, do not mention him. It may scare customers away.
npc.frodo.stdmod_18: No idea who that is, but maybe you'll find something in the Royal Archives...
npc.frodo.stdmod_19: Oh, the Royal Archives are in Rain Castle!
npc.frodo.stdmod_2: I hope you like it. Would you like some {food}?
npc.frodo.stdmod_20: The king's residence has been renovated lately.
npc.frodo.stdmod_21: Many travellers tell funny stories about all the emancipated women in this northern town.
npc.frodo.stdmod_22: Here in Thais is the center of Tibia.
npc.frodo.stdmod_23: He is a little shy. In his youth he dreamed to become a druid.
npc.frodo.stdmod_24: He's able to drink a bottle or two.
npc.frodo.stdmod_25: I am trying to hire him for an evening or two.
npc.frodo.stdmod_26: Oh, that old guy! He's a good customer, that's for sure.
npc.frodo.stdmod_27: Can you believe that she actually told her guildfellows that alcohol is a bad thing?
npc.frodo.stdmod_28: She makes excellent arrows and bows.
npc.frodo.stdmod_29: Many of his customers visit my Hut, too.
npc.frodo.stdmod_3: I am the owner of this saloon. I call it Frodo's Hut. I am also {selling} food.
npc.frodo.stdmod_30: The knights have sometimes parties here after some arena fights.
npc.frodo.stdmod_32: I think some time ago a stranger from Fibula with that name stayed here for some nights.
npc.frodo.stdmod_33: I overheard some conversations about his evilness. That's enough to hope, that I never ever meet him.
npc.frodo.stdmod_34: A sorceress, you can find her in their guild sitting befor a book - always!
npc.frodo.stdmod_35: Just between you and me: What a babe!
npc.frodo.stdmod_36: Marvik seldom leaves his guildhall at all.
npc.frodo.stdmod_37: The McRonalds are a nice couple. Donald is a dear friend of mine.
npc.frodo.stdmod_38: Muriel has never visited this place.
npc.frodo.stdmod_39: I hate him. Each of his visits here ends with a bar brawl.
npc.frodo.stdmod_4: I can offer you bread, cheese, ham, or meat. If you'd like to see my offers, ask me for a trade.
npc.frodo.stdmod_40: He hardly visits my humble tavern.
npc.frodo.stdmod_41: A loud neighbour, I get a lot of complaints about him.
npc.frodo.stdmod_42: That fellow is filthy rich. He rented a room upstairs for months in advance and always orders the best beer and wine i serve.
npc.frodo.stdmod_5: Some travelers from Edron told about a great treasure guarded by cruel demons in the dungeons there.
npc.frodo.stdmod_6: Oh, our beloved king! Thanks to him, alcohol is so cheap.
npc.frodo.stdmod_7: Harkath Bloodblade is the royal general.
npc.frodo.voice_1: Come into my tavern and share some stories!
npc.frodo.walkaway_msg_1: Please come back from time to time.
npc.frosty.greet_msg_1: No, you can't have my nose! If you're in need of a {carrot}, go to the market or just dig up one! Or did you come to bring me a {percht skull}?
npc.frosty.say_1: For a {} you will need {}. Do you have it with you?
npc.frosty.say_2: I can give you one of the following sleighs: {{}}.
npc.frosty.stdmod_1: What about 'no' do you not understand, hrm? You are more annoying than any {percht} around here! Not to mention those bothersome {bunnies} who try to graw away my nose!
npc.frosty.stdmod_2: Well why didn't you say that rightaway, if you give me such a skull I can give you one of my {sleighs}.
npc.frosty.stdmod_3: Always trying to eat my nose!
npc.gabel.farewell_msg_1: Farewell, stranger. May Uman open your minds and your hearts to Daraman's wisdom!
npc.gabel.walkaway_msg_1: Farewell, stranger. May Uman open your minds and your hearts to Daraman's wisdom!
npc.galuna.greet_msg_1: Oh, please come in, |PLAYERNAME|. What do you need? Distance weapons? I sell lots of them.
npc.galuna.voice_1: Bows, crossbows and ammunition on special sale today.
npc.gamel.farewell_msg_1: Bye. Tell others about... my little shop here.
npc.gamel.greet_msg_1: Pssst! Be silent. Do you wish to {buy} something?
npc.gamel.walkaway_msg_1: Bye. Tell others about... my little shop here.
npc.gamon.farewell_msg_1: You'll come back. They all do.
npc.gamon.greet_msg_1: Nice to meet you, Mister |PLAYERNAME|! Looking for furniture? You've come to the right place!
npc.gamon.sendtrade_msg_1: Have a look. Most furniture comes in handy kits. Just use them in your house to assemble the furniture. Do you want to see only a certain type of furniture?
npc.gamon.stdmod_1: Any time's a good time to buy some furniture!
npc.gamon.stdmod_2: Making a stake from a chair? Are you insane??! I won't waste my chairs on you for free! You will have to pay for it, but since I consider your plan a blasphemy, it will cost 5000 gold pieces. Okay?
npc.gamon.stdmod_3: Argh... my heart aches! Alright... a promise is a promise. Here - take this wooden stake, and now get lost.
npc.gamon.stdmod_4: You can't even pay for that.
npc.gamon.voice_1: Any time's a good time to buy some furniture!
npc.garamond.greet_msg_1: Welcome, child. Have you come to learn about {magic}? Then you are in the right place. I can teach you many useful {spells}.
npc.garamond.say_1: Spells are very useful in combat - not only for mages, though of course we particularly rely on them for much of our damage output. ...
npc.garamond.say_10: Ah, the beauty of our world! It is vast and extraordinarily diverse. Strange islands, beautiful cities and fierce monsters that roam the wildernesses. Mysteries, adventures, danger around every corner. ...
npc.garamond.say_11: Once you have reached level 8, you are ready to choose a vocation and go to the Tibian Mainland.
npc.garamond.say_12: Your choice of vocation will determine your life in Tibia, and the skills and fighting techniques you may use. ...
npc.garamond.say_13: There are four vocation: knight, druid, paladin and sorcerer. If you want to know more about them, talk to Oressa in the temple. ...
npc.garamond.say_14: I myself teach try-out spells for both the magical classes, whereas Tybald in the next room specialises in knight and paladin spells.
npc.garamond.say_15: A very intelligent girl. Prefers to listen to wild animals' noises instead of humans', which is quite understandable when you think about it. ...
npc.garamond.say_16: However, she's also a very apt healer and can give you advice on your choice of vocation.
npc.garamond.say_2: There's a broad variety of what spells can do, as you will see as you progress further. The next spells you can buy with level 8 and on. ...
npc.garamond.say_3: Some attack spells can be directed at a single target while others affect an area, having an effect either over time or instantaneous. Even other spells protect you, or can be used to create runes. ...
npc.garamond.say_4: Each vocation has its own individual spells that none of the other vocations can use. You can only learn spells at a spell trainer of your vocation. ...
npc.garamond.say_5: The spells here on Dawnport are for trying out only, and you will forget them once you choose your definite vocation and leave for the Mainland. ...
npc.garamond.say_6: There, you can go to a spell teacher in a city to permanently learn a spell.
npc.garamond.say_7: The Mainland offers many more adventures, dangers and quests than this small isle, and also has spell teachers where you can permanently learn a spell for your vocation. ...
npc.garamond.say_8: Once you reach level 8 you may choose your definite vocation and leave for Main. Go to a city and seek out the spell trainer of your vocation to learn a spell. And make sure you have enough gold! ...
npc.garamond.say_9: The art of spell teaching is complex and dangerous, and we will only impart our valuable knowledge of a spell to a novice if they can pay the price.
npc.garamond.stdmod_1: In this category I have '{Lighthealing}', '{Healfriend}', and '{Curepoison}'.
npc.garamond.stdmod_10: Roughened and toughened by life's tragedies. A good man, but somber.
npc.garamond.stdmod_11: Yes, child. If you wish to learn a spell, tell me.
npc.garamond.stdmod_12:
A very headstrong young man, though I appreciate his devotion to the craft of potion-making. \z
		No respect for senior authority or age at all! Except maybe for a little soft spot for Mr Morris.
npc.garamond.stdmod_13:
A strange young man. He seems driven, to my mind. By what force, I do not know. \z
		I take it the world needs adventurers such as him.
npc.garamond.stdmod_14:
Redeeming one's soul by becoming a clerk? Not very likely. Once a pirate, always a pirate. \z
		But he's a charming old rogue.
npc.garamond.stdmod_15:
Not a half bad cook, truly. Must have been that squirrel diet, it seems to have lead him to \z
		discover a new cuisine - everything to forget the bad taste of squirrels, he said.
npc.garamond.stdmod_16:
He is proficient in the martial arts. A very skilled teacher of spells for knights and paladins. \z
		If that is your vocation, you should talk to Ser Tybald.
npc.garamond.stdmod_17:
Ah, yes. Travelled with Plunderpurse a lot as I recall. Captain Plunderpurse, then. \z
			Got his head full of numbers and statistics, that boy.
npc.garamond.stdmod_2:
In this category I have '{Findperson}', '{Magicrope}', '{Levitate}', '{Light}', \z
		'{Greatlight}', '{Haste}', '{Poisonfield}', '{Firefield}', '{Lightmagicmissile}' and '{Energyfield}'.
npc.garamond.stdmod_4:
I can teach you {healing spells}, {support spells} and {attack spells}. \z
		What kind of spell do you wish to learn?
npc.garamond.stdmod_6:
Did you not listen? I am the teacher of druid and sorcerer spells for level 8 to 18. \z
		I teach young adventurers spells they can use once they have the proper vocation - druid or sorcerer.
npc.garamond.stdmod_7: I have an old friend there. Haven't heard from him in a while.
npc.garamond.stdmod_8:
Oh, it's not too bad here, believe me. At least I always get young and enthusiast disciples! \z
		Though I must confess I miss the vastness of the Tibian plains. <sighs>
npc.garamond.stdmod_9:
A kind old hunter. He loves to see young life around, taking on the ways and lays of the land. \z
		If you have any question, ask Inigo for help.
npc.gareth.greet_msg_1: Welcome to the wonderful and only recently opened Museum of Tibian Arts! Free entrance for everybody, but patrons of the arts are wanted and favoured.
npc.gareth.greet_msg_2: The Druid of Crunor has sent you? He seems to know that this new museum shines like a diamond. Enjoy your stay! If you like to {support} this place, talk to me.
npc.gareth.greet_msg_4: You again? How could you flee from the last floor. The cultists should have 'dealt' with you! That beats me. You have to leave this place right now. There's nothing more to say.
npc.gate_guardian.greet_msg_1: Chhhhzzz. Ugly humanzzz! You better have a good reazzzon to be here!
npc.gelagos.farewell_msg_1: Hope you die and lose it.
npc.gelagos.stdmod_6: You are as stupid as Bron.
npc.gelagos.stdmod_7: Any cyclops is smarter than Bron.
npc.gelidrazahs_thirst.greet_msg_1: Have you come to answer Gelidrazah's questions?
npc.gerimor.barkless_complete_1: The Penitent, thats what they called him? If their spiritual leader and creator of this following changed so radically...
npc.gerimor.barkless_complete_2: Something far more dangerous must have stood behind this.
npc.gerimor.barkless_text_1: However, recently they became more prominent as their leader seems to hava taken a turn for the worse. Rumors of violent acts and disappearing people are linked to this cult. ...
npc.gerimor.barkless_text_2: Someone... Should look into that, don't you think?
npc.gerimor.greet_msg_1: Greeting, |PLAYERNAME|! I welcome you to this sacred {place}. If you are interested in {missions} just ask.
npc.gerimor.humans_complete_1: Zathroth wasn't behind this after all. That's good... what's not good is that we have to deal with an unknown power now, let's hope for the best.
npc.gerimor.humans_text_1: It's a forbidden and abandoned place but... There is an ancient temple of Zathroth beneath Carlin. Some say it's not that abandoned anymore. ...
npc.gerimor.humans_text_2: Voices, flickering lights in the dead of night, and even a strange gate like sphere wich leads to who knows where. I can't really request this from you but... Someone should take a look, or not?
npc.gerimor.life_complete_1: Thanks a lot. You have revealed the mystery of this cult and killed the sandking. ...
npc.gerimor.life_complete_2: The signature AM you have seen, could stand for 'Aeterna Exsistentia' regarding the eternal life. As a reward I give this to you.
npc.gerimor.life_text_1: Its worshippers wish for eternal, life free of pain and sorrow. The entrance to this cult can be found in the dark pyramid. Would you life to investigate it for me?
npc.gerimor.minotaurs_complete_1: You have found the source of power which strengthened the minotaurs. Thanks a lot! Here your reward.
npc.gerimor.minotaurs_text_1: This is an animal-like cult. Only minotaurs can be found there, but no idea what there are expecting and what they are worshipping. ...
npc.gerimor.minotaurs_text_2: Maybe they are a bit different to the creatures you already know. Would you like to dinf out more for me?
npc.gerimor.misguided_complete_1: So the leader of these... Misguided was actually controlled and not the other way round? Whatever is behind all this, that's some first-rate irony right there.
npc.gerimor.misguided_text_1: There's a camp of outlaws to the east of Thais. Rumour has it that people are going missing but it's not linked to the bandits. ...
npc.gerimor.misguided_text_2: Lights have been seen at night in the abandoned ruin in the vicinity of the camp, somewhere to the south-west. Brave enough to check it out?
npc.gerimor.orcs_complete_1: That was no god - yet you rid the world of a being which, without the help of one, would not even have been here in the first place. Nicely done.
npc.gerimor.orcs_text_1: Several Edron orcs have taken to a dangerous idol it seems. It may not be too late to stop them if you act quickly. A powerful cult of orcs with a broad following could prove unsurmountable in the end. ...
npc.gerimor.prosperity_complete_1: Thanks a lot. As I already supposed the museum is just a disguise. ...
npc.gerimor.prosperity_complete_2: You found out the true meaning. As you have described their cult object the AM on the floor might stand for "Aurea Manus". Here is your reward for your effort.
npc.gerimor.prosperity_text_1: The alleged incentive to follow this cult is infinite prosperity. Therefore most of the worshippers are already very rich citizens of Tibia. ...
npc.gerimor.prosperity_text_2: This cult is abandoned in the recently opened new museum in Thais. This can be entered in the Thais exhibition. Would you like to have a look at this cult?
npc.gerimor.stdmod_1: This place is a sanctuary of Crunor and provides me with a opportunity of spiritual contemplation.
npc.gerimor.stdmod_10:
I'm a member of a circle of persons, that joined wisdom and resources for a common purpose. Let's say, we have an eye on the greater picture in the matters of our world. ... \z
	We are watching and evaluating what is happening in our world.	Trying to avert the worst and offering a helping hand where we deem it needed. ... \z
	We usually avoid to interfere directly in the affairs of the world and vain politics are not our concern at all.
npc.gerimor.stdmod_11:
Well, while I focus more on the matters of life, some of my peers have different approaches and emphasize other aspects of the world more in their observations. ... \z
	Regardless we share a common goal of balance and harmony.
npc.gerimor.stdmod_12:
Even we know the individual that was somewhat of our funder, only as the wise man. ... \z
	He was the first to bring bright and dedicated minds together, to bring at least a little order and guidance into troubled and chaotic times. ... \z
	The order predates mankind and never bothered to give itself a name. Such assumptions of pretence and vanity have no place in our mindset.
npc.gerimor.stdmod_13:
Most times we are silent watchers and keeper of knowledge that share what they have learned with each other. We are more concerned about knowledge and wisdom and power means little to us. ... \z
	To solve problems we usually try to convince the right people to do the right thing. We usually even lack the means for a more direct interference.
npc.gerimor.stdmod_14:
Sometimes it's necessary to do something about a situation that became threatening to the world itself. ... \z
	It is gladly a rare occurrence and usually it is sufficient to somewhat offer a guiding hand to avert a course that would lead to more dire consequences. Nonetheless sometimes we have to interfere.
npc.gerimor.stdmod_15:
The fae vary greatly in size and appearance. There are different kinds of fae like fauns, pixies, pookas, swan maidens, nymphs and boogies. Those mystical creatures are wielding power in magic and elementals. ... \z
	Most of them are rather reclusive and live peaceful lives in their secret realm. Sometimes they are called the 'children of dreams' or 'the dream born' because the fae are born from the mortals' dreams.
npc.gerimor.stdmod_16:
Fauns are half-human, half-beast nature spirits inhabiting the woods and mountains of Feyrist. They are a slightly roguish but cheerful folk, lovers of wine and dancing. ... \z
	Fauns show a youthful and graceful aspect but they are also brave and fearless when it comes to defend themselves. As Maelyrra told me, they emerge from mortals' dreams about celebrations, music and dancing. ... \z
	Lately, some fauns on Feyrist are tainted by the mysterious, sinister force that is threatening Feyrist as well as the rest of Tibia.
npc.gerimor.stdmod_17:
Pixies are small nature spirits and mythical creatures inhabiting the forests and plains of Feyrist. They are generally benign, but at times, they may also display mischievous traits. ... \z
	Like most of the fae, pixies love dancing and are often gathering in larger groups to dance on secluded glades. Pixies love flowers, butterflies, shimmering beetles, gems and other colourful things. ... \z
	They also love the taste of honey, sweetened oat and ripe grapes. As Maelyrra told me, pixies emerge from mortals' dreams about friends and family.
npc.gerimor.stdmod_18:
Pookas are nature spirits in animal form, looking like big hares with a faintly glittering fur. They are benign but mischievous, for sure with good reason regarded as the tricksters among the fae. ... \z
	Pookas love to play pranks on others, snitching and hiding things or telling made-up stories. They are capricious and fickle creatures. Pookas emerge from mortals' dreams about gems, treasures and gold. ... \z
	Lately, some pookas on Feyrist are tainted by a mysterious, sinister force that is threatening Feyrist as well as the rest of Tibia.
npc.gerimor.stdmod_19:
Swan maidens are fae who can shapeshift from human form to swan form. The magical item allowing this transformation is a swan feather cloak, a garment with swan feathers attached. ... \z
	Here on Feyrist it is always hard to tell whether a swan swimming on a lake is an ordinary animal or a swan maiden in her bird shape. ... \z
	They protect the wilds of their secret realm from every intruder and live in small flocks along secluded lakeshores. As Maelyrra told me, swan maidens emerge from mortals' dreams about flying.
npc.gerimor.stdmod_2: We focus our interest on this we see as threatening for live and the laws of nature itself.
npc.gerimor.stdmod_20:
Nymphs are female nature spirits and usually take the form of beautiful, young maidens who love to dance and sing. They dwell in the hills and forests of Feyrist, often near lakes and streams and they can't die of old age nor illness. ... \z
	They have a special, strong bond to the plants and animals of their domain and are very protective of Feyrist's flora and fauna. As Maelyrra told me, nymphs emerge from mortals' dreams about love.
npc.gerimor.stdmod_21:
Boogies are a rather twisted kind of fae. Other than pixies, nymphs or fauns they favour underground caves and tunnels over forests or lush meadows. ... \z
	Only at night, they are roaming the surface, chasing other fae and visitors to Feyrist alike. They were once clumsy yet peaceful fae, but they are now twisted and tainted by a mysterious, sinister force.
npc.gerimor.stdmod_22:
She's the queen of a fae court. You can find her on a glade in the deep forest. It was queen Maelyrra who granted me permission to stay here in Feyrist. ... \z
	I promised to inform her about anything I find out about the abominable force that threatens this world.
npc.gerimor.stdmod_23:
The fae vary greatly in size and appearance. There are different kinds of fae like fauns, pixies, pookas, swan maidens, nymphs and boogies. Those mystical creatures are wielding power in magic and elementals. ... \z
	Most of them are rather reclusive and live peaceful lives in their secret realm. Sometimes they are called the ,children of dreams' or ,the dream born' because the fae are born from the mortals' dreams.
npc.gerimor.stdmod_24:
It doesn't seem that the cults share a common theme or object of reverence but there has to be some connection beyond being at the centre of culminations of disruptive power from beyond. ... \z
	The connection is of second thought though. Connected or not, they further the death of our world. That alone makes it imperative to dig those cults out and destroy their cores. ... \z
	We won't be able to rout our each and any movement but if we manage to neutralize the worst, we gain some time and deny the enemy much of its leverage on the future of our world.
npc.gerimor.stdmod_25:
We have located some of the worst culminations of otherworldly presence and our sources returned information about them with different results of success. ... \z
	Some information I can provide you will be rather sparse and much is left to speculation but you should have at least some lead where to go and investigate.
npc.gerimor.stdmod_26:
We haven't completely figured out what our enemy exactly is. For one, this thing defies all laws of nature and comprehension, ... \z
	that understanding it is either impossible or twist a mind in ways that are not meant to be. Also the Yalahari who figured out way too much about the thing, became tainted and changed by this knowledge ... \z
	And ultimately not only fell and became his, they also provided the thing with something of their own, be it knowledge, understanding or even direction, purpose. ... \z
	In some way their tainted knowledge brought the unthinkable into a resemblance of existence. ... \z
	That is why we cant dabble too much in figuring this out and rather concentrate on our fight to severe its ties to our world.
npc.gerimor.stdmod_3: We might not be many but we are diverse. Our rather informal order came together in the dawn of time, when the wars of the gods ravaged the world.
npc.gerimor.stdmod_4: Interference comes in different forms. In this particular case there is sadly little time for subtlety and a more direct approach is necessary.
npc.gerimor.stdmod_5: The fae granted me permission to enter their hidden realm. As a druid I'm in close touch with nature so I could gain their trust. The nature spirits are inhabiting this peninsula for ages.
npc.gerimor.stdmod_6: Those cults have to be stopped by any means possible. These are desperate times and they demand desperate actions.
npc.gerimor.stdmod_7: Spare lives where you see it fit but the cults may not be allowed to exist and disrupt the fabric of the world even more.
npc.gerimor.stdmod_8: The weakened fabric of our reality still repels the unnatural intruder. The cults provide the thing a hold and supply it with more power, even if we couldn't figure out yet, how this works at all.
npc.gerimor.stdmod_9: I have several missions available that deal with servering the ties of the corrupting influence on our world.

npc.ghost_of_a_priest.stdmod_1: We are the {guardians}. We are all what is left from the glory of the past.
npc.ghost_of_a_priest.stdmod_10: There are many forms of corruption in this world. All of it is the work of the egg stealers who spread their taint. The creation hatched by the Great {Snake} was perfect without even the option of corruption.
npc.ghost_of_a_priest.stdmod_11: Creatures from beyond. Greedy and traitorous, they stole parts of the world and of life for themselves. They corrupted the world by their deceptions and stole our {birthright}.
npc.ghost_of_a_priest.stdmod_12: We were overthrown by those of who we vainly thought we could use for our advantage, even though we knew about the foulness of the false-born.
npc.ghost_of_a_priest.stdmod_13: Everything that lacks scales is no true litter of the Great Snake. They are the corrupted kin of the egg stealers.
npc.ghost_of_a_priest.stdmod_14: Such concepts are of little consequence for the dead.
npc.ghost_of_a_priest.stdmod_15: They are a manifestation of the snake god's power. They are its avatars in some way.
npc.ghost_of_a_priest.stdmod_16: We are the true-born. We are the children of the snake. But as children we have yet much to learn. One day we might take our rightful place in creation, but only if we prove {worthy}.
npc.ghost_of_a_priest.stdmod_17: They are the false-born. They hatched from foul eggs - poisoned by the egg stealers. They are numerous and like a plague for the world.
npc.ghost_of_a_priest.stdmod_18: This was once the centre of power of our religion. From here we ruled Tiquanda in the name of the snake god.
npc.ghost_of_a_priest.stdmod_19: We were not aware of another civilisation that was left. Only recently the awareness of the Great Snake touched us in our slumber and we learnt through visions of its other children.
npc.ghost_of_a_priest.stdmod_2: We are the keepers of this old temple and the guardians of its sacred {secrets}.
npc.ghost_of_a_priest.stdmod_20:
Some of the relics are still left in this world. They are insignia of the snake god's power. We know that you came for one of those insignia. ... \z
	The Great {Snake} approves that you acquire its holy {sceptre}. We will not question the wisdom of the god to hand this relic to one of the false-born.
npc.ghost_of_a_priest.stdmod_21:
We have failed our god and paid a high price. But all tragedies and obstacles are just a test of the Great Snake. We will have to prove we are worthy to be its first true-born. ... \z
	Only in the face of seemingly impossible odds, we can prove what we are capable of. If we overcome all obstacles, the favour of the Great {Snake} will return to us. ... \z
	The god has cast us down only to elevate us to new heights if we are worthy.
npc.ghost_of_a_priest.stdmod_22:
We understand what he is and what he has become. We were not aware there were others like us left in the world. ... \z
	Perhaps there is still a chance our race can redeem itself in the eyes of the Great {Snake}.
npc.ghost_of_a_priest.stdmod_23:
The father and mother of everything. Its first egg hatched the world. Its second egg hatched life itself. The lizard people were of its third litter. ... \z
	Of the third litter but the first true-born, we became its keepers. As its first true children, we inherited the earth but it was taken from us by the {egg stealers}.
npc.ghost_of_a_priest.stdmod_24:
We were the rulers of the world. We overlooked the world in the name of the Great {Snake}. The egg stealers and their creatures stole it from our claws. ... \z
	We have failed the Great {Snake} and our {decline} is its punishment.
npc.ghost_of_a_priest.stdmod_25:
The Great Snake deserves that we try to use the best of our abilities and capabilities to serve it. Our existence is a test in this world corrupted by the egg stealers. ... \z
	Only when we overcome all obstacles cast into our way, we will become worthy to serve the Great Snake in all eternity.
npc.ghost_of_a_priest.stdmod_26:
Some of the relics are still left in this world. They are insignia of the snake god's power. We know that you came for one of those insignia. ... \z
	The Great Snake approves that you acquire its holy sceptre. We will not question the wisdom of the god to hand this relic to one of the false-born.
npc.ghost_of_a_priest.stdmod_27:
We were once the heigh priests of the Great Snake. We willingly left our mortal existence behind to become bound to this temple. ... \z
	In this state we can serve the Great Snake in a more suitable way. You have to understand that it is an honour and a privilege, not a sacrifice.
npc.ghost_of_a_priest.stdmod_3: We are keepers of the {lore} of the Great {Snake} and we guard some of its {relics}.
npc.ghost_of_a_priest.stdmod_4: The lore of the Great {Snake} is contorted like a snake. Although we feel you are touched by the snake's essence, you are not ready yet to receive the blessing of the deeper wisdom.
npc.ghost_of_a_priest.stdmod_5: Once the powerful relics of the Great {Snake} were abundant. Most got lost to the ravages of time and our enemies. What is {left} is all the more precious.
npc.ghost_of_a_priest.stdmod_6: We are the guardians. We are all what is left from the glory of the past.
npc.ghost_of_a_priest.stdmod_7: What you call Banuta was once a centre of our civilisation and culture. We gave those {apes} so much, but they wanted more. In the end, the Great {Snake} used them as a tool to teach our people a painful but necessary lesson.
npc.ghost_of_a_priest.stdmod_8: In their vanity our descendants thought they could use those false-born as servants. They paid a terrible price. Their downfall might only be temporary though if we can {redeem} our race in the eyes of the snake god.
npc.ghost_of_a_priest.stdmod_9: Dragons are one of the greatest creations of the Great {Snake}. Yet, they are still distanced from the Great {Snake} and susceptible for {corruption} and the lies of the egg stealers.

npc.gnommander.greet_msg_1: Hi there! Welcome to the spike.
npc.gnommander.speech_1: I'm the operating commander of the Spike, the latest great accomplishment of the gnomish race.
npc.gnommander.speech_2: The Spike is a crystal structure, created by our greatest crystal experts. It has grown from a crystal the size of my fist to the structure you see here and now.
npc.gnommander.speech_3: Of course this did not happen from one day to the other. It's the fruit of the work of several gnomish generations. Its purpose has changed in the course of time.
npc.gnommander.speech_4: At first it was conceived as a fast growing resource node. Then it was planned to become the prototype of a new type of high security base.
npc.gnommander.speech_5: Now it has become a military base and a weapon. With our foes occupied elsewhere, we can prepare our strike into the depths of the earth.
npc.gnommander.speech_6: This crystal can withstand extreme pressure and temperature, and it's growing deeper and deeper even as we speak.
npc.gnommander.speech_7: The times of the fastest growth have come to an end, however, and we have to slow down in order not to risk the structural integrity of the Spike. But we are on our way and have to do everything possible to defend the Spike.

npc.gnomus.greet_msg_1: Greetings, member of the Bigfoot Brigade. We could really use some {help} from you right now. You should prove {worthy} to our alliance.
npc.gnomus.say_1: You want to offer {} suspicious device{}. Which leader shall have it, (Gnomus) of the {gnomes}, (Klom Stonecutter) of the {dwarves} or the {scouts} (Lardoc Bashsmite)?
npc.gnomus.say_2: The gnomes are still in need of your help, member of Bigfoot's Brigade. Prove your worth by answering their calls! ({}/10)
npc.gnomus.say_3: The dwarves are still in need of your help, member of Bigfoot's Brigade. Prove your worth by answering their calls! ({}/10)
npc.gnomus.say_4: The scouts are still in need of your help, member of Bigfoot's Brigade. Prove your worth by answering their calls! ({}/10)
npc.gnomus.stdmod_1: If you're willing to help us, we could need an escort for arriving {ordnance}, help with {charting} the cave system and someone needs to get some heat {measurements} fast.
npc.gnomus.stdmod_3: I'm the main gnomish contact for this base. I coordinate our efforts with those of the dwarves to ensure everything is running smoothly.
npc.gnomus.stdmod_4:
You're already known amongst the gnomes, member of the Bigfoot Brigade. I will make sure that the alliance learns of your deeds but you'll still need to help the dwarves and gnomes of this outpost to show your worth. ... \z
	We also found {suspicious devices} carried by all kinds of creatures down here. Down here, they are of extreme worth to us since they could contain the key to what's happening all around us. ... \z
	If you can aquire any, return them to me and I make sure to tell the others of your generosity. Return to me afterwards to check on your current {status}.
npc.gnomus.stdmod_5:
Our surveys of the area showed us some spikes in heat and seismic activity at very specific places. ... \z
	We conclude this is no coincidence and the enemy is using devices to pump up the lava to flood the area. We have seen it before and had to retreat each time. ... \z
	This time though we might have a counter prepared - given me manage to pierce their defences.
npc.gnomus.stdmod_6:
Gnomish supplies and ingenuity have helped to establish and fortify this outpost. ... \z
	Our knowledge of the enemy and it's tactics would be of more use if the dwarves would listen to us somewhat more. But gnomes have learned to live with the imperfection of the other races.

npc.graubart.greet_msg_1: Ahoi, young man |PLAYERNAME|. Looking for work on my ship?
npc.graubart.stdmod_1: My name is Graubart, captain of the great SeaHawk!
npc.graubart.stdmod_10: Bruno is one of the best sailors I know. He is nearly as good as me. *laughs loudly*
npc.graubart.stdmod_2: Ah, my whole proud: My ship named SeaHawk. We rode out so many stormy nights together. I think I couldn't live without it.
npc.graubart.stdmod_3: Ah, my whole proud: My ship named SeaHawk. We rode out so many stormy nights together. I think I couldn't live without it.
npc.graubart.stdmod_4: I'm a merchant. I sail all over the world with my ship and trade with many different races!
npc.graubart.stdmod_5: A merchant is someone who trades goods with other people and tries to make a little profit. *laughs*
npc.graubart.stdmod_6: I trade nearly everything, for example weapons, food, water, and even magic runes.
npc.graubart.stdmod_7: You know; elves, dwarfs, lizardmen, minotaurs and many others.
npc.graubart.stdmod_9: Pssst. Marlene is not near right now...? You know... she is a lovely woman, but she talks too much! So I always try to keep distance from her because she can't stop talking.
npc.gregor.say_1: Well then, listen closely. First, you will have to prove that you are a fierce and restless warrior by bringing me 100 perfect behemoth fangs. ...
npc.gregor.say_2: Secondly, please retrieve a helmet for us which has been lost a long time ago. The famous Ramsay the Reckless wore it when exploring an ape settlement. ...
npc.gregor.say_3: Third, we need a new flask of warrior's sweat. We've run out of it recently, but we need a small amount for the show battles in our arena. ...
npc.gregor.say_4: Lastly, I will have our smith refine your helmet if you bring me royal steel, an especially noble metal. ...
npc.gregor.say_5: Did you understand everything I told you and are willing to handle this task?
npc.gregor.stdmod_1: Gather around me, young knights! I'm going to teach you some spells!
npc.gregor.stdmod_10: Beautiful Tibia. And with our help everyone is save.
npc.gregor.stdmod_11: It is time to join the Knights!
npc.gregor.stdmod_12: Knights are the warriors of Tibia. Without us, no one would be safe. Every brave and strong man or woman can join us.
npc.gregor.stdmod_13: Some day someone will make something happen to him...
npc.gregor.stdmod_14: A bow might be a fine weapon for someone not strong enough to wield a REAL weapon.
npc.gregor.stdmod_15: I and my students often share a cask of beer or wine at Frodo's hut.
npc.gregor.stdmod_16: Always concerned with his profit. What a loss! He was adventuring with baxter in the old days.
npc.gregor.stdmod_18: Before she became a priest she won the Miss Tibia contest three times in a row.
npc.gregor.stdmod_2: In this category I have '{Wound Cleansing}' and '{Cure Poison}'.
npc.gregor.stdmod_20: A fine game to hunt. But be careful, he cheats!
npc.gregor.stdmod_21: Bah, go away with these sorcerer tricks. Only cowards use tricks.
npc.gregor.stdmod_23: I will never understand this peaceful monks and priests.
npc.gregor.stdmod_24: He has the muscles, but lacks the guts.
npc.gregor.stdmod_3: In this category I have '{Light}', '{Find Person}' and '{Great Light}'.
npc.gregor.stdmod_4: I can teach you {healing spells} and {support spells}. What kind of spell do you wish to learn? You can also tell me for which level you would like to learn a spell, if you prefer that.
npc.gregor.stdmod_5: I am the first knight. I trained some of the greatest heroes of Tibia.
npc.gregor.stdmod_6: Of course, you heard of them. Knights are the best fighters in Tibia.
npc.gregor.stdmod_8: You are joking, eh? Of course, you know me. I am Gregor, the first knight.
npc.gregor.voice_1: Gather around me, young knights! I'm going to teach you some spells!
npc.grizzly_adams.boss_intro_10a: Superb work. However, there is something else I want you to do. It is said that there is a quara general named 'Thul' who is responsible for the attacks on Liberty Bay. Find and kill the general and bring peace back to Liberty Bay! ...
npc.grizzly_adams.boss_intro_10b: If you're up for another hunting mission, just ask me for a {task}. Be aware that you can only have one 'Thul' task active at the same time!
npc.grizzly_adams.boss_intro_11: Well THAT was a hunt. Good job. Have you heard about the 'Old Widow'? It must have a hideout. Try to find it and slay the beast. You can ask about new {tasks} by the way. Be aware that you can only have one 'Old Widow' task active at the same time!
npc.grizzly_adams.boss_intro_12a: What an impressive hunt. Nicely done. By the way there is still something I want you to do for me. 'Hemming' a furious werewolf is up to mischief. Find its hideout and bring it down! ...
npc.grizzly_adams.boss_intro_12b: If you're up for another hunting mission, just ask me for a {task}. Be aware that you can only have one 'Hemming' task active at the same time!
npc.grizzly_adams.boss_intro_13a: Thumbs up, nice performance. Have you heard about 'Tormentor'? Find it and slay the beast. ...
npc.grizzly_adams.boss_intro_13b: If you're up for another hunting mission, just ask me for a {task}. Be aware that you can only have one 'Tormentor' task active at the same time!
npc.grizzly_adams.boss_intro_14: Well THAT was a hunt. Good job. Have you heard about 'Flameborn'? It must have a hideout. Try to find it and slay the beast. You can ask about new {tasks} by the way. Be aware that you can only have one 'Flameborn' task active at the same time!
npc.grizzly_adams.boss_intro_15a: What an impressive hunt. Nicely done. Have you heard about 'Fazzrah'? Try to find it and slay the beast. ...
npc.grizzly_adams.boss_intro_15b: You can ask about new {tasks} by the way. Be aware that you can only have one 'Fazzrah' task active at the same time!
npc.grizzly_adams.boss_intro_16a: Nicely done. However, there is something else I want you to do. I have heard that there is a stampor the hunters in the Muggy Plains call 'Tromphonyte'. It is an extremely dangerous example of its kind! ...
npc.grizzly_adams.boss_intro_16b: I believe you are equal to the task, |PLAYERNAME|! Find and kill it and bring peace back! ...
npc.grizzly_adams.boss_intro_16c: If you're up for another hunting mission, just ask me for a {task}. Be aware that you can only have one 'Tromphonyte' task active at the same time!
npc.grizzly_adams.boss_intro_17: If you're up for another hunting mission, just ask me for a {task}. Be aware that you can only have one 'Sulphur Scuttler' task active at the same time!
npc.grizzly_adams.boss_intro_18: If you're up for another hunting mission, just ask me for a {task}. Be aware that you can only have one 'Bruise Payne' task active at the same time!
npc.grizzly_adams.boss_intro_19: If you're up for another hunting mission, just ask me for a {task}. Be aware that you can only have one 'Many' task active at the same time!
npc.grizzly_adams.boss_intro_1a: Spiffing work, old chap. Now I have a special task for you. Recently several citizens of Port Hope vanished. It is rumoured that they were killed by a crocodile. The people call it 'Snapper'. Hunt down and kill that evil man-eating beast. ...
npc.grizzly_adams.boss_intro_1b: Ask me about new {tasks} if you're up for a further hunting mission. Be aware that you can only have one 'Snapper' task active at the same time!
npc.grizzly_adams.boss_intro_2: Nicely done! Now I shall assign you a special task. Rumour has it that there is an ancient and evil tarantula who preys on humans. She is called 'Hide'. Track her down and kill her! Good luck, old chap.
npc.grizzly_adams.boss_intro_20a: My - you can be proud of yourself! However, you're not finished yet. There are rumours about a being called 'The Noxious Spawn' which was seen deep down in the ruins of Banuta. Try to find its hideout. ...
npc.grizzly_adams.boss_intro_20b: You can ask about new {tasks} bye the way. Be aware that you can only have one 'Noxious Spawn' task active at the same time!
npc.grizzly_adams.boss_intro_21: If you're up for another hunting mission, just ask me for a {task}. Be aware that you can only have one 'Gorgo' task active at the same time!
npc.grizzly_adams.boss_intro_22a: Such marvellous hunting skills! Perhaps you can help me with this one. Have you heard about 'Stonecracker'? ...
npc.grizzly_adams.boss_intro_22b: It's the oldest and most dangerous of all behemoths and was last seen under the Cyclopolis in Edron. What do you think? Are you hunter enough? I think you are!
npc.grizzly_adams.boss_intro_23a: Good job, old chap! Are you up for a challenge? Have you heard of the legendary sea serpent called the 'Leviathan'? It must be somewhere near the spot you found. ...
npc.grizzly_adams.boss_intro_23b: This is a true test of your hunting skills - find it and kill it. Good hunting! ...
npc.grizzly_adams.boss_intro_23c: You can ask about new {tasks} by the way. Be aware that you can only have one 'Leviathan' task active at the same time!
npc.grizzly_adams.boss_intro_24a: Outstanding! You do have impressive hunting skills. Have you already heard about Kerberos the oldest and most dangerous of all hellhounds? He must have a hideout somewhere. Try to find him and slay the beast. ...
npc.grizzly_adams.boss_intro_24b: You can ask about new tasks by the way. Be aware that you can only have one Kerberos task active at the same time!
npc.grizzly_adams.boss_intro_25: If you're up for another hunting mission, just ask me for a {task}. Be aware that you can only have one 'Ethershreck' task active at the same time!
npc.grizzly_adams.boss_intro_26: If you're up for another hunting mission, just ask me for a {task}. Be aware that you can only have one 'Paiz the Pauperizer' task active at the same time!
npc.grizzly_adams.boss_intro_27: If you're up for another hunting mission, just ask me for a {task}. Be aware that you can only have one 'Bretzecutioner' task active at the same time!
npc.grizzly_adams.boss_intro_28: If you're up for another hunting mission, just ask me for a {task}. Be aware that you can only have one 'Zanakeph' task active at the same time!
npc.grizzly_adams.boss_intro_3a: Well done, old chap. Now i shall assign you a special task. Rumour has it that there is an old carniphila somewhere in the jungle. Find Deathbine's hideout and kill it! Good luck, old chap ...
npc.grizzly_adams.boss_intro_3b: Ask me about new {tasks} if you're up for further hunting mission. Be aware that you can only have one 'Deathbine' task active at the same time!
npc.grizzly_adams.boss_intro_4: Jolly good job you did there, but now I have a special task for you. The citizens of Svargrond live in fear because of a frightfully bad-tempered mammoth they call 'Blood Tusk'. Go there and put an end to him. Happy hunting!
npc.grizzly_adams.boss_intro_5a: As I see it, you need more of a challenge! I have heard that there is an ice golem the hunters in Svargrond call 'Shardhead'. It is an extremely dangerous example of its kind! ...
npc.grizzly_adams.boss_intro_5b: I believe you are equal to the task, |PLAYERNAME|! If you're up for another hunting mission, just ask me for a {task}. Be aware that you can only have one 'Shardhead' task active at the same time!
npc.grizzly_adams.boss_intro_6a: Very good work, old chap. Lucky you are here - I have just been told of a task which is perfect for you. ...
npc.grizzly_adams.boss_intro_6b: The Yalaharians are having a spot of bother with a huge mutated rat. They call it 'Esmeralda' and you should find her somewhere in the sewers. Good hunting!
npc.grizzly_adams.boss_intro_7a: Very good work, old chap. Lucky you are here - I have just been told of a task which is perfect for you. ...
npc.grizzly_adams.boss_intro_7b: The people of Ankrahmun are having a spot of bother with a huge ancient scarab. They call it 'Fleshcrawler' and you should find and kill it. Good hunting! ...
npc.grizzly_adams.boss_intro_7c: If you're up for another hunting mission, just ask me for a {task}. Be aware that you can only have one 'Fleshcrawler' task active at the same time!
npc.grizzly_adams.boss_intro_8a: Very good work, old chap. Have you heard about 'Ribstride'? It must have a hideout. Try to find it and slay the beast. ...
npc.grizzly_adams.boss_intro_8b: If you're up for another hunting mission, just ask me for a {task}. Be aware that you can only have one 'Ribstride' task active at the same time!
npc.grizzly_adams.boss_intro_9a: Very good work, old chap. Have you heard about 'Bloodweb'? It must have a hideout. Try to find it and slay the beast. ...
npc.grizzly_adams.boss_intro_9b: If you're up for another hunting mission, just ask me for a {task}. Be aware that you can only have one 'Bloodweb' task active at the same time!
npc.grizzly_adams.boss_start_deathbine: Find Deathbine, the old carniphila, somewhere in the jungle. Find its hideout and kill it!
npc.grizzly_adams.boss_start_default: Okay. Go forth and kill him.
npc.grizzly_adams.boss_start_many: Keep your head and focus when you confront her!
npc.grizzly_adams.carniphilas_1: Interesting kind and not so easy to find. The fun begins when you want to hunt {Tiquanda's Revenge}. It's strong and smart like no other carniphila.
npc.grizzly_adams.carniphilas_2: Damn walking weed-thingies! You'll find them deeper in the jungle. Weed out 150 carniphilas for our society. Alright?
npc.grizzly_adams.else_max_rank: You already achieved the maximum rank for your level range. If you accept this task, you won't gain points for our society. Hunt {0} {1} and you'll be rewarded with experience and the possibility to choose a {boss}. Are you in, old chap?
npc.grizzly_adams.greet_msg_1: Hi there, do you want to to {join} the 'Paw and Fur - Hunting Elite'?
npc.grizzly_adams.greet_msg_2: Welcome to the 'Paw and Fur - Hunting Elite' |PLAYERNAME|. Feel free to do {tasks} for us.
npc.grizzly_adams.greet_msg_3: Good to see you again {}. You gained {} points for our society. Ask me for {promotion} to advance your rank!
npc.grizzly_adams.multi_1: Such brave deed deserves a special reward! Take this holy icon. It neutralises great evil and gives you access to areas which are protected by those forces. But remember ...

npc.grizzly_adams.multi_22: Alright, what would you like to hunt? Be aware you won't gain any paw and fur points as you already achieved the highest rank, but you'll get an experience reward and can face bosses. ...
npc.grizzly_adams.multi_24: as well as {hellhounds}, {ghastly dragons}, {undead dragons}, {draken} and {destroyers} or maybe {demons}.
npc.grizzly_adams.multi_25: The spawn of pure evil must be erased from Tibia. You'll find demons lurking in the northern ruins of Edron as well as in some other deeper dungeons of Tibia. Slay 6666 demons for the greater good! Do you think you can handle this task?
npc.grizzly_adams.multi_26: You gained 10 points! Let me promote you to the first rank: 'Huntsman'. Congratulations! ...
npc.grizzly_adams.multi_27: If you find any trophies - either monster heads or other parts of monsters that you don't need - feel free to ask me for a trade.
npc.grizzly_adams.multi_28: You gained 20 points. It's time for a promotion. You advance to the rank of a 'Ranger'. Congratulations! ...
npc.grizzly_adams.multi_29: Oh, I made a deal with Lorek. He ships Rangers from our society - and higher ranks of course - to Banuta, Chor or near the mountain pass to Darama. Just ask him for a passage.
npc.grizzly_adams.multi_3: Ah, okay. This time you'll just get an experience reward, no points for our society as you already gained enough points for your level range. Ask me for a {boss} and the choice is yours. ...
npc.grizzly_adams.multi_30: Good show! You gained 40 points for the 'Paw and Fur - Hunting Elite'. You have earned the right to join the ranks of those known as 'Big game hunter'. Congratulations! ...
npc.grizzly_adams.multi_31: From now on I'll buy more trophies from you!
npc.grizzly_adams.multi_32: Spiffing! You gained 70 hunting points! From now on you can call yourself a 'Trophy hunter'. As a reward I have this special backpack for you and in addition, you can sell some more rare trophies to me. ...
npc.grizzly_adams.multi_33: Ask me for {special} tasks from time to time.
npc.grizzly_adams.multi_34: You can choose between the {Snapper}, {Hide}, {Deathbine} and the {Bloodtusk}.
npc.grizzly_adams.multi_35: You can choose between the {Snapper}, {Hide}, {Deathbine}, the {Bloodtusk}, {Shardhead}, {Fleshcrawler}, {Ribstride}, {Bloodweb} and {Esmeralda}
npc.grizzly_adams.multi_36: You can choose between the {Snapper}, {Hide}, {Deathbine}, the {Bloodtusk}, {Shardhead}, {Fleshcrawler}, {Ribstride}, {Bloodweb}, {Esmeralda}, ...

npc.grizzly_adams.multi_5: You've three unfinished tasks running old chap. If you want to accept a new one, you have to delete one of your old ones. Do you want to delete a task?

npc.grizzly_adams.start_task_ancient_sca: They can be found in tombs beneath the desert around Ankrahmun. Hunt 250 ancient scarabs of them. Interested?
npc.grizzly_adams.start_task_apes: You'll find the apes deeper in the jungle. Hunt 300 merlkins, kongras or sibangs to complete this task. Alright?
npc.grizzly_adams.start_task_badgers: You'll find them in the surrounding of Svargrond. Hunt 300 badgers and you'll get a reward. Interested?
npc.grizzly_adams.start_task_behemoths: Behemoths must be kept away from the settlements at all costs. You'll find them east of here in the taboo-area or under Cyclopolis in Edron. Go there and hunt a few of them - shall we say... 700? Are you up for that?
npc.grizzly_adams.start_task_bonebeasts: In this task you must defeat 300 bonebeasts. Are you sure that you want to start this task?
npc.grizzly_adams.start_task_brimstone_b: You can find them on the Zaoan landmass. Kill 500 brimstone bugs to complete this task. Are you in?
npc.grizzly_adams.start_task_crocodiles: They are a nuisance! You'll find them here in the jungle near the river. Hunt 300 crocodiles and you'll get a nice reward. Interested?
npc.grizzly_adams.start_task_crystal_spi: In this task you must defeat 300 crystal spiders. Are you sure that you want to start this task?
npc.grizzly_adams.start_task_destroyers: You can find those dark creatures on several places all over Tibia. For this task I want you to kill 650 destroyers. Are you in?
npc.grizzly_adams.start_task_drakens: Go to the Zaoan landmass and reduce their number! Kill 900 drakens, I'll accept: draken abomination, draken elite, draken spellweaver and draken warmaster. Are you in?
npc.grizzly_adams.start_task_gargoyles: They can be found all over Tibia. Hunt 300 gargoyles of them. Interested?
npc.grizzly_adams.start_task_ghastly_dra: Ghastly dragons are devastating creatures which can be found in many dangerous places all over Tibia. Kill 500 of them. Are you in?
npc.grizzly_adams.start_task_giant_spide: Never liked spiders. Simply too many legs. And I always find them in my bath! Those nasty creepy-crawlies are a threat to the hygiene of every living being in Tibia. Hunt 500 of them. Okay?
npc.grizzly_adams.start_task_gnarlhounds: This particular species is found in Zao Steppe. Hunt 300 gnarlhounds of them. Understood?
npc.grizzly_adams.start_task_hellhounds: These harbingers of darkness can be found in many deep dungeons all over Tibia. Kill 250 of them. Are you in?
npc.grizzly_adams.start_task_hellspawns: Recently, I heard of a disturbing development - hellspawns. If they spread to the rest of Tibia... <shudders> My task for you is to contain their numbers. Hunt 600 of them. What do you say?
npc.grizzly_adams.start_task_high_class_: I want you to decrease the number of high class lizards on the Zaoan landmass. Hunt 800 of them. I accept lizard chosens, lizard dragon priests, lizard high guards, lizard legionnaires and lizard zaoguns. Are you interested?
npc.grizzly_adams.start_task_hydras: The hydras are located in the eastern jungle of Tiquanda and there are several mountain caves that are inhabited by them. Your task is to hunt a mere 650 hydras. Are you willing to do that?
npc.grizzly_adams.start_task_ice_golems: The ice golems on the glacier of Hrodmir are becoming a threat to the civilians in Svargrond. Travel to the Ice Islands and hunt 300 ice golems. Do you accept this task?
npc.grizzly_adams.start_task_killer_caim: Killer caiman populations can be found on the landmass of Zao. Hunt down 250 of them for this task. Interested?
npc.grizzly_adams.start_task_lancer_beet: Lancer beetle populations can be found on the landmass of Zao. Hunt down 300 of this crawlers for this task. Alright?
npc.grizzly_adams.start_task_mammoths: This particular species is found in Svargrond. Impressive beasts, but you wouldn't want one in your backyard. Hunt 300 mammoths of them. Alright?
npc.grizzly_adams.start_task_medusae: They live deep in the old ruins of Banuta and they are nasty! I think a mere 500 medusae should do the trick. What do you say?
npc.grizzly_adams.start_task_mutated_bat: Recently, I heard of a disturbing development in Yalahar - a plague of monstrous mutated bats! If they were to spread to the rest of Tibia... <shudders> My task for you is to contain their numbers in Yalahar. Hunt 400 of them. What do you say?
npc.grizzly_adams.start_task_mutated_rat: Recently, I heard of a disturbing development in Yalahar - a plague of monstrous Mutated rats! If they were to spread to the rest of Tibia.. <shudders> My task for you is to contain their numbers in Yalahar. Hunt 400 mutated rats of them. What do you say?
npc.grizzly_adams.start_task_mutated_tig: In this task you must defeat 300 mutated tigers. Are you sure that you want to start this task?
npc.grizzly_adams.start_task_nightmares: Nightmares and nightmare scions can be found all over Tibia. For this task kill 400 of them. Interested?
npc.grizzly_adams.start_task_quara_scout: The {scouts} can be found on Malada, one of the Shattered Isles. Your task is to kill 400 quara scouts. I accept quara constrictor scouts, quara hydromancer scouts, quara mantassin scouts, quara pincher scouts and quara predator scouts, are you in?
npc.grizzly_adams.start_task_sea_serpent: The sea serpent threat increases! Captain Haba knows where to find them. ...
Go to Svargrond and talk to him. 900 sea serpents, including the young ones, should be enough to reduce the threat. Got it?
npc.grizzly_adams.start_task_serpent_spa: Very dangerous, nasty and slimy creatures. They live deep in the old ruins of Banuta. I think a mere 800 serpent spawns should do the trick. What do you say?
npc.grizzly_adams.start_task_stampors: Stampors can be found in a dungeon on the Zaoan landmass. Hunt 600 of them. Are you interested?
npc.grizzly_adams.start_task_stone_golem: They can be found all over Tibia. You'll find them in mountain caves or rocky dungeons. Hunt 200 stone golems of them and come back to me. Understood?
npc.grizzly_adams.start_task_tarantulas: There is a veritable plague of tarantulas living in the caves north of the river to the east. Can you squish 300 tarantulas for the Hunting Elite. What do you say?
npc.grizzly_adams.start_task_terramites: This particular species can be found beneath Zao Steppe. Hunt 300 terramites of them. Understood?

npc.grizzly_adams.start_task_undead_drag: You are a thrill seeker? Undead dragons belong to one of the most powerful races that can be found in Tibia. Kill 400 of them. Are you in?

Well, you might be just the hero they need there. To tell you the truth, some our most reliable ore mines have started to run low. ... \z

npc.halvar.greet_msg_1: Hello competitor! Do you want to {fight} in the arena or shall I explain the {rules} first?
npc.halvar.say_1: So you agree with the {rules} and want to participate in the {challenge}? The {fee} for one try in {{}} is {} gold pieces. Do you really want to participate and pay the {fee}?
npc.halvar.stdmod_1: What do you want to know? Something about the three different {difficulties}, the {general} rules or the {prices}? Maybe you also want to know what happens when you {die}?
npc.halvar.stdmod_10: Basically you pay me a {fee}, and you are sent into an arena with 10 different stages. If you succeed you will be rewarded accordingly.
npc.halvar.stdmod_11: My job is to explain about the rules and to get the fee from the competitors.
npc.halvar.stdmod_12: Well I would rather call it an {Ultimate Challenge} than a mission.
npc.halvar.stdmod_2: There are three difficulties: Greenhorn, Scrapper and Warlord. On each challenge you will be confronted with ten monsters increasing in strength.
npc.halvar.stdmod_3: There are three difficulties: Greenhorn, Scrapper and Warlord. On each challenge you will be confronted with ten monsters increasing in strength.
npc.halvar.stdmod_4: There are three difficulties: Greenhorn, Scrapper and Warlord. On each challenge you will be confronted with ten monsters increasing in strength.
npc.halvar.stdmod_5: That is the easiest way in our arena. The {fee} is 1000 gold. We were setting this up for of our children to challenge some easy monsters and train them for the future.
npc.halvar.stdmod_6: The most common difficulty for us. The {fee} is 5000 gold. So if you are experienced in fighting middle class monsters this is your challenge!
npc.halvar.stdmod_7: Only the strongest among us will take this challenge. The {fee} is 10000 gold. If you pass that I promise you the respect of all citizens here. You will be a hero!
npc.halvar.stdmod_8: The fee is either 1000, 5000 or 10000 gold for one try. Remember that if you {die}, it is YOUR problem and you won't be able to get back to your corpse and your backpack.
npc.halvar.stdmod_9: It would be better not to die! In every pit there is an emergency exit, the portal to the south. If you die in a pit... well... your corpse and backpack are gone, so you enter the arena at your own risk.
npc.hamish.greet_msg_1: Hi there, fellow adventurer. \z What's your need? Say {trade} and we'll soon get you fixed up. Or ask me about {potions}, {wands}, or {runes}.
npc.hamish.say_1: Small and deceptively friendly-looking island. Well, I used to study the plants and herbs here for my potions.
npc.hamish.say_2: Nowadays, I leave that to Oressa, she has a better way with that horrible wildlife here. I prefer to distil potions in the quiet of my lab. If you need some potions, runes or other magic equipment, ask for a trade.
npc.hamish.say_3: Dawnport is not far off from the coast of the Tibian Mainland. Lots of cities, monsters, bandits, brigands, mean folk and people of low understanding with no sense of respect towards alchemical genius. <mutters to himself>
npc.hamish.say_4: Ahem. Once you're level 8, you should be experienced enough to choose your definite vocation and leave Dawnport for Main - and Tibia definitely needs more skilled adventurers to keep those monsters in check which roam our lands!
npc.hamish.say_5: I wish I had thought of changing my name to that of a hero. Would have smoothed my way no end!
npc.hamish.say_6: Anyway, whatever he was before he joined, Tybald now fits the bill of the legendary hero. He even has a crush on lady Oressa. Cute. <chuckles>

npc.henricus.say_1: Do you want to receive the blessing of the inquisition - which means {} blessings - for {} gold?
npc.henricus.say_2: Do you want to buy the special flask of holy water for {} gold?
npc.henricus.stdmod_1: It's a shame that only a few paladins still use their abilities to further the cause of the gods of good. Too many paladins have become selfish and greedy.
npc.henricus.stdmod_10: Drefia used to be a city of sin and heresy, just like Carlin nowadays. One day, the gods decided to destroy this town and to erase all evil there.
npc.henricus.stdmod_11: Darashia is a godless town full of mislead fools. One day, it will surely share the fate of its sister town Drefia.
npc.henricus.stdmod_12: Demons exist in many different shapes and levels of power. In general, they are servants of the dark gods and command great powers of destruction.
npc.henricus.stdmod_13: Carlin is a city of sin and heresy. After the reunion of Carlin with the kingdom, the inquisition will have much work to purify the city and its inhabitants.
npc.henricus.stdmod_14: We can see his evil influence almost everywhere. Keep your eyes open or the dark one will lead you on the wrong way and destroy you.
npc.henricus.stdmod_15: The church of Crunor works closely together with the druid guild. This makes a cooperation sometimes difficult.
npc.henricus.stdmod_16: We owe to the gods of good our creation and continuing existence. If it weren't for them, we would surely fall prey to the minions of the vile and dark gods.
npc.henricus.stdmod_17: The churches of the gods united to fight heresy and dark magic. They are the shield of the true believers, while the inquisition is the sword that fights all enemies of virtuousness.
npc.henricus.stdmod_18: The churches of the gods entrusted me with the enormous and responsible task to lead the inquisition. I leave the field work to inquisitors who I recruit from fitting people that cross my way.
npc.henricus.stdmod_19: Belive on the gods and they will show you the path.
npc.henricus.stdmod_2: Nowadays, most knights seem to have forgotten the noble cause to which all knights were bound in the past. Only a few have remained pious, serve the gods and follow their teachings.
npc.henricus.stdmod_20: By edict of the churches I'm the Lord Inquisitor.
npc.henricus.stdmod_3: Those who wield great power have to resist great temptations. We have the burden to eliminate all those who give in to the temptations.
npc.henricus.stdmod_4: The druids here still follow the old rules. Sadly, the druids of Carlin have left the right path in the last years.
npc.henricus.stdmod_5: The dwarfs are allied with Thais but follow their own obscure religion. Although dwarfs keep mostly to themselves, we have to observe this alliance closely.
npc.henricus.stdmod_6: The dwarfs are allied with Thais but follow their own obscure religion. Although dwarfs keep mostly to themselves, we have to observe this alliance closely.
npc.henricus.stdmod_7: Those elves are hardly any more civilised than orcs. They can become a threat to mankind at any time.
npc.henricus.stdmod_8: Those elves are hardly any more civilised than orcs. They can become a threat to mankind at any time.
npc.henricus.stdmod_9: Venore is somewhat difficult to handle. The merchants have a close eye on our activities in their city and our authority is limited there. However, we will use all of our influence to prevent a second Carlin.
npc.henricus.walkaway_msg_1: This ungraceful haste is most suspicious!
npc.hireling.farewell_msg_1: Farewell, |PLAYERNAME|, I'll be here if you need me again.

npc.hireling.food_29409: Divine! Carrot is a well known nourishment that makes the eyes see even more sharply.
npc.hireling.food_29410: Magnifique! A tiger meat that has been marinated for several hours in magic spices.
npc.hireling.food_29411: Aaah, the beauty of the simple dishes! A delicate salad made of selected ingredients, capable of bring joy to the hearts of bravest warriors and their weapons.
npc.hireling.food_29412: Oh yes, very spicy chilly combined with delicious minced carniphila meat and a side dish of fine salad!
npc.hireling.food_29413: Aaah, the northern cuisine! A catch of fresh salmon right from the coast Svargrond is the base of this extraordinary fish dish.
npc.hireling.food_29414: A traditional and classy meal. A beefy casserole which smells far better than it sounds!
npc.hireling.food_29415: A tasty chunk of juicy beef with an aromatic sauce and parsley potatoes, mmh!
npc.hireling.food_29416: Oooh, well... that one didn't quite turn out as it was supposed to be, I'm sorry.
npc.hireling.goods_no_trader: While I'm not a trader, I still have a collection of {various} items to sell if you like!
npc.hireling.goods_trader: I sell a selection of {various} items, {exercise weapons}, {equipment}, {distance} weapons, {wands} and {rods}, {potions}, {runes}, {supplies}, {tools} and {postal} goods. Just ask!
npc.hireling.greet_bank: Alright! What can I do for you and your bank business, |PLAYERNAME|?
npc.hireling.greet_food: Hmm, yes! A variety of fine food awaits! However, a small expense of 15000 gold is expected to make these delicious masterpieces happen. For 90000 gold I will also serve you a specific dish. Just tell me what it shall be: a {specific} meal or a little {surprise}.
npc.hireling.greet_msg_1: It is good to see you. I'm always at your {service}.
npc.hireling.greet_stash: Of course, here is your stash! Well-maintained and neatly sorted for your convenience!

npc.hireling.say_13: In my youth I dreamt to wield it! Now I wield the broom of... brooming. I guess that's the next best thing!

npc.hireling.say_15: I'll keep an eye open for it when cleaning up the things you brought home!

npc.hireling.say_18: Are you sure you want me to go back to my lamp?
npc.hireling.say_19: Alright then, I will be here.
