npc.klom_stonecutter.multi_1: We need to find a way to drive off the exiles from these caves. Countless makeshift homes are popping up at every corner. Destroy them and get the Lost out of hiding to eliminate them. ...
npc.klom_stonecutter.multi_10: Prepared to get rid of some seriously foul creepers for us?
npc.klom_stonecutter.multi_2: If you can capture a few of them, you'll receive a bonus. Just bring 'em to the border of our outpost and we will take care of the rest. ...
npc.klom_stonecutter.multi_4: We need to find a way to drive off the exiles from these caves. Countless makeshift homes are popping up at every corner. Destroy them and get the Lost out of hiding to eliminate them. ...
npc.klom_stonecutter.multi_5: If you can capture a few of them, you'll receive a bonus. Just bring 'em to the border of our outpost and we will take care of the rest. ...
npc.klom_stonecutter.multi_7: Vermin. Everywhere. We get a lot of strange four-legged crawlers and worms down here lately. It's getting out of hand and... well, I need a real killer for this.
npc.klom_stonecutter.multi_8: Prepared to get rid of some seriously foul creepers for us?
npc.klom_stonecutter.multi_9: Vermin. Everywhere. We get a lot of strange four-legged crawlers and worms down here lately. It's getting out of hand and... well, I need a real killer for this.
npc.klom_stonecutter.say_1: You want to offer {} suspicious device{}. Which leader shall have it, (Gnomus) of the {gnomes}, (Klom Stonecutter) of the {dwarves} or the {scouts} (Lardoc Bashsmite)?
npc.klom_stonecutter.say_10: If you bring me any suspicious devices on creatures you slay down here, I'll make it worth your while by telling the others of your generosity. How many do you want to offer?
npc.klom_stonecutter.say_13: You don't have enough suspicious devices.
npc.klom_stonecutter.say_15: You don't have enough suspicious devices.
npc.klom_stonecutter.say_17: You don't have enough suspicious devices.
npc.klom_stonecutter.say_18: So you want to know what we all think about your deeds? What leader's opinion are you interested in, the {gnomes} (Gnomus), the {dwarves} (Klom Stonecutter) or the {scouts} (Lardoc Bashsmite)?
npc.klom_stonecutter.say_2: The gnomes are still in need of your help, member of Bigfoot's Brigade. Prove your worth by answering their calls! ({}/10)
npc.klom_stonecutter.say_3: The dwarves are still in need of your help, member of Bigfoot's Brigade. Prove your worth by answering their calls! ({}/10)
npc.klom_stonecutter.say_4: The scouts are still in need of your help, member of Bigfoot's Brigade. Prove your worth by answering their calls! ({}/10)
npc.klom_stonecutter.say_5: I don't need your help for now. Come back later.
npc.klom_stonecutter.say_6: Come back when you have finished your job.
npc.klom_stonecutter.say_7: So you did it. Well, that won't be the last of 'em but this sure helps our situation down here. Return to me later if you want to help me again!
npc.klom_stonecutter.say_8: So you did it. And you even made prisoners, the bonus is yours! Well, that won't be the last of 'em but this sure helps our situation down here. Return to me later if you want to help me again!
npc.klom_stonecutter.say_9: Very well, now try to find some of their makeshift homes and tear'em down. There's bound to be some stragglers you can 'persuade' to surrender, eliminate any resistance. Get back here when you're done.
npc.klom_stonecutter.stdmod_1: Well, the biggest problem we need to address are the ever charging {subterraneans} around here. And on top of that, there's the threat of the Lost, who quite made themselves at {home} in these parts.
npc.klom_stonecutter.stdmod_7:
The attacks of the enemy forces are fierce but we hold our ground. ...  \z
	I'd love to face one of their generals in combat but as their masters they cowardly hide far behind enemy lines and I have other duties to fulfil. ...  \z
	I envy you for the chance to thrust into the heart of the enemy, locking weapons with their jaws... or whatever... and see the fear in their eyes when they recognise they were bested.
npc.klom_stonecutter.stdmod_8:
I welcome a fine battle as any dwarf worth his beard should do. As long as it's a battle against something I can hit with my trusty axe. ... \z
	But here the true {enemy} eludes us. We fight wave after wave of their lackeys and if the gnomes are right the true enemy is up to something far more sinister.
npc.klom_stonecutter.stdmod_9:
I have no idea what kind of creeps are behind all this. Even the gnomes don't and they have handled that stuff way more often. ... \z
	But even if we knew nothing more about them, the fact alone that they employ the help of those mockeries of all things dwarfish, marks them as an enemy of the dwarves and it's our obligation to annihilate them.
npc.kroox.greet_msg_1: Welcome to Kroox Quality Armor, |PLAYERNAME|! Wanna take a look, ask me for a trade.
npc.kulag_the_guard.stdmod_1: It's my duty to protect the city.
npc.lailene.greet_msg_1: What do you want in my magical robe store? I doubt I have anything that's of interest to you.
npc.lailene.stdmod_1: ... what?! Uh - no, no. Of course I wouldn't have anything to do with... them.
npc.lardoc_bashsmite.greet_msg_1: Since you are obviously not one of my relatives who pays me a long overdue visit, we should get {work} right away. We'll see if you can prove your {worth} to our alliance.
npc.lardoc_bashsmite.say_1: You want to offer {} suspicious device{}. Which leader shall have it, (Gnomus) of the {gnomes}, (Klom Stonecutter) of the {dwarves} or the {scouts} (Lardoc Bashsmite)?
npc.lardoc_bashsmite.say_2: The gnomes are still in need of your help, member of Bigfoot's Brigade. Prove your worth by answering their calls! ({}/10)
npc.lardoc_bashsmite.say_3: The dwarves are still in need of your help, member of Bigfoot's Brigade. Prove your worth by answering their calls! ({}/10)
npc.lardoc_bashsmite.say_4: The scouts are still in need of your help, member of Bigfoot's Brigade. Prove your worth by answering their calls! ({}/10)
npc.lardoc_bashsmite.stdmod_1: Here's the situation: a tide of hazardous bugs, the gnomes named them {diremaws}, threatens our base. Then there is some kind of {growth} which seems connected to them somehow. We need to get rid of both.
npc.lardoc_bashsmite.stdmod_2: Bashsmite. That's all you need to know.
npc.lardoc_bashsmite.stdmod_3:
You're already known amongst the gnomes, member of the Bigfoot Brigade. I will make sure that the alliance learns of your deeds but you'll still need to help the dwarves and gnomes of this outpost to show your worth. ... \z
	We also found suspicious devices carried by all kinds of creatures down here. Down here, they are of extreme worth to us since they could contain the key to what's happening all around us. ...  \z
	If you can aquire any, return them to me and I make sure to tell the others of your generosity. Return to me afterwards to check on your current {status}.
npc.lardoc_bashsmite.stdmod_4:
Leading the charge! It's a war down here. I maintain the outer defences and supplies which are organised back in Kazordoon and also by the gnomes. ... \z
	I have sealed some of the areas far too dangerous for anyone to enter. If you can prove you're capable, you'll get an oportunity to help destroying the weird machines, pumping lava into the caves leading to the most dangerous enemies. \z
	But even if we knew nothing more about them, the fact alone that they employ the help of those mockeries of all things dwarfish, marks them as an enemy of the dwarves and it's our obligation to annihilate them.
npc.lazaran.greet_msg_1: Me greet. You no enemy of tribe.
npc.lea.stdmod_1: I am the archsorcerer of Carlin. I keep the secrets of our order.
npc.lea.stdmod_3: Sorry, I only sell spells to sorcerers.
npc.lea.stdmod_4: Time is a force we sorcerers will master one day.
npc.lea.stdmod_5: Any sorcerer dedicates his whole life to the study of the arcane arts.
npc.lea.stdmod_6: We sorcerers wield arcane powers beyond comprehension of men.
npc.lea.stdmod_7: We sorcerers wield arcane powers beyond comprehension of men.
npc.lector.sendtrade_msg_1: Of course, take a good look at my meat.
npc.lector.stdmod_1: I can offer you ham or meat. If you'd like to check the quality of my wares, ask me for a {trade}.
npc.lee_delle.greet_msg_1: Nice to see you, |PLAYERNAME|! Ask me for a {trade} if you like to see my exclusive offers.
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_1: Ask me if you need help!
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_10: There are many merchants in this village. Just ask them for a {trade} to see their offers. But I can promise you - my offers are the best around!
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_11: I'm fine. I'm delighted to welcome you as my customer.
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_12: What kind of information do you need? I could tell you about different topics such as {equipment}, {monsters} or {Rookgaard} in general.
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_13: How can I help you? Would you like to {trade} with me? I can also give you general {hints}. Or just ask me anything you'd like to know.
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_14: You should really take some time and travel around the marvellous areas of Tibia. There's everything - ice islands, deserts, jungles and mountains!
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_15: The temple is the place to go when you are very low on {health} or poisoned. Ask {Cipfried} for a heal - he usually notices emergencies by himself.
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_16: Health potions will heal you for about 75 hit points. It can't hurt to carry one with you, just in case.
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_17: Well, very important equipment would be a {backpack}, a {rope}, a {shovel}, a {weapon}, an {armor} and a {shield}. Maybe also a torch if you're heading into a dark {dungeon}.
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_18: I sell fishing rods and worms in case you want to go fishing. Simply ask me for a {trade}.
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_19: You could check out which weapons I offer by asking me for a {trade}. Don't be shy!
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_2: Buy and sell everything you want here!
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_20: Oh, I'm sorry, that's one of the things I don't have for sale. But {Willie} or {Billy} surely have something to eat for you.
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_21: The king supports our little village very much!
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_22: In the academy you can get a lot of information from books. You can also try out a few things by yourself.
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_23: Isn't it lovely here? You'll be surprised once you reach the {mainland} -  so much to explore!
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_24: Well, the mainland also consists of several continents. You can go there once you've reached level 8 and talked to the {oracle}.
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_25: Good monsters to start with are rats. They live in the {sewers} under the village of {Rookgaard}.
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_26: Just ask me for a {trade} to see what I buy from you.
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_27: Be careful down there! Make sure you bought enough {torches} and a {rope} or you might get lost.
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_28: There are many sewer entrances throughout Rookgaard. If you want to know more details about monsters and dungeons, best talk to one of the guards.
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_29: Just ask me for a {trade} to see my offers. Apart from that, I also sell {footballs}.
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_3: No need to run from shop to shop, my place is all that's needed!
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_30: I really love flowers. My favourites are {honey flowers}. Sadly, they are very rare on this isle. If you can find one for me, I'll give you a little reward.
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_31: You could check out which armors or shields I offer by asking me for a {trade}. Don't be shy!
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_32: Yes, I'm selling that. Simply ask me for a {trade} to view all my offers.
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_33: Well, no gold, no deal. Earn gold by fighting {monsters} and picking up the things they carry. Sell it to {merchants} to make profit!
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_34: He sells {weapons}. However, I can offer you better deals than him!
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_35: I'm glad she stopped selling stuff. There was too much of a competition going on!
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_36: Sometimes, I see him walking outside the village near some hole.
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_37: He dedicated his life to welcome newcomers to this island.
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_38: Poor old woman, her son {Tom} never visits her.
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_39: Al Dee has a general {equipment} store in the north-western part of the village.
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_40: She lives under the {academy}. Always nice to chat with her!
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_41: He's a local farmer. If you need fresh {food} to regain health, it's a good place to go. He's only trading with premium adventurers, though.
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_42: He's a local farmer. If you need fresh {food} to regain your health, it's a good place to go. However, many monsters carry also food such as meat. Or you could simply pick {blueberries}.
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_43: Visiting Cipfried in the {temple} is a good idea if you are injured or poisoned. He can heal you.
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_44: She's {Obi's} granddaughter and deals with {armors} and {shields}, just as I do.
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_45: He mostly stays by himself. He's a hermit outside of town - good luck finding him.
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_46: She buys all {blueberries} and {cookies} you can find.
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_47: You can find the oracle on the top floor of the {academy}, just above {Seymour}. Go there when you are level 8 to reach more areas of {Tibia}.
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_48: He is the {bank} clerk, just below the academy.
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_49: Seymour is a teacher running the {academy}. He has a lot of important {information} about Tibia.
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_50: He's the local tanner. You could try selling fresh corpses or leather to him.
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_51: He is a great warrior and our protector.
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_52: Do you want to buy a football for 111 gold?
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_6: I'm a merchant. If you like to see my offers, just ask me for a {trade}.
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_8: Well, it's a good idea to leave most of your money in the bank and only take what you need. That way your gold is safe.
npc.lee_delle.stdmod_9: Oh no! I've got to watch what I eat. {Lily} loves cookies, though.
npc.lee_delle.voice_1: Ask me if you need help!
npc.lee_delle.voice_2: Buy and sell everything you want here!
npc.lee_delle.voice_3: No need to run from shop to shop, my place is all that's needed!
npc.legola.stdmod_1: Teaching paladin spells! Just come to me!
npc.legola.voice_1: Teaching paladin spells! Just come to me!
npc.liane.farewell_msg_1: It was a pleasure to help you, |PLAYERNAME|.
npc.liane.greet_msg_1: Hello. How may I help you |PLAYERNAME|? Ask me for a trade if you want to buy something. I can also explain the {mail} system.
npc.liane.sendtrade_msg_1: Here. Don't forget that you need to buy a label too if you want to send a parcel. Always write the name of the {receiver} in the first line.
npc.liane.voice_2: Hey, send a letter to your friend now and then. Keep in touch, you know.
npc.liane.voice_3: If you need help with letters or parcels, just ask me. I can explain everything.
npc.liane.voice_4: No, no, no, there IS no parcel bug, I'm telling you!
npc.liane.walkaway_msg_1: It was a pleasure to help you, |PLAYERNAME|.
npc.lily.greet_msg_1: Oh hey, |PLAYERNAME|! Vascalir must have sent you to help me with a little {mission}, right?
npc.lily.greet_msg_2: Hello, |PLAYERNAME|! Back so soon? Have you delivered the herbs to Hyacinth?
npc.lily.greet_msg_3: Welcome, |PLAYERNAME|! You look a little stressed today. If you like to view my offers of potions, just ask me for a {trade}. In case you're looking for the marketplace and dungeons, just follow the path to the east!
npc.lily.kw_premium_1: If you purchase premium time for your account, this opens up a lot of possibilities. ...
npc.lily.kw_premium_2: For example, you will be able to travel off the mainland, ride a mount and benefit from offline training as well as having more outfits and magic spells to choose from.
npc.lily.sendtrade_msg_1: Of course, just browse through my offers. If you buy a potion, don't forget that there's a {deposit} of 5 gold on the empty flask.
npc.lily.stdmod_1: Are you injured or poisoned? Get your potions here! All natural, no artificial ingredients!
npc.lily.stdmod_10: Is something... wrong? You didn't lose the herbs, did you?
npc.lily.stdmod_11: Well, at least you're honest. I can give you another sack, but only if you promise not to lose them this time. Okay?
npc.lily.stdmod_12: Phew. That's a relief. Well, don't forget to deliver them to Hyacinth! They have to be fresh to create potions.
npc.lily.stdmod_13: Oh. Well, if you change your mind, let me know.
npc.lily.stdmod_14: Just ask me for a {trade} to see what I buy from you. If you want to sell {blueberries}, ask me about them separately.
npc.lily.stdmod_15: Just ask me for a {trade} to see my offers. If you want to sell {blueberries}, ask me about them separately.
npc.lily.stdmod_16: How can I help you? If you like to buy something, just ask me for a {trade}. We can also chat about {Tibia}. Or, I could give you general {hints} about the game.
npc.lily.stdmod_17: You definitely need a good {weapon}, an {armor} and a {shield}. Also, you should never leave for a {dungeon} without {rope}, {shovel} and {torch}.
npc.lily.stdmod_18: I'm in tune with myself and with nature. Thank you.
npc.lily.stdmod_19: I'm a {druid}, bound to the spirit of nature. My {potions} will help you if you feel bad. I also buy {blueberries} and {cookies}. Just ask me for a {trade}.
npc.lily.stdmod_2: Hey you, over there! Let's have a little chat, shall we?
npc.lily.stdmod_20: My name is Lily, like the flower. It also stands for purity, just like my {potions} are!
npc.lily.stdmod_21: It's about |TIME|. But does it really matter? Don't rush yourself and enjoy all these little moments.
npc.lily.stdmod_22: It's wise to store most of your gold at the bank below the academy. It's safer that way.
npc.lily.stdmod_23: If you tell me the name of a citizen, I'll tell you what I know about him or her.
npc.lily.stdmod_24: Antidote potions will cure {poisoning}. They also have a lovely {blueberry} taste. You only need them when you get poisoned deep down in a dungeon, else just go to the {temple} for a free heal!
npc.lily.stdmod_25: Some creatures like snakes or poison spiders can poison you. That will diminish your health over a certain amount of time, so be careful when dealing with those creatures!
npc.lily.stdmod_26: Being a druid is a wonderful profession. You control the forces of nature and can heal others.
npc.lily.stdmod_27: There are many shops around here which are owned by local {citizens}.
npc.lily.stdmod_28: The temple is just to the right. You can get a healing for free there if you are badly injured or poisoned.
npc.lily.stdmod_29: Tibia is our beautiful world, created by the gods. Being a {druid}, I'm a worshipper of {Crunor}.
npc.lily.stdmod_3: Oh, just in case you are looking for the marketplace and dungeons, just follow the path to the east.
npc.lily.stdmod_30: Crunor is the great lord of trees and the creator of all plants. Despite what some people believe, he didn't create the {monsters}, though.
npc.lily.stdmod_31: Oh, I'm sorry honey, I don't sell food. If you are hungry, visit one of the farmers {Billy} and {Willie}. I buy {blueberries} and {cookies}, though.
npc.lily.stdmod_32: I can offer you homemade {antidote} potions and small {health} potions. Ask me for a {trade} if you like to see them.
npc.lily.stdmod_33: Health potions will heal you for about 75 hit points. It can't hurt to carry one with you, just in case.
npc.lily.stdmod_34: I think Tibia would be a better place without authorities who lead others to war. Can't we just all live in peace?
npc.lily.stdmod_35: The academy is the big stone building in the town centre. If you're ready to leave Rookgaard, go there to see the {oracle}.
npc.lily.stdmod_36: Well, in this village and its surroundings you can {train} your skills until you are level 8. Then you should see the {oracle} and head to the {main} continent.
npc.lily.stdmod_37: To train your skills, simply help us {fighting} monsters.
npc.lily.stdmod_38: If you want to fight monsters, you should get better {equipment} from the {merchants}. You should also talk to one of the bridge {guards} to find suitable monsters for you.
npc.lily.stdmod_39: To view the offers of a merchant, simply talk to him or her and ask for a {trade}. They will gladly show you their offers and also the things they buy from you.
npc.lily.stdmod_4: Anyone got some cookies for me?
npc.lily.stdmod_40: The main continent is huge! The gods of Tibia created everything from great seas, deep jungles and large deserts.
npc.lily.stdmod_41: Sadly, our little village of {Rookgaard} is invaded by monsters. From the {dungeons} they creep to the surface and attack the city. We always need adventurers helping us to {fight} them.
npc.lily.stdmod_42: If you are looking for weapons, you should visit {Obi}'s shop east of here. Or, if you have a {premium} account, go to {Lee'Delle} for better offers.
npc.lily.stdmod_43: Armors? Best buy them at {Dixi}'s little counter, just upstairs from {Obi}'s shop. Or, if you have a {premium} account, go to {Lee'Delle} for better offers.
npc.lily.stdmod_44: Shields? Best buy them at {Dixi}'s little counter, just upstairs from {Obi}'s shop. Or, if you have a {premium} account, go to {Lee'Delle} for better offers.
npc.lily.stdmod_45: If you need information about the dungeons here, you should talk to one of the bridge {guards}. They will show you where to go.
npc.lily.stdmod_46: Our bridge guards are {Dallheim} and {Zerbrus}. You can find Dallheim if you follow the path to the right, then turn north at the {temple}.
npc.lily.stdmod_47: Yum, cookies! If you have some for me, just ask me for a trade.
npc.lily.stdmod_48: Earn gold by fighting {monsters} and picking up what they carry. Sell it to {merchants} to make profit!
npc.lily.stdmod_49: I will pay you 5 gold for every empty vial and potion flask. Just ask me for a {trade}.
npc.lily.stdmod_5: Do you need help? Just ask me about anything you'd like to know!
npc.lily.stdmod_50: You best buy such equipment at {Al Dee}'s store in the North of the village. Or, if you have a {premium} account, go to {Lee'Delle} for better offers.
npc.lily.stdmod_51: Oh yes, I love cookies! Will you accept 1 gold for it?
npc.lily.stdmod_53: Sorry, you do not have one.
npc.lily.stdmod_55: Oh, do you have blueberries for sale? I need them for my {antidote potion}. I give you 1 gold for 5 of them, yes?
npc.lily.stdmod_57: Oh, I'm sorry. I'm not buying less than 5 blueberries.
npc.lily.stdmod_59: He sells {weapons}. His shop is east of here.
npc.lily.stdmod_6: I'm buying all of your blueberries for my famous blueberry juice!
npc.lily.stdmod_60: I don't know what to think about all this new bar. {Rookgaard} needs a little peace!
npc.lily.stdmod_61: He used to help me gather blueberries. Then, one day, he suddenly stopped comming here. They say he went a little out of his mind.
npc.lily.stdmod_62: We tried everything to fight that cockroach plague in his cellar, but natural anti-bug potions simply won't help. I guess those roaches need to be fought with stronger weapons.
npc.lily.stdmod_7: Oh. In that case, maybe you're interested in a {trade} - I sell potions and buy a few other things.
npc.lily.stdmod_77:
That's great to hear! You see, I'm not the only potion brewer on Rookgaard. The hermit Hyacinth has his little alchemy lab outside the village. ... \z
	He's old and can't make his way into the village anymore, but needs some of the herbs that grow only around here. Could you please deliver a bag of herbs to Hyacinth?
npc.lily.stdmod_78:
Here you go, honey. I really appreciate your help. To find Hyacinth, leave the village to the north and go pretty much straight to the east. ... \z
	His little alchemy lab is on top of a mountain. I'll mark the ramp leading up on your map, here. Don't stray from the path! There are dangerous monsters roaming the island.
npc.lily.stdmod_79:
Here you go, honey. I really appreciate your help. To find Hyacinth, leave the village to the north and go pretty much straight to the east. ... \z
	His little alchemy lab is on top of a mountain. I'll mark the ramp leading up on your map, here. Don't stray from the path! There are dangerous monsters roaming the island.
npc.lily.stdmod_8: Oh. Well, if you change your mind, let me know.
npc.lily.stdmod_9: No, you haven't. If you're looking for the way to Hyacinth, just leave the village to the north and then go east. I've marked it on your map!
npc.lily.voice_1: Are you injured or poisoned? Get your potions here! All natural, no artificial ingredients!
npc.lily.voice_2: Hey you, over there! Let's have a little chat, shall we?
npc.lily.voice_3: Oh, just in case you are looking for the marketplace and dungeons, just follow the path to the east.
npc.lily.voice_4: Anyone got some cookies for me?
npc.lily.voice_5: Do you need help? Just ask me about anything you'd like to know!
npc.lily.voice_6: I'm buying all of your blueberries for my famous blueberry juice!
npc.lisander.greet_msg_1: I'd rather be left in {peace}. Keep it short.
npc.lizard_tunnel_guard.spotted: The guards have spotted you. You were forcibly dragged into a small cell. It looks like you need to build another disguise.
npc.lokur.greet_msg_1: Yes? What may I do for you, |PLAYERNAME|? Bank business, perhaps?
npc.lokur.voice_1: Don't forget to deposit your money here in the Tibian Bank before you head out for adventure.
npc.lorek.stdmod_1: Do you seek a passage to {0} for {1}?
npc.lorek.stdmod_3: I heard he is some scary magician or so.

npc.lorietta.greet_msg_1: Welcome, young |PLAYERNAME|! If you are heavily wounded or poisoned, I can {heal} you for free.
npc.lorietta.keyword_1: So receive the protection of the twist of fate, pilgrim.
npc.lorietta.stdmod_1: So receive the protection of the twist of fate, pilgrim.
npc.lorietta.stdmod_11: You are hurt, my child. I will heal your wounds.
npc.lorietta.stdmod_12: You aren't looking that bad. Sorry, I can't help you. But if you are looking for additional protection you should go on the {pilgrimage} of ashes or get the protection of the {twist of fate} here.
npc.lorietta.stdmod_13: Whenever you receive a lethal wound, your vital force is damaged and there is a chance that you lose some of your equipment. With every single of the five {blessings} you have, this damage and chance of loss will be reduced.
npc.lorietta.stdmod_14: There are five blessings available in five sacred places: the {spiritual} shielding, the spark of the {phoenix}, the {embrace} of Tibia, the fire of the {suns} and the wisdom of {solitude}. Additionally, you can receive the {twist of fate} here.
npc.lorietta.stdmod_15: I see you received the spiritual shielding in the whiteflower temple south of Thais.
npc.lorietta.stdmod_16: I can sense that the druids north of Carlin have provided you with the Embrace of Tibia.
npc.lorietta.stdmod_17: I can see you received the blessing of the two suns in the suntower near Ab'Dendriel.
npc.lorietta.stdmod_18: I can sense that the spark of the phoenix already was given to you by the dwarven priests of earth and fire in Kazordoon.
npc.lorietta.stdmod_19: I can sense you already talked to the hermit Eremo on the isle of Cormaya and received this blessing.
npc.lorietta.stdmod_2: Fine. You are free to decline my offer.
npc.lorietta.stdmod_20: You can ask for the blessing of spiritual shielding in the whiteflower temple south of Thais.
npc.lorietta.stdmod_21: The druids north of Carlin will provide you with the embrace of Tibia.
npc.lorietta.stdmod_22: You can ask for the blessing of the two suns in the suntower near Ab'Dendriel.
npc.lorietta.stdmod_23: The spark of the phoenix is given by the dwarven priests of earth and fire in Kazordoon.
npc.lorietta.stdmod_25:
This is a special blessing I can bestow upon you once you have obtained at least one of the other blessings and which functions a bit differently. ... \z
	It only works when you're killed by other adventurers, which means that at least half of the damage leading to your death was caused by others, not by monsters or the environment. ... \z
	The {twist of fate} will not reduce the death penalty like the other blessings, but instead prevent you from losing your other blessings as well as the amulet of loss, should you wear one. It costs the same as the other blessings. ... \z
	Would you like to receive that protection for a sacrifice of |PVPBLESSCOST| gold, child?
npc.lorietta.stdmod_4: Ah, you want to replace your adventurer's stone for free?
npc.lorietta.stdmod_7: Ah, you want to replace your adventurer's stone for 30 gold?
npc.lorietta.stdmod_9: Sorry, you don't have enough money.
npc.lorietta.walkaway_msg_1: Remember: If you are heavily wounded or poisoned, I can heal you for free.
npc.lothar.greet_msg_1: Welcome to my humble hut, |PLAYERNAME|. What brings you {here}?
npc.lothar.stdmod_1: I enjoy the peace and solitude out here. You're welcome to be my guest as long as you behave in a quiet and tolerable manner.
npc.lothar.stdmod_10: I heard that terror birds really love carrots. I'd try waving it in front of one of those.
npc.lothar.stdmod_11: Ah, what a pretty ribbon. Reminds me of the elusive dragonlings - they're quite elegant and vain. They would probably welcome a decorative element. They're sometimes spotted during volcano eruptions.
npc.lothar.stdmod_12: What a neat little elvish gadget. Did you know a diapason works with vibrations to create sound? I actually think this could work on a creature made of crystals.
npc.lothar.stdmod_13: I'm against violence towards any creature. I've heard those barbarians in the desert use it for disobedient dromedaries.
npc.lothar.stdmod_14: Oh, what a nice little plant! Did you know it's supposed to bring luck? So is the lady bug. Both of them might actually go well together.
npc.lothar.stdmod_15: I've heard that there once was a gang of manta ray riders who liked to adorn their mantas with a foxtail. Don't ask me why, maybe they like how it floats in the wind when running really fast?
npc.lothar.stdmod_16: What a strange device! This looks like a tool for someone who creates golems and modifies living creatures. You could probably tame a modded creature with it, but I doubt they live in the wild.
npc.lothar.stdmod_17: Oh, that's one of the favourite foods of a crustacea gigantica. I think you can just distract it with the food and quickly jump on its back.
npc.lothar.stdmod_18: Have you ever encountered a magma crawler? They only eat and drink really hot things. You could probably try and make one drink some glow wine - and quickly mount it as long as it's drunk.
npc.lothar.stdmod_19: Hm. What an interesting find. This is definitely not used for any sort of animal. Maybe a vehicle? I can imagine it could be used for a bike of some sorts.
npc.lothar.stdmod_2: Some call me {animal} whisperer. Others say I'm just crazy. I refer to myself as a simple {stable} keeper.
npc.lothar.stdmod_20: That looks like it might fit a draptor. If you can ever get close enough to one to catch it, I'd simply try putting it on while whispering calming words.
npc.lothar.stdmod_21: The sound of a hunting horn is often intimidating to forest creatures, but I heard that wild boars actually like it.
npc.lothar.stdmod_22: Ironblights consist mainly of stone and iron. With a strong magnet like that you can basically force it to walk in the direction you're wanting it to.
npc.lothar.stdmod_23: Try catching a midnight panther using that one. Don't hit the panther, mind you. Just let the whip crack in the air - I think that will work.
npc.lothar.stdmod_24: As far as I know, leeches can be found in terrestrial, swampy areas. Leeches often help large animals such as water buffaloes to get rid of parasites.
npc.lothar.stdmod_25: You should show that giant jaw to a creature looking like the one you got it from. It will respect you when it sees those scary teeth.
npc.lothar.stdmod_26: Where did you get that? What a rare treat. This must have been crafted by someone who truly loves both music and animals. I can't tell you anything else about it.
npc.lothar.stdmod_27: Oh, a nail case..., I hate paring nails. But I heard gravediggers become trusting when they get the right treatment.
npc.lothar.stdmod_28: How impressive, a nightmare horn. Have you ever encountered a shock head? Try hypnotizing them with your horn.
npc.lothar.stdmod_29: You could probably ride a black sheep with these. Talk to it gently and carefully put on the reins.
npc.lothar.stdmod_3: Some call me {animal} whisperer. Others say I'm just crazy. I refer to myself as a simple {stable} keeper.
npc.lothar.stdmod_30: Wow, that's a rarity. Have you ever met one of those large sandstone scorpions? They're quite impressive. You need such a sceptre to show to one that you're its new master.
npc.lothar.stdmod_31: That might be the only way to tame a bear. It has a sensitive spot right between the ears which will calm it down, but you're not strong enough for simple acupressure. Using the slingshot is likely to help you with that.
npc.lothar.stdmod_32: As the name indicates - this can be used to make a slug much faster than it normally is! Once you've tamed it, it will race you wherever you want to go.
npc.lothar.stdmod_33: Create sugar oat by just mixing a bunch of sugar cane with a bunch of wheat. All horses love sugar oat! Sometimes when the horses from the horse station in Thais are on the loose, wild horses mix with the herd. Maybe they can be tamed?
npc.lothar.stdmod_34: The interesting part about that bait isn't the sweet stuff - it's the flies attracted to the sweet smell. Spiders love to eat flies, especially the Zaoan ones.
npc.lothar.stdmod_35: Hm! Now that's an interesting one. Where did you get that from? I could imagine it winds something up in a factory, but it's definitely not a normal animal.
npc.lothar.stdmod_4: I love all animals, whether small or big. I also believe each one, even the wildest and most ferocious being, can be talked to, understood and {tamed}.
npc.lothar.stdmod_5: It's my dream to shelter many different tamed animals. Maybe one day that dream will come true.
npc.lothar.stdmod_6: Well, usually you can tame animals with the help of a few simple items. If you've found such an {item}, show it to me and I might be able to help you with instructions on the taming process.
npc.lothar.stdmod_7: Well? Which item have you found and require advice for?
npc.lothar.stdmod_8: That's among the favourite foods of donkeys, as far as I know. It's a shame I haven't really seen any donkey around. It could require a magic trick to actually get to meet one.
npc.lothar.stdmod_9: Pandas love to eat bamboo leaves, but the Tiquandan pandas are actually not that skilled at climbing, so they have a hard time getting some for themselves. You might be able to tame one with them.
npc.lothar.voice_1: I enjoy the peace and solitude out here. You're welcome to be my guest as long as you behave in a quiet and tolerable manner.
npc.loui.stdmod_10: They were so many, EVERYWHERE! I could barely escape alive. I have no clue what THEY were but one more second down there and I'd have been dead!
npc.loui.stdmod_11: Sorry, I'm out of mana and ingredients, please visit Cipfried in town.
npc.loui.stdmod_12: The good thing is that those horrible rats stay mostly in town. The bad thing is that they do so because of bigger {monsters} that would devour them outside.
npc.loui.stdmod_13: Everything around us, that is Tibia.
npc.loui.stdmod_14: Most adventurers take their first steps there.
npc.loui.stdmod_15: Pah, king! He should do something about this {hole}!
npc.loui.stdmod_16: This is the place where everything starts.
npc.loui.stdmod_17: Was it...? Yes, I might have looked for blueberries as I foolishly entered this unholy {hole}.
npc.loui.stdmod_18: There must be an army of them, just down this {hole}.
npc.loui.stdmod_19: Then, they must be magic wielding beasts using creature illusion! Good thing you escaped.
npc.loui.stdmod_20: The gods blessed Tibia with abundant forms of life.
npc.loui.stdmod_21: The good thing is that those horrible rats stay mostly in town. The bad thing is that they do so because of bigger {monsters} that would devour them outside.
npc.loui.stdmod_22: I have no quests but to stay away from that {hole} and I recommend you to do the same.
npc.loui.stdmod_23: I'm penniless and poor as becomes a humble monk like me.
npc.loui.stdmod_24: She owns a shop in town.
npc.loui.stdmod_25: She owns a bar in town.
npc.loui.stdmod_26: Waaaah! Don't shock me like that!
npc.loui.stdmod_27: He has his own monsters, I believe.
npc.loui.stdmod_29: He owns a shop in town.
npc.loui.stdmod_3: What are you doing here?? Get away from that hole!
npc.loui.stdmod_30: Who's that? Never heard about her.
npc.loui.stdmod_31: He owns a shop in town.
npc.loui.stdmod_33: The gods may protect me from his rudeness.
npc.loui.stdmod_34: A hermit on the other side of town.
npc.loui.stdmod_35: The oracle! Yes! You should get off this island as fast as you can!
npc.loui.stdmod_5: I'm a {monk}. I wanted to do something here, but I forgot what it was when I fell in that {hole}.
npc.loui.stdmod_6: I'm a humble servant of the {gods}.
npc.loui.stdmod_7: They created Tibia and all lifeforms.
npc.loui.stdmod_8: I have no idea how long I've been in this {hole}. It seemed like an eternity!
npc.loui.stdmod_9: While looking for something - which I forgot - I found that {hole}. I went down, even though I had no torch. And then I heard {THEM}! There must be dozens!
npc.loui.voice_3: What are you doing here?? Get away from that hole!
npc.lubo.greet_msg_1: Welcome to my adventurer shop, |PLAYERNAME|! What do you need? Ask me for a {trade} to look at my wares.
npc.lubo.stdmod_1: Stop by and rest a while, tired adventurer! Have a look at my wares!
npc.lubo.stdmod_2: I am selling equipment for adventurers. If you need anything, let me know.

npc.lubo.stdmod_5: I am Lubo, the owner of this shop.
npc.lubo.stdmod_6: Oh! I'm sorry, I sold the last one just five minutes ago.
npc.lubo.stdmod_7: My hat? Hanna made this one for me.
npc.lubo.stdmod_8: Oh, you sure mean this old story about the mage Dago, who lost two fingers when he conjured a dragon.
npc.lubo.voice_1: Stop by and rest a while, tired adventurer! Have a look at my wares!

npc.luna.sendtrade_msg_1: Of course, just browse through my wares.
npc.luna.stdmod_1: Selling herbs, mushrooms and flowers, all picked under the light of the full moon!
npc.luna.voice_1: Selling herbs, mushrooms and flowers, all picked under the light of the full moon!

npc.lynda.say_10: *After a whispered blessing opens an hand towards {}* Take these two engraved wedding rings and give one of them to your spouse.
npc.lynda.say_11: You may now kiss your bride.
npc.lynda.say_12: Are you sure you want to remove your wedding proposal with {{}}?
npc.lynda.say_13: Are you sure you want to divorce of {{}}?
npc.lynda.say_2: You already made a wedding proposal to {{}}. You can always remove the proposal by saying {remove} proposal.
npc.lynda.say_4: {{}} is already engaged to {{}} and they will going to marry soon.
npc.lynda.say_5: {{}} already made a wedding proposal to {{}}.
npc.lynda.say_6: Ok, now let's wait and see if {{}} accepts your proposal. I'll give you back your wedding ring as soon as {{}} accepts your proposal or you {remove} it.
npc.lynda.say_7: Dear friends and family, we are gathered here today to witness and celebrate the union of {} and {} in marriage.
npc.lynda.say_8: Through their time together, they have come to realize that their personal dreams, hopes, and goals are more attainable and more meaningful through the combined effort and mutual support provided in love, commitment, and family;
npc.lynda.say_9: and so they have decided to live together as husband and wife. And now, by the power vested in me by the Gods of Tibia, I hereby pronounce you husband and wife.
npc.lynda.say_divorce: Ok, you are now divorced of {0}. Think better next time after marrying someone.
npc.lynda.say_remove_engage: Ok, your marriage proposal to {0} has been removed. Take your wedding ring back.
npc.lynda.stdmod_3: Great! Marriages should be an eternal commitment.
npc.lynda.stdmod_4: Ok, you are now divorced of {
npc.lynda.stdmod_5: Would you like to get married? Make sure you have a wedding ring and the wedding outfit box with you.
npc.lynda.stdmod_7: And who would you like to marry?
npc.lynda.stdmod_8: Is your soulmate and friends here with you for the celebration?

npc.maeryn.voice_1: Not enough purple nightshade ... not enough liquid silver. *sigh*
npc.maeryn.voice_2: You think the full moon is a romantic affair? Think again!
npc.maeryn.voice_3: This place isn't safe. You should leave this island.
npc.malor.farewell_msg_1: Farewell, human. When I have taken my rightful place I shall remember those who served me well. Even if they are only humans.
npc.malunga.greet_msg_1: Greetings. I have only little time to {spare}, so the conversation will be short. I teach sorcerer {spells} and buy a few magical {ingredients}.
npc.marina.greet_msg_1: Oh, hello |PLAYERNAME|. A visitor, how nice!
npc.marina.stdmod_1: Sorry, I don't have a spare comb. I lost my favourite one when diving around in Calassa.

Do you smell this? It's the smell of fire... the fire of a forge. Many people searched this rock here for a hidden path, but they haven't found anything. ... \z
	I'd search on Fenrock if I were you. Even though there's snow on the surface, it's still warm underground. There are often caves under fresh lava streams.
npc.markwin.greet_msg_2: Well ... you defeated my guards! Now everything is over! I guess I will have to answer your questions now.
npc.marlene.farewell_msg_1: Good bye and come again for another small talk! *waves*
npc.marlene.greet_msg_1: Ahhh, welcome |PLAYERNAME|! Say, have you already heard the latest news about the {seamonster}, {Aneus}, or the {rumours} in this area?
npc.marlene.stdmod_2: I'm Bruno's wife. Besides: Have you already heard the latest news about the seamonster, Aneus, or the rumours in this area?
npc.marlene.stdmod_3: Bruno is a wonderful husband. But he is seldom at home. *looks a little bit sad*
npc.marlene.stdmod_4: Ah, old Graubart. A very nice person. But he is strange. He always is busy when I want to talk to him. *lost in thoughts*
npc.marlene.stdmod_5: My pleasure, I always enjoy sharing interesting stories.
npc.marvin.greet_msg_1: Ah, you come just in time for the special voting about the most recent {funding} project. I guess you want to participate in it.
npc.mazarius.greet_msg_1: Greetings, dear visitor. Please tell me what {brings} you here, to my humble adobe.
npc.mehkesh.greet_msg_1: Be mourned, |PLAYERNAME|, pilgrim in flesh. If you are looking for potions, seek no further.
npc.mehkesh.voice_1: Potions brewed by the leading alchemists of the land!
npc.melchior.farewell_msg_1: Farewell, stranger. May Uman the Wise guide your steps in this treacherous land.

npc.melian.stdmod_20: The only humans I've seen on this continent are those that come up to my carpet.
npc.melian.stdmod_21: What a strange and bizarre continent. I'm glad my landing place is far away from all the mess I've seen from above.
npc.melian.stdmod_22: You are probably talking about the {FEMOR hills}.
npc.melian.stdmod_23: It's 2:55 pm right now. I think I'm five minutes late in my schedule.
npc.melian.stdmod_3: There are many of them to the north and south of this continent. I had thought they only existed on Tiquanda, but I was mistaken.
npc.melian.stdmod_4: What a strange and bizarre continent. I'm glad my landing place is far away from all the mess I've seen from above.

npc.melian.stdmod_6: I'm a carpet pilot. I can fly you to the {Femor Hills}, to {Kazordoon}, {Svargrond}, {Edron}, {Darashia}, {Issavi} or {Marapur}.
npc.melian.stdmod_7: I'm a carpet pilot. I can fly you to the {Femor Hills}, to {Kazordoon}, {Svargrond}, {Edron}, {Darashia}, {Issavi} or {Marapur}.
npc.melian.stdmod_9: These mountains don't look friendly. I prefer not staying long inbetween my carpet trips.
npc.memech.greet_msg_1: Be mourned, |PLAYERNAME|, pilgrim in flesh. Have a look at my fine {weapons} and {armors}.
npc.memech.voice_1: Selling weapons and armors to protect mortal souls.
npc.menesto.say_1: Finally, reinforcements - oh but no, you came through the crystal portal, like the others! I am ser Menesto, I guard the portal. That beast caught me by surprise, I lost my dagger and had to retreat. ...
npc.menesto.say_4: You look hungry, you should eat regularly to reagain your strength! See what you can find while hunting. Or buy food in a city shop. Here, have some of my rations, I'll take my dagger. Tell me when you're {ready}.
npc.menesto.say_5: I'll stay here till reinforcements come. Go up the ladder to reach the surface. You'll need a rope for the ropestot that comes after the ladder - here, take my spare equipment. ...
npc.menesto.say_6: And remember: Tibia is a world with many dangers and mysteries, so be careful! Farewell, friend.
npc.miles_the_guard.stdmod_1: It's my duty to protect the city.
npc.mirabell.greet_msg_1: Welcome to the Horn of Plenty, |PLAYERNAME|. Sit down, have a {drink} or some {food}!
npc.mirabell.sendtrade_msg_1: Of course, take a look at my tasty offers.
npc.mirabell.stdmod_1: The Horn of Plenty is always open for tired adventurers.
npc.mirabell.stdmod_2: I can offer you beer, wine, lemonade and water. If you'd like to see my offers, ask me for a {trade}.
npc.mirabell.voice_1: The Horn of Plenty is always open for tired adventurers.
npc.miraia.ape_fur_ask: Have you really managed to fulfil the task and brought me 100 pieces of ape fur?
npc.miraia.ape_fur_done: Ahhh, this softness! I'm impressed, |PLAYERNAME|. You're on the best way to earn that turban. Now, please retrieve 100 fish fins.
npc.miraia.ape_fur_info: Only ape fur is good enough to touch the feet of our Caliph.
npc.miraia.blue_cloth_ask: Ah, have you brought the 100 pieces of blue cloth?
npc.miraia.blue_cloth_done: Ah! Congratulations - I hope this veil will turn out as beautiful as you are. Here, I'll do it for you.
npc.miraia.blue_cloth_info: It's a great material for turbans.
npc.miraia.chicken_wings_ask: Were you able to get hold of two enchanted chicken wings?
npc.miraia.chicken_wings_done: Great, thank you very much. Just bring me 100 pieces of blue cloth now and I will happily show you how to make a turban.
npc.miraia.chicken_wings_info: Enchanted chicken wings are actually used to make boots of haste, so they could be magically extracted again. Djinns are said to be good at that.
npc.miraia.fish_fins_ask: Were you able to discover the undersea race and retrieved 100 fish fins?
npc.miraia.fish_fins_done: I never thought you'd make it, |PLAYERNAME|. Now we only need two enchanted chicken wings to start our waterwalking test!
npc.miraia.fish_fins_info: I really wonder what the explorer society is up to. Actually I have no idea how they managed to dive unterwater.
npc.miraia.greet_msg_1: Daraman's blessings, |PLAYERNAME|. Welcome to the Enlightened Oasis. Sit down, have a {drink} or some {food}!
npc.miraia.say_1: Hehe, would you like to wear a pretty veil like I do? Well... I could help you, but you would have to complete a task first.
npc.miraia.stdmod_1: I can offer you lemonade, camel milk, and water. If you'd like to see my offers, ask me for a {trade}.
npc.miraia.stdmod_2: Are you looking for food? I have bread, cheese, ham, and meat. If you'd like to see my offers, ask me for a {trade}.
npc.moe.greet_msg_1: Greetings, traveller. It seems, you're a {guest} here, just like me.
npc.moe.voice_1: The menu of the day sounds delicious!
npc.moe.voice_2: The last visit to the theatre was quite rewarding.
npc.moe.voice_3: Such a beautiful and wealthy city - with so many opportunities ...
npc.mordecai.greet_msg_1: Welcome to the magic emporium, child. Ask me for a trade if you need {runes}, {wands}, or spellbooks.
npc.mordecai.say_1: Of course, just browse through my wares. You can also look at {}.
npc.mordecai.voice_1: Come in, young mages! Purchase the latest in runes and wands!
npc.mordecai.voice_2: Perhaps I need to bake them hotter? Or was it longer?
npc.mordecai.voice_3: Offering all sorts of magic equipment!
npc.mordecai.voice_4: Now where did Alaistar put the wood for the new wands?
npc.mordecai.voice_5: Hmmm.. Maybe those crushed gems caused the strange side effect?
npc.mordecai.voice_6: Wands and rods, the true magician's weapons of choice!
npc.morgan.stdmod_1: I can forge the finest {weapons} for knights and warriors. They may wear them proudly and visible to everyone.
npc.morgan.stdmod_2: Would you rather be interested in a {knight's sword} or in a {warrior's sword}?
npc.mother_of_jack.greet_msg_1: I demand an explanation of you entering our house without any invitation.
npc.mother_of_jack.voice_2: Oh dear, I can't find anything in here!
npc.mother_of_jack.voice_3: There is still some dust on the drawer over there. What where you thinking, Jane?
npc.mr._west.greet_msg_1: Wh .. What? How did you get here? Where are all the guards? You .. you could have killed me but yet you chose to talk? What a relief! ...
npc.mr._west.greet_msg_2: So what brings you here my friend, if I might call you like that?
npc.mr._west.greet_msg_3: Murderer! But .. I give in, you won!
npc.mr._west.greet_msg_4: Dictate me your conditions but please, I beg you, spare my life. What do you want?
npc.mr._west.say_1: Indeed, I can see the benefits of a mutual agreement. I will later read the details and send a letter to your superior.
npc.mr._west.say_2: Yes, for the sake of my life I'll accept those terms. I know when I have lost. Tell your master I will comply with his orders.
npc.mr_brandon.voice_1: <grumble> Maybe I should rearrange some warm currents to get rid of this horrible fog.
npc.mr_brandon.voice_2: All these treasures I cannot reach... what a pity.
npc.mr_morris.greet_msg_1: Welcome, young adventurer. \z If you seek to help me with some things, I might have a little {quest} or {mission} for you.
npc.mr_morris.say_1: One of our ...less fortunate members lost an ancient amulet somewhere on the island, along with his life. If you could retrieve the amulet at least, there's a little reward. Would you go on that errand?
npc.mr_morris.say_10: I will reward you if you kill 20 minotaur bruisers. Would you do that?
npc.mr_morris.say_11: The first log book from the first foray group has been stolen by trolls. One wonders what for, as they can hardly read! Anyway, we need it back. Would you go looking for it?
npc.mr_morris.say_12: Ah, yes, that's it! Torn and gnawed, but, ah well, the information is still retrievable. Thank you. Here's your reward.
npc.mr_morris.say_13: Some of those salamanders have crawled into Oressa's herb garden and munched all her Dawnfire herbs. Would you get some fresh herbs?
npc.mr_morris.say_14: Ah, wonderful. Freshly cut and full of potent... whatever it is it does. Thanks. Here's your reward.
npc.mr_morris.say_15: This is an undercover thing - the key to the dormitory has disappeared. No one wants to own up who has lost it, at least not to me. Maybe they'll talk to you. I'll reward you if you find it. You in?
npc.mr_morris.say_16: Wonderful. I don't believe you will find Dormovo alive, though. He would not have stayed abroad that long without refilling his inkpot for his research notes. But at least the amulet should be retrieved.
npc.mr_morris.say_17: Good. The logbook or whatever is left of it is very valuable to my research. If you return its contents to me, I will reward you accordingly.
npc.mr_morris.say_18: Good. Killing 20 will teach them a lesson, without provoking desperate retaliation. Still, take care!
npc.mr_morris.say_2: Ah, you found the amulet! Ah. Really? Poor Dormovo. Always a bit hasty. Forgot his rope, or food, or potions - it was to be expected he would meet an early end. Oh, well. ...
npc.mr_morris.say_3: Splendid. Those Dawnfire buds are just the thing against nasty troll bites, you know? But they're quite rare.
npc.mr_morris.say_4: Look for a bush with yellow glowing flower buds. It grows only on a special, light grey-brown sand, and is usually surrounded by fireflies. Use the herb to pluck off the fresh flower buds, and return to me.
npc.mr_morris.say_5: Mountain trolls are worse than magpies, stealing everything that's not nailed down. Lately, they have raided our ship and made off with most of the Captain's rum stock!
npc.mr_morris.say_6: I will reward you if you kill 20 mountain trolls. Would you do that?
npc.mr_morris.say_7: Footmen of the muglex clan are worse than magpies, stealing everything that's not nailed down. Lately, they have raided our ship and made off with most of the Captain's rum stock!
npc.mr_morris.say_8: I will reward you if you kill 20 muglex clan footmen. Would you do that?
npc.mr_morris.say_9: Minotaur bruisers are worse than magpies, stealing everything that's not nailed down. Lately, they have raided our ship and made off with most of the Captain's rum stock!
npc.mr_morris.stdmod_1: I have a quest that needs doing. Interested?
npc.mr_morris.stdmod_10:
Hm. Well, you look like you want to take a look at the unknown yourself. \z
			I might have a job for you. Choose what you would like to do - {fetch} some things, or {kill} some monsters.
npc.mr_morris.stdmod_11:
There's three things that need to be found. You can look for an {amulet}, \z
			a {log book} or pick some rare {herbs}. Take your pick.
npc.mr_morris.stdmod_12:
Well, those monsters have grown very uppity lately. There's a choice of three - mountain {trolls}, \z
			muglex clan {goblins} or, if you are up to it or together with some friends, \z
			there's a need to weed out some risky {minotaur} bruisers. Choose your target.
npc.mr_morris.stdmod_14:
There's always someone who needs to be at the front, to take the first step into the unknown. \z
			My whole life has been full of such steps.
npc.mr_morris.stdmod_15:
Ah, that old story of how it was named? I spread it around. \z
			Can't remember really what its origins are. Interesting archeological findings here, though.
npc.mr_morris.stdmod_16:
Ah yes. Well, the magic that led us here seems to be most potent at a certain time, close before sunrise. \z
			Perhaps like a giant pulse, or beacon. Maybe the gods set it here, or a mad sorcerer, \z
			we don't know for sure yet... The portal deep down in the caves, resonating with magical energy where you came \z
			through, can maybe bring something else into this world as well. \z
			So it must be carefully guarded while we investigate the island for more clues... \z
			There are some very interesting archeological findings here on the island throughout. \z
			Seems the island has drawn some cults here, but why they are gone now, no one knows.
npc.mr_morris.stdmod_17:
It seems that throughout its history, this island was inhabited by very different species. \z
			I like to study their remains.
npc.mr_morris.stdmod_18:
Yeah. Long time I haven't been to that place. How's old Vascalir? Still hanging around in the academy? \z
			And Kraknaknork? Hah, I remember our brawl after that last card game. Fun times.
npc.mr_morris.stdmod_19:
What about him? Is he in one of his dark moods again? That's his normal mood, I mean. \z
			Just buy your armor, weaponry and ammunition there and don't worry.
npc.mr_morris.stdmod_2: Hmmm. Interesting. If only someone could help investigate this.
npc.mr_morris.stdmod_20: Tired of the academy, maybe, but not of teaching. If you need druid or sorcerer spells, go to him.
npc.mr_morris.stdmod_21:
Ah, good old Hamish. A real wizard with potions. \z
			Will supply you with very useful magic equipment for hunting.
npc.mr_morris.stdmod_3: There's a task for an intrepid adventurer open! Any volunteers?
npc.mr_morris.stdmod_4: Hey, you. Yes, you. I could use your help.
npc.mr_morris.stdmod_5:
<sigh> The Adventurers' Guild really should have equipped me with more man power. \z
