	Would you like to receive that protection for a sacrifice of |PVPBLESSCOST| gold, child?
npc.rock_with_a_soft_spot.stdmod_4: Ah, you want to replace your adventurer's stone for free?
npc.rock_with_a_soft_spot.stdmod_7: Ah, you want to replace your adventurer's stone for 30 gold?
npc.rock_with_a_soft_spot.stdmod_9: Sorry, you don't have enough money.
npc.rokyn.greet_msg_1: Yes? What may I do for you, |PLAYERNAME|? Bank business, perhaps?
npc.rokyn.voice_1: Don't forget to deposit your money here in the Global Bank before you head out for adventure.
npc.romella.farewell_msg_1: Goodbye and please bring more gold next time <chuckles>. I mean, it would be nice to see you again.
npc.romella.greet_msg_1: I welcome thee, |PLAYERNAME|! I suppose you are looking for a trade in fine weapons!
npc.romella.stdmod_1: Check out my good and sturdy weapons!
npc.romella.stdmod_2: I am Romella and I will be serving you today.
npc.romella.stdmod_3: I have many weapons to offer. If you'd like to see my offers, ask me for a {trade}.
npc.romella.stdmod_4: I sell and buy weapons. If you'd like to see my offers, ask me for a {trade}.
npc.romella.stdmod_5: Our warehouse is the main supplier of the local garrison.
npc.romella.stdmod_6: It says the amazons are looking for a certain magical weapon in this area.
npc.romella.stdmod_7: I wonder how they finance themselves. I bet they are secretly trading in some strange stuff.
npc.romella.stdmod_8: Make sure to buy some extra weapons before facing that one.
npc.romella.stdmod_9: I heard the amazons are after it.
npc.romella.voice_1: Check out my good and sturdy weapons!
npc.romir.greet_msg_1: Greetings, traveller. I'm a magical trader and trainer for sorcerer spells. How may I help you?
npc.romir.say_1: Of course, just browse through my wares. You can also look at {}.
npc.roswitha.greet_msg_1: Hello, my lad. Sit down, have a drink, why don't you?
npc.rotem_valos.voice_1: <sigh> The world has grown complicated since my youth.
npc.rottin_wood.greet_msg_1: Hunter's greeting! I assume you want something from me since you came all the way out here on your own. This is a dangerous place to be, I doubt that all my men will accept strangers like I do. You don't seem to have any problems with that, though.
npc.rowenna.greet_msg_1: Welcome to the finest weaponshop in the land, |PLAYERNAME|! Tell me if you're looking for a good {trade}.
npc.rowenna.sendtrade_msg_1: Of course, just browse through my wares.
npc.rudolph.greet_msg_1: Oh, a customer. Hello |PLAYERNAME|. If you'd like to see my wonderful self-tailored clothes, ask me for a {trade}.
npc.rudolph.sendtrade_msg_1: Of course, just browse through my wares.
npc.ruprecht.say_1: So you want to exchange {}, for {} christmas tokens?
npc.ruprecht.say_2: So you want to exchange {} to {} christmas token(s)?
npc.saideh.greet_msg_1: Hello, my name is Saideh. Once this was the entry to the crypt of our heroes. One of the graves belongs to our beloved hero Dayyan. Nowadays it is not a good idea to visit this place.
npc.sam.greet_msg_1: Welcome to my shop, adventurer |PLAYERNAME|! I {trade} with weapons and armor.
npc.sam.stdmod_1: Hello there, adventurer! Need a deal in weapons or armor? I'm your man!
npc.sam.voice_1: Hello there, adventurer! Need a deal in weapons or armor? I'm your man!
npc.sandomo.say_1: You have {} inquisition gold registered in my book.
npc.sandomo.say_2: Ah yes, you currently have {} of righteously earned inquisition gold in my book. 100 inquisition gold equals one cluster. How many clusters do you want in exchange?
npc.sandomo.say_3: You do not have enough inquisition gold for that, so far you can ask for up to {} clusters.
npc.sandomo.say_4: There you are. Now I register {} inquisition gold of yours in my book.
npc.sandra.sendtrade_msg_1: Of course, just browse through my wares. By the way, if you'd like to join our bonus system for depositing flasks and vial, you have to tell me about that {deposit}.
npc.sandra.stdmod_1: Great spirit potions as well as health and mana potions in different sizes!
npc.sandra.voice_1: Great spirit potions as well as health and mana potions in different sizes!
npc.sandra.voice_2: If you need alchemical fluids like slime and blood, get them here.
npc.sane_mage.greet_msg_1: ...er... hello? Yes...? Well, if... if you have any questions - I am not even here.
npc.sane_mage.stdmod_1: Hm? What is the meaning of all this?
npc.sane_mage.stdmod_2: What have I become? What is slime if it's not for everyone?
npc.sane_mage.stdmod_3: Slime! Everywhere! SLIME TIME! Or... not?
npc.sane_mage.stdmod_4: I AM THE... I mean... I am - what is a mage, if he is not {mad}? If he isn't... raging? I am... I am just sane. A sane mage.
npc.sane_mage.stdmod_5: I am not mad... I- YES, that's the whole problem, isn't it? What's going on, what's happening to me? I don't even know anymore.
npc.sane_mage.stdmod_6: Yes, well... I'm taking a break. It will take some time. I don't know how long I just... I want to get away from all this for some time, that's it.
npc.sane_mage.voice_1: Hm? What is the meaning of all this?
npc.sane_mage.voice_2: What have I become? What is slime if it's not for everyone?
npc.sane_mage.voice_3: Slime! Everywhere! SLIME TIME! Or... not?
npc.santiago.greet_msg_1: Hello |PLAYERNAME|, nice to see you on Rookgaard! I saw you walking by and wondered if you could help me. Could you? Please, say {yes}!
npc.santiago.greet_msg_2: Oh, |PLAYERNAME|, it's you again! It's probably impolite to disturb a busy adventurer like you, but I really need help. Please, say {yes}!
npc.santiago.greet_msg_3: Welcome back, |PLAYERNAME|! Ahh, you found my chest. Let me take a look at you. You put on that coat, {yes}?
npc.santiago.greet_msg_4: Hey, I want to give you a weapon for free! You should not refuse that, in fact you should say '{yes}'!
npc.santiago.greet_msg_5: Good job! For that, I'll grant you 100 experience points! Oh - what was that? I think you advanced a level, {right}?
npc.santiago.greet_msg_6: Welcome back! Where were we... ? Ah, right, I asked you if you saw your 'level up'! You did, {right}?
npc.santiago.voice_1: Evil little beasts... I hope someone helps me fight them.
npc.santiago.voice_3: Hey! You over there, could you help me with a little quest? Just say 'hi' or 'hello' to talk to me!
npc.santiago.voice_4: Don't be shy, can't hurt to greet me with 'hello' or 'hi'!
npc.santiago.walkaway_msg_1: Good bye traveller, and enjoy your stay on Rookgaard.
npc.sarina.greet_msg_1: Oh, please come in, |PLAYERNAME|. What can I do for you? If you need adventure equipment, ask me for a {trade}.
npc.sarina.sendtrade_msg_1: Of course, just browse through my wares. {Footballs} have to be purchased separately.
npc.sarina.voice_1: General equipment and all sorts of goods. Visit my store!
npc.scott.voice_1: Hey there, adventurer! Need a little rest in my inn? Have some food!
npc.scrutinon.greet_msg_1: |PLAYERNAME|. I have been watching your fate for quite some time. It's about time you came here. Do you seek to enter the riven island of Quirefang or travel back from where you came?
npc.scrutinon.stdmod_2: We would like to serve you some time.
npc.scrutinon.stdmod_3:
My name is Scrutinon. However, there are not many people calling my name nowadays. Not many captains even dare to land on this island. It is too close to {Quirefang}. ... \z
	Most of them do not know this island by that name. Some call it Demon Horn, others the Dragon's Tooth or the Gray Beach as none of them ever came closer than a fair distance. ... \z
	There are drifts and storms surrounding that place that are far too dangerous to navigate through even for the most versed captains. They often sail not closer than to this island here and drop off whoever dares to explore near this dreaded coast.
npc.sebastian.greet_msg_1: Greetings, daring adventurer. If you need a {passage}, let me know.
npc.sebastian.stdmod_1: Do you want to sail {0} for {1}?
npc.sebastian.stdmod_2: We would like to serve you some time.
npc.sebastian.stdmod_3: Where do you want to go? To {Liberty bay} or to {Nargor}?
npc.sebastian.stdmod_4: I am the captain of this ship.
npc.sebastian.stdmod_5: I am the captain of this ship.
npc.sebastian_nargor.greet_msg_1: Greetings, daring adventurer. If you need a {passage}, let me know.
npc.sebastian_nargor.stdmod_1: Do you want to sail {0} for {1}?
npc.sebastian_nargor.stdmod_2: We would like to serve you some time.
npc.sebastian_nargor.stdmod_3: Where do you want to go? To {Liberty bay} or to {Meriana}?
npc.sebastian_nargor.stdmod_4: I am the captain of this ship.
npc.sebastian_nargor.stdmod_5: I am the captain of this ship.
npc.ser_tybald.greet_msg_1: Welcome, child. Have you come to learn about {magic}? Then you are in the right place. I can teach you many useful {spells}.
npc.ser_tybald.say_1: Spells are very useful in combat - not only for mages, though of course we particularly rely on them for much of our damage output. ...
npc.ser_tybald.say_10: Ah, the beauty of our world! It is vast and extraordinarily diverse. Strange islands, beautiful cities and fierce monsters that roam the wildernesses. Mysteries, adventures, danger around every corner. ...
npc.ser_tybald.say_11: Once you have reached level 8, you are ready to choose a vocation and go to the Tibian Mainland.
npc.ser_tybald.say_12: Your choice of vocation will determine your life in Tibia, and the skills and fighting techniques you may use. ...
npc.ser_tybald.say_13: There are four vocation: knight, druid, paladin and sorcerer. If you want to know more about them, talk to Oressa in the temple. ...
npc.ser_tybald.say_14: I myself teach try-out spells for both the magical classes, whereas Tybald in the next room specialises in knight and paladin spells.
npc.ser_tybald.say_15: A very intelligent girl. Prefers to listen to wild animals' noises instead of humans', which is quite understandable when you think about it. ...
npc.ser_tybald.say_16: However, she's also a very apt healer and can give you advice on your choice of vocation.
npc.ser_tybald.say_2: There's a broad variety of what spells can do, as you will see as you progress further. The next spells you can buy with level 8 and on. ...
npc.ser_tybald.say_3: Some attack spells can be directed at a single target while others affect an area, having an effect either over time or instantaneous. Even other spells protect you, or can be used to create runes. ...
npc.ser_tybald.say_4: Each vocation has its own individual spells that none of the other vocations can use. You can only learn spells at a spell trainer of your vocation. ...
npc.ser_tybald.say_5: The spells here on Dawnport are for trying out only, and you will forget them once you choose your definite vocation and leave for the Mainland. ...
npc.ser_tybald.say_6: There, you can go to a spell teacher in a city to permanently learn a spell.
npc.ser_tybald.say_7: The Mainland offers many more adventures, dangers and quests than this small isle, and also has spell teachers where you can permanently learn a spell for your vocation. ...
npc.ser_tybald.say_8: Once you reach level 8 you may choose your definite vocation and leave for Main. Go to a city and seek out the spell trainer of your vocation to learn a spell. And make sure you have enough gold! ...
npc.ser_tybald.say_9: The art of spell teaching is complex and dangerous, and we will only impart our valuable knowledge of a spell to a novice if they can pay the price.
npc.ser_tybald.stdmod_1: In this category I have '{Lighthealing}', '{Healfriend}', and '{Curepoison}'.
npc.ser_tybald.stdmod_10: Roughened and toughened by life's tragedies. A good man, but somber.
npc.ser_tybald.stdmod_11: Yes, child. If you wish to learn a spell, tell me.
npc.ser_tybald.stdmod_12:
A very headstrong young man, though I appreciate his devotion to the craft of potion-making. \z
		No respect for senior authority or age at all! Except maybe for a little soft spot for Mr Morris.
npc.ser_tybald.stdmod_13:
A strange young man. He seems driven, to my mind. By what force, I do not know. \z
		I take it the world needs adventurers such as him.
npc.ser_tybald.stdmod_14:
Redeeming one's soul by becoming a clerk? Not very likely. Once a pirate, always a pirate. \z
		But he's a charming old rogue.
npc.ser_tybald.stdmod_15:
Not a half bad cook, truly. Must have been that squirrel diet, \z
		it seems to have lead him to discover a new cuisine - everything to forget the bad taste of squirrels, he said.
npc.ser_tybald.stdmod_16:
He is proficient in the martial arts. A very skilled teacher of spells for knights and paladins. \z
		If that is your vocation, you should talk to Ser Tybald.
npc.ser_tybald.stdmod_17:
Ah, yes. Travelled with Plunderpurse a lot as I recall. Captain Plunderpurse, then. \z
			Got his head full of numbers and statistics, that boy.
npc.ser_tybald.stdmod_2:
In this category I have '{Findperson}', '{Magicrope}', '{Levitate}', '{Light}', \z
		'{Greatlight}', '{Haste}', '{Poisonfield}', '{Firefield}', '{Lightmagicmissile}' and '{Energyfield}'.
npc.ser_tybald.stdmod_4:
I can teach you {healing spells}, {support spells} and {attack spells}. \z
		What kind of spell do you wish to learn?
npc.ser_tybald.stdmod_6:
Did you not listen? I am the teacher of druid and sorcerer spells for level 8 to 18. \z
		I teach young adventurers spells they can use once they have the proper vocation - druid or sorcerer.
npc.ser_tybald.stdmod_7: I have an old friend there. Haven't heard from him in a while.
npc.ser_tybald.stdmod_8:
Oh, it's not too bad here, believe me. At least I always get young and enthusiast disciples! \z
		Though I must confess I miss the vastness of the Tibian plains. <sighs>
npc.ser_tybald.stdmod_9:
A kind old hunter. He loves to see young life around, taking on the ways and lays of the land. \z
		If you have any question, ask Inigo for help.
npc.serafin.greet_msg_1: Welcome to my fruit and vegetable store, |PLAYERNAME|! Ask me for a {trade} if you'd like to see my wares.
npc.serafin.stdmod_1: There's something about these words which makes me feel awkward. Or maybe it's you who causes that feeling. You better get lost.
npc.servant_sentry.greet_msg_1: The. Slime. Has. Entered. Our. Master. Has. Left! We. Must. Help.
npc.seymour.farewell_1: Good bye, |PLAYERNAME|! And remember: No running up and down in the academy!
npc.seymour.greet_1: Hello, |PLAYERNAME|. Welcome to the Academy of Rookgaard. May I sign you up as a {student}?
npc.seymour.say_1: Have you brought {0} dead rats to me to pick up your reward?
npc.seymour.say_2: Hmmm, let me look at you. You got that intelligent sparkle in your eyes and you'd love to handle great power - that must be a future sorcerer!
npc.seymour.say_3: Hmmm, let me look at you. You have an aura of great wisdom and may have healing hands as well as a sense for the powers of nature - I think you're a natural born druid!
npc.seymour.say_4: Hmmm, let me look at you. You seem to have keen eyes and a steady hand - I bet you'd make an excellent paladin!
npc.seymour.say_5: Hmmm, let me look at you. Strong and sturdy, with a determined look in your eyes - no doubt the knight profession would be suited for you!
npc.seymour.stdmod_1: Newcomers - visit me! I'll answer your questions!
npc.seymour.stdmod_10: Thank you! Here is your reward.
npc.seymour.stdmod_100: Dixi sells and buys {armors}, {shields}, {helmets} and {legs}. You can find her shop south of the academy, just go up the stairs in {Obi}'s shop.
npc.seymour.stdmod_101: A mysterious druid who lives somewhere in the wilderness. He sells small health {potions} just like {Lily}.
npc.seymour.stdmod_102: Lee'Delle's shop is in the western part of town, on the {premium} side. She sells everything cheaper.
npc.seymour.stdmod_103: In the southern part of town, Lily sells {potions} which might come in handy once you are deep in a dungeon and need {health}.
npc.seymour.stdmod_11: HEY! You don't have so many!
npc.seymour.stdmod_12: Go and find some rats to kill!
npc.seymour.stdmod_13: Have you brought a dead rat to me to pick up your reward?
npc.seymour.stdmod_14: Thank you! Here is your reward.
npc.seymour.stdmod_15: HEY! You don't have one! Stop playing tricks on me or I'll give you some extra work!
npc.seymour.stdmod_16: Go and find some rats to kill!
npc.seymour.stdmod_17: Do you have a suitable present box for me?
npc.seymour.stdmod_18: THANK YOU! Here is a helmet that will serve you well.
npc.seymour.stdmod_19: HEY! You don't have one! Stop playing tricks on me or I'll give you some extra work!
npc.seymour.stdmod_2: Get some training in the academy!
npc.seymour.stdmod_20: Well, I would like to send our king a little present but I do not have a suitable box. If you find a nice box, please bring it to me.
npc.seymour.stdmod_21: You are pretty inexperienced. I think killing rats is a suitable challenge for you. For each fresh {dead rat} I will give you two shiny coins of gold.
npc.seymour.stdmod_22: For this remark I will wash your mouth with soap, young lady!
npc.seymour.stdmod_23: For this remark I will wash your mouth with soap, young man!
npc.seymour.stdmod_24: This is an island with {vocation} teachers. You can learn all about the different vocations there once you are level 8.
npc.seymour.stdmod_25: It's |TIME|, so you are late. Hurry!
npc.seymour.stdmod_26: My name is Seymour, but for you I am 'Sir' Seymour.
npc.seymour.stdmod_27: At least you know how to address a man of my importance.
npc.seymour.stdmod_28: I'm the master of this fine {academy}, giving {lessons} to my students.
npc.seymour.stdmod_29: Oh, which lesson did you want to attend again? Was it {Rookgaard}, {fighting}, {equipment}, {citizens}, the {academy} or the {oracle}?
npc.seymour.stdmod_3: Feeling lost? Ask me for help!
npc.seymour.stdmod_30: In a bank you can deposit your earned gold coins safely. Just go downstairs to {Paulie} and ask him to {deposit} your money.
npc.seymour.stdmod_31: Yes, depositing your money will keep it safe, so it is a good idea to store it in the bank. Of course, you can always withdraw it again.
npc.seymour.stdmod_32: Well, the {king} doesn't send troops anymore, the {academy} is dreadfully low on money, and the end of the world is pretty nigh. Apart from that I'm reasonably fine, I suppose.
npc.seymour.stdmod_33: Most of the citizens here are {merchants}. You can give me the name of any non-player character and I will tell you something about him or her.
npc.seymour.stdmod_34: Merchants buy and sell goods. Just ask them for a {trade} to see what they offer or buy from you.
npc.seymour.stdmod_35: Trolls are quite nasty monsters which you shouldn't face before level 3 or 4 depending on your {equipment}. Ask the bridge {guards} for their locations!
npc.seymour.stdmod_36: The guards {Dallheim} and {Zerbrus} protect our village from {monsters} trying to enter. They also mark useful {dungeon} locations on your map.
npc.seymour.stdmod_37: There are four vocations: {knights}, {paladins}, {sorcerers} and {druids}. You can choose your vocation once you are level 8 and have talked to the {oracle}.
npc.seymour.stdmod_38: Sorcerers are talented elemental magicians. You will learn all about them once you are level 8 and reached the Island of {Destiny}.
npc.seymour.stdmod_39: Knights are strong melee fighters. You will learn all about them once you are level 8 and reached the Island of {Destiny}.
npc.seymour.stdmod_4: Gain some knowledge in the academy!
npc.seymour.stdmod_40: Druids are nature magic users and great healers. You will learn all about them once you are level 8 and reached the Island of {Destiny}.
npc.seymour.stdmod_41: Paladins are swift distance fighters. You will learn all about them once you are level 8 and reached the Island of {Destiny}.
npc.seymour.stdmod_42: We have a {weapon} and an {armor} shop south of the academy. {Equipment} such as {ropes} are sold to the north-west. {Potions} can be bought to the south. And then there are the {farms}.
npc.seymour.stdmod_43: The world of Tibia is very large with tons of places to explore. Vast deserts, Caribbean islands, deep jungles, green meadows and jagged mountains await you!
npc.seymour.stdmod_44: The temple is the place to go when you are very low on {health} or poisoned. Ask {Cipfried} for a heal - he usually notices emergencies by himself.
npc.seymour.stdmod_45: Your current health is shown by the red bar on the right side. {Death} awaits you if it goes down to zero.
npc.seymour.stdmod_46: Dying in Tibia is painful, so try to avoid it. You will lose part of your {experience} points and also equipment. Make sure your {health} always stays up!
npc.seymour.stdmod_47: You gain experience when fighting {monsters}. You can take a look at your skill window to check your progress.
npc.seymour.stdmod_48: Good monsters to start hunting are {rats}. They live in the {sewers} below the village.
npc.seymour.stdmod_49: One entrance to the sewers is south of this {academy}. Look for a sewer grate, then use it to climb down.
npc.seymour.stdmod_5: Hello, |PLAYERNAME|. Welcome to the Academy of Rookgaard. May I sign you up as a {student}?
npc.seymour.stdmod_50: The academy is the building you are standing in. We have a {library}, a {bank} and the room of the {oracle}.
npc.seymour.stdmod_51: There are many books in the bookcases around you, unless some naughty kids stole them again. Read them for more and detailed information.
npc.seymour.stdmod_52: Don't go hunting without proper equipment. You need at least a suitable {weapon}, {armor}, {shield}, {rope} and {shovel}. A {torch} is also good as well as {legs}, a {helmet} and {shoes}.
npc.seymour.stdmod_53: Make money by killing {monsters} and picking up their {loot}. You can sell many of the things they carry.
npc.seymour.stdmod_54: Once a monster is dead, you can select 'Open' on the {corpse} to check what's inside. Sometimes they carry {money} or other items which you can sell to {merchants}.
npc.seymour.stdmod_55: You can even sell some corpses! For example, you can sell fresh dead rats to {Tom} the tanner or me. He also buys other dead creatures, just ask him for a {trade}.
npc.seymour.stdmod_56: You definitely need a rope to progress in dungeons, else you might end up stuck. Buy one from {Al Dee} or {Lee'Delle}.
npc.seymour.stdmod_57: A shovel is needed to dig some {dungeon} entrances open. 'Use' it on a loose stone pile to make a hole large enough to enter.
npc.seymour.stdmod_58: You should not descend into dungeons without proper {equipment}. Once you are all prepared, ask the bridge {guards} for suitable {monsters}.
npc.seymour.stdmod_59: A torch will provide you with light in dark {dungeons}. 'Use' it to light it. You can buy them from {Al Dee} or {Lee'Delle}.
npc.seymour.stdmod_6: Brilliant! We need fine adventurers like you! If you are ready to learn, just ask me for a lesson. You can always ask for the differently coloured words - such as this one - to continue the lesson.
npc.seymour.stdmod_60: Well, I could give you valuable {lessons} or some general {hints} about the game, or a small {quest} if you're interested.
npc.seymour.stdmod_61: The starter armor, a coat, does not protect you well. First of all, earn some money and try to get a sturdy leather armor from {Dixi}'s  or {Lee'Delle}'s shop. Simply ask for a {trade}.
npc.seymour.stdmod_62: The starter weapon, a club, won't get you far. You should earn some {money} and buy a better weapon such as a sabre from {Obi}'s or {Lee'Delle}'s shop. Simply ask for a {trade}.
npc.seymour.stdmod_63: A sturdy leather helmet is a good choice for a beginner. You can either buy it from {Dixi} and {Lee'Delle}, or, once you are strong enough, {loot} them from {trolls}.
npc.seymour.stdmod_64: I fear you have to buy your first shield by yourself. A wooden shield from {Dixi} or {Lee'Delle} is a good choice.
npc.seymour.stdmod_65: Leather boots are basic shoes which will protect you well. You can either buy them from {Dixi} and {Lee'Delle}, or, once you are strong enough, {loot} them from {trolls}.
npc.seymour.stdmod_66: Leather legs might be a good basic protection. You can buy them from {Dixi} or {Lee'Delle}. Or, once you are strong enough, hunt {trolls}. They sometimes carry them in their {loot}.
npc.seymour.stdmod_67: Many monsters, such as rabbits or deer, are excellent food providers. You can also buy food from {Willie} or {Billy}, the farmers.
npc.seymour.stdmod_68: Paying for your Tibia account will turn it into a premium account. This means access to more areas and functions of the game as well as other neat features.
npc.seymour.stdmod_69: Hail to King Tibianus! Long live our king! Not that he cares for an old veteran who is stuck on this godforsaken island...
npc.seymour.stdmod_7: Brilliant! We need fine adventurers like you! If you are ready to learn, just ask me for a lesson. You can always ask for the differently coloured words - such as this one - to continue the lesson.
npc.seymour.stdmod_70: Use a small health potion in case of emergencies to fill up around 75 health points. You can buy them at {Lily}'s shop. She also has {antidote} potions.
npc.seymour.stdmod_71: Some monsters poison you. To heal poison, use an antidote potion on yourself. Buy them at {Lily}'s store.
npc.seymour.stdmod_72: Rookgaard is the name of this {village} as well as of the whole {island}. It belongs to the kingdom of {Thais}, in our world which is called {Tibia}.
npc.seymour.stdmod_73: The island is separated into a {premium} side and a non-premium side. On both sides you will find {dungeons}, but the premium side tends to be a little less crowded with other players.
npc.seymour.stdmod_74: The city of Thais is reigned by King Tibianus. Of course, there are many other cities but you will learn about them later.
npc.seymour.stdmod_75: The most important places in this village are the {temple}, the different {shops}, the {academy} and the {bridges}.
npc.seymour.stdmod_76: There is a bridge to the north and one to the west which lead outside the village. You should only leave once you are well {equipped} and at least level 2.
npc.seymour.stdmod_77: You can leave for mainland once you are level 8. To do so talk to the {oracle}.
npc.seymour.stdmod_78: You have to fight {monsters} to train your {skills} and {level}. If you lose {health}, eat {food} to regain it or use a {potion}.
npc.seymour.stdmod_79: The more you fight with a weapon, the better will be your skill handling this weapon. Don't worry about that right now though, this will become important once you have a {vocation}.
npc.seymour.stdmod_8: Only nonsense on your mind, eh?
npc.seymour.stdmod_80: Once you gained enough experience for a level, you will advance. This means - among other things - more {health} points, a faster walking speed and more strength to carry things.
npc.seymour.stdmod_81: The farms are west of here. You can buy and sell {food} there which you need to regain {health}.
npc.seymour.stdmod_82: To attack a rat, simply click on it in your battle list. Make sure that you have proper {equipment}, though! Also, I give you 2 gold coins for each {dead rat}.
npc.seymour.stdmod_83: I personally don't have anything to trade, but you can ask {merchants} for a trade. That will open a window where you can see their offers and the things they buy from you.
npc.seymour.stdmod_84: Well, I could give you valuable {lessons} or some general {hints} about the game, or a small {quest} if you're interested.
npc.seymour.stdmod_85: Shall I try and take a guess at your destiny?
npc.seymour.stdmod_86: Well, like I told you before, I really think you got that spirit of a sorcerer in you. But of course it's completely up to you!
npc.seymour.stdmod_87: Well, like I told you before, I really think you got that spirit of a druid in you. But of course it's completely up to you!
npc.seymour.stdmod_88: Well, like I told you before, I really think you got that spirit of a paladin in you. But of course it's completely up to you!
npc.seymour.stdmod_89: Well, like I told you before, I really think you got that spirit of a knight in you. But of course it's completely up to you!
npc.seymour.stdmod_9: Good bye, |PLAYERNAME|! And remember: No running up and down in the academy!
npc.seymour.stdmod_90: Obi sells and buys {weapons}. You can find his shop south of the academy.
npc.seymour.stdmod_91: Norma has recently opened a bar here meaning she sells drinks and snacks. Nothing of importance to you, young student.
npc.seymour.stdmod_92: Oh, let's not talk about Loui.
npc.seymour.stdmod_93: A fine and helpful man. Without him, many new adventurers would be quite clueless.
npc.seymour.stdmod_94: This is Tom the tanner's mother. Other than that, I don't think she is of importance.
npc.seymour.stdmod_95: Al Dee has a general {equipment} store in the north-western part of the village. He sells useful stuff such as {ropes}.
npc.seymour.stdmod_96: A traveller from the {main} continent. I wonder what brought her here. No one comes here of his own free will.
npc.seymour.stdmod_97: Billy is {Willie}'s cousin, but he has his farm on the {premium} side of the village.

npc.seymour.stdmod_99: A humble monk living in the {temple} south of here. He can heal you if you are wounded or poisoned.

npc.tereban.crystal_done: The crystal you have found is absolutely flawless. You did a great job indeed.
npc.tereban.crystal_failure_1: Sorry, you must be wrong. It is probably not easy to find the crystal that we need in such a huge desert which may contain several tombs, but please don't give up. ...

npc.tereban.silk_failure: Sorry, you must be wrong. Search the spider caves of the continent Zao for the silk. They have to be somewhere in the east of Zao's southern part. My sources claim there you will find the silk that we need.
npc.tereban.silk_no: Then search the spider caves of the continent Zao for the silk. They have to be somewhere in the east of Zao's southern part. My sources claim there you will find the silk that we need.
npc.tereban.silk_success: Great. I better don't think about how big a spider has to be to produce such strands of silk.
npc.tereban.sinew_deliver: Do you have the required sinew?
npc.tereban.sinew_done: Your bravery earned us this excellent sinew.
npc.tereban.sinew_failure: Sorry, you must be wrong. Perhaps Heoni was out to hunt when you were looking for it. Search in the mountains of Edron. I put my trust in your abilities.
npc.tereban.sinew_no: Perhaps Heoni was out to hunt when you were looking for it. Search in the mountains of Edron. I put my trust in your abilities.
npc.tereban.sinew_success: Ah, not only did you bring some sinew to me, you also made the world a safer place by killing Heoni.
npc.tereban.wood_deliver: Could you find the wood we were talking about?
npc.tereban.wood_done: The wood you have found is just what we needed.
npc.tereban.wood_failure_1: Sorry, you must be wrong. The wood that I need should be in one of the barbarian camps. ...
npc.tereban.wood_failure_2: It seems logical to search the most northern camp first, it is closest to the place where the tree was cut. Please hurry, there is still so much to do before the birthday.
npc.tereban.wood_no: The wood that I need should be in one of the barbarian camps. It seems logical to search the most northern camp first, it is closest to the place where the tree was cut. Please hurry, there is still so much to do before the birthday.
npc.tereban.wood_success: Thank you. I feel somewhat embarrassed to put you into such a danger for some birthday present but I am sure you can handle it.
npc.terrence.greet_msg_1: Hey there, you are surely interested in helping the Rathleton city guard, right? Right - especially now since the dreaded minotaurs gain more ground every day.
npc.tesha.greet_msg_1: Yes? What may I do for you, |PLAYERNAME|? Bank business, perhaps?
npc.tesha.voice_1: Don't forget to deposit your money here in the Global Bank before you head out for adventure.
npc.testserver_assistant.greet_msg_1: Hey {}. I'm Testserver Assistant and I can give {money}, {experience} and {blessing} which will be useful for testing on {} server. You can too to back to level 8 with {reset}.
npc.thanita.farewell_msg_1: Take good care of yourself traveller. Would be a shame to lose such a courageous wanderer to those green monsters.
npc.thanita.greet_msg_1: How could you sneak up on me like this? I thought you were one of THEM! Well, since you are not, what brings you to this wilderness?
npc.thanita.walkaway_msg_1: Take good care of yourself traveller. Would be a shame to lose such a courageous wanderer to those green monsters.
npc.the_beggar_king.greet_msg_1: Hi! You look like someone on a {mission}.
npc.the_beggar_king.say_1: Some parts of the sewers were abandoned when they were beyond repair due to old age and earthquakes. ...
npc.the_beggar_king.say_2: That part was never truly well liked. There were rumours that the workers found some ancient structures there and that it was ripe with accidents during the construction. ...
npc.the_beggar_king.say_3: The city sealed those parts off, and I have no idea how anything could get in or out without the permission of the magistrate. ...
npc.the_beggar_king.say_4: But since you are investigating on their behalf, you might work out some agreement with them, if you're mad enough to enter the sewers at all. ...
npc.the_beggar_king.say_5: However, you will have to talk to one of the Glooth Brothers who are responsible for the sewer system's maintenance. You'll find them somewhere down there.
npc.the_blind_prophet.greet_msg_1: Be greeted, friend of the apes.
npc.the_blind_prophet.stdmod_1: Me put name away name long ago. Now only blind prophet of ape people are.
npc.the_blind_prophet.stdmod_10: Our people a lot to learn have. One day we might live in peace with you hairless apes, who knows.
npc.the_blind_prophet.stdmod_11: Me not know. Me seldom have visions of not banana related objects.
npc.the_blind_prophet.stdmod_2: Me is who in dreams speak to holy banana. Me divine the will of banana.
npc.the_blind_prophet.stdmod_4: Me is who in dreams speak to holy banana. Me divine the will of banana.
npc.the_blind_prophet.stdmod_5: Me guard the forbidden land behind the great palisade. If any want to enter, he must ask me for transport.
npc.the_blind_prophet.stdmod_6: Me guard the forbidden land behind the great palisade. If any want to enter, he must ask me for transport.
npc.the_blind_prophet.stdmod_7: Good ape he is. Has to work hard to make other apes listen but you helped a lot.
npc.the_blind_prophet.stdmod_8: Our holy ancestor he is. Big as mountain. Lizards say they built palisade to keep him but we not believe ... We think Bong palisade built to have peace from pesky lizards. We respect peace of Bong, keep people away from forbidden land.
npc.the_blind_prophet.stdmod_9: The lizards evil and vengeful are. Ape people on guard must be.
npc.the_dream_master.farewell_msg_1: Good bye. May the gods watch over your path.
npc.the_empress.greet_msg_2: You succeeded! Issavi is safe again. Take this as a sign of our grace and gratitude, brave mortal being. It is a precious relic from earlier times. More precisely, it is one of four parts of the relic called the Regalia of Suon. ...
npc.the_empress.greet_msg_3: Should you ever find the other three parts, a talented jeweler might be able to combine them and recreate the regalia for you.
npc.the_empress.greet_msg_4: I see. There is enough and adequate evidence that the Ambassador of Rathleton is indeed an arch traitor. So, Eshaya was right. Well done, mortal being. You have proven your loyalty and bravery, therefore allow me to ask you one more favour. ...
npc.the_empress.greet_msg_5: The Cult of Fafnar is a serious problem for Issavi. The cultists are roaming the sewers and catacombs beneath the city now and again but this time they are really up to something. ...
npc.the_empress.greet_msg_6: As a member of the Sapphire Blade found out, they are planning to cause a major earthquake, that could severely damage or even destroy Issavi. You may wonder how. ...
npc.the_empress.greet_msg_7: Well, they want to activate five Fafnar statues which they have already enchanted. They are hidden in the catacombs underneath the city. Please go down and search for the statues. ...
npc.the_empress.greet_msg_8: Then use this sceptre to bless them in the name of Suon and Bastesh. This will destroy the disastrous enchantment and Issavi will be safe again.
npc.the_first_dragon.greet_msg_1: Hello, my sparring buddy. We should have another fight sometimes. I think you may have earned a little reward.
npc.the_first_dragon.stdmod_1: Times have changed <sigh>. In the past dragons were feared and respected. Only the {demons} rivalled our notoriety.
npc.the_first_dragon.stdmod_2: Those upstarts! I wonder why would anyone care about them. They lack our style. For them it is all about brute force and showing-off.
npc.the_first_dragon.stdmod_3: Breathing fire is an art! Instead of setting everything on fire, you exhale a cone of fire to give a worthy opponent a chance to avoid it.
npc.the_first_dragon.stdmod_4: Your lives are so short and meaningless and yet you are here! And as a race you even have your own history and remember things with the help of {books}, which amazes me.
npc.the_first_dragon.stdmod_5: I like the idea of books so much that I acquired a human servant to record my memoirs. You find a copy somewhere in my lair.
npc.the_first_dragon.stdmod_6: Lava is only fun as long as it doesn't harden - then it turns into an annoyance.
npc.the_librarian.greet_msg_1: Greetings, dear guest. If you are interested in paperware such as books or scrolls, ask me for a trade.
npc.the_librarian.voice_1: I really have to find this scroll. Where did I put it?
npc.the_librarian.voice_2: Too much dust here. I should tidy up on occasion.
npc.the_librarian.voice_3: Someone opened the Grimoire of Flames without permission. Egregious!
npc.the_lootmonger.greet_msg_1: Ah, a customer! Be greeted, |PLAYERNAME|! I buy all kinds of loot, would you like a {trade}? I can also show you my {shop options}.
npc.the_lootmonger.say_2: Of course, just browse through my wares. You can also look at {}.
npc.the_oracle.farewell_msg_1: COME BACK WHEN YOU ARE PREPARED TO FACE YOUR DESTINY!
npc.the_oracle.greet_msg_1: {}, ARE YOU PREPARED TO FACE YOUR DESTINY?
npc.the_oracle.say_1: {}, I CAN'T LET YOU LEAVE - YOU ARE TOO STRONG ALREADY! \z YOU CAN ONLY LEAVE WITH LEVEL 9 OR LOWER.
npc.the_oracle.say_2: IN {}! AND WHAT PROFESSION HAVE YOU CHOSEN: \z {KNIGHT}, {PALADIN}, {SORCERER}, OR {DRUID}?
npc.the_oracle.say_3: IN WHICH TOWN DO YOU WANT TO LIVE: {CARLIN}, {THAIS}, OR {VENORE}?
npc.the_oracle.say_8: CHILD! COME BACK WHEN YOU HAVE GROWN UP!
npc.the_oracle.vocation_druid: A DRUID! ARE YOU SURE? THIS DECISION IS IRREVERSIBLE!
npc.the_oracle.vocation_knight: A KNIGHT! ARE YOU SURE? THIS DECISION IS IRREVERSIBLE!
npc.the_oracle.vocation_paladin: A PALADIN! ARE YOU SURE? THIS DECISION IS IRREVERSIBLE!
npc.the_oracle.vocation_sorcerer: A SORCERER! ARE YOU SURE? THIS DECISION IS IRREVERSIBLE!
npc.the_oracle.walkaway_msg_1: COME BACK WHEN YOU ARE PREPARED TO FACE YOUR DESTINY!
npc.the_orc_king.greet_msg_1: Harrrrk! You think you are strong now? You shall never escape my wrath! I am immortal!
npc.the_orc_king.say_1: Arrrrgh! A dirty paleskin! To me my children! Kill them my guards!
npc.the_orc_king.stdmod_1: I am Charkahn the Slayer! The immortal father of the {orcs} and master of this {hive}.
npc.the_orc_king.stdmod_10: Pah! Don't mock me, mortal! This shape is a curse which the evil {djinn} bestowed upon me!
npc.the_orc_king.stdmod_11: This cursed djinn king! I set him free from an enchanted {lamp}, and he {cheated} me!
npc.the_orc_king.stdmod_12: Because I freed him he granted me three wishes. He was true to his word in the first two {wishes}.
npc.the_orc_king.stdmod_13: He built this fortress over Uldrek's grave within a single night. Also, he granted me my second wish and gave me immortality. Test it and try to kill me if you want. Har Har!
npc.the_orc_king.stdmod_14: I wished to father more healthy and fertile children as any orc has ever done. But the djinn cheated me and made me a slime! Then he laughed at me and left for his abandoned fortress in the {Deathwish} Mountains.
npc.the_orc_king.stdmod_15: His ancient fortress on Darama was deserted as the evil Djinn fled this world after his imprisonment. Now the time has come for the evil Djinns to return to their master although this will certainly awaken the {good Djinn} too.
npc.the_orc_king.stdmod_16: I will not share anything more about that topic with you {paleskins}.
npc.the_orc_king.stdmod_17: You are as ugly as maggots, although not quite as as tasty.
npc.the_orc_king.stdmod_18: This cursed djinn king! I set him free from an enchanted lamp, and he cheated me!
npc.the_orc_king.stdmod_2: The orcs are the bearers of Blogs rage. This makes us the ultimate fighters and the most powerful of all races.
npc.the_orc_king.stdmod_3: The orcs are the bearers of Blogs rage. This makes us the ultimate fighters and the most powerful of all races.
npc.the_orc_king.stdmod_4: I can sense the presence and the feelings of my underlings and {minions}. I embrace the rage of the horde.
npc.the_orc_king.stdmod_5: The orcish horde of this hive is under my control. I sense their emotions and their needs and provide them with the leadership they need to focus their hate and rage
npc.the_orc_king.stdmod_6: Hate and rage are the true blessings of Blog, since they are powerful weapons. They give the hive strength. I provide them with direction and focus.
npc.the_orc_king.stdmod_7: The Raging One blessed us with his burning hate. We are truly his children and therefore {divine}.
npc.the_orc_king.stdmod_8: To conquer, to destroy and to dominate. Orcs are born to rule the {world}.
npc.the_orc_king.stdmod_9: One day I will rule the world, even when turned into a {slime}.
npc.the_queen_of_the_banshees.greet_msg_: Be greeted, dear visitor. Come and {stay} ... a while.
npc.the_queen_of_the_banshees.stdmod_2: It's my curse to be the eternal {guardian} of this ancient {place}.
npc.the_queen_of_the_banshees.stdmod_3: I'm the {guardian} of the {SEVENTH} and final seal. The seal to open the last door before ... but perhaps it's better to see it with your own eyes.
npc.the_queen_of_the_banshees.stdmod_4: It served as a temple, a source of power and ... as a sender for an ancient {race} which lived a long time ago and has long been forgotten.
npc.the_queen_of_the_banshees.stdmod_5: The race that built this edifice came to this place from the stars. They ran from an enemy even more horrible than themselves. But they carried the {seed} of their own destruction in them.
npc.the_queen_of_the_banshees.stdmod_6: This ancient race was annihilated by its own doings, that's all I know. Aeons have passed since then, but the sheer presence of this {complex} is still defiling and desecrating this area.
npc.the_queen_of_the_banshees.stdmod_7: Its constructors were too strange for you or even me to understand. We don't know what this ... thing they built was supposed to be good for. I feel a constant twisting and binding of souls, though, that is probably only a side-effect.
npc.the_queen_of_the_banshees.stdmod_8: The place you know as the Ghostlands had a different name once ... and many names after. Too many to remember them all.
npc.the_queen_of_the_banshees.walkaway_m: Yes, flee from death. But know it shall be always one step behind you.
npc.thorgrin.greet_msg_1: Welcome, |PLAYERNAME|! May earth protect you on the rocky grounds. If you need a {passage} back, I can help you.
npc.thorwulf.stdmod_1:
In this category I have '{Bruise Bane}', '{Cure Bleeding}', '{Wound Cleansing}', \z
		'{Cure Poison}', '{Intense Wound Cleansing}', '{Recovery}' and '{Intense Recovery}'.
npc.thorwulf.stdmod_2:
In this category I have '{Light}', '{Find Person}', '{Magic Rope}', '{Levitate}', '{Haste}', \z
		'{Charge}' and '{Great Light}'.
npc.thorwulf.stdmod_3:
I can teach you {healing spells}, {attack spells} and {support spells}. \z
		What kind of spell do you wish to learn? \z
		You can also tell me for which level you would like to learn a spell, if you prefer that.
npc.thorwulf.stdmod_4: In this category I have '{Whirlwind Throw}', '{Groundshaker}', '{Berserk}' and '{Fierce Berserk}' as well as ... '{Brutal Strike}', '{Front Sweep}', '{Inflict Wound}' and '{Annihilation}'.
npc.tibra.farewell_msg_1: Good bye, |PLAYERNAME|. May the gods be with you to guard and guide you, my child!
npc.tibra.greet_msg_1: Welcome in the name of the gods, pilgrim |PLAYERNAME|!
npc.tibra.stdmod_1: I think you have forgotten to bring your stake, my child.
npc.tibra.stdmod_10: I am a priest of the great pantheon.
npc.tibra.stdmod_11: The teachings of Crunor tell us to honor life and not to harm it.
npc.tibra.stdmod_12: It is my mission to bring the teachings of the gods to everyone.
npc.tibra.stdmod_13: It is my mission to bring the teachings of the gods to everyone.
npc.tibra.stdmod_14: My name is Tibra. Your soul tells me that you are |PLAYERNAME|.
npc.tibra.stdmod_15: Queen Eloise is wise to listen to the proposals of the druidic followers of Crunor.
npc.tibra.stdmod_16: The grace of the gods must be earned, it cannot be bought!
npc.tibra.stdmod_17: The world of Tibia is the creation of the gods.
npc.tibra.stdmod_19: There's something strange in its neighbourhood. But whom we gonna call for help if not the gods?
npc.tibra.stdmod_2: Yes, I was informed what to do. Are you prepared to receive my line of the prayer?
npc.tibra.stdmod_20: Remind: Not everything you call monster is evil to the core!
npc.tibra.stdmod_21: The mythical blade was hidden in ancient times. Its said that powerful wards protect it.
npc.tibra.stdmod_22: The fallen one should be mourned, not feared.
npc.tibra.stdmod_23: Only a man can fall as low as he did. His soul rotted away already.
npc.tibra.stdmod_24: The gods of good guard us and guide us, the gods of evil want to destroy us and steal our souls!
npc.tibra.stdmod_25: The gods we call the good ones are Fardos, Uman, the Elements, Suon, Crunor, Nornur, Bastesh, Kirok, Toth, and Banor.
npc.tibra.stdmod_26: Fardos is the creator. The great obsever. He is our caretaker.
npc.tibra.stdmod_27: Uman is the positive aspect of magic. He brings us the secrets of the arcane arts.
npc.tibra.stdmod_28: Air is one of the primal elemental forces, sometimes worshipped by tribal shamans.
npc.tibra.stdmod_29: Fire is one of the primal elemental forces, sometimes worshipped by tribal shamans.
npc.tibra.stdmod_3: So receive my prayer: 'Hope may fill your heart - doubt shall be banned'. Now, bring your stake to Maealil in the elven settlement for the next line of the prayer. I will inform him what to do.
npc.tibra.stdmod_30: Sula is the essence of the elemental power of water.
npc.tibra.stdmod_31: Suon is the lifebringing sun. He observes the creation with love.
npc.tibra.stdmod_32: Crunor, the great tree, is the father of all plantlife. He is a prominent god for many druids.
npc.tibra.stdmod_33: Nornur is the mysterious god of fate. Who knows if he is its creator or just a chronist?
npc.tibra.stdmod_34: Bastesh, the deep one, is the goddess of the sea and its creatures.
npc.tibra.stdmod_35: Kirok, the mad one, is the god of scientists and jesters.
npc.tibra.stdmod_36: Toth, Lord of Death, is the keeper of the souls, the guardian of the afterlife.
npc.tibra.stdmod_37: Banor, the heavenly warrior, is the patron of all fighters against evil. He is the gift of the gods to inspire humanity.
npc.tibra.stdmod_38: The gods we call the evil ones are Zathroth, Fafnar, Brog, Urgith, and the Archdemons!
npc.tibra.stdmod_39: Zathroth is the destructive aspect of magic. He is the deciver and the thief of souls.
npc.tibra.stdmod_40: Fafnar is the scorching sun. She observes the creation with hate and jealousy.
npc.tibra.stdmod_41: Brog, the raging one, is the great destroyer. The berserk of darkness.
npc.tibra.stdmod_42: The bonemaster Urgith is the lord of the undead and keeper of the damned souls.
npc.tibra.stdmod_43: The demons are followers of Zathroth. The cruelest are known as the ruthless seven.
npc.tibra.stdmod_44: I don't want to talk about that subject!
npc.tibra.stdmod_5: You should visit Maealil in the elven settlement now, my child.
npc.tibra.stdmod_6: You already received my line of the prayer, dear child.
npc.tibra.stdmod_7: A blessed stake? That is a strange request, my child. Maybe Quentin knows more, he is one of the oldest monks after all.
npc.tibra.stdmod_8: You are hurt, my child. I will heal your wounds.
npc.tibra.stdmod_9: You aren't looking that bad. Sorry, I can't help you. But if you are looking for additional protection you should go on the {pilgrimage} of ashes or get the protection of the {twist of fate} here.
npc.tigo.greet_msg_1: There, there initiate. You will now become one of us, as so many before you. One of the {Barkless}. Walk with us and you will walk tall my friend.
npc.tim_the_guard.stdmod_1: It's my duty to protect the city.
npc.timothy.greet_msg_1: Oh, hello! It's a pleasure to see a visitor from the continent.
npc.timur.greet_msg_1: Welcome to my little shop, adventurer! First read my blackboards.
npc.timur.voice_2: Selling ammunition and buying bows and crossbows!
npc.todd.farewell_msg_1: Yes, goodbye |PLAYERNAME|, just leave me alone.
npc.todd.greet_msg_1: Uhm oh hello |PLAYERNAME|... not so loud please... my {head}... What ... do you {want}?
npc.todd.stdmod_1: I am... a traveler. Just leave me alone if you have nothing {interesting} to talk about.
npc.todd.stdmod_10: I don't know anything about money, missing or not.
npc.todd.stdmod_11: He often comes here. But his constant confusion gives me a worse headache than Frodo's beer. I rather avoid him.
npc.todd.stdmod_12: Uhm, never heard about him... and you can't prove otherwise.
npc.todd.stdmod_13: Thats a common name, perhaps I met a William, not sure about that.
npc.todd.stdmod_2: I am... a traveler. Just leave me alone if you have nothing {interesting} to talk about.
npc.todd.stdmod_3: Uhhh ohhhh one of the beers yesterday must have been bad.
npc.todd.stdmod_4: My Name? I am To... ahm... hum... My name is {Hugo}.
npc.todd.stdmod_5: Yes, that's my name of course.
npc.todd.stdmod_6: Uh .. I... I met a Todd on the road. He told me he was traveling to Venore, look there for your Todd.
npc.todd.stdmod_8: I never was there. Now leave me alone.
npc.todd.stdmod_9: Resistance is futile... uhm... I wonder where I picked that saying up. Oh my head...
npc.tom.greet_msg_1: Hey there, |PLAYERNAME|. Did Vascalir send you to me for a {mission}?
npc.tom.greet_msg_2: Now, now - we can't work with that. Go back to that wolf den and fulfil your mission! Unless there is anything else I can help you with.
npc.tom.greet_msg_3: Hey there, |PLAYERNAME|. You look... exhausted. Did you run a lot? And more importantly, were you able to find some war wolf leather?
npc.tom.stdmod_1: Buying fresh corpses of rats, rabbits and wolves.
npc.tom.stdmod_10: {Dixi} and {Lee'Delle} sell my leather clothes in their shops.
npc.tom.stdmod_11: That's my job. It can be dirty at times but it provides enough income for my living.
npc.tom.stdmod_12: Do I look like a tourist information centre? Go ask someone else.
npc.tom.stdmod_13: Help? I will give you a few gold coins if you have some fresh dead {animals} for me. Note the word {fresh}.
npc.tom.stdmod_14: Fresh means: shortly after their death.
npc.tom.stdmod_16: Good monsters to start with are rats. They live in the {sewers} under the village of {Rookgaard}.
npc.tom.stdmod_17: Dungeons can be dangerous without proper {equipment}.
npc.tom.stdmod_18: You need at least a {backpack}, a {rope}, a {shovel}, a {weapon}, an {armor} and a {shield}.
npc.tom.stdmod_19: Sorry, I haven't been outside for a while, so I don't know.
npc.tom.stdmod_2: Oh yeah, I'm also interested in wolf paws and bear paws.
npc.tom.stdmod_20: Troll leather stinks. Can't use it.
npc.tom.stdmod_21: I don't buy orcs. Their skin is too scratchy.
npc.tom.stdmod_23: Nope, sorry, don't sell that. Go see {Al Dee} or {Lee'Delle}.
npc.tom.stdmod_24: Nope, sorry, don't sell that. Ask {Dixi} or {Lee'Delle}.
npc.tom.stdmod_25: Nope, sorry, don't sell that. Ask {Obi} or {Lee'Delle}.
npc.tom.stdmod_26: I'm buying fresh {corpses} of rats, rabbits and wolves. I don't buy half-decayed ones. If you have any for sale, {trade} with me.
npc.tom.stdmod_29: He's a better cook than his cousin {Willie}, actually.
npc.tom.stdmod_30: I kinda like him. At least he says what he thinks.
npc.tom.stdmod_32: He sticks his nose too much in books.
npc.tom.stdmod_33: My mother?? Did you meet my mother??
npc.tom.stdmod_34: I don't have a problem with him.
npc.tom.stdmod_36: It's in the academy, just above Seymour. Go there once you are level 8 to leave this place.
npc.tom.stdmod_4: Alright. Can I help you with something else then?
npc.tom.stdmod_45:
I can help you get boots, but I can't give them to you for free. Besides, you'd want good boots, not that stuff made from rat leather. The best leather you'd find on Rook is wolf leather. ... \z
	War wolf leather, to be precise. Problem is - war wolves are rare, and you can't hope to fight and defeat them. So your only chance is to find an already dead war wolf, take his skin, and escape really fast. ... \z
	What an interesting coincidence that I've seen a poacher sneak into the wolf den just a few hours ago. I'm not exactly a fan of poachers - they kill too many of our wolves. ... \z
	Sooo... what I'm suggesting is: follow his traces into the wolf den, and if you get lucky, you'll be able to take one of his illegally obtained war wolf skins. ... \z
	That's why I wouldn't call it 'stealing', what an ugly word... anyway, if you bring the skin back to me, I'll make some great war wolf boots from them. What do you say?
npc.tom.stdmod_46:
Hmm... unfortunately the skin is damaged too badly. Whoever skinned this wolf wasn't very skilled at it. Hmm. ... \z
	Ah, no need to fret. Tell you what kid, I'm gonna give you some normal leather boots instead. They should keep your feet warm as well. Here you go. ... \z
	By the way... that running you did to get out of the cave will be your normal walking speed when you are several levels higher. With each level you gain, you'll also become a little faster. ... \z
	There are also other items, spells and equipment that increase your speed. ... \z
	You can also tame creatures to ride on that will also increase your speed. So don't worry if you're out of breath now - you won't always be that slow. Now off with you and back to Vascalir, I have work to do.
npc.tom.stdmod_5: That's what I thought. I marked the wolf den on your map. To go there, exit the village to the north and walk north-east. Good luck finding that poacher and figuring out a plan to take those skins! Hehe.
npc.tom.stdmod_6: Well, then walk Rookgaard barefoot. It's up to you!
npc.tom.stdmod_7: Are you sure? I think I see some war wolf leather on you. You should reply with {yes}.
npc.tom.stdmod_8: My name is Tom the tanner.
npc.tom.stdmod_9: I'm the local {tanner}. I buy fresh animal {corpses}, tan them, and convert them into fine leather clothes which I then sell to {merchants}.
npc.tom.voice_1: Buying fresh corpses of rats, rabbits and wolves.
npc.tom.voice_2: Oh yeah, I'm also interested in wolf paws and bear paws.
npc.tomruk_the_ruddy.greet_msg_1: Hello hello! Always good to see fresh blood! What brings you here?
npc.tomruk_the_ruddy.voice_1: Interesting reaction. Bloodcurdling. Must inspect further.
npc.tomruk_the_ruddy.voice_3: Hmm... the conductors are too dry to transmit energy.
npc.tonar.stdmod_1: What a beautiful day for a little boat trip.
npc.tonar.voice_1: What a beautiful day for a little boat trip.
npc.tonar_oskayaat.stdmod_1: I don't feel safe here ... I hope we can return to Ankrahmun soon.
npc.tonar_oskayaat.voice_1: I don't feel safe here ... I hope we can return to Ankrahmun soon.
npc.topsy.greet_msg_1: Hello, dear |PLAYERNAME|. How can I help you? \z If you need magical equipment such as {runes} or {wands}, just ask me for a {trade}.
npc.topsy.say_1: So you ask me for a {{}} to begin your adventure?
npc.topsy.say_2: What? I have already gave you one {{}}!
npc.topsy.say_3: Of course, just browse through my wares. You can also look at {}.
npc.topsy.voice_1: Runes, wands, rods, health and mana potions! Have a look!
npc.torkada.greet_msg_1: Greetings! This isn't the {time} to chitchat though.
npc.towncryer.voice_1: Hear me! Hear me! The mage Wyrdin in the Edron academy is looking for brave adventurers to undertake a task!
npc.towncryer.voice_2: Hear me! Hear me! The postmaster's guild has open spots for aspiring postmen! Contact Kevin Postner at the post office in the plains south of Kazordoon!
npc.towncryer.voice_3: Hear me! Hear me! The inquisition is looking for daring people to fight evil! Apply at the inquisition headquarters next to the Thaian jail!
npc.towncryer.voice_4: In Ankrahmun's desert, a storm has revealed the entry to a nightmare that can't be sealed. Horrible creatures there spell instant death to all young adventurers who dare take a breath!
npc.towncryer.voice_5: Near Darashia's coast, a storm has revealed the entry to a nightmare that can't be sealed. Horrible creatures there spell instant death to all young adventurers who dare take a breath!
npc.towncryer.voice_6: Near Drefia's mountains, a storm has revealed the entry to a nightmare that can't be sealed. Horrible creatures there spell instant death to all young adventurers who dare take a breath!
npc.towncryer.voice_7: Hear ye! Hear ye! What a lucky and beautiful day! Visit Carlin, Ankrahmun, or Liberty Bay. Yasir, the oriental trader might be there. Gather your creature products, for this chance is rare.
npc.towncryer.voice_8: Hear ye! Hear ye! A fiery gate has opened, threatening a city! Guard the people frightened, their death would be a pity!
npc.trisha.bones_deliver: How are you faring with your mission? Have you collected all 100 hardened bones?
npc.trisha.bones_success: I'm surprised. That's pretty good for a man. Now, bring us the 100 turtle shells.
npc.trisha.bones_wrong: Well, I'll give you a little hint. They can sometimes be extracted from creatures that consist only of - you guessed it, bones. You need an obsidian knife though.
npc.trisha.claw_deliver: Have you actually managed to obtain the dragon claw I asked for?
npc.trisha.claw_success: You did it! I have seldom seen a man as courageous as you. I really have to say that you deserve to wear a spike. Go ask Cornelia to adorn your armour.
npc.trisha.claw_wrong: You cannot get this special red claw from any common dragon in Tibia. It requires a special one, a lord among the lords.
npc.trisha.farewell_msg_1: Don't hurt yourself with that weapon, little one.
npc.trisha.say_1: Okay, who knows, maybe you have a chance. A really small one though. Listen up: ...
npc.trisha.say_2: First, you have to prove your guts by bringing me 100 hardened bones. ...
npc.trisha.say_3: Next, if you actually managed to collect that many, please complete a small task for our guild and bring us 100 turtle shells. ...
npc.trisha.say_4: It is said that excellent shields can be created from these. ...
npc.trisha.say_5: Alright, um, afterwards show me that you have fighting spirit. Any true hero needs plenty of that. ...
npc.trisha.say_6: The last task is the hardest. You will need to bring me a claw from a mighty dragon king. ...
npc.trisha.say_7: Did you understand everything I told you and are willing to handle this task?
npc.trisha.spirit_deliver: So, can you show me your fighting spirit?
npc.trisha.spirit_success: Correct - pretty smart for a man. But the hardest task is yet to come: the claw from a lord among the dragon lords.
npc.trisha.spirit_wrong: You should have enough fighting spirit if you are a true hero. Sorry, but you have to figure this one out by yourself. Unless someone grants you a wish.
npc.trisha.stdmod_1: In this category I have '{Wound Cleansing}'' and '{Cure Poison}''.
npc.trisha.stdmod_2: In this category I have '{Light}', '{Find Person}' and '{Great Light}'.
npc.trisha.stdmod_3: I can teach you {healing spells} and {support spells}. What kind of spell do you wish to learn? You can also tell me for which level you would like to learn a spell, if you prefer that.
npc.trisha.turtle_deliver: Did you get us 100 turtle shells so we can make new shields?
npc.trisha.turtle_success: Well done - for a man. These shells are enough to build many strong new shields. Thank you! Now - show me fighting spirit.
npc.trisha.turtle_wrong: Turtles can be found on some idyllic islands which have recently been discovered.

npc.turvy.voice_1: Courageous adventurers, come buy your weapons and armors here!
npc.tyrias.greet_msg_1: Welcome, young |PLAYERNAME|! If you are heavily wounded or poisoned, I can {heal} you for free.
npc.tyrias.keyword_1: So receive the protection of the twist of fate, pilgrim.
npc.tyrias.stdmod_1: So receive the protection of the twist of fate, pilgrim.
npc.tyrias.stdmod_11: You don't even have that strange stake with you.
npc.tyrias.stdmod_12: Brewster sent me a strange message about some strange hocus-pocus. I think it's nonsense, but since you have come that far, I'll play along. Are you ready?
npc.tyrias.stdmod_13: So receive my prayer: 'Your mind shall be a vessel for joy, light and wisdom' - uh, wow, something happened. Well, I guess that's it, but next time if you need some mumbo jumbo rather go to Chondur.
npc.tyrias.stdmod_14: You don't even have that strange stake with you.
npc.tyrias.stdmod_15: No problem, I have other things to do.
npc.tyrias.stdmod_16: A blessed stake? I don't believe in things like that. If anyone does, it's probably old Quentin.
npc.tyrias.stdmod_17: I won't do that rubbish again. Go pester Chondur with your hocus-pocus.
npc.tyrias.stdmod_18: You are hurt, my child. I will heal your wounds.
npc.tyrias.stdmod_19: You aren't looking that bad. Sorry, I can't help you. But if you are looking for additional protection you should go on the {pilgrimage} of ashes or get the protection of the {twist of fate} here.
npc.tyrias.stdmod_2: Fine. You are free to decline my offer.
npc.tyrias.stdmod_20: Whenever you receive a lethal wound, your vital force is damaged and there is a chance that you lose some of your equipment. With every single of the five {blessings} you have, this damage and chance of loss will be reduced.
npc.tyrias.stdmod_21: There are five blessings available in five sacred places: the {spiritual} shielding, the spark of the {phoenix}, the {embrace} of Tibia, the fire of the {suns} and the wisdom of {solitude}. Additionally, you can receive the {twist of fate} here.
npc.tyrias.stdmod_22: I see you received the spiritual shielding in the whiteflower temple south of Thais.
npc.tyrias.stdmod_23: I can sense that the druids north of Carlin have provided you with the Embrace of Tibia.
npc.tyrias.stdmod_24: I can see you received the blessing of the two suns in the suntower near Ab'Dendriel.
npc.tyrias.stdmod_25: I can sense that the spark of the phoenix already was given to you by the dwarven priests of earth and fire in Kazordoon.
npc.tyrias.stdmod_26: I can sense you already talked to the hermit Eremo on the isle of Cormaya and received this blessing.
npc.tyrias.stdmod_27: You can ask for the blessing of spiritual shielding in the whiteflower temple south of Thais.
npc.tyrias.stdmod_28: The druids north of Carlin will provide you with the embrace of Tibia.
npc.tyrias.stdmod_29: You can ask for the blessing of the two suns in the suntower near Ab'Dendriel.
npc.tyrias.stdmod_30: The spark of the phoenix is given by the dwarven priests of earth and fire in Kazordoon.
npc.tyrias.stdmod_32:
This is a special blessing I can bestow upon you once you have obtained at least one of the other blessings and which functions a bit differently. ... \z
	It only works when you're killed by other adventurers, which means that at least half of the damage leading to your death was caused by others, not by monsters or the environment. ... \z
	The {twist of fate} will not reduce the death penalty like the other blessings, but instead prevent you from losing your other blessings as well as the amulet of loss, should you wear one. It costs the same as the other blessings. ... \z
	Would you like to receive that protection for a sacrifice of |PVPBLESSCOST| gold, child?
npc.tyrias.stdmod_4: Ah, you want to replace your adventurer's stone for free?
npc.tyrias.stdmod_7: Ah, you want to replace your adventurer's stone for 30 gold?
npc.tyrias.stdmod_9: Sorry, you don't have enough money.
npc.tyrias.walkaway_msg_1: Remember: If you are heavily wounded or poisoned, I can heal you for free.

npc.urks_the_mute.greet_msg_1: Welcome, |PLAYERNAME|! Lovely steamboat, ain't it? I can even offer you a {passage} if you like.
npc.urks_the_mute.stdmod_1: <the dwarf quizzically raises his brow - the only destinations he accepts seems to be {Cormaya} or {Kazordoon}>
npc.urks_the_mute.stdmod_2:
Well, you might be just the hero they need there. To tell you the truth, some our most reliable ore mines have started to run low. ... \z
	This is why we developed new steamship technologies to be able to further explore and cartograph the great subterraneous rivers. Our brothers have established a base on a continent far, far away. ... \z
	We call that the far, far away base. But since it will hopefully become a flourishing mine one day, most of us started to call it {Farmine}. The dwarfs there could really use some help right now.

npc.uzon.stdmod_10: I would never transport this one.
npc.uzon.stdmod_11: So you heard about haunted Drefia? Many adventures travel there to test their skills against the undead: vampires, mummies, and ghosts.
npc.uzon.stdmod_12: Some people claim it is hidden somewhere under the endless sands of the devourer desert in Darama.
npc.uzon.stdmod_13: Thais is noisy and overcrowded. That's why I like Darashia more.
npc.uzon.stdmod_14: I have seen almost every place on the continent.
npc.uzon.stdmod_15: I could retell the tales of my travels for hours. Sadly another flight is scheduled soon.
npc.uzon.stdmod_16: Just another Thais but with women to lead them.
npc.uzon.stdmod_17: You can buy flying carpets only in Darashia.
npc.uzon.stdmod_18: I transport travellers to the continent of Darama for a small fee. So many want to see the wonders of the desert and learn the secrets of Darama.
npc.uzon.stdmod_19: I heard too many news to recall them all.
npc.uzon.stdmod_2: Never heard about a place like this.
npc.uzon.stdmod_20: I heard too many news to recall them all.
